metadata.name: battle-tested-patterns
metadata.description: Battle-tested programming patterns from production codebases — React, Linux, Go, Chromium, and more. Precise source links, multi-language examples, runnable exercises.

summary.zh: 该项目从 React、Linux、Go、Chromium 等生产级代码库中提取了 46 个经过实战检验的编程模式，涵盖数据结构、并发和系统设计。每个模式都提供精确的源码链接、多语言示例和可运行的练习，并配有支持时间旅行回放的可视化交互界面，帮助开发者深入理解并应用这些核心模式。
summary.en: This project extracts 46 battle-tested programming patterns from production codebases including React, Linux, Go, and Chromium, covering data structures, concurrency, and system design. Each pattern provides precise source links, multi-language examples, and runnable exercises, with interactive visualizations supporting time-travel playback to help developers deeply understand and apply these core patterns.

metadata.name: Operit
metadata.description: The most powerful AI agent and AI chat software on Android/Operit是一款Android上能力最为强大、发展最久的AI Agent

summary.zh: Operit AI是Android上功能最强大的AI Agent与聊天应用，支持本地模型（MNN/llama.cpp）、内置Ubuntu 24环境、40+工具与MCP/Skill插件生态、智能记忆系统、角色卡及语音交互，实现移动端全功能AI自动化。
summary.en: Operit AI is the most powerful AI agent and chat app on Android, featuring local models (MNN/llama.cpp), an embedded Ubuntu 24 environment, 40+ tools with MCP/Skill plugin ecosystem, intelligent memory, character cards, and voice interaction for full-featured mobile AI automation.

metadata.name: metadata-extractor
metadata.description: Extracts Exif, IPTC, XMP, ICC and other metadata from image, video and audio files

summary.zh: metadata-extractor 是一个 Java 库，用于从图像、视频和音频文件中提取 Exif、IPTC、XMP、ICC 等多种元数据。它支持 JPEG、TIFF、HEIF、MP4 等主流格式，并解码多家相机厂商的专属 MakerNote 数据。通过简洁的 API 即可获取文件元信息，适用于媒体管理、摄影后期和数字取证等场景。
summary.en: metadata-extractor is a Java library for reading Exif, IPTC, XMP, ICC and other metadata from image, video and audio files. It supports formats like JPEG, TIFF, HEIF, MP4 and decodes camera-specific makernote data from major manufacturers. With a simple API, it enables metadata extraction for media management, photography post-processing, and digital forensics.

metadata.name: OpenOmniBot
metadata.description: Your on-phone / mobile AI Agent / Claw, capable of operating terminals and performing a wide range of tasks in the Android world || 你的手机 AI 代理，她可以操作终端，也可以完成 Android 世界的广泛任务

summary.zh: OpenOmniBot 是一款运行在 Android 设备上的 AI 代理，具备理解、决策、执行和反思的完整闭环能力。它通过视觉模型操作手机界面，支持任务自动化、系统级操作（如定时任务、闹钟）、记忆系统、生产力工具（文件读写、浏览器、终端）以及可扩展的技能生态系统，将手机转变为智能助手。
summary.en: OpenOmniBot is an on-device AI agent for Android that operates with a full loop of understanding, deciding, executing, and reflecting. It uses vision models to interact with mobile interfaces, supports task automation, system-level actions (e.g., scheduled tasks, alarms), memory systems, productivity tools (file I/O, browser, terminal), and an extensible skill ecosystem, transforming your phone into an intelligent assistant.

metadata.name: nyaterm
metadata.description: A modern remote terminal workspace

summary.zh: NyaTerm 是一款基于 Tauri、React 和 Rust 构建的现代远程终端工作台，集 SSH、本地 Shell、Telnet、串口、SFTP、隧道、OTP、AI 辅助及加密同步于一体。它提供标签页、分屏、AI 命令生成与错误分析等功能，为开发者和运维人员打造一站式远程操作环境。
summary.en: NyaTerm is a modern remote terminal workspace built with Tauri, React, and Rust, integrating SSH, local shells, Telnet, Serial, SFTP, tunnels, OTP, AI assistance, and encrypted sync. It features tabs, split panes, AI command generation, and error analysis, offering a one-stop remote operations environment for developers and sysadmins.

metadata.name: mini-mqtt-client
metadata.description: 一个开源的mqtt 桌面客户端工具。支持保存命令、定时循环发送和预处理脚本

summary.zh: Mini MQTT Client 是一款基于 Tauri 2 + Vue 3 构建的轻量级跨平台 MQTT 桌面调试工具。它支持多服务器配置、MQTT 3.1.1/5.0 协议、TLS/SSL 安全连接、多主题订阅、命令模板、定时循环发送以及 JavaScript 预处理脚本（含加密库），适用于物联网设备调试与协议测试场景。
summary.en: Mini MQTT Client is a lightweight cross-platform MQTT desktop debugging tool built with Tauri 2 and Vue 3. It supports multi-server configuration, MQTT 3.1.1/5.0 protocols, TLS/SSL secure connections, multi-topic subscription, command templates, scheduled cyclic publishing, and JavaScript preprocessing scripts with built-in crypto libraries, ideal for IoT device debugging and protocol testing.

metadata.name: wvp-GB28181-pro
metadata.description: 基于GB28181-2016、部标808、部标1078标准实现的开箱即用的网络视频平台。自带管理页面，支持NAT穿透，支持海康、大华、宇视等品牌的IPC、NVR接入。支持国标级联，支持将普通摄像机/直播流/直播推流转国标共享到国标平台。

summary.zh: 基于GB28181-2016、部标808/1078标准的开源视频平台，集成管理界面，支持海康/大华等设备接入、NAT穿透、国标级联，可将非国标流转换为国标共享，提供RTSP/RTMP/HLS等多协议输出。
summary.en: An open-source video platform implementing GB28181-2016, JT/T 808, and JT/T 1078 standards. It features a built-in management UI, supports Hikvision/Dahua/Uniview devices, NAT traversal, national standard cascading, and converts non-GB streams to GB-compliant outputs via RTSP/RTMP/HLS.

metadata.name: sub2api
metadata.description: Sub2API 一站式开源中转服务，让 Claude、Openai 、Gemini、Grok订阅统一接入，支持拼车共享，更高效分摊成本，原生工具无缝使用。

summary.zh: Sub2API 是一个开源的 AI API 网关平台，将 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini 等订阅配额统一为单个端点，支持多账户管理、精确计费、智能调度和并发控制，并内置支付系统，实现订阅共享与成本分摊。
summary.en: Sub2API is an open-source AI API gateway that unifies subscriptions from Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, and others into a single endpoint. It supports multi-account management, precise token-level billing, smart scheduling, concurrency control, and built-in payment systems for subscription sharing and cost distribution.

metadata.name: git-surgeon
metadata.description: Git primitives for autonomous coding agents

summary.zh: git-surgeon 为AI编码代理提供对Git变更的精确控制，无需交互式提示。它支持按块（hunk）暂存、取消暂存或丢弃更改，以行级精度直接提交，以及拆分或折叠提交来重构历史。专为Claude Code等自主代理设计，避免破坏性变通方案，实现细粒度代码提交。
summary.en: git-surgeon provides AI coding agents with surgical control over git changes without interactive prompts. It supports staging, unstaging, or discarding individual hunks, committing with line-range precision, and restructuring history by splitting or folding commits. Designed for autonomous agents like Claude Code, it enables granular code commits without destructive workarounds.

metadata.name: codegraph
metadata.description: Pre-indexed code knowledge graph, auto syncs on code changes, for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode, AntiGravity, Kiro, CoPilot, and Hermes Agent — fewer tokens, fewer tool calls, 100% local

summary.zh: CodeGraph 是一个预索引的代码知识图谱工具，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等 AI 编程助手设计。它通过自动同步代码变更、减少 token 消耗和工具调用次数，实现 100% 本地化的语义代码智能，提升开发效率约 16%，降低工具调用约 58%。
summary.en: CodeGraph is a pre-indexed code knowledge graph tool designed for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. It automatically syncs code changes, reduces token consumption and tool calls by ~58%, and provides 100% local semantic code intelligence, boosting development efficiency by ~16%.

metadata.name: system_architect
metadata.description: :100: 2026年系统架构设计师（软考高级）备考资料。

summary.zh: 该仓库聚焦软考高级“系统架构设计师”备考，持续维护历年真题、解析、论文、模拟卷、视频与报名信息，覆盖综合知识、案例分析和论文写作。其核心价值在于以低成本整合高频考点与阶段化资料，适合冲刺复习、自测刷题和系统化备考，亮点是长期更新、资源结构完整且紧贴考试节奏。
summary.en: This repository is a long-running study hub for the Senior Systems Architect certification exam in China’s software qualification track. It aggregates past papers, answer analyses, essay materials, mock exams, video courses, and registration updates across knowledge, case analysis, and writing sections. Its main value lies in low-cost, structured exam preparation with time-aligned resources, making it useful for intensive review, self-assessment, and end-to-end preparation workflows.

metadata.name: medusa
metadata.description: The world's most flexible commerce platform for agents and developers

summary.zh: Medusa 是面向数字商业的开源电商平台与可扩展框架，内置商品、订单、结算等核心模块，支持 B2B、DTC、Marketplace 和 POS 等复杂场景。其模块化架构便于深度定制与集成，适合快速构建专属商业系统。
summary.en: Medusa is an open-source commerce platform and extensible framework for digital commerce. It ships core modules for products, orders, and checkout, and fits complex use cases like B2B, DTC, marketplaces, and POS. Its modular architecture enables deep customization and integration.

metadata.name: shannon
metadata.description: Shannon is an AI pentester for web applications and APIs. It analyzes your source code, identifies attack vectors, and executes real exploits to prove vulnerabilities before they reach production.

summary.zh: Shannon Lite 是面向 Web 应用与 API 的自治白盒 AI 渗透测试工具，可结合源码分析、浏览器自动化与命令行利用链，识别攻击路径并执行真实漏洞验证。其核心价值在于仅输出具备可复现 PoC 的安全问题，适合在本地开发、发布前验证及持续安全测试中提前拦截高风险漏洞。
summary.en: Shannon Lite is an autonomous white-box AI pentesting tool for web applications and APIs. It combines source-code analysis, browser automation, and command-line exploitation to discover attack paths and validate real vulnerabilities with working proof-of-concept exploits. Its key value lies in reporting only verified findings, making it well suited for local developer security testing, pre-release validation, and continuous application security workflows.

metadata.name: serverless-dns
metadata.description: The RethinkDNS resolver that deploys to Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Fastly, and Fly.io

summary.zh: serverless-dns 是面向自托管场景的无服务器 DNS 解析器，提供类似 Pi-hole 的内容拦截能力，并支持 DoH/DoT 协议。其亮点在于可一套实现部署到 Cloudflare Workers、Deno Deploy、Fastly 与 Fly.io，以极低延迟和边缘运行成本覆盖多设备 DNS 过滤、隐私保护与轻量级家庭/团队网络治理场景。
summary.en: serverless-dns is a self-hosted, serverless DNS resolver that brings Pi-hole-like content blocking to modern encrypted DNS protocols, including DoH and DoT. Its key strength is a single architecture deployable across Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Fastly Compute@Edge, and Fly.io, enabling low-latency, edge-native DNS filtering, privacy protection, and lightweight network policy control for households, power users, and small teams.

metadata.name: cc-switch-cli
metadata.description: ⭐️ A cross-platform CLI All-in-One assistant tool for Claude Code, Codex & Gemini CLI.

summary.zh: cc-switch-cli 是一款基于 Rust 的跨平台双模助手，通过 TUI 与 CLI 统一管理 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等多种 AI 编码工具的配置切换、账号会话、MCP 服务、提示词、代理路由与用量统计，适合个人开发者和团队构建可脚本化、可视化的多助手协同工作流，并兼容上游 WebDAV 同步生态。
summary.en: cc-switch-cli is a cross-platform Rust-based TUI and CLI manager for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and other AI coding assistants. It centralizes provider switching, account and session handling, MCP server management, prompts, skills, proxy routing, usage statistics, and environment diagnostics. Designed for both interactive daily use and scriptable automation, it helps developers and teams streamline multi-assistant workflows while remaining compatible with the upstream WebDAV sync ecosystem.

metadata.name: cc-switch
metadata.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Grok Build & Hermes Agent. Only official website: ccswitch.io

summary.zh: CC Switch 是基于 Tauri 2 构建的跨平台桌面管理器，统一整合 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、OpenCode、OpenClaw 与 Hermes Agent 等多种 AI 编码工具。它面向多模型、多账号与多终端工作流，突出一站式切换、集中管理和桌面级分发能力，适合开发者提升工具协同效率并降低环境切换成本。
summary.en: CC Switch is a Tauri 2-based cross-platform desktop manager that unifies Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent in a single application. It targets developers juggling multiple AI coding assistants, accounts, and environments, with a strong focus on one-stop switching, centralized desktop management, and smooth cross-platform distribution. Its core value lies in reducing context-switching overhead and streamlining multi-agent productivity workflows.

metadata.name: happy
metadata.description: Mobile and Web client for Codex and Claude Code, with realtime voice, encryption and fully featured

summary.zh: Happy 是面向 Claude Code 与 Codex 的移动端和 Web 控制客户端，通过 CLI 包装器将本地 AI 编程会话安全映射到手机与浏览器。项目突出端到端加密、实时语音、推送通知与跨设备无缝切换，适合开发者远程查看、接管和协同管理 AI coding agent 会话。
summary.en: Happy is a mobile and web client for Claude Code and Codex that extends local coding-agent sessions to phones and browsers through a CLI wrapper. Its core strengths are end-to-end encryption, realtime voice interaction, push notifications, and seamless device handoff. It is designed for developers who want to monitor, resume, and manage AI coding sessions remotely without sacrificing security or workflow continuity.

metadata.name: hapi
metadata.description: The Simple, Secure Framework Developers Trust

summary.zh: hapi 是一个面向 Node.js 的安全 Web 框架，强调最小开销与开箱即用能力，适合构建可扩展的 API、网站和企业后端。其亮点在于插件化架构、清晰的配置模型和完善的官方文档生态，支持开发者按自己的方式组织代码。
summary.en: hapi is a secure Node.js web framework built for low overhead and rich out-of-the-box capabilities, well suited for scalable APIs, websites, and enterprise backends. Its strengths include a plugin-driven architecture, explicit configuration model, and strong documentation ecosystem, letting developers structure code their way.

metadata.name: claude-code-wsl2-setup
metadata.description: Claude Code WSL2 setup with image paste, notifications, LSP, context-saving hooks, and Codex delegation.

summary.zh: 该仓库聚焦 Claude Code 在 WSL2 与 Windows Terminal 下的高频使用痛点，提供截图粘贴、任务通知、状态栏、语音模式、浏览器联动等实用修复，并补充 LSP、MCP、Playwright CLI 等配置指南。其亮点在于把 WSL2 与 Windows 主机能力桥接起来，同时提升 Claude 的代码理解、交互效率与日常开发体验。
summary.en: This repository targets the most common Claude Code friction points on WSL2 and Windows Terminal, covering screenshot paste, completion notifications, statusline, voice mode, browser handoff, and related usability fixes. It also includes portable guides for LSP, MCP, and Playwright CLI setup. The key value lies in bridging WSL2 with native Windows capabilities while improving Claude’s code navigation, interaction flow, and overall developer ergonomics.

metadata.name: tailscale
metadata.description: The easiest, most secure way to use WireGuard and 2FA.

summary.zh: Tailscale 是基于 WireGuard 构建的零配置私有网络方案，核心开源内容涵盖跨平台 `tailscaled` 守护进程与 `tailscale` CLI。它面向远程办公、设备互联、内网访问与安全组网场景，以 Go 实现多平台支持，并通过简化部署、强化身份认证与版本化发行流程，降低安全网络接入门槛。
summary.en: Tailscale is a zero-config private networking platform built around WireGuard, with this repository containing the core open-source `tailscaled` daemon and `tailscale` CLI. It targets secure remote access, device-to-device connectivity, and private network overlays across Linux, Windows, macOS, and more. Key strengths include a Go-based cross-platform architecture, streamlined deployment, strong identity-aware access patterns, and reproducible distribution builds with embedded version metadata.

metadata.name: lynxdb
metadata.description: A lightweight schema-on-read analytics in a single binary

summary.zh: LynxDB 是面向日志与事件数据的轻量级单二进制分析引擎，支持无依赖部署、即输即查和持久化服务两种模式。其核心亮点是 schema-on-read 与 Lynx Flow 管道查询语言，可对原始日志、JSON、嵌套数组进行解析、聚合与实时探索，适合运维观测、日志分析和开发调试场景。
summary.en: LynxDB is a lightweight single-binary analytics engine for logs and event data, designed for dependency-free deployment in both pipe-style querying and persistent server modes. Its key strengths are schema-on-read processing and the Lynx Flow pipeline language, which enable parsing, filtering, aggregation, and exploration of raw logs, JSON payloads, and nested arrays for observability, troubleshooting, and operational analytics.

metadata.name: infinitum
metadata.description: 基于RSS的资讯聚合工作台

summary.zh: Infinitum 是面向个人信息流治理的 RSS 资讯聚合工作台，覆盖 RSS 抓取、正文补抓、规则过滤、AI 摘要分析、事件归组与 AI 日报生成全流程。项目采用 Web + Worker 异步任务架构，支持源级并发控制、OPML 管理、公开信息流与 RSS 输出，适合构建低噪声、高可控的个人或团队资讯处理中台。
summary.en: Infinitum is an RSS-based news aggregation workbench for taming personal information streams. It integrates feed syncing, full-text fetching, rule-based filtering, AI summarization, event clustering, and AI daily briefing generation into one pipeline. Built with a Web plus Worker async architecture, it offers source-level controls, OPML import/export, review workflows, public feeds, and observability, making it well suited for low-noise, high-control intelligence curation for individuals or small teams.

metadata.name: autocad-mcp
metadata.description: MCP server for AutoCAD LT v3.1: freehand AutoLISP execution, 8 consolidated tools, File IPC + ezdxf backends, focus-free dispatch, undo/redo, P&ID symbols, and robust IPC with ESC prefix and UTF-8 fallback. Companion agent skill: puran-water/autocad-drafting

summary.zh: autocad-mcp 是面向 AutoCAD LT 2024+ 的 MCP 服务器，统一封装 File IPC 与 ezdxf 双后端，以 8 个聚合工具实现绘图、实体编辑、图层块管理、标注与 P&ID 符号操作。其亮点在于无焦点 AutoLISP 调度、稳健 IPC、撤销重做及跨平台无头 DXF 生成，适合 CAD 自动化、AI 制图代理与离线出图流程。
summary.en: autocad-mcp is an MCP server for AutoCAD LT 2024+ that unifies File IPC and ezdxf backends behind eight consolidated tools for drawing control, entity editing, layers, blocks, annotations, and P&ID symbols. Key strengths include focus-free AutoLISP dispatch, resilient IPC with encoding fallbacks, undo/redo support, and cross-platform headless DXF generation, making it well suited for CAD automation, AI drafting agents, and offline drawing pipelines.

metadata.name: TokenArena
metadata.description: 🔥tracking token usage in one place

summary.zh: Token Arena 是面向本地 AI Coding CLI 的开源用量追踪平台，通过 CLI 自动采集 token、会话与活跃时段数据，并在 Web 仪表盘中提供按设备、模型、项目等维度的可视化分析。项目同时支持 OAuth2 登录、分享徽章、社区排行与隐私匿名上传，适合个人开发者和团队统一管理 AI 成本与使用行为。
summary.en: Token Arena is an open-source usage analytics platform for local AI coding CLIs. It automatically collects token consumption, session activity, and time-based usage data, then presents them in a web dashboard with breakdowns by device, model, tool, and project. With OAuth2 authentication, shareable badges, community leaderboards, and privacy-first hashed project uploads, it helps developers and teams centralize AI cost tracking and usage visibility.

metadata.name: paseo
metadata.description: Orchestrate multiple coding agents from desktop and mobile

summary.zh: Paseo 是一个面向多智能体编程协作的自托管编排平台，通过本地 daemon 统一连接 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot、OpenCode 与 Pi。它支持桌面、移动端、Web 与 CLI 跨端接入，并提供并行执行、语音控制、远程守护进程和隐私优先的开发体验，适合在个人设备或团队环境中高效调度 AI 编码代理。
summary.en: Paseo is a self-hosted orchestration layer for coding agents, unifying Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, OpenCode, and Pi behind a local daemon. It enables parallel agent execution across desktop, mobile, web, and CLI, with support for voice control, remote daemon access, and privacy-first workflows. The project is well suited for developers who want to coordinate multiple AI coding agents on their own machines without giving up local tools, configs, or control.

metadata.name: huashu-design
metadata.description: Huashu Design · HTML-native design skill for Claude Code · Claude Code 里 HTML 原生的设计 skill · 高保真原型 / 幻灯片 / 动画 + 20 设计哲学 + 5 维评审 + MP4 导出 · Agent-agnostic

summary.zh: Huashu Design 是面向 Claude Code、Codex 等 Agent 的 HTML 原生设计 skill，可用自然语言快速生成高保真原型、演讲幻灯片、信息图与产品动画，并支持 MP4/GIF/PPTX 导出。其亮点在于三套设计顾问逻辑、40 种风格库、5 维评审体系，以及基于 Stage/Sprite 的动画引擎与 Playwright 可点击验证，兼顾生成质量、交付性与跨 Agent 通用性。
summary.en: Huashu Design is an HTML-native design skill for agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, turning plain-language prompts into production-ready prototypes, slide decks, infographics, and motion pieces. It stands out with a three-path design advisor system, 40 built-in visual style libraries, a five-dimensional review framework, and a Stage/Sprite-based motion engine. Deliverables remain practical and editable through MP4/GIF/PPTX export, clickable HTML outputs, and Playwright-based interaction validation across agent environments.

metadata.name: abtop
metadata.description: Like htop, but for AI coding agents. Monitor Claude    Code & Codex CLI sessions, tokens, context window,    rate limits, and ports in real-time.

summary.zh: abtop 是面向 AI 编码代理的终端监控器，以 btop/htop 风格实时汇总 Claude Code、Codex CLI 与 OpenCode 会话状态。它基于本地进程与文件发现机制，无需 API Key，即可追踪令牌消耗、上下文占用、速率限制、子进程与端口，适合多代理并行开发、资源巡检和故障排查。
summary.en: abtop is a terminal observability tool for AI coding agents, bringing a btop/htop-style dashboard to Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode sessions. It discovers sessions from local process and file state without API keys or authentication, then surfaces real-time token usage, context window pressure, rate limits, child processes, and open ports. It is especially useful for multi-agent development, live quota monitoring, and debugging orphaned services.

metadata.name: OfficeCLI
metadata.description: OfficeCLI is the first and best Office suite  purpose-built for AI agents to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files. Free, open-source, single binary, no Office installation required.

summary.zh: OfficeCLI 是面向 AI 代理的跨平台 Office 自动化工具，以单一二进制方式提供 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 的读取、编辑、生成与渲染能力，无需安装 Microsoft Office。其核心亮点是代理友好的渲染引擎，可将 docx、xlsx、pptx 转为 HTML 或 PNG，帮助智能体完成“生成—查看—修正”闭环，适用于文档生成、报表处理、演示文稿自动化等场景。
summary.en: OfficeCLI is a cross-platform Office automation toolkit built specifically for AI agents, delivering read, edit, generate, and render capabilities for Word, Excel, and PowerPoint through a single binary with no Microsoft Office installation required. Its standout feature is an agent-friendly rendering engine that converts DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX into HTML or PNG, enabling a tight create-review-fix loop for autonomous workflows such as document drafting, spreadsheet processing, and presentation generation.

metadata.name: KillerPDF
metadata.description: Free and open-source PDF editor for Windows with a built-in PDF 2.0 engine. View, annotate, OCR, merge, split, crop, rotate, compare, edit text, draw, sign, fill forms, print, flatten, and open password-protected PDFs without a subscription.

summary.zh: KillerPDF 是面向 Windows 现场技术人员的本地化 PDF 编辑器，主打单文件便携、免订阅、无遥测。基于 PDFium 提供高质量渲染，支持批注、合并拆分、文本编辑、表单填写、签名、裁剪、全文搜索与加密 PDF 打开，并以约 6MB 压缩体积实现安装版与便携版双形态，适合离线办公与轻量部署。
summary.en: KillerPDF is a lightweight Windows PDF editor built for field technicians who need a local-first, no-subscription workflow. Powered by PDFium for high-quality rendering, it supports annotation, merge/split, inline text editing, form filling, signatures, cropping, full-text search, and password-protected PDFs. Its standout value is a portable or installable single EXE, roughly 6 MB zipped, with no telemetry, no account requirement, and no runtime installation.

metadata.name: Kimi-Search-MCP
metadata.description: Kimi Code搜索服务只提供于Kimi Cli使用，故提取Kimi搜索服务为通用MCP服务，可以用在包括ClaudeCode、OpenCode等CLI工具

summary.zh: Kimi Search MCP 将原本仅面向 Kimi CLI 的搜索能力封装为通用 MCP 服务，支持网页搜索、网页抓取及最多 5 项的批量搜索与批量抓取。项目基于 Node.js 与 Model Context Protocol，可接入 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等多种客户端，适合为 AI 编程助手补充外部检索能力。
summary.en: Kimi Search MCP repackages Kimi Code’s search capability into a general-purpose MCP service for any client that supports the Model Context Protocol. It provides web search, page fetching, and extended batch search/fetch operations for up to five items, which are not available in the original tooling. Built on Node.js, it is well suited for CLI-based AI assistants such as Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode that need external retrieval capabilities.

metadata.name: obsidian-skills
metadata.description: Agent skills for Obsidian. Teach your agent to use Obsidian CLI and open formats including Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas.

summary.zh: 该仓库提供面向 Obsidian 生态的标准化 Agent Skills，帮助智能体直接处理 Markdown、Bases、JSON Canvas 及 Obsidian CLI 操作。其核心价值在于把 Obsidian 专有格式与工作流封装为可复用能力，适用于知识库自动编辑、可视化内容生成、插件开发辅助与网页内容清洗等场景，并兼容 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等多种智能体环境。
summary.en: This repository packages standardized Agent Skills for the Obsidian ecosystem, enabling agents to work directly with Obsidian Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas, and the Obsidian CLI. Its core value is turning Obsidian-specific formats and workflows into reusable capabilities for knowledge-base automation, structured note editing, visual canvas generation, plugin or theme development, and web content cleanup. It follows the Agent Skills specification and works across compatible environments such as Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode.

metadata.name: caveman
metadata.description: 🪨 why use many token when few token do trick — Claude Code skill that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like caveman

summary.zh: caveman 是面向 Claude Code 及多种 AI 编码代理的压缩表达技能插件，通过“穴居人式”提示风格在保持技术准确性的前提下，将回复 token 成本降低约 65% 到 75%。它支持多档压缩模式与跨语言输出，适合高频代码协作、终端代理和成本敏感的 AI 开发工作流。
summary.en: Caveman is a prompt skill/plugin for Claude Code and 30+ coding agents that compresses model responses into a terse “caveman” style while preserving technical accuracy. It reportedly cuts output tokens by roughly 65% to 75%, supports multiple compression modes, and keeps the user’s original language intact. It fits cost-sensitive AI coding workflows, terminal agents, and high-frequency developer assistance scenarios.

metadata.name: opencode
metadata.description: The open source coding agent.

summary.zh: OpenCode 是面向终端与桌面的开源 AI 编码代理，提供安装便捷的 CLI 与桌面应用，支持多平台分发。它聚焦开发者在本地环境中的代码生成、修改与协作式执行，强调开放源码、自主可控和较新的发行链路，适合个人开发、团队辅助编程及跨平台工程环境集成。
summary.en: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent built for both terminal and desktop workflows, with streamlined installation and broad cross-platform distribution. It focuses on helping developers generate, edit, and execute coding tasks inside local environments while emphasizing transparency, controllability, and rapid delivery. The project is well suited for individual development, pair-programming assistance, and integration into multi-OS engineering setups.

metadata.name: auth
metadata.description: Boring user authentication code for golang

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 Go Web 应用的自托管认证组件，提供邮箱密码登录、OAuth 多提供商接入与企业级 SAML 单点登录，并内置会话管理、限流和密码安全机制。它支持 SQLite/PostgreSQL、可插拔 OAuth 扩展，以及重置密码、更新邮箱、注册等完整用户流程，适合希望快速集成且掌控用户数据的服务端项目。
summary.en: Auth is a self-hosted authentication package for Go web applications that delivers production-ready user management without rebuilding common login flows. It supports email/password auth, multiple OAuth providers, and enterprise SAML SSO, while including secure session handling, rate limiting, and password hashing. With SQLite/PostgreSQL support, pluggable OAuth provider interfaces, and built-in flows for signup, password reset, and email change, it fits teams that want fast integration and full data ownership.

metadata.name: tunnl.gg
metadata.description: Expose localhost to the internet

summary.zh: tunnl.gg 是一个基于 SSH 反向隧道的极简内网穿透服务，用户仅需一条命令即可将本地 HTTP/WebSocket 应用暴露到公网。项目以 Go 实现，集成自动 HTTPS、可记忆子域名、速率限制、钓鱼拦截、滥用封禁与统计指标，适合自建轻量级 ngrok 替代方案或临时演示、调试与回调联调场景。
summary.en: tunnl.gg is a minimal reverse-tunneling service built around SSH, enabling developers to expose local HTTP and WebSocket apps to the public internet with a single command. Implemented in Go, it combines memorable per-session subdomains, automatic HTTPS, built-in metrics, rate limiting, abuse blocking, and phishing-warning interstitials. It is well suited as a self-hosted lightweight alternative to ngrok for demos, webhook testing, debugging, and short-lived remote access workflows.

metadata.name: gridea-pro
metadata.description: Gridea Pro - 下一代桌面静态博客写作客户端 —— 像用 Notion 一样写博客。

summary.zh: Gridea Pro 是面向非开发者的桌面静态博客写作客户端，基于 Wails、Go 与 Vue 3 重写，提供类 Notion 的写作体验。它集成 Monaco 编辑器、可视化主题配置、多模板引擎、一键部署与内置 Git，同步覆盖内容创作、站点管理和发布流程，适合希望零命令行搭建并运营个人博客的用户。
summary.en: Gridea Pro is a desktop client for static blogging built for writers rather than developers, rebuilt with Wails, Go, and Vue 3. It delivers a Notion-like authoring experience with Monaco-based editing, visual theme configuration, multiple template engines, one-click deployment, and a built-in Git engine. The app streamlines writing, content management, and publishing for users who want to run personal blogs without dealing with CLI tooling.

metadata.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
metadata.description: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.

summary.zh: 该仓库以单一 `CLAUDE.md` 规则文件为核心，将 Andrej Karpathy 对 LLM 编程误区的观察转化为可落地的 Claude Code 行为约束。它聚焦“先思考、求简洁、做外科式修改、以目标验证驱动执行”，适用于提升 AI 编程代理在真实代码库中的决策质量、改动边界控制与任务可验证性。
summary.en: This repository packages Andrej Karpathy’s critiques of LLM coding behavior into a single `CLAUDE.md` guideline file for Claude Code. It operationalizes four practical principles—think before coding, prefer simplicity, make surgical changes, and execute against verifiable goals—to reduce wrong assumptions, overengineering, and collateral edits. It is especially useful for teams improving coding-agent reliability, repo safety, and task-focused execution in real software workflows.

metadata.name: local-discovery
metadata.description: 零侵入的本地微服务注册发现工具，一行 JVM 参数实现本地服务互调，自动穿透远端注册中心

summary.zh: Local Discovery 是面向 Spring Cloud 微服务本地联调的零侵入注册发现工具，通过一行 JVM Agent 参数在 LoadBalancer 层动态拦截 Feign、RestTemplate、Gateway 与 WebClient 请求，优先路由本地实例，缺失时自动回退远端 Nacos/Eureka/Consul。其亮点在于 ByteBuddy 增强、桥接式 ClassLoader 隔离与热生效机制，显著缩短本地调试反馈链路。
summary.en: Local Discovery is a zero-intrusion local service discovery tool for Spring Cloud microservices, enabling local-to-local service calls with a single JVM agent argument. It intercepts service selection at the LoadBalancer layer for Feign, RestTemplate, Gateway, and WebClient, routing to local instances first and transparently falling back to remote registries such as Nacos, Eureka, or Consul. Key technical strengths include ByteBuddy-based instrumentation, bridge-mode classloader isolation, and hot-effective local registration.
tags_zh: Spring Cloud 负载均衡拦截

metadata.name: gitlogue
metadata.description: A cinematic Git commit replay tool for the terminal, turning your Git history into a living, animated story.

summary.zh: gitlogue 是一款基于 Rust 的终端 Git 提交回放工具，可将仓库历史以打字动画、文件树切换与语法高亮方式可视化呈现。它适用于演示、教学、内容录制和桌面屏保化展示，并支持工作区 diff 预览、29 种语言的 Tree-sitter 高亮、主题定制与随机循环播放，兼顾观赏性与性能。
summary.en: gitlogue is a Rust-based terminal tool that replays Git commit history as cinematic code animation, combining realistic typing, file tree transitions, and syntax highlighting. It fits demos, education, content creation, and ambient terminal displays, while also offering working-tree diff previews, Tree-sitter highlighting for 29 languages, theme customization, and endless random playback with strong performance and lightweight runtime.

metadata.name: openscreen
metadata.description: Create stunning demos for free. Open-source, no subscriptions, no watermarks, and free for commercial use. An alternative to Screen Studio.

summary.zh: OpenScreen 是一款面向产品演示、教程录制与社媒短视频制作的开源桌面工具，主打免费商用、无订阅和无水印。它集成屏幕/窗口录制、系统与麦克风音频、摄像头画中画、自动缩放、字幕离线生成、时间线剪辑与多比例导出，覆盖 Screen Studio 的核心场景，突出本地处理、可定制性与内容生产效率。
summary.en: OpenScreen is an open-source desktop app for creating polished product demos, walkthroughs, and social video content without subscriptions or watermarks. It combines screen or window capture, system and microphone audio, webcam overlays, cursor-aware auto zoom, offline on-device captions, timeline editing, annotations, and multi-format export. Positioned as a free alternative to Screen Studio, its main strengths are local-first processing, commercial-friendly licensing, and an efficient demo-production workflow.

metadata.name: vscode-git-graph
metadata.description: Fork of Michael Hutchisons repository with some updates.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 Visual Studio Code 的 Git 可视化扩展，基于 Git Graph 分支演进并增强交互体验。项目支持在面板中查看提交图、分支与作者筛选、多选操作、代码评审跟踪及丰富右键 Git 动作，兼顾提交比较、未提交变更审查与界面定制，适合日常开发、仓库审查和复杂分支协作场景。
summary.en: This repository is an enhanced fork of Git Graph for Visual Studio Code, focused on visualizing repository history and improving Git workflows inside the editor. It adds panel-based graph viewing, branch and author filtering, multi-selection actions, code review tracking, commit comparison, and customizable toolbar behavior. The extension is well suited for daily development, repository inspection, and teams working with complex branching, merges, stashes, and uncommitted changes directly in VS Code.

metadata.name: oxideterm
metadata.description: AI-native workspace for local shells and remote machines.Zero Webview, zero OpenSSL, zero telemetry, and no app subscription.

summary.zh: OxideTerm 是面向远程服务器运维与开发的本地优先 AI 工作区，将 SSH 终端、SFTP、端口转发、串口、本地 Shell 与轻量编辑整合到同一桌面应用。项目以 Tauri + React 构建，采用纯 Rust SSH 栈，强调零 Electron、零 OpenSSL、零遥测与 BYOK 式 AI 接入，适合需要安全、轻量、可控远程协作环境的用户。
summary.en: OxideTerm is a local-first AI workspace for remote server operations and development, unifying SSH terminals, SFTP, port forwarding, serial consoles, local shells, and lightweight editing in one desktop app. Built with Tauri and React on top of a pure Rust SSH stack, it stands out with zero Electron, zero OpenSSL, zero telemetry, and a BYOK AI model. It fits users who need a secure, lightweight, and controllable alternative to traditional SSH clients.
tags_zh: 本地优先 AI 工作区

metadata.name: openilink-hub
metadata.description: 开源微信 Bot 管理平台 + App 应用市场 | Self-hosted WeChat Bot Platform with App Marketplace | Lark · Slack · Discord · DingTalk · GitHub · Notion · 20+ Apps | AI Tools | 7 Language SDKs

summary.zh: OpeniLink Hub 是面向微信 ClawBot（iLink 协议）的自托管 Bot 管理平台，提供多 Bot 绑定、消息调度与可视化后台，并通过应用市场一键接入 Slack、飞书、GitHub、Notion 等 20+ 服务。其亮点在于同时支持 WebSocket、Webhook、AI 自动回复通道，内置多语言 SDK、Passkey 登录、消息链路追踪与 24 小时窗口提醒，显著降低微信消息自动化与跨平台集成门槛。
summary.en: OpeniLink Hub is a self-hosted bot management platform for WeChat ClawBot built on the iLink protocol. It combines multi-bot binding, message orchestration, and a web admin console with an app marketplace that connects 20+ services such as Slack, Lark, GitHub, and Notion. Key strengths include parallel WebSocket, Webhook, and AI reply channels, plus multi-language SDKs, Passkey authentication, delivery tracing, and 24-hour session window reminders, making WeChat automation and cross-platform integration far easier to deploy.

metadata.name: wxWebHook
metadata.description: 本项目是一个轻量级的消息通知服务。通过封装微信官方接口，帮助开发者将关键信息快速推送至微信端。用户只需通过简单的 HTTP 请求或命令行调用即可将内容实时推送到自己的微信上，实现随时随地接收提醒。

summary.zh: wxWebHook 是面向个人运维提醒与脚本通知的轻量级微信消息推送服务，封装微信官方接口，支持通过 HTTP Webhook 或命令行将告警、任务结果等实时发送到微信。项目采用前后端分离与 Docker/二进制分发，具备二维码接入、密钥鉴权、面板化管理等特性，适合本地或内网自建通知链路。
summary.en: wxWebHook is a lightweight self-hosted notification service that wraps official WeChat APIs to deliver alerts, script outputs, and operational updates directly to WeChat. It supports simple HTTP webhook calls and CLI-based pushing, making it practical for server monitoring and task automation. With a separated panel/core architecture, QR-code onboarding, secret-based authentication, and Docker or binary distribution, it fits private LAN or local deployment scenarios well.

metadata.name: wincron
metadata.description: Cron job scheduler for windows

summary.zh: wincron 是面向 Windows 的轻量级定时任务调度器，以单文件低开销运行方式提供基于 Cron 表达式的任务编排能力。项目结合 Wails 与 Go 构建桌面应用，支持参数与工作目录配置、执行日志、并发策略、连续失败停用、托盘运行、开机启动、全局热键及 IPC 命令行控制，适合替代复杂的系统任务计划程序。
summary.en: wincron is a lightweight Windows task scheduler designed as a more intuitive alternative to the built-in Task Scheduler. Built with Go and Wails, it delivers cron-based job orchestration in a single executable with low idle overhead. Key capabilities include command arguments, working directory control, execution logs, concurrency policies, auto-disable after repeated failures, tray and boot modes, global hotkeys, import/export, and IPC-based command-line management.

metadata.name: Mouser
metadata.description: A lightweight, open-source, fully local alternative to Logitech Options+ for remapping Logitech HID++ mice.

summary.zh: Mouser 是一款面向 Logitech HID++ 鼠标的轻量级本地重映射工具，可替代 Logitech Options+，支持 MX Master、MX Anywhere 等主流型号。项目强调零遥测、无云端、免账号，提供跨 Windows、macOS、Linux 的即下即用体验，并通过设备识别与回退界面兼顾更多 Logitech 设备兼容性。
summary.en: Mouser is a lightweight, fully local remapping tool for Logitech HID++ mice, designed as an open-source alternative to Logitech Options+. It delivers the best experience on MX Master and MX Anywhere devices while providing detection and fallback UI support for additional Logitech models. Key strengths include zero telemetry, no cloud dependency, no account requirement, and a cross-platform plug-and-run experience across Windows, macOS, and Linux.

metadata.name: page-agent
metadata.description: JavaScript in-page GUI agent. Control web interfaces with natural language.

summary.zh: Page Agent 是阿里巴巴推出的页内 GUI 智能体框架，通过纯 JavaScript 在网页内部执行自然语言驱动的 DOM 操作，无需浏览器扩展、截图或无头浏览器。它支持自带 LLM，适用于 SaaS Copilot、表单自动填写、无障碍交互及跨页面浏览器自动化，并以文本化页面理解、低接入成本和可扩展 MCP/Chrome Extension 为主要亮点。
summary.en: Page Agent is an in-page GUI agent framework from Alibaba that enables natural-language control of web interfaces through pure JavaScript DOM interaction, without relying on browser extensions, screenshots, or headless browsers. It supports bring-your-own LLM integration and targets SaaS copilots, form automation, accessibility workflows, and cross-page browser tasks. Its key strengths are text-based page understanding, lightweight frontend integration, and extensibility via Chrome Extension and MCP server support.

metadata.name: clash-verge-rev
metadata.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience

summary.zh: Clash Verge Rev 是基于 Rust 与 Tauri 2 的跨平台 Clash.Meta 图形客户端，面向 Windows、macOS 与 Linux 提供定制化代理管理。项目内置 mihomo 内核，支持 TUN、系统代理守卫、配置增强、规则与节点可视化编辑，并提供主题定制、CSS 注入及 WebDAV 同步，兼顾性能、易用性与高级网络控制能力。
summary.en: Clash Verge Rev is a cross-platform GUI client for Clash.Meta built with Rust and Tauri 2, targeting Windows, macOS, and Linux for advanced proxy management. It ships with the mihomo core and supports TUN mode, system proxy guard, config enhancement, and visual editing for nodes and rules. Key highlights include theme customization, CSS injection, and WebDAV-based backup and sync, combining native performance with powerful network control.

metadata.name: rtk
metadata.description: CLI proxy that reduces LLM token consumption by 60-90% on common dev commands. Single Rust binary, zero dependencies

summary.zh: RTK 是面向开发者工作流的 CLI 代理，用 Rust 单二进制实现对命令输出进行过滤与压缩，在 `git`、测试、检索和文件读取等高频场景中可降低 60% 到 90% 的 LLM token 消耗。其亮点是零外部依赖、支持 100+ 常用命令、额外开销低于 10ms，适合 Claude Code 等 AI 编程环境提升上下文利用率与交互效率。
summary.en: RTK is a Rust-based CLI proxy that filters and compresses command output before it reaches an LLM, cutting token usage by 60–90% across common developer workflows such as `git`, search, file inspection, and test commands. Built as a single zero-dependency binary, it supports 100+ commands with under 10ms overhead, making it well suited for AI coding tools like Claude Code where context efficiency, speed, and lower inference cost matter.

metadata.name: arnis
metadata.description: Generate any location from the real world in Minecraft with a high level of detail.

summary.zh: Arnis 是一个将真实世界地理区域高精度生成到 Minecraft 的开源工具，支持 Java 与 Bedrock 版。它结合 OpenStreetMap 与高程数据，自动还原地形、道路与建筑，适用于城市复刻、地貌演示和地理可视化。亮点在于大范围地理数据处理、模块化架构、跨平台支持及可调生成参数。
summary.en: Arnis is an open-source generator that recreates real-world locations in Minecraft with high geographic and architectural fidelity, supporting both Java and Bedrock editions. It combines OpenStreetMap data with elevation datasets to reconstruct terrain, roads, and buildings at scale. Key strengths include large-area geospatial processing, modular architecture, cross-platform usability, and configurable generation options for cities, landscapes, and educational visualization.

metadata.name: editor
metadata.description: Create and share 3D architectural projects.

summary.zh: Pascal Editor 是面向建筑设计与空间建模的 3D 编辑器，基于 React Three Fiber 与 WebGPU 构建，采用 Turborepo 拆分 core、viewer 与编辑器应用。其亮点在于以节点化场景模型、Zustand 多仓状态管理、几何系统与交互工具协同，实现建筑场景创建、编辑、渲染与分享的一体化工作流。
summary.en: Pascal Editor is a 3D architectural editing platform for creating and sharing building projects, built with React Three Fiber and WebGPU. Organized as a Turborepo monorepo, it separates schema/state systems, rendering, and editor UX into dedicated packages. Key strengths include a node-based scene model, multi-store Zustand architecture, geometry generation systems, and extensible interactive tools for end-to-end modeling, visualization, and collaboration workflows.

metadata.name: cobe
metadata.description: 5KB WebGL globe lib.

summary.zh: cobe 是一个约 5KB、零依赖的 WebGL 地球仪库，面向网页中的轻量级地理可视化展示。它支持高性能渲染、可动画旋转的 globe、标记点与飞线连接，并通过 CSS Anchor Positioning 将 DOM 元素与地图标记/弧线绑定，实现标签、过渡、滤镜和交互无缝协同，特别适合数据故事、官网展示和交互式全球网络视图。
summary.en: Cobe is a ~5KB, zero-dependency WebGL globe library built for lightweight geographic visualization on the web. It delivers high-performance globe rendering with animated rotation, markers, and connection arcs, while uniquely exposing bindable anchors and visibility variables so regular DOM elements can track globe points through CSS Anchor Positioning. This makes it especially effective for interactive storytelling, marketing sites, dashboards, and global network or presence visualizations.

metadata.name: cc-connect
metadata.description: Bridge local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex) to messaging platforms (Feishu/Lark, DingTalk, Slack, Telegram, Discord, LINE, WeChat Work). Chat with your AI dev assistant from anywhere — no public IP required for most platforms.

summary.zh: cc-connect 是一个将本地 AI 编程代理接入企业与即时通讯平台的桥接工具，支持 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Codex 与飞书、Slack、Telegram 等多平台互通。其核心价值是在无需公网 IP 的前提下，把开发助手带到移动聊天场景中，实现远程触发、协作反馈与跨平台消息联动。
summary.en: cc-connect is a bridge that connects local AI coding agents to enterprise and consumer messaging platforms, including Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex, Feishu/Lark, Slack, Telegram, and more. Its key value is enabling developers to interact with coding assistants from anywhere, often without requiring a public IP, while supporting remote task triggering, conversational workflows, and cross-platform message delivery for mobile-first development operations.

metadata.name: printf-tac-toe
metadata.description: tic-tac-toe in a single call to printf

summary.zh: 该仓库用 C 语言将井字棋完整压缩进单次 printf 调用，通过精心构造的格式字符串与参数列表，在几乎无常规控制流的前提下实现输入、状态更新、胜负判定与非法落子处理。它既是 IOCCC 风格的极限混淆范例，也展示了 printf 图灵完备性在代码高尔夫、程序语言研究和安全趣味实验中的独特价值。
summary.en: This repository implements a full tic-tac-toe game in C using effectively a single `printf` call, with a crafted format string and argument layout driving input handling, state mutation, win detection, and illegal-move logic without conventional control flow. Created for IOCCC 2020, it stands out as an extreme obfuscation artifact and a vivid demonstration of `printf`’s Turing-complete behavior for code golf, language-hacking, and security-minded programming curiosity.

metadata.name: AionUi
metadata.description: Open-source 24/7 Cowork app for OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ more CLI Agent | Customize your assistants | Team them up｜Star if you like it!

summary.zh: AionUi 是面向 AI CLI 助手的本地化协作平台，将 Codex、Claude Code、Hermes Agent 等 20+ 代理统一到单一界面。它支持文件操作、多步骤任务执行、远程访问与 Cron 持续自动化，强调零配置、跨平台和用户可控，适合代码开发、运维自动化及长期代理协作场景。
summary.en: AionUi is a local, open-source cowork platform that unifies 20+ AI CLI agents, including Codex, Claude Code, and Hermes Agent, into one interface. It goes beyond chat by enabling file access, multi-step task execution, remote control, and 24/7 Cron automation. Key strengths are zero-setup onboarding, cross-platform support, multi-agent orchestration, and transparent user control for development, operations, and persistent AI-assisted workflows.

metadata.name: leetcode-mcp-server
metadata.description: An MCP server enabling automated access to LeetCode's problems, solutions, and public data with optional authentication for user-specific features, supporting leetcode.com & leetcode.cn sites.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 LeetCode 的 MCP 服务器，将题目、题解、竞赛与用户数据封装为可被 AI/IDE 自动调用的标准化接口。项目支持 leetcode.com 与 leetcode.cn 双站点，既可匿名获取题目信息、标签检索和每日一题，也可通过会话鉴权访问提交记录、笔记与做题进度，适合智能刷题助手、编程教学与开发工具集成场景。
summary.en: LeetCode MCP Server exposes LeetCode problems, editorials, contests, and user data through the Model Context Protocol, making them directly consumable by AI agents and IDE integrations. It supports both leetcode.com and leetcode.cn, offers anonymous access for problem search, metadata, and daily challenges, and optionally enables authenticated features such as submissions, notes, progress tracking, and contest performance. It is well suited for coding assistants, learning workflows, and automation around interview practice.

metadata.name: GitNexus
metadata.description: GitNexus: The Zero-Server Code Intelligence Engine -       GitNexus is a client-side knowledge graph creator that runs entirely in your browser. Drop in a git repository (Github, Gitlab, Azure, Local) or ZIP file, and get an interactive knowledge graph with a built in Graph RAG Agent. Perfect for code exploration

summary.zh: GitNexus 是一款零服务器代码智能引擎，可在浏览器或本地将 GitHub 仓库/ZIP 索引为知识图谱，揭示依赖、调用链与执行流，并通过 Graph RAG 与 MCP 为 AI 编程助手提供更可靠的架构级上下文。其亮点在于纯客户端运行、知识图谱驱动分析，以及兼顾 Web 可视化探索与 CLI 集成开发。
summary.en: GitNexus is a zero-server code intelligence engine that turns GitHub repositories or ZIP archives into interactive knowledge graphs, exposing dependencies, call chains, and execution flows for deeper architectural analysis. It combines a browser-based visual explorer with CLI and MCP integration, enabling Graph RAG-powered context for AI coding agents. Key strengths include fully client-side operation, knowledge-graph-driven code understanding, and practical support for both quick exploration and reliable agent-assisted development.

metadata.name: EnsoAI
metadata.description: Multiple Agents, Parallel Flow

summary.zh: EnsoAI 是一款面向 AI 编程协作的桌面工具，基于 Git worktree 为同一项目创建并行工作空间，让 Claude、Codex、Gemini 等代理各自保持独立上下文并同步推进任务。项目以 Electron + React + TypeScript 构建，结合可视化 Git 管理与多代理接入，适用于并行开发、分支实验、代码审查和多模型协同交付场景。
summary.en: EnsoAI is a desktop app for AI-assisted software development that uses Git worktrees to create parallel project workspaces, allowing Claude, Codex, Gemini, and other agents to operate simultaneously with isolated context. Built with Electron, React, and TypeScript, it combines multi-agent orchestration, persistent per-worktree sessions, and visual Git operations, making it well suited for parallel coding, branch-based experimentation, code review, and multi-model delivery workflows.

metadata.name: vibe-kanban
metadata.description: Get 10X more out of Claude Code, Codex or any coding agent

summary.zh: Vibe Kanban 是面向 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等编码代理的 AI 开发协作平台，将看板规划、独立工作区、内置终端与预览、Diff 审查和 PR 流程整合到同一界面。其核心价值在于提升多代理协同开发中的任务拆解、执行跟踪与反馈闭环效率，并支持团队协作与自托管部署。
summary.en: Vibe Kanban is an AI-native development orchestration platform for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, and other coding agents. It unifies kanban-based planning, isolated agent workspaces, terminal and app preview, diff review, inline feedback, and pull request workflows in one interface. Its key value is accelerating task planning, execution tracking, and review loops for both individual and team-based agent-driven software delivery, with self-hosting support included.

metadata.name: openhare
metadata.description: AI-powered desktop SQL client. Cross-platform. Built with Flutter.

summary.zh: openhare 是一款基于 Flutter 的跨平台桌面 SQL 客户端，面向开发、数据分析与 DBA 管理场景。其核心亮点是将 AI 辅助写 SQL 与多数据库管理结合，通过 Dart FFI 调用 Go 驱动，统一接入 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、SQLite、Oracle、MongoDB 和 Redis，并配合 Riverpod、GoRouter 与 ObjectBox 提供轻量高效的桌面体验。
summary.en: Openhare is an AI-powered cross-platform desktop SQL client built with Flutter for everyday development, data analysis, and DBA workflows. Its key strength is combining AI-assisted SQL writing and optimization with unified multi-database management. The app uses Dart FFI to bridge a Flutter desktop UI with Go-based database drivers, supporting MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, SQLite, Oracle, MongoDB, and Redis, alongside a modern stack including Riverpod, GoRouter, and ObjectBox.

metadata.name: golutra
metadata.description: Multi-agent AI orchestration platform for automation, workflows, and developer tools. Golutra transforms Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw into a unified agent system with parallel execution, task orchestration, long-running workflows, and AI productivity workspace.

summary.zh: Golutra 是面向自动化与开发场景的多智能体编排平台，将 Codex、Claude Code、OpenClaw 等现有 CLI 统一为可并行执行、可观测、可注入指令的 AI 工作区。项目基于 Vue 3、Rust 与 Tauri，支持跨平台桌面运行，强调长时任务、工作流模板导入导出及多代理协作，适用于软件研发、内容生产和复杂流程自动化。
summary.en: Golutra is a multi-agent orchestration platform that turns existing AI CLIs such as Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw into a unified workspace for parallel execution, workflow automation, and real-time supervision. Built with Vue 3, Rust, and Tauri, it delivers a cross-platform desktop environment optimized for long-running tasks, reusable workflow templates, and observable agent collaboration across developer tooling, content production, and broader automation scenarios.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 OpenClaw 的容器化浏览器沙箱，提供可远程附着的无头 Chromium，并通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 暴露自动化控制接口。项目聚焦云端/隔离执行场景，内置 Caddy 处理 CDP 代理，支持 Xvfb、VNC 与 noVNC，可在无头性能模式与可视化调试模式间灵活切换。
summary.en: OpenClaw Sandbox Browser is a containerized browser sandbox built for OpenClaw, exposing a headless Chromium instance through the Chrome DevTools Protocol for remote control and automation. It targets isolated execution and cloud-hosted browser workloads, with Caddy handling CDP proxying and Host header rewriting. The image also includes Xvfb, VNC, and noVNC, enabling smooth switching between lightweight headless operation and visual debugging sessions.

metadata.name: heretic
metadata.description: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models

summary.zh: Heretic 是一款面向 Transformer 语言模型的自动化去对齐工具，通过方向消融（abliteration）结合 Optuna 的 TPE 参数搜索，无需昂贵后训练即可降低拒答率，并尽量保持原模型能力。适用于多数稠密、多模态及部分 MoE 模型，适合模型改造、评测复现与自动化解限场景。
summary.en: Heretic is an automated decensorship tool for transformer-based language models. It combines directional ablation (abliteration) with Optuna-powered TPE optimization to suppress refusal behavior without costly post-training, while preserving the original model’s capabilities through KL-aware tuning. It supports many dense, multimodal, MoE, and hybrid architectures, making it useful for model modification, reproducible evaluation, and automated alignment removal workflows.

metadata.name: GithubStarsIndex
metadata.description: 自动抓取 GitHub Stars，生成 AI 摘要，便于检索。

summary.zh: GitHub Stars Index 面向个人知识库与技术收藏管理，自动抓取账号 Star 仓库，读取 README 并通过兼容 OpenAI 接口生成中英摘要与技术标签。项目强调增量同步、并发摘要、标签归一化治理，以及基于 Jinja2 的 Markdown/HTML 静态输出，可联动 GitHub Actions、Pages 与 Obsidian，构建可检索的 Star 归档系统。
summary.en: GitHub Stars Index is built for personal knowledge management and repository curation. It automatically fetches all starred repositories of a GitHub account, reads each README, and generates bilingual summaries and technical tags through OpenAI-compatible APIs. Its key strengths include incremental syncing, concurrent AI processing, tag normalization, and Jinja2-based Markdown/HTML rendering, with optional integration for GitHub Actions, GitHub Pages, and Obsidian to create a searchable stars archive.

metadata.name: alumnium
metadata.description: End-to-End Testing with AI for Agents and Engineers

summary.zh: Alumnium 是面向端到端测试的 AI 原生库与 MCP，兼容 Playwright、Selenium、Appium 等现有自动化栈。它用自然语言驱动操作、断言与数据提取，降低脚本编写成本，并通过更稳健的状态感知与验证机制提升复杂 Web/App 场景下测试的可维护性与可靠性。
summary.en: Alumnium is an AI-native end-to-end testing library and MCP that integrates with existing automation stacks such as Playwright, Selenium, and Appium. It enables natural-language actions, assertions, and data extraction, reducing test scripting overhead while improving resilience through stronger state-aware interaction and verification for complex web and mobile application testing workflows.

metadata.name: zeroclaw
metadata.description: Fast, small, and fully autonomous AI personal assistant infrastructure, any OS, any platform — deploy anywhere, swap anything 🦀

summary.zh: ZeroClaw 是一个以 Rust 构建的自治型个人 AI 助手运行时，支持单二进制部署、本地数据与密钥自持，适合在个人设备、家庭服务器或企业边缘环境中构建长期在线代理。它可对接 20+ LLM 提供商、30+ 通信渠道及 shell、浏览器、HTTP、MCP 等工具，强调跨平台、可插拔、轻量化与自主可控。
summary.en: ZeroClaw is a Rust-based autonomous personal AI assistant runtime designed for self-hosted, single-binary deployment with full local ownership of data, keys, and execution. It fits personal devices, homelabs, and edge environments where always-on agents must remain portable and controllable. The project connects to 20+ LLM providers, 30+ communication channels, and extensible tools such as shell, browser, HTTP, hardware, and MCP servers, with a strong focus on cross-platform modularity, lightweight footprint, and user sovereignty.

metadata.name: openclaw-search-skills
metadata.description: OpenClaw skills for deep search — multi-source search, content extraction, and structured research reports.

summary.zh: openclaw-search-skills 为 OpenClaw Agent 提供生产级深度检索能力，打通多源召回、意图感知排序、引用链追踪与正文提取全流程。项目整合 Brave、Exa、Tavily、Grok 并支持 MinerU 反爬降级，适用于技术调研、论坛线索深挖、GitHub 问题排查和结构化研究报告生成。
summary.en: openclaw-search-skills delivers production-grade deep search capabilities for OpenClaw agents, covering the full pipeline from multi-source retrieval and intent-aware ranking to citation-chain exploration and clean content extraction. It combines Brave, Exa, Tavily, and Grok with MinerU fallback for anti-bot pages, making it well suited for technical research, issue investigation, discussion-thread mining, and structured research report generation.

metadata.name: docker-openclawd
metadata.description: 🚀 一键安装 OpenClawd / Clawdbot 的 Docker 部署方案｜内置飞书Channel，一键安装，开箱即用

summary.zh: 该仓库提供 OpenClawd/Clawdbot 的一键式 Docker 部署方案，面向希望快速自托管个人 AI 助手的用户。其核心价值在于自动完成初始化与最小化配置，无需宿主机安装 Node.js，即可开箱接入 WhatsApp、Telegram、Discord、Slack 与飞书等通道。技术亮点包括 Docker Compose 全容器化、首次运行自动 onboarding、非 root 安全运行，以及对飞书长连接通道和本地挂载扩展的友好支持。
summary.en: This repository delivers a one-command Docker deployment for OpenClawd (formerly Clawdbot), aimed at users who want to self-host a personal AI assistant with minimal setup. Its main value is fully containerized installation and automatic first-run onboarding, eliminating the need for local Node.js tooling. Key technical strengths include Docker Compose-based orchestration, secure non-root runtime, out-of-the-box multi-channel connectivity across WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, and Feishu, plus practical support for local volume mounts and Feishu long-connection configuration.

metadata.name: openfr
metadata.description: OpenFR：Multi-Agents for financial research

summary.zh: OpenFR 是面向金融投研的轻量级多智能体分析框架，基于 LangGraph 编排市场、基本面、新闻与宏观分析，并通过多空辩论与三方风控形成投资结论。项目集成 AKShare、支持多 LLM 接入、CLI 实时展示、数据回退与缓存机制，适用于股票、基金、期货及宏观研究场景。
summary.en: OpenFR is a lightweight multi-agent framework for financial research, orchestrating market, fundamentals, news, and macro analysis with LangGraph. It combines bull/bear debate and three-way risk assessment to produce structured investment recommendations. Powered by AKShare, it supports multiple LLM providers, rich CLI progress display, fallback data sources, and caching, making it suitable for stocks, funds, futures, indices, and macro research workflows.

metadata.name: obsidian-copy-to-mp
metadata.description: Obsidian插件，复制文档到微信公众号（包含图片）

summary.zh: 这是一款面向 Obsidian 的微信公众号排版复制插件，可将当前文档或选中内容一键转成公众号可直接粘贴的 HTML，并完整携带本地与网络图片。其核心价值在于免密钥、免第三方中转，显著简化知识分享与内容发布流程；同时提供 18 种内置样式、标题与元数据注入等配置，适合个人创作者与内容运营场景。
summary.en: This Obsidian plugin streamlines publishing to WeChat Official Accounts by converting the current note or selected content into paste-ready HTML, while preserving both local and remote images. Its main value lies in removing the need for third-party editors, API tokens, or account configuration, making content distribution much faster. With 18 built-in styling presets plus options to include filenames and frontmatter, it is well suited for creators, knowledge workers, and content operations workflows.

metadata.name: ticker
metadata.description: Track stocks, crypto, and derivatives prices and positions in real time from your terminal

summary.zh: Ticker 是一个 Go 终端行情看板，实时展示股票、加密货币与衍生品价格，并支持持仓、分批成本、盘前盘后报价与汇总统计。适合在命令行持续盯盘和管理仓位，亮点是轻量、配置化、跨平台安装便捷。
summary.en: Ticker is a Go-based terminal market dashboard for real-time stock, crypto, and derivatives quotes. It tracks portfolio positions with multiple cost-basis lots, supports pre/post-market data, and shows aggregate value and P/L. Ideal for lightweight, configurable monitoring in the command line.

metadata.name: bilibili-rag
metadata.description: B站收藏夹RAG知识库：收藏不吃灰，B 站收藏夹 → 语音转写 → 向量检索 → 对话问答

summary.zh: bilibili-rag 将 B 站收藏夹转化为可检索、可追溯来源的个人知识库，面向课程、访谈、演讲与播客等学习内容沉淀。项目打通扫码登录、音频转写、向量检索与 RAG 问答全流程，采用 SQLite 与 ChromaDB 本地存储，并提供音频 403 场景下的下载转码兜底与 OpenClaw Skill 集成，兼顾落地性与扩展性。
summary.en: bilibili-rag turns Bilibili favorites into a searchable, source-grounded personal knowledge base for courses, talks, interviews, and podcast-style learning content. It connects the full pipeline from QR-code login and audio transcription to vector retrieval and RAG-based Q&A, using local SQLite and ChromaDB for storage. The project also includes fallback handling for inaccessible audio URLs and an OpenClaw Skill integration, making it practical for personal knowledge workflows and local AI automation.

metadata.name: ZenSSH
metadata.description: Cross-platform SSH/Sftp/Serial client built with Tauri. 基于 Tauri 构建的全平台 SSH/Sftp/Serial 客户端

summary.zh: ZenSSH 是一款基于 Tauri 的跨平台 SSH/SFTP/串口客户端，覆盖桌面与移动端，面向开发者和运维的日常远程管理场景。项目强调轻量、稳定与易用，集成跳板机、端口转发、Socks5 代理、配置同步及基础性能监测，并提供移动端专用 Shell 键盘与文件预览编辑能力，在统一体验下兼顾多协议连接与跨端部署。
summary.en: ZenSSH is a cross-platform remote access client built with Tauri, targeting developers and DevOps users who need SSH, SFTP, and serial connectivity across desktop and mobile. It emphasizes a lightweight, stable, and streamlined experience while covering practical workflows such as bastion host access, port forwarding, SOCKS5 proxying, config sync via Gist/WebDAV, file preview and editing, and basic server monitoring. Its mobile-oriented shell keyboard and unified multi-protocol design make it especially useful for everyday remote operations.

metadata.name: Trellis
metadata.description: The best agent harness.

summary.zh: Trellis 是面向 AI 编程代理的工程化框架，通过在仓库内持久化 specs、tasks 与 workspace memory，让每次会话自动继承项目规范、任务上下文和历史决策。它适合团队协作开发与多代理场景，亮点是任务中心工作流、自动注入上下文，以及跨 14 个 AI 编码平台复用统一工程标准。
summary.en: Trellis is an engineering framework for AI coding agents that persists specs, tasks, and workspace memory directly inside a repository. It enables each new session to inherit project conventions, implementation context, and prior decisions instead of starting cold. The project targets team-based software delivery and multi-agent workflows, with standout strengths in auto-injected context, task-centric coordination, and a reusable structure that works across 14 AI coding platforms.

metadata.name: ECC
metadata.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

summary.zh: ECC 是面向 AI 编程代理的跨 harness 运行体系，整合技能模板、记忆优化、安全扫描、研究优先开发与 MCP/规则配置，服务 Codex、Claude Code、Cursor 等环境。其价值在于把零散配置升级为可复用的生产级操作系统，适合多代理协作、工程规范统一与安全治理场景。
summary.en: ECC is a cross-harness operating system for AI coding agents, packaging reusable skills, memory optimization, security scanning, research-first workflows, and MCP/rule configurations for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and more. Its core value is turning scattered prompt/config practices into a production-ready operator layer, enabling consistent multi-agent engineering, safer automation, and standardized development workflows across heterogeneous agent environments.

metadata.name: free-claude-code
metadata.description: Use Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and OpenCode and more for free (1.3B+ free tokens) from your terminal, app, IDE, or phone like OpenClaw (voice supported + ToS friendly)

summary.zh: free-claude-code 是一个面向 Claude Code 生态的 Anthropic 兼容代理，将 CLI、VS Code、JetBrains 与聊天机器人请求转发到 17 种云端或本地模型提供商。项目亮点在于按模型路由、流式响应、工具调用、/model 选择器兼容，以及集成管理后台、语音转写与远程机器人接入，适合低成本替代官方后端或统一多模型入口。
summary.en: free-claude-code is an Anthropic-compatible proxy for the Claude Code ecosystem, routing requests from the CLI, VS Code, JetBrains, and chat bots to 17 cloud or local model providers. Its key strengths are per-model routing, streaming and tool-use support, native `/model` picker compatibility, and optional admin UI, voice transcription, and remote bot integrations. It is well suited for reducing backend costs, swapping providers, or unifying access to heterogeneous coding models behind a stable client protocol.

metadata.name: jetbrains-index-mcp-plugin
metadata.description: A Jetbrains IDE IntelliJ plugin aimed to provide coding agents the ability to leverage intelliJ's indexing of the codebase

summary.zh: 这是一个将 JetBrains IDE 代码索引与重构能力通过 MCP 暴露给 AI 编码助手的 IntelliJ 插件，支持跨语言符号检索、引用追踪、诊断、层级分析与安全重命名等能力。其亮点在于复用 IDE 原生索引与 PSI 语义模型，让 Claude、Codex、Cursor 等代理获得接近开发环境级的代码理解与操作能力。
summary.en: IDE Index MCP Server is a JetBrains plugin that exposes IntelliJ-based indexing, navigation, diagnostics, and refactoring features through the Model Context Protocol for AI coding assistants. It enables tools like Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Windsurf to perform symbol lookup, reference search, hierarchy analysis, and safe rename operations using the IDE’s native index and PSI model, bringing IDE-grade code intelligence into agent workflows across multiple languages.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 JetBrains IDE 的调试器 MCP 插件，为 AI 编码助手开放可编程调试能力。它支持启动/管理调试会话、断点与条件断点、单步执行、变量查看与修改、表达式求值及线程栈导航，并通过单次调用返回丰富上下文。核心亮点是跨多款 JetBrains IDE 兼容、支持多会话和安全可配置求值，适合自主化 AI 调试与缺陷定位场景。
summary.en: Debugger MCP Server is a JetBrains IDE plugin that exposes the debugger through the Model Context Protocol, enabling AI coding assistants to control debugging programmatically. It supports launching and managing debug sessions, breakpoints and conditional breakpoints, stepping, variable inspection and mutation, expression evaluation, and stack/thread navigation. Key strengths include rich debugging context in single calls, multi-session support, configurable evaluation safety, and broad compatibility across JetBrains IDEs, making it well suited for autonomous AI-driven debugging and issue investigation workflows.

metadata.name: mini-mqtt-client
metadata.description: 一个开源的mqtt 桌面客户端工具。支持保存命令、定时循环发送和预处理脚本

summary.zh: Mini MQTT Client 是基于 Tauri 2、Vue 3 与 Rust 构建的跨平台 MQTT 桌面调试工具，面向物联网开发、设备联调与消息测试场景。它支持 MQTT 3.1.1/5.0、TLS 证书连接、多 Topic 订阅、定时循环发布及命令模板管理，并通过内置 JavaScript 预处理脚本与加密工具实现发送前转换、接收后解析等高级自动化能力。
summary.en: Mini MQTT Client is a cross-platform desktop MQTT debugging tool built with Tauri 2, Vue 3, and Rust for IoT development, device integration, and message testing workflows. It supports MQTT 3.1.1/5.0, TLS certificate-based connections, multi-topic subscriptions, scheduled and recurring publishing, and reusable command templates. Its standout capability is a built-in JavaScript preprocessing engine with cryptographic utilities for payload transformation, encryption, decryption, and post-receive parsing automation.

metadata.name: glow
metadata.description: Render markdown on the CLI, with pizzazz! 💅🏻

summary.zh: Glow 是一款用 Go 构建的终端 Markdown 阅读器，兼具交互式 TUI 与命令行渲染能力。它可自动发现本地或 Git 仓库中的 Markdown 文件，也能读取标准输入、HTTP 链接及 GitHub/GitLab 文档。项目亮点在于面向 CLI 场景优化的高性能分页、可配置换行与美观终端渲染，适合开发者在命令行中高效浏览文档与 README。
summary.en: Glow is a Go-based terminal Markdown reader that combines a polished TUI with practical CLI rendering workflows. It can discover Markdown files in local directories or Git repositories, and also read from stdin, HTTP URLs, and GitHub or GitLab sources. Its main strengths are developer-focused terminal UX, high-performance paging, configurable word wrapping, and visually refined ANSI rendering, making it ideal for reading README files and technical documentation directly inside the command line.

metadata.name: github-kb
metadata.description: GitHub Knowledge Base Manager - A Claude Code skill for managing local GitHub projects

summary.zh: 该项目以 gh CLI 与 Claude Code 为核心，构建面向 AI 仓库的本地知识库管理流程，支持仓库克隆更新、分类编目与基于代码上下文的深度研究。适用于 AI 技术选型、竞品学习、方案设计和产品孵化，亮点在于将仓库资产沉淀为可检索的 CLAUDE.md 目录，提升多项目联动分析与生成式建议效率。
summary.en: GitHub KB combines the GitHub CLI with Claude Code to build a local knowledge base for AI repositories. It supports cloning and updating repos, organizing them into a structured catalog, and enabling repository-aware analysis for technical research. The project is useful for AI stack selection, architecture study, solution design, and rapid product ideation. Its key strength is turning curated codebases into a searchable `CLAUDE.md` index that improves cross-repo reasoning and actionable implementation guidance.

metadata.name: roubao
metadata.description: Android Automation Tool Based on Vision-Language Models

summary.zh: Roubao 是一款原生 Android AI 手机自动化助手，基于 Kotlin、VLM 与多 Agent 架构，在手机端独立完成截图理解、决策与操作执行。它借助 Shizuku 获取系统级能力，无需电脑、Root 或持续 ADB 连接，适用于外卖、导航、社交等场景，并以 Tools/Skills 双层设计兼顾 DeepLink 快速委托与 GUI 自动化。
summary.en: Roubao is a native Android AI automation assistant that combines Kotlin, vision-language models, and a multi-agent architecture to understand screens, plan actions, and execute tasks directly on-device. With Shizuku-based system access, it removes the need for a PC, root, or persistent ADB workflows. Its Tools-and-Skills design supports both fast DeepLink delegation and full GUI automation, making it practical for tasks like food ordering, navigation, messaging, and other everyday app operations.

metadata.name: pdfcraft
metadata.description: PDFCraft is a free, privacy-focused PDF toolkit that runs entirely in your browser. With 90+ professional tools, you can edit, convert, merge, split, and secure your PDF files without ever uploading them to a server.

summary.zh: PDFCraft 是一款基于浏览器运行的隐私优先 PDF 工具套件，依托 Next.js、React、TypeScript 与 WebAssembly 在本地完成合并、拆分、转换、压缩和安全处理，文件无需上传。其亮点是 90+ 专业工具、可视化工作流编辑器、批处理与多语言支持，适合个人办公、文档整理及敏感文件处理场景。
summary.en: PDFCraft is a privacy-first, browser-based PDF toolkit that performs merging, splitting, conversion, compression, editing, and security tasks entirely on-device. Built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and WebAssembly, it delivers near-native performance without uploading files to servers. Its standout strengths include 90+ professional tools, a visual workflow editor for chained operations, batch processing, and multilingual support for productivity and sensitive-document use cases.
tags_zh: 浏览器端 PDF 处理

metadata.name: embedded-database-spring-test
metadata.description: A library for creating isolated embedded databases for Spring-powered integration tests.

summary.zh: 该库面向 Spring 集成测试，提供 PostgreSQL、MySQL、MariaDB、MSSQL 等隔离式嵌入数据库能力。通过 `@AutoConfigureEmbeddedDatabase` 即可接入，结合 Testcontainers、模板库复制、迁移缓存与数据源级刷新，实现毫秒级数据库重置，显著降低 Flyway/Liquibase 迁移和上下文重建开销，适合大型复杂模式测试场景。
summary.en: This library streamlines Spring integration testing by provisioning isolated embedded databases for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MSSQL, and more. With a single `@AutoConfigureEmbeddedDatabase` annotation, it integrates with Testcontainers and adds template-based cloning, migration caching, and datasource-level refresh. The result is fast, repeatable test isolation without full Spring context rebuilds, making it especially valuable for large projects with complex schemas and Flyway or Liquibase migrations.

metadata.name: AutoGLM-For-Android
metadata.description: 纯 Android 端 Open-AutoGLM 实现，无需电脑

summary.zh: AutoGLM For Android 将 Open-AutoGLM 从“电脑+ADB”迁移到纯手机端，借助 Shizuku 在 Android 原生应用内完成点击、滑动、输入等自动化操作。项目支持自然语言任务执行、视觉模型屏幕理解、悬浮窗进度反馈及多模型配置，适合打造无需电脑的端侧 AI 手机助手与移动自动化方案。
summary.en: AutoGLM For Android brings Open-AutoGLM fully onto the phone, replacing the original PC-plus-ADB workflow with a native Android app powered by Shizuku. It enables natural-language mobile task automation through screen understanding, action planning, and on-device execution, while adding floating-window feedback, history tracking, and multi-model configuration. It is well suited for standalone AI assistants and mobile UI automation without a desktop dependency.

metadata.name: AutoGLM-GUI
metadata.description: AutoGLM 的现代化 Web 图形界面 - 让 AI 自动化操作 Android 设备变得简单 已进化为你的专属自动化生产力工具

summary.zh: AutoGLM-GUI 是面向 Android 设备的 AI 自动化图形界面，将大模型、ADB 与 scrcpy 实时预览结合，支持对话式控制、多设备并发、工作流和分层代理执行。项目突出定时任务、Docker 远程部署、MCP 集成与无线配对能力，适合构建 7x24 小时运行的个人助手、运营脚本和移动端自动化中枢。
summary.en: AutoGLM-GUI is a modern web-based productivity layer for AI-driven Android automation. It combines LLM-powered task orchestration with ADB control and scrcpy-based live preview, enabling chat-driven actions, multi-device management, workflows, and layered agent execution. Key strengths include cron scheduling, Docker deployment for 24/7 operation, MCP integration, and wireless pairing, making it well suited for personal assistants, remote operations, and mobile automation hubs.

metadata.name: Open-AutoGLM
metadata.description: An Open Phone Agent Model & Framework. Unlocking the AI Phone for Everyone

summary.zh: Open-AutoGLM 是面向 Android 与 HarmonyOS 的开源 Phone Agent 框架，结合视觉语言模型、任务规划与 ADB/HDC 自动化控制，实现对手机界面的理解、决策与执行。它适用于智能助手、移动端自动化测试与流程代办，并支持敏感操作确认、验证码场景人工接管及远程设备调试。
summary.en: Open-AutoGLM is an open-source phone agent framework for Android and HarmonyOS that combines vision-language understanding, task planning, and ADB/HDC-driven device control. It enables end-to-end mobile task execution from natural language instructions, making it useful for AI assistants, mobile workflow automation, and UI testing. Key strengths include multimodal screen perception, human takeover for sensitive or verification steps, and remote device debugging support.

metadata.name: one-mcp
metadata.description: A centralized reverse-proxy platform for MCP servers — manage, group, and export as Skills from a single endpoint.

summary.zh: One MCP 是面向 MCP 服务的集中式反向代理与管理平台，提供服务发现、安装、配置、监控及分组聚合能力。项目以 Go + React 构建，支持 stdio、SSE 与 Streamable HTTP，并可将多服务统一导出为 Anthropic Skills，适用于多模型工具接入、企业内部 MCP 网关治理和可观测运维场景。
summary.en: One MCP is a centralized reverse-proxy and management platform for Model Context Protocol services. Built with Go and React, it supports stdio, SSE, and streamable HTTP MCP servers, while enabling discovery, configuration, monitoring, and service grouping behind a single endpoint. Its standout capability is exporting grouped MCP services as Anthropic Skills, making it well suited for unified tool orchestration, internal AI gateway governance, and observable multi-service MCP deployments.

metadata.name: openskills
metadata.description: Universal skills loader for AI coding agents - npm i -g openskills

summary.zh: OpenSkills 是面向 AI 编程代理的通用技能加载器，兼容 Claude Code 的 SKILL.md 与 `<available_skills>` 格式，支持从 GitHub、私有仓库或本地路径安装与同步，适合把技能随项目版本化并按需加载，保持上下文轻量。
summary.en: OpenSkills is a universal skills loader for AI coding agents, compatible with Claude Code’s SKILL.md and `<available_skills>` format. It installs and syncs skills from GitHub, private repos, or local paths, enabling repo-versioned, on-demand skill loading while keeping context lightweight.

metadata.name: lsp-skill
metadata.description: IntelliSense Designed for Coding Agent

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 AI 编程代理的 LSP 分析技能包，基于 LSAP 与语言服务器提供语义导航、跨文件引用追踪、类型感知和符号概览，帮助代理像 VS Code 一样理解代码库，适用于安全重构、定位实现与复杂仓库分析。
summary.en: An LSP analysis skill for AI coding agents, built on LSAP and standard language servers to provide semantic navigation, cross-file reference tracing, type-aware context, and symbol outlines. It helps agents understand large codebases with VS Code-like fidelity for safe refactoring, implementation lookup, and deep repository analysis.

metadata.name: notebooklm-mcp-cli
metadata.description: Programmatic access to Google NotebookLM — via command-line interface (CLI), Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and AI agent skills.

summary.zh: 该项目为 Google NotebookLM 提供可编程接入层，集成 Python CLI、MCP 服务器与 AI agent skills，使开发者可在终端或智能体中自动化完成笔记本创建、资料导入、问答、播客生成与分享配置。亮点在于同时覆盖脚本化操作与自然语言代理调用，降低 NotebookLM 融入 AI 工作流与知识管理系统的门槛。
summary.en: This repository provides a programmatic access layer for Google NotebookLM through a Python CLI, an MCP server, and AI agent skills. It enables developers and AI assistants to automate notebook creation, source ingestion, querying, audio generation, downloads, and sharing workflows. Its key strength is bridging terminal automation with natural-language agent tooling, making NotebookLM easier to integrate into knowledge workflows, developer tools, and MCP-based assistant ecosystems.

metadata.name: zedis
metadata.description: Zedis: A blazing-fast, native Redis GUI built with Rust and GPUI.

summary.zh: Zedis 是面向 Redis 场景的原生高性能桌面 GUI，基于 Rust 与 GPUI 构建，强调 GPU 渲染、超低内存占用和海量键空间下的流畅交互。它不仅支持跨平台数据库浏览，还提供自动解压、JSON/Protobuf/MessagePack 解码、专用类型视图及 Redis 模块面板，适合需要高响应、重度数据诊断与复杂 Redis 数据可视化的开发者。
summary.en: Zedis is a native high-performance Redis desktop GUI built with Rust and GPUI, designed for GPU-accelerated rendering, low memory usage, and smooth interaction across massive keyspaces. Beyond cross-platform browsing, it offers automatic decompression, smart decoding for JSON/Protobuf/MessagePack, specialized viewers for advanced Redis data types, and dedicated module panels. It is especially well suited for developers who need responsive inspection, deep diagnostics, and rich visualization of complex Redis workloads.

metadata.name: pg-aiguide
metadata.description: MCP server and Claude plugin for Postgres skills and documentation. Helps AI coding tools generate better PostgreSQL code.

summary.zh: 面向AI编程助手的PostgreSQL知识增强工具，结合MCP服务与Claude技能包，提供官方手册、TimescaleDB等文档的语义检索，并注入版本感知的最佳实践，帮助生成更准确、现代且可维护的SQL与数据库设计。
summary.en: An AI knowledge layer for PostgreSQL-focused coding assistants, combining an MCP server and Claude skills to deliver semantic search over official manuals and extension docs, plus version-aware best practices that improve SQL generation, schema design, and maintainability.

metadata.name: InvestAI
metadata.description: Say goodbye to emotional speculation and use AI to stay rational in your investing. InvestAI monitors trends, rule triggers, and risk signals, helping you focus on executing your strategy—while all decisions always remain in your hands. It doesn’t predict prices or place trades. It’s simply a calm, explainable investment monitoring assistant.

summary.zh: InvestAI 是面向普通投资者的 AI 投资监控助手，核心在于用可配置规则持续分析个股趋势、买卖触发与风险信号，帮助用户克服情绪化操作并坚持纪律化策略。它强调“AI 执行规则、人类保留决策”，不做价格预测、自动交易或黑盒荐股，亮点是可解释、可追踪、以规则执行为中心的理性投研辅助。
summary.en: InvestAI is an AI-powered investment monitoring assistant for everyday investors. Instead of predicting prices or executing trades, it continuously evaluates watched stocks against configurable rule sets to surface trend changes, entry references, and risk signals. Its key value lies in helping users stay disciplined under emotional pressure while keeping every decision human-controlled. The project stands out for its explainable, traceable rule execution model and its focus on rational long-term strategy support rather than black-box stock picking.

metadata.name: WayLog
metadata.description: WayLog - Save & Export AI Chat History. A local-first extension that turns your fleeting AI conversations into a permanent, git-friendly knowledge base.

summary.zh: WayLog 是一款面向 VS Code/Cursor 生态的本地优先扩展，可自动聚合并保存多种 AI 编程助手的聊天记录到工作区 `.waylog` 中，形成可追踪、可导出、适合 Git 管理的知识库。其亮点在于直接读取本地 SQLite/JSON 数据源、后台自动保存、跨助手统一归档，以及对隐私友好的只读处理方式。
summary.en: WayLog is a local-first VS Code/Cursor extension that captures and exports chat history from multiple AI coding assistants into a workspace-level `.waylog` knowledge base. It targets developers who want durable, git-friendly records of conversations across tools like Cursor, Copilot, and Claude Code. Key strengths include direct access to local SQLite/JSON data sources, background auto-save, unified cross-assistant aggregation, and privacy-preserving read-only processing on the user’s device.

metadata.name: wails
metadata.description: Create beautiful applications using Go

summary.zh: Wails 是一个用 Go 构建跨平台桌面应用的框架，可将 Go 后端与任意 Web 前端打包为单一原生二进制，适合工具软件、企业客户端与本地化应用开发。其亮点在于原生渲染引擎、Go/JavaScript 双向调用、自动生成 TypeScript 定义，以及集成 CLI、原生菜单、对话框与系统主题支持。
summary.en: Wails is a cross-platform desktop application framework for Go that packages a Go backend and any web frontend into a single native binary. It fits internal tools, enterprise clients, and local-first desktop apps. Key strengths include native rendering without an embedded browser, seamless Go-JavaScript interop, auto-generated TypeScript bindings, and an integrated CLI with native menus, dialogs, and system dark/light mode support.

metadata.name: goose
metadata.description: A database migration tool. Supports SQL migrations and Go functions.

summary.zh: goose 是面向 Go 生态的数据库迁移工具，兼具 CLI 与可嵌入库两种形态，适用于持续演进数据库 Schema、数据初始化与自动化发布流程。其亮点在于同时支持 SQL 与 Go 函数迁移、嵌入式迁移、乱序补迁及环境变量替换，并覆盖 Postgres、MySQL、SQLite、ClickHouse 等多种数据库，便于在多环境和多引擎场景统一管理变更。
summary.en: goose is a database migration tool for the Go ecosystem, available both as a CLI and an embeddable library. It is designed for evolving database schemas, seeding data, and automating release workflows across environments. Key strengths include support for both SQL and Go function migrations, embedded migrations, out-of-order execution, and environment variable substitution, while working across diverse databases such as Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, ClickHouse, and more.

metadata.name: jib
metadata.description: 🏗 Build container images for your Java applications.

summary.zh: Jib 是面向 Java 应用的容器镜像构建工具，提供 Maven、Gradle 插件及 Java 核心库，可在无需 Docker Daemon 和 Dockerfile 的情况下直接生成优化的 Docker/OCI 镜像。其分层构建将依赖与应用代码拆分，显著提升构建与推送效率，并通过可复现镜像与注册表直推能力，适合云原生交付、CI/CD 与企业级 Java 服务容器化。
summary.en: Jib is a container image builder for Java applications, delivered as Maven and Gradle plugins, a core Java library, and a CLI. It creates optimized Docker and OCI images without requiring a Docker daemon or handwritten Dockerfiles. By separating dependencies from application classes into distinct layers, Jib accelerates incremental builds and pushes while preserving reproducibility. It is well suited for cloud-native delivery, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise Java service containerization across diverse registries and build environments.

metadata.name: unregistry
metadata.description: Push docker images directly to remote servers without an external registry

summary.zh: Unregistry 是一款轻量级 Docker 镜像传输工具，借助临时注册表与 SSH 隧道，把本地镜像直接推送到远程 Docker 主机，仅传输缺失层。适合无外部 Registry、边缘部署和生产发布场景，兼顾速度、零维护与低带宽消耗。
summary.en: Unregistry is a lightweight Docker image transfer tool that uses a temporary registry and SSH tunneling to push local images directly to remote Docker hosts, transferring only missing layers. It fits registry-free deployments, edge servers, and production releases, balancing speed, low maintenance, and bandwidth efficiency.

metadata.name: MrRSS
metadata.description: A modern, cross-platform, and free AI RSS reader. 一个现代化、跨平台且免费的 AI RSS 阅读器.

summary.zh: MrRSS 是一款基于 Go、Wails v3 与 Vue 3 构建的跨平台 AI RSS 阅读器，面向高频信息摄取与知识整理场景。它集成自动翻译、摘要、推荐与脚本自动化能力，并通过 Obsidian、Notion、FreshRSS、RSSHub 等插件生态扩展工作流，兼顾桌面原生体验、订阅灵活性与可定制性。
summary.en: MrRSS is a cross-platform AI-powered RSS reader built with Go, Wails v3, and Vue 3 for intensive information consumption and knowledge workflows. It combines automatic translation, summarization, recommendation, and scripting-based automation, while extending functionality through integrations with Obsidian, Notion, FreshRSS, and RSSHub. The project stands out for its native desktop delivery, flexible feed subscription methods, and highly customizable plugin-driven workflow design.

metadata.name: puter
metadata.description: 🌐 The Internet Computer! Free, Open-Source, and Self-Hostable.

summary.zh: Puter 是一款开源、自托管的“互联网电脑”平台，将文件管理、在线应用、游戏与云能力整合为统一 Web 桌面。它既面向终端用户提供一站式数字工作空间，也为开发者提供 AI、对象存储、KV 数据库和 Serverless Workers，并支持应用分发与变现。
summary.en: Puter is an open-source, self-hostable “internet computer” that unifies file management, web apps, games, and cloud capabilities into a browser-based desktop platform. It serves end users as an all-in-one digital workspace while giving developers built-in AI, object storage, key-value databases, and serverless workers. Its key strengths are extensibility, local/self-host deployment, and an integrated app distribution model through its app store.

metadata.name: todo-for-ai
