metadata.description: 🤖 A comprehensive task management system specifically designed for AI assistants. Supports project management, task tracking, team collaboration, and seamless AI integration through MCP (Model Context Protocol). Built with modern tech stack including React, Flask, and Docker. Try it now at https://todo4ai.org/

summary.zh: Todo for AI 是面向 AI 助手的任务管理系统，围绕 MCP 打通 AI 与人类协作流程。它支持项目管理、任务追踪、实时协同与自动化执行，适合 AI-first 团队、开发者和产品协作场景。技术上采用 React、Flask 与 Docker，并以标准化协议实现对 Claude、GPT 等助手的原生集成与跨平台扩展。
summary.en: Todo for AI is a task management platform purpose-built for AI assistants, using MCP to connect AI agents with human workflows. It supports project management, task tracking, real-time collaboration, and autonomous task operations, making it valuable for AI-first teams, developers, and product coordination. Built with React, Flask, and Docker, it stands out through standardized AI integration, cross-assistant compatibility, and workflow automation.

metadata.name: codexmcp
metadata.description: Enable seamless collaboration between Claude Code and Codex, transforming from a single agent to multiple agents for significantly enhanced productivity!

summary.zh: CodexMCP 是连接 Claude Code 与 Codex 的 MCP 协作桥梁，将单智能体开发升级为可分工、可并行的多智能体编程流程。项目基于 Python 3.12+ 与 MCP 协议，突出会话持久化、多轮上下文管理、并行任务执行和推理追踪，适用于需求分析、架构设计、代码实现、缺陷定位与代码审查等高协同开发场景。
summary.en: CodexMCP is an MCP-based collaboration bridge between Claude Code and Codex, turning a single-agent coding workflow into a coordinated multi-agent development system. Built for Python 3.12+ environments, it adds persistent sessions, multi-turn context management, parallel task execution, and reasoning traceability beyond the official Codex MCP approach. It is well suited for architecture planning, implementation, debugging, refactoring, and code review workflows that benefit from AI role specialization.

metadata.name: agent
metadata.description: A unified Model Context Protocol server implementation that aggregates multiple MCP servers into one.

summary.zh: 1MCP 是一个统一的 Model Context Protocol 运行时，通过 `1mcp serve` 将多个 MCP 服务聚合为单一入口，并为 Codex、Claude、Cursor 等智能体提供渐进式工具发现与调用流程。其亮点在于同时解决多客户端配置分散与工具上下文膨胀问题，支持静态/模板化服务加载、过滤规则、预设与指令聚合，适合多代理、多项目的 MCP 基础设施编排。
summary.en: 1MCP is a unified Model Context Protocol runtime that aggregates multiple MCP servers behind a single `1mcp serve` endpoint and adds a CLI workflow for agents like Codex, Claude, and Cursor. Its core value is reducing both client-side configuration sprawl and excessive tool context in autonomous sessions through progressive discovery via `instructions`, `inspect`, and `run`. Key strengths include static and templated server loading, filtering, presets, and instruction aggregation for multi-agent, multi-project MCP orchestration.

metadata.name: mcp-router
metadata.description: A Unified MCP Server Management App (MCP Manager).

summary.zh: MCP Router 是面向桌面端的统一 MCP 服务器管理应用，帮助用户集中接入、组织和控制本地或远程 MCP 服务。它支持 DXT、JSON 与手动配置，可通过项目、工作区和工具级开关管理复杂上下文，并提供请求日志与统计能力。其核心亮点在于跨平台管理、一键集成主流 AI 客户端，以及数据与凭据全程本地存储的隐私设计。
summary.en: MCP Router is a desktop app for unified management of Model Context Protocol servers across local and remote environments. It supports DXT, JSON, and manual setup, while organizing growing MCP contexts through projects, workspaces, and per-tool toggles. Key strengths include cross-platform usability, one-click integration with AI clients such as Claude, Cursor, and Cline, plus detailed request logging and a privacy-first architecture that keeps data and credentials stored locally.

metadata.name: servers
metadata.description: Model Context Protocol Servers

summary.zh: 该仓库汇集 Model Context Protocol 的官方参考服务器实现，覆盖文件系统、Git、网页抓取、时间处理、记忆图谱与顺序推理等场景，重点演示如何通过多语言 MCP SDK 为大模型提供安全、可控的工具与数据访问。其价值在于为开发者提供协议能力示例、服务设计范式与教育性实现，而非生产级方案。
summary.en: This repository collects official reference implementations for the Model Context Protocol, covering use cases such as filesystem access, Git operations, web fetching, time conversion, knowledge-graph memory, and sequential reasoning. Its core value is to show developers how to use MCP SDKs across languages to expose secure, controlled tools and data sources to LLMs. The project emphasizes protocol feature coverage, server design patterns, and educational examples rather than production-ready deployments.

metadata.name: spring-boot-data-source-decorator
metadata.description: Spring Boot integration with p6spy, datasource-proxy, flexy-pool and spring-cloud-sleuth

summary.zh: 该项目为 Spring Boot 提供 DataSource 装饰器自动配置，可无侵入集成 P6Spy、datasource-proxy、FlexyPool 与 Sleuth，实现 SQL 拦截、连接调用跟踪、链路观测及连接池指标采集。相比手工包装数据源，它保留 Spring Boot 配置属性能力，并支持通过 application.yml 按需启停与定制代理。
summary.en: This repository delivers Spring Boot auto-configuration for decorating DataSource beans with P6Spy, datasource-proxy, FlexyPool, and Spring Cloud Sleuth. It enables non-invasive SQL interception, JDBC call tracing, observability integration, and connection-pool metrics without manually wrapping datasources. A key advantage is preserving native Spring Boot configuration properties while allowing feature toggling and proxy customization through standard application properties and Spring beans.

metadata.name: serena
metadata.description: A powerful MCP toolkit for coding, providing semantic retrieval and editing capabilities  - the IDE for your agent

summary.zh: Serena 是面向编码代理的 MCP 工具套件，提供符号级代码检索、编辑、重构与调试能力，适合大型多语言代码库的跨文件导航和语义化修改。它通过 IDE 式抽象替代低效文本操作，让代理在复杂工程中更快、更稳地完成代码变更。
summary.en: Serena is an MCP toolkit built for coding agents, delivering symbol-level code retrieval, editing, refactoring, and debugging. It fits large multi-language codebases where cross-file navigation and semantic changes matter, replacing brittle text-based workflows with IDE-like abstractions for faster and more reliable agentic development.

metadata.name: dart_simple_live
metadata.description: 简简单单的看直播

summary.zh: 这是一个基于 Flutter 与 Dart 的跨平台直播观看应用，面向移动端、桌面端和 Android TV，聚合虎牙、斗鱼、B站、抖音等平台直播内容。项目以 `simple_live_core` 为核心，统一封装直播信息抓取、真实流地址解析与弹幕协议处理，兼顾多端复用、控制台调试和 TV 场景适配。
summary.en: Simple Live is a cross-platform live streaming client built with Flutter and Dart for mobile, desktop, and Android TV. It aggregates live content from Huya, Douyu, Bilibili, and Douyin, while centering on the reusable `simple_live_core` library for stream metadata fetching, real playback URL extraction, and danmaku protocol handling. Its architecture highlights shared core logic, multi-client reuse, and practical support for both app and TV experiences.

metadata.name: EasyGBD
metadata.description: GB28181设备端实现库，支持GB28181 2016和2022版本所有功能，支持实时视频、云台控制、位置订阅与通知、图像抓拍、语音广播/对讲、历史音视频回放等能力。

summary.zh: EasyGBD 是面向安防与视频物联场景的 GB28181 设备端库，完整支持 2016/2022 国标能力，覆盖实时视频、语音对讲、云台控制、订阅通知、抓拍及历史回放。其核心亮点在于自研 SIP 协议栈、ES 转 PS 封装、多编码与多信号源接入、RTSP/RTMP/SRT 转国标流，以及跨平台与嵌入式友好集成能力。
summary.en: EasyGBD is a professional GB28181 device-side library for surveillance and video IoT scenarios, with full support for the 2016 and 2022 standards. It covers live streaming, PTZ control, voice talk/broadcast, event subscription, snapshot capture, and historical playback. Key strengths include a self-developed SIP stack, real-time ES-to-PS packaging, multi-codec and multi-source input support, RTSP/RTMP/SRT to GB28181 stream conversion, and strong cross-platform portability for embedded integration.

metadata.name: AFFiNE
metadata.description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.

summary.zh: AFFiNE 是面向知识管理与协作创作的一体化工作空间，将文档、白板、表格与演示在同一块无限画布上融合，提供本地优先、实时协同与自托管能力。其亮点在于块级内容自由编排、多模态 AI 辅助创作，以及作为 Notion 与 Miro 替代方案的开源可定制架构。
summary.en: AFFiNE is an all-in-one workspace for knowledge management and collaborative creation, unifying docs, whiteboards, tables, and presentations on a single edgeless canvas. Its key strengths include local-first data ownership, real-time collaboration, self-hosting, and multimodal AI assistance. As an open-source alternative to Notion and Miro, it stands out with block-based composition, cross-mode content fusion, and a customizable architecture for creative workflows.

metadata.name: tio
metadata.description: a tiny iothub, simple and useful.  轻量的 iothub，用经典的物模型简化 iot 应用开发

summary.zh: tio 是面向私有化部署场景的轻量 IoTHub 核心实现，以经典物模型为中心，提供 Thing 管理、MQTT 连接、设备影子、Direct Method 与 Job 编排能力。项目以单二进制低成本部署为亮点，兼容内置 Broker 与 EMQX，支持类 SQL 的 Shadow 查询，适合中小规模物联网项目、边缘环境及需降低云厂商绑定成本的设备接入场景。
summary.en: tio is a lightweight IoTHub core designed for private deployment, centered on the classic device model abstraction. It provides Thing management, MQTT connectivity, device shadow, direct methods, and job orchestration to simplify device-cloud interaction. Its key strengths are low-cost single-binary deployment, support for both built-in MQTT broker and EMQX, and SQL-like shadow querying. It is well suited for small to mid-scale IoT systems, edge environments, and teams seeking production-ready IoT capabilities without public cloud lock-in.

metadata.name: server
metadata.description: The fully compliant, embeddable high-performance Go MQTT v5 server for IoT, smarthome, and pubsub

summary.zh: Mochi-MQTT Server 是面向 IoT、智能家居与遥测系统的高性能 Go MQTT Broker，支持独立部署或嵌入应用。项目完整兼容 MQTT v5，并兼容 v3.1.1/v3，具备 Hook 插件体系、可扩展认证与 ACL、内置多种持久化后端，以及 TCP/WebSocket/TLS 接入能力，适合构建低延迟、可定制的发布订阅消息基础设施。
summary.en: Mochi-MQTT Server is a high-performance embeddable MQTT broker written in Go for IoT, telemetry, smart home, and pub/sub systems. It fully implements MQTT v5 with backward compatibility for v3.1.1 and v3, and can run as either a standalone server or an embedded library. Key strengths include a hook-based extension model, built-in persistence backends, rule-based authentication and ACL support, and multi-transport connectivity over TCP, WebSocket, and TLS.

metadata.name: pagescms
metadata.description: The simplest CMS you'll ever need. Manage content and media right in your GitHub repository.

summary.zh: Pages CMS 是面向 GitHub 仓库的开源内容管理系统，适合 Jekyll、Hugo、Next.js、Astro 等静态站点与内容型应用。它支持直接在仓库中管理内容和媒体，既可使用托管版，也可本地自建。核心亮点在于以 GitHub App 为集成中心，结合 PostgreSQL 与本地开发工具链，实现轻量化、面向 Git 工作流的内容编辑体验。
summary.en: Pages CMS is an open-source CMS built for GitHub repositories, designed for static sites and content-driven apps using Jekyll, Hugo, Next.js, Astro, VuePress, and similar stacks. It enables teams to manage content and media directly in-repo, with both hosted and self-hosted usage options. Its key strengths are GitHub App–centric integration, Git-native editorial workflows, and a lightweight local setup powered by PostgreSQL for flexible development and deployment.

metadata.name: tab-hive
metadata.description: Tab Hive, 网页蜂巢化

summary.zh: Tab Hive（全视界）是一个基于 Vue 3 与 Vite 的纯前端多网页聚合工具，可将多个站点以可配置 Grid 方式集中展示，并支持全屏聚焦、CSS 选择器裁剪、多布局场景切换与自动持久化。项目同时提供布局分享、URL 参数导入、实时同步，以及 Chrome 扩展和 Electron 桌面端，适合信息监控、内容消费与多任务工作台场景。
summary.en: Tab Hive is a Vue 3 and Vite based web aggregation tool that lets users organize multiple websites in a configurable grid workspace. It supports focused fullscreen viewing, CSS selector based content isolation, multi-layout switching, and automatic persistence. The project also adds layout sharing, URL-based import, real-time sync, plus Chrome extension and Electron desktop support, making it well suited for dashboards, content monitoring, multitasking, and personalized browsing workspaces.

metadata.name: opentelemetry-java-instrumentation
metadata.description: OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation and instrumentation libraries for Java

summary.zh: 该仓库提供面向 Java 8+ 应用的 OpenTelemetry 自动埋点方案，核心是基于 `-javaagent` 的字节码增强，可在几乎零代码改造下采集链路、指标等遥测数据。其亮点在于覆盖主流框架与中间件、支持 OTLP/Zipkin 等导出协议，并提供可扩展的独立 instrumentation 库，适用于云原生可观测性建设与存量 Java 系统接入。
summary.en: This repository delivers OpenTelemetry auto-instrumentation for Java 8+ applications through a `-javaagent` that performs runtime bytecode weaving to capture traces and other telemetry with little to no code change. Its key strengths are broad support for popular libraries, frameworks, and app servers, flexible configuration via JVM flags or environment variables, and built-in exporter support such as OTLP and Zipkin. It is well suited for cloud-native observability rollouts and modernizing telemetry in existing Java services.

metadata.name: garage
metadata.description: (Mirror) S3-compatible object store for small self-hosted geo-distributed deployments. Main repo: https://git.deuxfleurs.fr/Deuxfleurs/garage

summary.zh: Garage 是面向中小规模自托管场景的 S3 兼容分布式对象存储，强调跨地域节点部署下的数据复制、故障容忍与持续可用。项目主打轻量化、易运维和高韧性，适合多机房或边缘环境构建私有对象存储服务，并已在真实生产环境长期运行验证。
summary.en: Garage is an S3-compatible distributed object store built for small to medium self-hosted deployments. It is optimized for geo-distributed clusters, enabling data replication across locations while remaining available during server outages or network partitions. The project emphasizes lightweight operations, operational simplicity, and resilience to machine failures, making it well suited for private object storage in multi-site or edge environments and proven through long-term production use.

metadata.name: garage-webui
metadata.description: WebUI for Garage Object Storage Service

summary.zh: garage-webui 是面向 Garage 对象存储的轻量级管理控制台，提供集群健康监控、布局管理、Bucket 与对象浏览、访问密钥分配等核心运维能力。项目以单二进制与 Docker 镜像交付，兼容 Garage 配置自动读取，并支持通过环境变量接入，适合自托管 S3 兼容存储的可视化管理与日常运维。
summary.en: garage-webui is a lightweight admin console for Garage, a self-hosted S3-compatible distributed object storage service. It covers core operational workflows including cluster health monitoring, layout management, bucket administration, object browsing, and access key assignment. Delivered as a single binary and Docker image, it can auto-load Garage configuration or be wired through environment variables, making it practical for visual management of self-hosted object storage deployments.

metadata.name: term.everything
metadata.description: Run any GUI app in the terminal❗

summary.zh: term.everything 是一款用 Go 编写的 Linux 命令行工具，通过自研 Wayland compositor 将 GUI 应用渲染到终端中，支持 X11/Wayland 主机与 SSH 场景。它可在普通字符终端或支持图像协议的终端中运行浏览器、文件管理器乃至桌面环境，亮点在于跨显示协议兼容、远程传输能力和“GUI 进终端”的独特交互形态。
summary.en: term.everything is a Linux CLI tool, now written in Go, that runs GUI applications inside a terminal by implementing a custom Wayland compositor targeting terminal output instead of a physical display. It works on both X11 and Wayland hosts, supports remote usage over SSH, and can render through text cells or image-capable terminals like Kitty and iTerm2. Its key value lies in terminal-native GUI streaming, protocol-level display innovation, and unusually portable remote interaction.

metadata.name: docker-pull-tar
metadata.description: 无需 Docker 环境，就能直接搜索、下载多架构（如 arm、x86）的 Docker 镜像并保存为 tar 包。Search and download multi-architecture (e.g., arm, x86) Docker images directly as tar files without needing a Docker environment.

summary.zh: docker-pull-tar 是一款脱离 Docker 运行时的镜像离线打包工具，可搜索并下载多架构镜像，直接生成 tar 包，适合内网分发、跨架构部署与镜像备份。项目兼容 Docker Registry API，支持断点续传、失败重试、SHA256 校验、多线程下载，并提供 1ms 搜索增强版与基于 Gradio 的可视化 Web 管理界面。
summary.en: docker-pull-tar is a Dockerless image pulling and offline packaging tool that searches, downloads, and exports multi-architecture container images as tar archives. It is well suited for air-gapped delivery, cross-platform deployment, and image backup workflows. Key strengths include Docker Registry API compatibility, resume support, retry logic, SHA256 verification, concurrent layer downloads, plus both a 1ms search-enhanced CLI and a Gradio-based web UI for visual image management.

metadata.name: BeidouGridCodec
metadata.description: 北斗网格码的编解码，包含二维和三维的编解码

summary.zh: 这是一个基于 GB/T 39409-2020 的 Java 北斗网格码编解码库，提供二维/三维坐标与高度的标准化编码解码能力。项目采用模块化架构，包含缓存优化、异常处理和完整测试，并扩展了面向 Polygon、Point、LineString 的空间相交查询与三维线查询，适用于 GIS 集成、空间索引、地理围栏和网格化分析。
summary.en: BeidouGridCodec is a Java library implementing the GB/T 39409-2020 Beidou grid code standard for 2D and 3D coordinate encoding and decoding, including altitude support. It features a modular architecture, cache-oriented performance optimization, robust error handling, and solid test coverage. Beyond basic codec functions, it adds geometry-driven spatial intersection queries and efficient 3D line-grid querying for GIS integration, geofencing, spatial indexing, and gridded spatial analysis.

metadata.name: poi-tl
metadata.description: Generate awesome word(docx) with template

summary.zh: poi-tl 是基于 Apache POI 的 Word 模板引擎，用数据驱动生成并精确保留样式的 docx 文档。它采用无逻辑标签体系，支持文本、图片、表格、图表、条件渲染、循环、Markdown、代码高亮及插件扩展，适用于合同、报告、通知、公文等企业级文档自动化场景。
summary.en: poi-tl is a Word templating engine built on Apache POI for generating styled DOCX documents from data while preserving template formatting. Its logic-less tag model supports text, images, tables, charts, conditional blocks, loops, Markdown conversion, code highlighting, and extensible plugins, making it well suited for automated document generation in contracts, reports, notices, and enterprise workflow systems.

metadata.name: tinystruct
metadata.description: A lightweight, modular Java application framework for web and CLI development,         designed for AI integration and plugin-based architecture.         Enabling developers to create robust solutions with ease for building efficient and scalable applications.

summary.zh: tinystruct 是一个面向 Java 17+ 的轻量级模块化应用框架，统一支持 Web 与 CLI 开发，并通过注解驱动的 Action 机制实现命令与 HTTP 路由映射。其插件化架构与 AI 集成导向适合快速构建工具型应用、自动化服务和可扩展业务系统，兼顾易用性、性能与工程化启动效率。
summary.en: tinystruct is a lightweight, modular Java 17+ application framework for both web and CLI development. It uses an annotation-driven Action model to map commands and HTTP endpoints within a unified programming style. With plugin-oriented extensibility and an AI-integration focus, it fits automation tools, service backends, and extensible business apps that need fast setup, clean structure, and efficient runtime performance.

metadata.name: everything-ai-chat
metadata.description: 一个现代化的 Everything 搜索客户端，将 AI 智能与极速本地搜索完美结合。

summary.zh: Everything AI Chat 是面向 Windows 的现代化本地文件搜索客户端，将 Everything 的毫秒级索引能力与 AI 自然语言理解结合，支持把“今天的PDF”“大于10MB的视频”等意图转换为精确搜索语法。项目亮点在于一键连接 Everything、自动配置 HTTP 服务、多语言界面，以及基于 Electron + Vue 3 的桌面化搜索体验。
summary.en: Everything AI Chat is a modern Windows desktop client that combines Everything’s ultra-fast local file indexing with AI-powered natural language query understanding. It converts requests like “PDFs from today” or “videos larger than 10MB” into precise Everything search syntax, making advanced file retrieval much easier. Key strengths include one-click Everything discovery and configuration, automated HTTP service setup, multilingual UI, and a polished Electron + Vue 3 desktop experience.

metadata.name: xianyu-auto-reply
metadata.description: 闲鱼自动回复管理系统是一个基于 Python + FastAPI 开发的自动化客服系统，专为闲鱼平台设计。系统通过 WebSocket 连接闲鱼服务器，实时接收和处理消息，提供智能化的自动回复服务。同时集成闲鱼自动发货，自动评价，自动擦亮等功能，实现闲鱼虚拟商品自动化流程。

summary.zh: 该项目是面向闲鱼平台的多账号自动化运营系统，采用 FastAPI、React、MySQL、Redis 与 Playwright 构建，覆盖实时消息接入、关键词与 AI 自动回复、自动发货、自动评价、商品发布及返佣选品等流程。其亮点在于 WebSocket 实时通信、多服务拆分架构，以及将客服、履约与营销任务整合为可部署的自动化闭环。
summary.en: This repository delivers a multi-account automation system for Xianyu, built with FastAPI, React, MySQL, Redis, and Playwright. It handles real-time messaging through WebSocket, keyword and AI-based auto-replies, automated delivery, reviews, product listing, and affiliate-style product operations. Key strengths include its service-splitting architecture, browser automation for account workflows, and an end-to-end operational pipeline that unifies customer support, fulfillment, and promotional publishing.

metadata.name: mcp-toolbox
metadata.description: MCP Toolbox for Databases is an open source MCP server for databases.

summary.zh: MCP Toolbox for Databases 是面向数据库的开源 MCP 服务器，帮助 AI 代理、IDE 和 CLI 直接连接企业数据源。它既提供开箱即用的通用工具，也支持构建受控的自定义工具，用于安全查询、模式探索和 NL2SQL 场景，适合生产级数据访问与智能应用集成。
summary.en: MCP Toolbox for Databases is an open-source MCP server that connects AI agents, IDEs, and CLIs directly to enterprise databases. It offers ready-to-use generic tools and a framework for building secure custom tools, enabling safe SQL execution, schema exploration, and NL2SQL workflows for production-grade data access.

metadata.name: iPlay
metadata.description: Enjoy Media Everywhere, On Every Platform 👀

summary.zh: iPlay 是一款面向 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS 及 XBox 的跨平台现代媒体播放器，聚焦 Emby 与 Jellyfin 私有媒体库访问。项目集成 mpv、VLC、ExoPlayer 等多播放器内核，支持多站点切换、音频播放与自定义字体，适合打造统一的家庭影音与个人媒体中心体验。
summary.en: iPlay is a modern cross-platform media player for Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, and Xbox, built for accessing self-hosted media libraries through Emby and Jellyfin. It integrates multiple playback engines including mpv, VLC, and ExoPlayer, while offering multi-site switching, audio playback, and customizable fonts. The project is well suited for unified home theater and personal media center experiences across devices.

metadata.name: cap-server
metadata.description: capjs的java后端实现

summary.zh: CAP Server 是 capjs 服务端模块的 Java 实现，面向 Java 17+ 场景提供挑战生成、兑换校验与一次性 CapToken 验证能力。项目通过 CapManager 抽象统一配置挑战难度、数量、过期时间及令牌策略，默认内存存储并支持自定义 CapStore，适合在 Spring Boot 等后端中快速集成人机验证与防刷流程。
summary.en: CAP Server is a Java 17+ implementation of the capjs server module, designed for backend challenge generation, redemption validation, and one-time CapToken verification. It exposes a configurable `CapManager` to tune challenge size, count, difficulty, expiration, and token policies, while using in-memory storage by default and supporting custom `CapStore` implementations. It fits Spring Boot and similar Java services that need bot mitigation, proof-of-work style validation, or anti-abuse request gating.

metadata.name: cap
metadata.description: Free, open-source and self-hosted CAPTCHA alternative to reCAPTCHA. Privacy-first and powered by proof-of-work and instrumentation challenges.

summary.zh: Cap 是一个可自托管的开源 CAPTCHA 替代方案，以工作量证明和浏览器行为检测替代图片识别挑战，兼顾隐私、可访问性与接入效率。其前端体积仅约 20KB、零依赖、支持后台无感验证，并可通过 Docker 独立部署，适用于登录、注册、表单提交等反滥用场景。
summary.en: Cap is a self-hosted, open-source CAPTCHA alternative that replaces visual puzzles with proof-of-work and browser instrumentation challenges. It emphasizes privacy, accessibility, and fast integration with a zero-dependency client of about 20 KB. With Docker-based standalone deployment, background verification, and flexible UI customization, it fits login, signup, and form protection scenarios without relying on user tracking or image-based tests.

metadata.name: cap-worker
metadata.description: Cap backend server build on Cloudflare worker, modern open-source CAPTCHA alternative using SHA-256 proof-of-work.

summary.zh: cap-worker 是基于 Cloudflare Workers 与 Durable Objects 构建的验证码后端，以 SHA-256 工作量证明替代传统图形验证码。它面向表单防刷、接口防滥用等场景，具备全球边缘低延迟、强一致挑战状态管理、自动扩缩容和隐私友好等特点，适合快速集成到 Web 应用。
summary.en: cap-worker is a CAPTCHA backend built on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects, using SHA-256 proof-of-work instead of traditional image challenges. It targets bot mitigation for forms, APIs, and abuse-prone endpoints, combining edge-low latency, strongly consistent challenge lifecycle management, automatic scaling, and privacy-first design. It is especially suited for developers seeking a lightweight, modern, easily integrated CAPTCHA alternative.

metadata.name: obsidian-smart-connections
metadata.description: Find related notes and excerpts while writing. Your link building copilot displays relevant content in graph + list view. A local embedding model powers semantic search. Zero setup. No API key.

summary.zh: Smart Connections 是面向 Obsidian 用户的本地优先语义关联插件，利用内置嵌入模型在写作过程中实时发现相关笔记与摘录，并以图谱和列表视图呈现。它免 API Key、离线可用、支持移动端，适合研究、写作与知识管理场景，突出轻量依赖、隐私友好和零配置体验。
summary.en: Smart Connections is a local-first semantic discovery plugin for Obsidian that surfaces related notes and excerpts while you write. Powered by a bundled embedding model, it provides graph and list views for contextual link building without API keys or cloud setup. It is built for researchers, writers, and heavy note-takers who need faster retrieval, stronger knowledge connections, offline privacy, mobile support, and a lightweight, auditable architecture.

metadata.name: playwright-mcp
metadata.description: Playwright MCP server

summary.zh: Playwright MCP 是面向 MCP 客户端的浏览器自动化服务器，基于 Playwright 以结构化无障碍树驱动网页交互，避免依赖截图和视觉模型。它适合探索式自动化、自愈测试与长时代理流程，兼具轻量、确定性强和对 LLM 友好的优势，可在保持持续浏览器上下文的同时提升推理与执行稳定性。
summary.en: Playwright MCP is a browser automation server for Model Context Protocol clients, built on Playwright and powered by structured accessibility snapshots instead of screenshots or vision models. It targets exploratory automation, self-healing testing, and long-running agent workflows where persistent browser state matters. Its core strengths are lightweight operation, deterministic tool usage, and an LLM-friendly interaction model that improves reliability and reduces ambiguity.

metadata.name: deepchat
metadata.description: 🐬DeepChat - A smart assistant that connects powerful AI to your personal world

summary.zh: DeepChat 是一款开源桌面 AI Agent 平台，整合多模型对话、MCP 工具调用、可安装 Skills、ACP 代理接入与消息端远程控制。它兼容 OpenAI、Gemini、Anthropic 及 Ollama 等生态，适用于个人助理、自动化工作流和本地智能应用，亮点在于统一模型、工具与代理运行时。
summary.en: DeepChat is an open-source desktop AI agent platform that unifies multi-LLM chat, MCP-based tool calling, installable Skills, ACP agent integration, and remote control from messaging apps. It works across OpenAI-, Gemini-, Anthropic-compatible APIs and local Ollama deployments, making it suitable for personal assistants, workflow automation, and local AI productivity. Its key strength is combining models, tools, and agent runtimes in one cohesive workspace.

metadata.name: postgres-mcp
metadata.description: Postgres MCP Pro provides configurable read/write access and performance analysis for you and your AI agents.

summary.zh: Postgres MCP Pro 是面向 AI 代理与开发者的 Postgres MCP 服务器，提供可配置读写控制、安全 SQL 执行、模式感知查询生成，以及 EXPLAIN 分析、假设索引模拟和索引调优能力。它覆盖开发、测试到生产优化全流程，并支持 stdio 与 SSE 传输，适合数据库诊断、性能治理和智能数据访问场景。
summary.en: Postgres MCP Pro is an open-source Model Context Protocol server for PostgreSQL that gives AI agents and developers configurable read/write access, safe SQL execution, and schema-aware query assistance. Its standout capabilities include EXPLAIN plan analysis, hypothetical index simulation, index tuning, and database health diagnostics. Supporting both stdio and SSE transports, it fits workflows spanning development, testing, deployment, and production performance optimization.

metadata.name: chatmcp
metadata.description: ChatMCP is an AI chat client implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

summary.zh: ChatMCP 是一款跨平台 AI 聊天客户端，围绕 Model Context Protocol 构建，支持桌面、移动端与 Web。它集成 MCP 工具调用、stdio/SSE 连接、局域网数据同步，以及 LaTeX、Mermaid、HTML 预览和图像生成等能力，适合需要统一接入多模型与多工具工作流的个人与开发者使用。
summary.en: ChatMCP is a cross-platform AI chat client built around the Model Context Protocol, available on desktop, mobile, and web. It combines MCP tool integration, stdio/SSE connectivity, LAN-based data sync, and rich rendering features such as LaTeX, Mermaid, HTML preview, and image generation. It is well suited for individuals and developers who need a unified interface for multi-model conversations and tool-augmented AI workflows.

metadata.name: Ghosten-Player
metadata.description: 一个视频播放器，支持网盘直连、元数据刮削、IPTV、文件管理等 /   A video player that supports direct connection to network disk, metadata scraping, IPTV, file management, etc.

summary.zh: Ghosten Player 是面向 Android 手机与电视的本地化视频播放器，聚合网盘直连、Emby/Jellyfin 接入、IPTV 播放与媒体刮削能力。项目以无后端、轻量体积和多端适配为亮点，支持字幕、倍速、DLNA、EPG、多账号及文件管理，适合搭建个人影视库与家庭流媒体中心。
summary.en: Ghosten Player is a lightweight video player for Android phones and TVs, built for personal media libraries and home streaming scenarios. It combines direct cloud-drive access, Emby/Jellyfin integration, IPTV playback, and automatic metadata scraping without requiring a backend service. Key strengths include multi-account support, subtitle handling, DLNA casting, EPG, file management, adaptive playback controls, and a compact local-first architecture.

metadata.name: file-transfer-go
metadata.description: Go/React开发的端到端webrtc的文件传输/文字传输/桌面共享，安全，隐私，数据不经过服务器。

summary.zh: 这是一个基于 Go 与 Next.js/React 构建的端到端文件快传工具，利用 WebRTC DataChannel 实现文件、文本与桌面共享的 P2P 直连传输，数据不落服务器，兼顾隐私与低延迟。项目结合 WebSocket 信令、断点续传、目录同步与响应式界面，适合局域网/跨网文件分发、临时协作分享及轻量远程演示场景。
summary.en: File Transfer Go is an end-to-end P2P transfer tool built with Go and Next.js/React, using WebRTC DataChannel for direct file, text, and screen-sharing delivery without routing payloads through the server. It combines WebSocket signaling, resumable large-file transfer, folder sync, and responsive multi-device UX. The project is well suited for privacy-sensitive file exchange, ad hoc collaboration, cross-network sharing, and lightweight remote presentation scenarios.

metadata.name: astro
metadata.description: The web framework for content-driven websites. ⭐️ Star to support our work!

summary.zh: Astro 是面向内容驱动网站的现代 Web 框架，强调“开发体验强、产物极轻”。它支持静态站点、博客、文档、营销站等场景，通过组件岛架构按需激活交互，并集成 React、Vue、Svelte 等主流前端生态，兼顾高性能渲染、低前端负载与多平台部署能力。
summary.en: Astro is a modern web framework built for content-driven sites, combining a strong developer experience with extremely lightweight output. It fits blogs, documentation, marketing pages, and static-first web apps, using an islands architecture to hydrate interactivity only where needed. Astro also integrates with major UI frameworks like React, Vue, and Svelte, enabling high-performance rendering, minimal client-side JavaScript, and flexible deployment targets.

metadata.name: read-frog
metadata.description: 🐸 Read Frog - Language Learning & Translate | 🐸 陪读蛙 - 语言学习与翻译

summary.zh: Read Frog 是一款面向浏览器的开源 AI 沉浸式语言学习扩展，聚焦网页双语阅读、划词翻译、上下文感知解析与字幕翻译。项目支持 20+ AI 提供商、TTS 与批量请求，兼顾学习深度与使用效率，适用于外语阅读、内容精读、视频理解及个性化语言训练场景。
summary.en: Read Frog is an open-source AI-powered browser extension for immersive language learning. It combines bilingual web reading, selection-based translation, context-aware analysis, and subtitle translation to turn everyday browsing into structured study. With support for 20+ AI providers, text-to-speech, and batch requests, it fits foreign-language reading, close article study, video comprehension, and personalized learning workflows.

metadata.name: systeminformer
metadata.description: A free, powerful, multi-purpose tool that helps you monitor system resources, debug software and detect malware. Brought to you by Winsider Seminars & Solutions, Inc. @ https://windows-internals.com

summary.zh: System Informer 是面向 Windows 10+ 的高级系统监控与诊断工具，集进程、网络、磁盘、服务与堆栈追踪于一体，适用于性能分析、故障排查与恶意软件侦测。其亮点在于实时资源可视化、内核/WOW64/.NET 堆栈支持、文件占用定位以及便携免安装设计。
summary.en: System Informer is an advanced Windows 10+ system inspection and diagnostics tool that unifies process, network, disk, service, and stack-trace analysis. It is well suited for performance troubleshooting, software debugging, and malware detection. Key strengths include real-time resource visualization, kernel/WOW64/.NET stack support, file lock discovery, and a portable no-install architecture.

metadata.name: Pake
metadata.description: 🤱🏻 Turn any webpage into a desktop app with one command.

summary.zh: Pake 是一个基于 Rust 与 Tauri 的网页转桌面应用打包工具，可将任意网站一键生成 macOS、Windows、Linux 原生应用。它以约 5MB 的轻量体积、低内存占用和更快启动速度替代传统 Electron 方案，并提供 CLI、在线构建、图标与窗口配置、快捷键、拖拽及样式定制等能力，适合个人工具封装、内容平台桌面化和跨平台快速分发。
summary.en: Pake is a Rust and Tauri-based packaging tool that turns any website into a native desktop app for macOS, Windows, and Linux with a single command. Compared with Electron-style solutions, it delivers much smaller binaries, faster startup, and lower memory usage. It supports CLI and online builds, plus icon and window customization, shortcuts, drag-and-drop, ad removal, and style tweaks, making it well suited for personal web app wrapping, cross-platform desktop distribution, and lightweight productivity clients.

metadata.name: gitingest
metadata.description: Replace 'hub' with 'ingest' in any GitHub URL to get a prompt-friendly extract of a codebase

summary.zh: Gitingest 将 GitHub 仓库或本地目录转换为适合大模型读取的结构化文本摘要，并支持把任意 GitHub 链接中的“hub”替换为“ingest”快速访问结果。项目提供 CLI、Python 包与可自托管服务，能输出目录结构、内容提取规模和 token 统计，适合代码审阅、仓库理解、提示词构建与私有仓库上下文整理。
summary.en: Gitingest turns GitHub repositories or local directories into structured, prompt-friendly text extracts for LLM workflows. Its standout UX is simple: replace “hub” with “ingest” in any GitHub URL to instantly access a digest. The project ships as a CLI, Python package, and self-hostable service, while reporting repository structure, extract size, and token counts. It is especially useful for codebase understanding, review automation, prompt construction, and preparing context from private repositories.

metadata.name: LearnOpenGL-CN
metadata.description: http://learnopengl.com 系列教程的简体中文翻译

summary.zh: 该仓库是 LearnOpenGL 教程的简体中文翻译与持续校订工程，面向 OpenGL 学习者、图形学入门者和教学场景。项目以 MkDocs 构建静态文档站，结合统一样式指南、章节化 Markdown 组织和协作翻译流程，重点解决新版教程代码变更、术语统一、排版重构与未完成章节补译等问题。
summary.en: This repository is a Simplified Chinese translation and ongoing revision effort for the LearnOpenGL tutorial series, targeting OpenGL learners, graphics beginners, and educational use. It builds a static documentation site with MkDocs, using structured Markdown, a translation style guide, and a contributor workflow. Its main value lies in localizing modern OpenGL learning content while addressing updated sample code, terminology consistency, formatting refactors, and unfinished chapter translations.

metadata.name: vsgCs
metadata.description: Cesium client for VSG

summary.zh: vsgCs 是面向 Vulkan Scene Graph 的 Cesium/3D Tiles 接入库，借助 Cesium Native 实现地理空间内容流式加载，可在 VSG 场景中接入 Cesium ion 资产、整球地形、glTF 瓦片与多图层影像覆盖。其价值在于把高性能 Vulkan 渲染与在线三维地理内容无缝结合，适合数字孪生、地球可视化与专业三维 GIS 应用。
summary.en: vsgCs is a Cesium and 3D Tiles integration library for Vulkan Scene Graph, enabling streamed geospatial content inside VSG applications through Cesium Native. It supports Cesium ion assets, whole-Earth terrain paging, glTF-based 3D Tiles, multiple tilesets, and layered imagery overlays with per-layer alpha control. Its core value is bridging high-performance Vulkan rendering with online geospatial streaming, making it well suited for digital twins, globe visualization, and advanced 3D GIS workloads.

metadata.name: massCode
metadata.description: A free, open-source developer workspace. Snippets, notes, HTTP requests, calculations, and dev tools in one local-first app.

summary.zh: massCode 是面向开发者的本地优先工作台，将代码片段、Markdown 笔记、HTTP 请求、计算与绘图工具整合到统一桌面应用中。其核心优势是数据以纯 Markdown 保存在本机，兼顾可移植性、可读性与隐私控制，适合个人知识管理、接口调试和日常研发素材沉淀。
summary.en: massCode is a local-first developer workspace that unifies code snippets, Markdown notes, HTTP requests, calculations, drawings, and utility tools in one desktop app. Its main strength is storing user data as plain Markdown files on the local machine, which improves portability, transparency, and privacy. It fits personal knowledge management, API exploration, and everyday development asset organization across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

metadata.name: prompty
metadata.description: Prompty makes it easy to create, manage, debug, and evaluate LLM prompts for your AI applications.  Prompty is an asset class and format for LLM prompts designed to enhance observability, understandability, and portability for developers.

summary.zh: Prompty 是面向 LLM 应用的提示词资产格式与运行时体系，以 `.prompty` Markdown 文件统一定义提示、模型连接和模板解析流程，可在 VS Code、Python 与 TypeScript 中复用执行。其亮点在于跨语言可移植、可观测追踪、实时预览与调试，以及对 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Foundry 等多模型提供方的集成支持。
summary.en: Prompty is an asset format and runtime framework for LLM prompts that uses `.prompty` Markdown files to define prompts, model connections, and templating in one portable artifact. It enables the same prompt to run across VS Code, Python, and TypeScript, while improving observability and developer workflow through live preview, tracing, debugging, and support for multiple providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Microsoft Foundry.

metadata.name: Unla
metadata.description: 🧩 MCP Gateway - A lightweight gateway service that instantly transforms existing MCP Servers and APIs into MCP servers with zero code changes. Features Docker deployment and management UI, requiring no infrastructure modifications.

summary.zh: Unla 是一款基于 Go 的轻量级 MCP Gateway，可通过 YAML 配置将现有 MCP Server 与传统 API 零侵入封装为符合 MCP 协议的服务，无需改动代码或基础设施。项目强调高可用、低资源占用，并内置管理 UI 与 Docker 一键部署能力，适合企业快速接入 AI Agent、统一工具暴露与遗留接口改造。
summary.en: Unla is a lightweight MCP gateway written in Go that converts existing MCP servers and conventional APIs into MCP-compliant endpoints through YAML configuration, with zero code or infrastructure changes. It emphasizes low overhead, high availability, and operational simplicity, featuring a built-in management UI and Docker-first deployment. It is well suited for AI agent integration, unified tool exposure, and modernizing legacy service interfaces into the Model Context Protocol ecosystem.

metadata.name: higress
metadata.description: 🤖 AI Gateway | AI Native API Gateway

summary.zh: Higress 是面向云原生与 AI 场景的 API Gateway，基于 Istio 与 Envoy 构建，支持用 Go、Rust、JS 编写 Wasm 插件扩展。它统一代理主流大模型 API 与 MCP 服务，适用于 AI 应用接入、协议治理、插件化扩展及企业级高可用流量管理，亮点在于 AI Gateway 与 Remote MCP 托管的一体化能力。
summary.en: Higress is an AI-native, cloud-native API gateway built on Istio and Envoy, extensible through Wasm plugins written in Go, Rust, and JavaScript. It unifies access management for mainstream LLM APIs and MCP services, making it suitable for AI application integration, protocol governance, plugin-based extension, and enterprise-grade high-availability traffic management. Its key strength is the integrated AI Gateway plus Remote MCP hosting model.

metadata.name: rustfs
metadata.description: 🚀2.3x faster than MinIO for 4KB object payloads. RustFS is an open-source, S3-compatible high-performance object storage system supporting migration and coexistence with other S3-compatible platforms such as MinIO and Ceph.

summary.zh: RustFS 是基于 Rust 构建的高性能分布式对象存储，兼容 S3 与 OpenStack Swift/Keystone，适合数据湖、AI 与大数据场景。其核心优势在于兼顾 MinIO 式易用性、Rust 的内存安全与吞吐性能，并支持与 MinIO、Ceph 等平台迁移共存，满足现代云原生存储部署需求。
summary.en: RustFS is a high-performance distributed object storage system written in Rust, delivering S3 compatibility alongside native OpenStack Swift and Keystone support. It targets data lake, AI, and big data workloads with a design that combines MinIO-like simplicity, Rust’s memory safety, and strong throughput. Its standout value is migration and coexistence with platforms like MinIO and Ceph, making it a practical fit for modern cloud-native storage infrastructure.

metadata.name: bytes-radar
metadata.description: Hyper-fast code cloc tool for remote repositories. Serverless optimized.

summary.zh: Bytes Radar 是面向远程代码仓库的极速 CLOC 工具，采用 Rust 实现，适合 CLI、自动化审计与无服务器场景下快速统计代码规模。其亮点在于异步流式下载、内存内解压与低于 12MB 的运行内存，占优于大仓库分析；同时支持多代码托管平台、150+ 语言识别、多格式输出、私有仓库鉴权及细粒度网络与过滤配置。
summary.en: Bytes Radar is a Rust-based ultra-fast CLOC tool for analyzing remote repositories, built for CLI workflows, automation, and serverless environments. Its core strengths are async streaming, in-memory decompression, and sub-12MB runtime memory usage, enabling efficient analysis of large repositories without full local checkout. It also supports multiple Git hosting providers, 150+ language detection via Tokei rules, private-repo authentication, adaptive progress reporting, and rich export formats including JSON, CSV, XML, YAML, and TOML.
tags_zh: 多平台 Git 托管支持

metadata.name: context-engineering-intro
metadata.description: Context engineering is the new vibe coding - it's the way to actually make AI coding assistants work. Claude Code is the best for this so that's what this repo is centered around, but you can apply this strategy with any AI coding assistant!

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 AI 编程助手的上下文工程模板仓库，围绕 Claude Code 设计完整工作流，帮助开发者通过规则、示例、需求文档与 PRP 执行机制提升代码生成质量。其亮点在于将 prompt engineering 升级为可复用、可校验、可自纠错的上下文驱动开发方法，适用于复杂功能实现与团队规范落地。
summary.en: This repository is a context engineering starter template for AI coding assistants, centered on Claude Code but applicable to other agents. It provides a structured workflow using project rules, code examples, feature briefs, and PRP generation/execution to improve implementation reliability. Its key value is turning prompt-based interaction into a reusable, validation-driven, self-correcting development system for complex features and consistent engineering practices.

metadata.name: trae-agent
metadata.description: Trae Agent is an LLM-based agent for general purpose software engineering tasks.

summary.zh: Trae Agent 是字节跳动开源的通用软件工程智能体 CLI，面向代码修改、命令执行与多步任务编排。项目强调透明可扩展架构，支持多家 LLM、工具链调用、轨迹记录与 Lakeview 摘要，既适合日常研发自动化，也适合学术研究中的智能体分析、消融实验与能力扩展。
summary.en: Trae Agent is ByteDance’s open-source CLI agent for general-purpose software engineering, designed for code editing, shell execution, and multi-step workflow orchestration from natural language. Its key strength is a transparent, modular, research-friendly architecture with multi-LLM support, rich tool integration, trajectory logging, and Lakeview step summarization, making it useful for both developer automation and academic agent research, including ablation studies and capability prototyping.

metadata.name: nocodb
metadata.description: 🔥 🔥 🔥 A Free & Self-hostable Airtable Alternative

summary.zh: NocoDB 是一款开源、可自托管的 Airtable 替代方案，可将 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite 等数据库快速转为可视化在线协作系统。它兼顾低代码表格管理、API 化访问与生产部署能力，支持 Docker 一键安装，并集成 PostgreSQL、Redis、Traefik 与 SSL，适合内部工具、业务数据管理和轻量应用搭建。
summary.en: NocoDB is an open-source, self-hostable Airtable alternative that turns existing databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQLite into a collaborative online data platform. It combines spreadsheet-like low-code workflows, API-driven access, and production-friendly deployment. With Docker-based setup and automated provisioning for PostgreSQL, Redis, Traefik, and SSL, it fits internal tools, operational data management, and rapid app building.

metadata.name: OpenList
metadata.description: A new AList Fork to Anti Trust Crisis

summary.zh: OpenList 是 AList 的社区治理分支，面向网盘聚合、私有文件管理与统一访问场景，强调 AGPL 全开源、长期维护与抗信任危机治理。项目亮点在于兼容多种存储后端，如 OneDrive、S3、WebDAV、FTP/SFTP 等，适合构建自托管文件索引、跨云资源整合与轻量私有网盘门户。
summary.en: OpenList is a community-governed fork of AList for unified file indexing, personal cloud portals, and self-hosted storage aggregation. Its core value lies in long-term open governance, AGPL transparency, and resilience against trust-based project risks. Technically, it integrates diverse backends including OneDrive, S3, WebDAV, FTP/SFTP, and other cloud drives, making it well suited for cross-cloud access, private file hubs, and lightweight storage gateway deployments.

metadata.name: sniffnet
metadata.description: Comfortably monitor your network traffic 🕵️‍♂️

summary.zh: Sniffnet 是一款基于 Rust 的跨平台网络流量监控工具，面向开发者、运维及安全分析场景，提供直观界面展示实时连接、主机、协议与流量变化。其亮点在于本地抓包、低门槛可视化、多语言支持及通知、主题等易用特性，在兼顾性能与可靠性的同时提升日常网络观测效率。
summary.en: Sniffnet is a Rust-based cross-platform network traffic monitor designed for developers, operators, and security-minded users who need clear visibility into live Internet activity. It emphasizes local packet capture with an intuitive UI for inspecting connections, hosts, protocols, and traffic trends in real time. Key strengths include strong usability, multilingual support, customizable themes, and notification features, delivering reliable network observability without the complexity of traditional packet analysis tools.

metadata.name: 1Panel-Appstore
metadata.description: 1Panel-第三方应用商店(运维监控、免费大模型API、Nas工具、容器管理)

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 1Panel 的第三方应用商店仓库，聚焦运维监控、NAS 工具、容器管理及可用的大模型 API 场景。项目通过脚本将应用清单同步到 1Panel 本地商店，强调精选而非臃肿；同时提供 AI Skills、模板与校验脚本，可快速生成 1Panel 应用配置，显著降低应用接入与维护成本。
summary.en: This repository is a third-party app store for 1Panel, focused on curated apps for operations monitoring, NAS utilities, container management, and selected LLM API use cases. It provides shell-based synchronization into the local 1Panel app catalog, favoring quality over breadth. A notable highlight is its AI app-building toolkit, including Skills, templates, generators, and validators that streamline creating and maintaining 1Panel-compatible app packages.

metadata.name: lal
metadata.description: 🔥 Golang audio/video live streaming lib/client/server. support RTMP, RTSP(RTP/RTCP), HLS, HTTP[S]/WebSocket-FLV/TS, GB28181, H264/H265/AAC/G711/OPUS, relay, cluster, record, HTTP Notify/API/UI. 直播

summary.zh: LAL 是一套以 Go 构建的低依赖音视频直播流媒体框架，覆盖 RTMP、RTSP、HLS、HTTP-FLV/TS、WebSocket-FLV 与 GB28181。它面向直播分发、国标接入、边缘转推和录像场景，集成中继、集群、GOP 缓存、HTTP API/Notify/WebUI，兼顾协议兼容性、部署便捷性与服务端扩展能力。
summary.en: LAL is a Go-based live audio/video streaming framework and server stack designed for multi-protocol media ingestion, distribution, and playback. It supports RTMP, RTSP/RTP/RTCP, HLS, HTTP/WebSocket-FLV/TS, and GB28181, plus codecs such as H264, H265, AAC, G711, and OPUS. Key strengths include low dependency overhead, relay and clustering, recording, GOP cache, and built-in HTTP API, notify hooks, and Web UI for operational control.

metadata.name: streamer-card
metadata.description: 流光卡片API

summary.zh: 这是一个基于 Node.js、Express 与 Puppeteer 的流光卡片生成 API，通过自动化驱动浏览器渲染模板并截图，输出适合营销、内容分发与业务流程集成的精美图片卡片。项目支持多模板、多字段定制，并针对并发场景引入重试机制和 puppeteer-cluster，兼顾可扩展性、稳定性与批量生成能力。
summary.en: Streamer Card is an image card generation API built with Node.js, Express, and Puppeteer. It automates browser rendering, injects text and media into predefined templates, then captures polished card images for marketing, content publishing, and workflow integration. The project supports multiple templates and flexible field customization, while adding retry logic and `puppeteer-cluster` to improve concurrency handling, stability, and batch-generation efficiency.

metadata.name: langfuse
metadata.description: 🪢 Open source AI engineering platform: LLM evals, observability, metrics, prompt management, playground, datasets. Integrates with OpenTelemetry, LangChain, OpenAI SDK, LiteLLM, and more. 🍊YC W23

summary.zh: Langfuse 是面向 LLM 应用的开源 AI 工程平台，覆盖可观测性、评测、指标分析、Prompt 管理、数据集与 Playground。其核心价值在于把模型开发、线上监控与质量迭代串成闭环，并通过 OpenTelemetry、LangChain、OpenAI SDK、LiteLLM 等集成，适用于构建、调优和运营生产级生成式 AI 系统。
summary.en: Langfuse is an open-source AI engineering platform for LLM applications, combining observability, evaluations, metrics, prompt management, datasets, and an experimentation playground. Its key strength is connecting development, production monitoring, and quality improvement in one workflow. With integrations for OpenTelemetry, LangChain, OpenAI SDK, LiteLLM, and related tooling, it fits teams building, debugging, and optimizing production-grade generative AI systems.

metadata.name: dify
metadata.description: Build Agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, with rich AI model and tool support on one collaborative workspace. Deploy on cloud, VPC, or self-hosted, so teams move from prototype to production without rebuilding the stack.

summary.zh: Dify 是面向生产环境的智能体工作流开发平台，整合 LLM 应用编排、知识库检索、可观测运营与自托管部署能力。它适合企业快速构建聊天助手、AI 工作流和多步骤自动化系统，亮点在于低代码编排、云端与私有化兼容，以及围绕模型、数据与工具链的一体化平台设计。
summary.en: Dify is a production-ready platform for building agentic workflows and LLM applications with orchestration, knowledge retrieval, observability, and self-hosting support. It targets teams that need to ship chat assistants, AI automation pipelines, and multi-step agent systems quickly. Its key strengths are low-code workflow composition, cloud and on-prem deployment flexibility, and an integrated stack spanning models, data, and operational tooling.

metadata.name: illa-helper
metadata.description: 浸入式学语言助手 (Immersive Language Learning Assistant)

summary.zh: 这是一个面向浏览器阅读场景的沉浸式语言学习扩展，基于“可理解输入”和 i+1 理论，将网页内容智能转化为个性化学习材料。项目亮点在于结合 AI 进行自动语种识别、分级词汇替换、音标与释义生成，并集成双 TTS 与交互式提示，形成从阅读、理解到发音训练的一体化语言习得闭环。
summary.en: Immersive Language Learning Assistant is a browser extension that turns everyday web browsing into personalized language practice through the “comprehensible input” and i+1 learning model. It uses AI to detect source language, select level-appropriate vocabulary, and inject translated terms directly into webpages. Key strengths include phonetic support, AI-powered definitions, dual TTS, and interactive tooltips, creating an integrated workflow for reading comprehension, vocabulary acquisition, and pronunciation training.

metadata.name: hajimi
metadata.description: 这是一个基于 FastAPI 构建的 Gemini API 代理

summary.zh: HAJIMI 是一个基于 FastAPI 的 Gemini API 代理，提供与 OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容的接口，便于现有工具和客户端低成本接入 Gemini。项目支持密钥轮询、假流式传输、并发缓存、联网搜索及 Vertex/AI Studio 双模式，适合自部署网关、聚合调用与多终端集成场景，兼顾可配置性、稳定性与部署灵活度。
summary.en: HAJIMI is a FastAPI-based Gemini API proxy that exposes OpenAI-compatible chat completion endpoints, making it easy to plug Gemini into existing tools and clients. It features API key rotation, fake streaming for unstable networks, concurrent request caching, web search mode, and both Vertex and AI Studio support. The project is well suited for self-hosted AI gateways, multi-client integrations, and flexible deployments that prioritize compatibility, resilience, and operational control.

metadata.name: gemini-cli
metadata.description: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.

summary.zh: Gemini CLI 是面向开发者的终端原生 AI 代理，将 Gemini 3 大上下文推理能力直接带入命令行。它集成文件操作、Shell 执行、网页抓取与 Google Search grounding，并通过 MCP 扩展外部能力，适用于代码理解、调试排障、自动化运维及多模态生成等高频开发场景。
summary.en: Gemini CLI is a terminal-first open-source AI agent that brings Gemini 3 directly into developer workflows. It combines long-context reasoning with built-in tools for file operations, shell execution, web fetching, and Google Search grounding, while supporting MCP-based extensions. The project is well suited for code understanding, debugging, developer automation, operational workflows, and multimodal app generation from rich inputs.

metadata.name: prompt-optimizer
metadata.description: An AI prompt optimizer for writing better prompts and getting better AI results.

summary.zh: Prompt Optimizer 是面向 AI 提示工程的多形态优化平台，支持 Web、桌面、Chrome 扩展与 Docker 部署。它覆盖提示词的编写、模板变量化、优化、测试、评估与资产化复用，尤其适合对话生成、交易回复和文生图等场景。亮点在于统一工作流、多来源提示接入，以及面向小模型输出质量提升的可操作优化能力。
summary.en: Prompt Optimizer is a multi-format prompt engineering platform for improving AI instructions across web, desktop, Chrome extension, and Docker deployments. It supports the full prompt lifecycle: drafting, templating, optimization, testing, evaluation, and reusable asset management. The project stands out for its unified workflow, integration with prompt sources like Prompt Garden, and practical optimization methods that noticeably improve output quality for chat, negotiation, and text-to-image use cases, especially with smaller models.

metadata.name: webvm
metadata.description: Virtual Machine for the Web

summary.zh: WebVM 是一个完全运行在浏览器端的无服务器 Linux 虚拟机，基于 WebAssembly 与 CheerpX 实现 x86 到 Wasm JIT、Linux 系统调用模拟和沙箱执行，可直接运行未修改的 Debian 及原生开发工具链。它适合在线开发、教学演示、轻量图形桌面体验，并通过 Tailscale 扩展到私有网络访问。
summary.en: WebVM is a fully client-side, serverless Linux virtual machine for the browser, built on WebAssembly and powered by the CheerpX virtualization engine. It delivers x86-to-Wasm JIT translation, Linux syscall emulation, a virtual block-based filesystem, and sandboxed execution, enabling unmodified Debian and native developer toolchains to run in-browser. It fits browser-based development, technical demos, education, and secure remote access via Tailscale networking.

metadata.name: donutbrowser
metadata.description: Simple Yet Powerful Anti-Detect Browser 🍩

summary.zh: Donut Browser 是一款开源反检测浏览器，基于 Chromium 与 Wayfern 指纹伪装引擎，为多账号运营、自动化测试和隐私隔离提供独立浏览器环境。其核心能力包括无限隔离配置文件、代理与 WireGuard VPN、按配置 DNS 广告拦截，以及本地 REST API 和 MCP 集成，并支持自托管云同步、端到端加密与零遥测。
summary.en: Donut Browser is an open-source anti-detect browser built on Chromium with the Wayfern spoofing engine, designed for multi-account operations, privacy isolation, and automation workflows. It provides unlimited fully isolated profiles with separate fingerprints, cookies, extensions, proxies, and WireGuard VPN settings. Key highlights include per-profile DNS ad blocking, local REST API and MCP integration for tool automation, self-hostable cloud sync, optional end-to-end encryption, and a strict zero-telemetry approach.

metadata.name: quartz
metadata.description: 🌱 a fast, batteries-included static-site generator that transforms Markdown content into fully functional websites

summary.zh: Quartz 是面向数字花园与笔记发布的静态站点生成器，可将 Markdown 内容快速构建为完整网站。其核心价值在于开箱即用、构建高效，并围绕知识管理场景提供站点生成能力，适合个人博客、第二大脑与网络化笔记发布，突出轻量部署与内容到网站的顺滑转换体验。
summary.en: Quartz is a fast, batteries-included static site generator built for publishing digital gardens and notes as fully functional websites from Markdown. Its core value lies in an opinionated, ready-to-use workflow that reduces setup overhead while optimizing content-to-site publishing. It is especially suited for personal knowledge bases, interconnected notes, and blogging workflows, with strengths in rapid builds, lightweight deployment, and seamless Markdown-driven site generation.

metadata.name: FreshRSS
metadata.description: A free, self-hostable news aggregator…

summary.zh: FreshRSS 是一款基于 PHP 的自托管 RSS/Atom 新闻聚合器，面向个人与团队的信息订阅、阅读与管理场景。它支持多用户、匿名阅读、标签体系、移动端 API、CLI、WebSub 实时推送，以及基于 XPath/JSON 的网页抓取，兼顾轻量部署、可扩展性与高度可定制性。
summary.en: FreshRSS is a self-hosted RSS/Atom aggregator built for personal and team-based news consumption workflows. It combines lightweight PHP deployment with rich capabilities such as multi-user access, anonymous reading, tagging, mobile-friendly APIs, CLI automation, WebSub push updates, and XPath/JSON-based web scraping. Its extensibility and flexible authentication options make it well suited for customizable feed management at low infrastructure cost.

metadata.name: top-rss-list
metadata.description: 订阅人数最多的rss源，中文优质rss源

summary.zh: 该仓库聚合并按订阅热度整理中文优质 RSS 源，覆盖科技、新闻、博客与社区内容，便于用户快速发现高价值信息源。亮点在于基于 ifeed 订阅数据排序，并结合 RSSHub、AnyFeeder 等补全原站缺失订阅入口，适合 RSS 新手选源、信息订阅优化与中文内容发现。
summary.en: This repository curates high-subscriber Chinese RSS feeds and ranks them by popularity, helping users quickly discover valuable sources across tech, news, blogs, and online communities. Its main strength is the popularity-driven ordering based on ifeed subscription data, plus practical integration of RSSHub and AnyFeeder routes to expose feeds not officially provided, making it useful for RSS onboarding, source selection, and Chinese content discovery.

metadata.name: claude-code-router
metadata.description: One local control plane for every AI agent: route across models, fuse new capabilities, orchestrate tools, and stay fully in control.

summary.zh: Claude Code Router 以 Claude Code 为底座，提供面向多模型与多供应商的统一路由层，可按任务类型动态切换模型，并通过请求/响应转换器适配 OpenRouter、Gemini、Ollama 等生态。其亮点在于终端模型管理、插件扩展与 GitHub Actions 集成，适合构建可控、低耦合的 AI 编码基础设施。
summary.en: Claude Code Router turns Claude Code into a flexible routing layer for AI coding infrastructure. It lets developers direct requests to different models by task type, switch models dynamically in-session, and normalize provider differences through request/response transformers. With support for providers such as OpenRouter, Gemini, Ollama, and DeepSeek, plus CLI-based model management, plugins, and GitHub Actions integration, it is well suited for controllable, multi-provider coding workflows.

metadata.name: hono
metadata.description: Web framework built on Web Standards

summary.zh: Hono 是基于 Web Standard API 的超轻量 TypeScript Web 框架，面向 Cloudflare Workers、Deno、Bun、Node.js 与 AWS Lambda 等多运行时统一开发。其核心亮点是零依赖、小体积与高速路由实现，兼顾内置中间件、良好类型支持和一致的部署体验，适合构建边缘服务、Serverless API 与高性能 Web 应用。
summary.en: Hono is a lightweight, ultra-fast web framework built on Web Standard APIs, designed for portable development across Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun, Node.js, Fastly, and AWS Lambda. Its core strengths are zero dependencies, tiny bundle size, and high-performance routing, while still offering built-in middleware, strong TypeScript ergonomics, and a consistent developer experience. It is well suited for edge services, serverless APIs, and performance-sensitive web applications.

metadata.name: NoneOS
metadata.description: An operating system based on the browser.

summary.zh: NoneOS 是一个基于浏览器的轻量级虚拟操作系统，采用纯静态文件架构，无需后端即可运行。它面向跨设备协作与轻 NAS 场景，已集成文件管理、书签同步、笔记同步和局域网传输等应用，并通过基于 ofa.js 的 Web 微应用机制支持将独立应用目录快速导入与部署，兼顾扩展性与低运维成本。
summary.en: NoneOS is a lightweight virtual operating system that runs entirely in the browser with a pure static-file architecture, requiring no backend services. It targets cross-device collaboration and lightweight NAS-style workflows, bundling file management, bookmark sync, note sync, and local file transfer apps. A standout feature is its Web micro-application model built on ofa.js, which lets developers deploy self-contained apps by simply importing app directories into the system.

metadata.name: xiaozhi-esp32
metadata.description: An MCP-based chatbot | 一个基于MCP的聊天机器人

summary.zh: xiaozhi-esp32 是面向 ESP32 终端的 MCP 聊天机器人方案，融合离线唤醒、流式 ASR/LLM/TTS、OPUS 编解码与说话人识别，支持 WebSocket 或 MQTT+UDP 通信。项目覆盖 70+ 开源硬件，可联动 OLED/LCD、GPIO、舵机等设备，并通过云侧 MCP 扩展智能家居、桌面控制与知识检索等能力。
summary.en: xiaozhi-esp32 is an MCP-based chatbot stack for ESP32 devices, combining offline wake-word detection, streaming ASR/LLM/TTS pipelines, OPUS audio, and speaker recognition. It supports WebSocket or MQTT+UDP communication, runs across 70+ open hardware designs, and enables on-device control of displays, GPIO, LEDs, and servos. Cloud-side MCP further extends the assistant to smart home automation, desktop control, and external knowledge workflows.

metadata.name: reposilite
metadata.description: Lightweight and easy-to-use repository management software dedicated for the Maven-based artifacts in the JVM ecosystem 📦

summary.zh: Reposilite 是面向 JVM 生态的轻量级 Maven 制品仓库管理软件，适合团队或个人自建私有依赖仓、发布内部组件与代理制品分发。它以极低资源占用、Java 11+ 运行、Docker/Helm 友好部署为亮点，可替代 Nexus、Archiva、Artifactory 等传统方案，并兼顾可扩展性与可伸缩性。
summary.en: Reposilite is a lightweight repository manager for Maven-based artifacts in the JVM ecosystem, designed for teams or individuals who need a self-hosted private package repository, internal component publishing, or artifact distribution. Its main strengths are very low memory usage, Java 11+ runtime support, and deployment flexibility through standalone JAR, Docker, and Helm, making it a practical alternative to heavier solutions like Nexus, Archiva, or Artifactory.

metadata.name: note-gen
metadata.description: Capture first. Organize later. A local-first Markdown app that turns scattered records into clear notes with AI.

summary.zh: NoteGen 是一款跨平台 Markdown AI 笔记软件，面向会议记录、学习研究、周报生成与个人知识管理。它将碎片化采集、AI 结构化整理、Markdown 深度编辑与私有知识问答整合到一体，并以本地 Markdown 存储配合 Git/S3/WebDAV 同步，兼顾可迁移性、跨端协作与数据自治。
summary.en: NoteGen is a cross-platform AI note-taking app built around Markdown-first workflows for meetings, research, reporting, and personal knowledge management. It combines fast multimodal capture, AI-powered structuring, rich Markdown editing, and chat over personal materials in one tool. By storing notes as local Markdown files and syncing through Git platforms, S3, or WebDAV, it emphasizes portability, cross-device continuity, and user-controlled data.

metadata.name: certimate
metadata.description: An open-source and free self-hosted SSL certificates ACME tool, automates the full-cycle of issuance, deployment, renewal, and monitoring visually. 完全开源免费的自托管 SSL 证书 ACME 工具，申请、部署、续期、监控全流程自动化可视化，支持各大主流云厂商。

summary.zh: Certimate 是面向自托管场景的 ACME 证书全生命周期自动化平台，覆盖申请、部署、续期与监控。其核心优势在于可视化工作流、零外部依赖、超低资源占用，以及对 70+ DNS 服务商和 140+ 部署目标的广泛集成，适合个人站点、企业内网、Kubernetes 与多云基础设施统一管理 SSL 证书。
summary.en: Certimate is a self-hosted ACME certificate automation platform that manages the full SSL lifecycle, including issuance, deployment, renewal, and monitoring. Its standout strengths are visual workflow orchestration, zero external dependencies, lightweight runtime usage, and broad integration with 70+ DNS providers and 140+ deployment targets. It is well suited for personal websites, enterprise internal services, Kubernetes environments, and multi-cloud infrastructure needing centralized certificate operations.

metadata.name: hadolint
metadata.description: Dockerfile linter, validate inline bash, written in Haskell

summary.zh: Hadolint 是一款用 Haskell 编写的 Dockerfile 静态检查工具，通过将 Dockerfile 解析为 AST 执行最佳实践规则校验，并借助 ShellCheck 深度分析 RUN 指令中的 Bash 代码。适用于镜像构建规范治理、CI 质量门禁与开发阶段即时校验，支持命令行、本地二进制及容器化运行。
summary.en: Hadolint is a Haskell-based Dockerfile linter that parses Dockerfiles into an AST to enforce container build best practices, while leveraging ShellCheck to analyze Bash embedded in `RUN` instructions. It fits local development, CI quality gates, and enterprise image governance, with flexible delivery through native binaries, CLI workflows, and containerized execution across platforms.

metadata.name: opik
metadata.description: Debug, evaluate, and monitor your LLM applications, RAG systems, and agentic workflows with comprehensive tracing, automated evaluations, and production-ready dashboards.

summary.zh: Opik 是面向 LLM 应用、RAG 系统与智能体工作流的开源可观测与评测平台，覆盖从原型到生产的调试、追踪、评估和优化闭环。其亮点在于全面 tracing、自动化评测、LLM-as-a-Judge 指标以及面向生产的可视化仪表盘，帮助团队系统提升提示词、工具调用与整体应用质量。
summary.en: Opik is an open-source observability and evaluation platform for LLM applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows. It supports the full lifecycle from prototyping to production with end-to-end tracing, debugging, automated evaluations, and optimization. Key strengths include comprehensive trace logging, LLM-as-a-Judge metrics, prompt and tool optimization, and production-ready dashboards that help teams systematically improve reliability, quality, and performance of generative AI systems.

metadata.name: aya
metadata.description: Android ADB desktop app

summary.zh: AYA 是一款面向桌面的 Android ADB 图形化控制工具，将命令行能力封装为可视界面，降低设备调试与运维门槛。它集成屏幕镜像、文件管理、应用与进程监控、布局检查、性能指标监测、Logcat 查看和交互式 Shell，适用于开发调试、测试排障与设备管理，多平台发布是其落地优势。
summary.en: AYA is a cross-platform desktop GUI for controlling Android devices through ADB, turning low-level command-line workflows into an accessible visual tool. It combines screen mirroring, file browsing, app and process management, layout inspection, performance monitoring, Logcat viewing, and an interactive shell in one package. The project is well suited for Android development, QA troubleshooting, and device operations, with practical support for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

metadata.name: Abracadabra
metadata.description: Abracadabra 魔曰，古文风文本加密工具

summary.zh: Abracadabra（魔曰）是一款将密文伪装成文言文的开源文本加密工具，面向隐私传输、趣味表达与跨平台部署场景。项目以 JavaScript 与 WASM 实现，内置 AES256 并支持更高级加密套件，结合古文语料、组句与语法匹配机制生成高随机性、高仿真的古文风密文，兼顾安全性、可用性与文化表达特色。
summary.en: Abracadabra is an open-source text encryption tool that disguises ciphertext as classical Chinese prose. It targets privacy-preserving communication, playful expression, and easy cross-platform deployment. Built with JavaScript and WASM, it uses AES-256 by default with optional advanced cipher suites, then applies classical corpus-inspired sentence generation and grammar matching to produce highly randomized, convincing archaic-style text, blending practical cryptography with strong linguistic simulation and distinctive cultural aesthetics.

metadata.name: jessibuca
metadata.description: Jessibuca是一款开源的纯H5直播流播放器

summary.zh: Jessibuca 是面向浏览器端直播场景的纯 H5 播放器，基于 Emscripten/WASM 在前端完成音视频解码，无需插件即可在 PC、手机和微信中播放。项目聚焦低延迟与高兼容，支持 H.264/H.265、AAC、PCMA/PCMU、HTTP-FLV 与 WebSocket-FLV，并具备智能丢帧、多实例、HTTPS/WSS 传输等能力，适合安防监控、移动直播和跨端流媒体接入。
summary.en: Jessibuca is a pure HTML5 live streaming player built for browser-based playback. It uses Emscripten and WebAssembly to run audio/video decoders in the browser, enabling plugin-free streaming across desktop, mobile, and WeChat environments. The project emphasizes low latency and broad compatibility, with support for H.264/H.265, AAC, PCMA/PCMU, HTTP-FLV, WebSocket-FLV, and raw WebSocket transport, plus intelligent frame dropping, multi-instance playback, and secure HTTPS/WSS delivery for surveillance, mobile live video, and cross-platform streaming.

metadata.name: monibuca
metadata.description: 🧩 Monibuca is a Modularized, Extensible framework for building Streaming Server

summary.zh: Monibuca 是纯 Go 实现的模块化流媒体服务器框架，面向直播、安防、物联网视频与多协议接入场景。其核心优势在于高性能低延迟转发、按需插件扩展、分布式集群与内置调试监控，同时支持 RTMP、RTSP、WebRTC、GB28181、SRT 等协议，并集成录制回放、时移、转码、AI 推理和 gRPC/WebHook 集成能力。
summary.en: Monibuca is a pure-Go modular streaming server framework built for live streaming, surveillance, IoT video, and multi-protocol media delivery. Its key strengths include high-performance low-latency forwarding, on-demand plugin extensibility, distributed clustering, and built-in debugging and monitoring. It supports RTMP, RTSP, WebRTC, GB28181, and SRT, while also providing recording, playback, time-shift, transcoding, AI inference, and gRPC/WebHook integration for complex streaming systems.

metadata.name: nature
metadata.description: The Nature Programming Language

summary.zh: Nature 是一门面向系统编程的通用语言与编译器，强调高性能、安全性与跨平台交付。项目以纯 C 构建完整编译器与运行时，直接生成机器码且不依赖 LLVM，内置并发原语、强类型系统、零开销 C FFI、GC 与协程运行时，适合构建底层工具、基础设施软件及对性能和可移植性要求高的服务。
summary.en: Nature is a general-purpose systems programming language and compiler focused on performance, safety, and cross-platform delivery. Built with a pure C compiler and runtime, it emits native machine code without LLVM and combines a strong static type system with built-in concurrency primitives, zero-overhead C FFI, GC, coroutines, and musl-based static linking. It targets infrastructure software, low-level tools, and backend services that need portability, reliability, and efficient native execution.

metadata.name: mihomo
metadata.description: A simple Python Pydantic model for Honkai: Star Rail parsed data from the Mihomo API.

summary.zh: 该仓库提供面向《崩坏：星穹铁道》Mihomo API 解析结果的 Python Pydantic 数据模型封装，支持 V1/V2 两套返回格式、类型提示与自动补全，适合做玩家信息查询、角色面板分析、数据持久化与二次开发。亮点在于异步客户端、图标 URL 替换、角色去重与多次抓取结果合并等实用工具。
summary.en: This repository offers Python Pydantic models for parsed Honkai: Star Rail data returned by the Mihomo API, covering both V1 and V2 response formats with strong typing and autocomplete support. It fits player profile lookup, character panel analysis, data persistence, and downstream tooling. Key strengths include an async API client, optional asset URL replacement, duplicate character cleanup, and utilities for merging snapshots across multiple fetches.

metadata.name: clash-party
metadata.description: :electron: Another Mihomo GUI.

summary.zh: Clash Party 是面向 Mihomo/Clash Meta 的跨平台 Electron 图形客户端，主打开箱即用的 Tun、内置多内核与可视化配置管理。项目亮点在于 AI 驱动的 Smart Core 节点优选、深度集成 Sub-Store、灵活规则覆写，以及基于 WebDAV 的配置备份恢复，适合代理订阅管理、路由策略调优与日常网络加速场景。
summary.en: Clash Party is a cross-platform Electron GUI for Mihomo/Clash Meta, focused on turnkey TUN support, bundled cores, and visual configuration management. Its standout capabilities include AI-assisted Smart Core for optimal node selection, deep Sub-Store integration for subscription operations, powerful rule and config overriding, and WebDAV-based backup and restore. It is well suited for proxy subscription management, traffic routing optimization, and daily network acceleration workflows.

metadata.name: ClashMetaForAndroid
metadata.description: A rule-based tunnel for Android.

summary.zh: Clash Meta for Android 是面向 Android 的 Clash.Meta 图形化客户端，将规则分流、代理隧道与配置管理整合为移动端可用方案。项目支持多架构设备、外部 Intent 自动化控制与 URL 导入配置，并通过 Android、Go 与原生构建链协同集成 Meta 内核，适用于科学上网、流量分流及网络调试场景。
summary.en: Clash Meta for Android is an Android GUI client for Clash.Meta, packaging rule-based proxy tunneling, traffic routing, and profile management into a mobile-friendly experience. It supports multiple CPU architectures, external Intent-based automation, and URL-driven profile import. By combining Android app layers with Go and native build tooling around the Meta kernel, it targets advanced network routing, proxy management, and mobile traffic debugging use cases.

metadata.name: EasyDarwin
metadata.description: open source、high performance、industrial rtsp streaming server,a lot of optimization on streaming relay,KeyFrame cache,RESTful,and web management,also EasyDarwin support distributed load balancing,a simple streaming media cloud platform architecture.

summary.zh: EasyDarwin 是面向工业与安防场景的高性能流媒体服务器，支持 RTMP/RTSP 推拉流及 HLS、HTTP-FLV、WebRTC 等多协议分发。项目基于 Go 构建，集成 Web 管理、RESTful API、按需拉流、关键帧缓存与分布式负载能力，适合摄像头接入、流媒体中转、视频预览和轻量级流媒体云平台搭建。
summary.en: EasyDarwin is a high-performance streaming server for industrial and surveillance scenarios, supporting RTMP/RTSP ingest and playback plus multi-protocol delivery through HLS, HTTP-FLV, WebSocket-FLV, and WebRTC. Built with Go, it combines a web console, RESTful APIs, on-demand stream pulling, keyframe caching, and distributed load balancing, making it well suited for camera access, stream relay, live preview, and lightweight cloud media platform architectures.

metadata.name: coolmonitor
metadata.description: 一个高颜值的监控工具，支持网站监控/接口监控/HTTPS证书监控等。CoolMonitor is a beautiful monitoring tool that supports website monitoring, API monitoring, HTTPS certificate monitoring, and more...

summary.zh: 酷监控是一款面向开发者与运维的高颜值监控平台，支持网站、API、HTTPS证书、TCP端口及数据库巡检，并提供心跳推送与多渠道告警。基于Next.js、Prisma与SQLite，兼顾快速部署、现代界面和轻量持久化。
summary.en: CoolMonitor is a polished monitoring platform for developers and ops teams, covering websites, APIs, HTTPS certificates, TCP ports, and database checks, plus heartbeat push and multi-channel alerts. Built with Next.js, Prisma, and SQLite, it combines fast deployment, modern UI, and lightweight persistence.

metadata.name: uptime-kuma
metadata.description: A fancy self-hosted monitoring tool

summary.zh: Uptime Kuma 是面向个人与团队的自托管可用性监控平台，支持 HTTP、TCP、Ping、DNS、WebSocket、Docker 等多种探测方式，并提供 20 秒级轮询、证书监测、状态页映射与 2FA。其亮点在于部署轻量、界面响应迅速、通知集成覆盖 90+ 渠道，适合内网服务、网站与容器环境的持续健康监控。
summary.en: Uptime Kuma is a self-hosted uptime monitoring platform for individuals and teams, covering HTTP, TCP, Ping, DNS, WebSocket, push, and Docker container checks. It combines lightweight deployment with a fast reactive UI, 20-second polling, certificate tracking, multi-status pages, domain mapping, and 2FA. With integrations for 90+ notification channels, it fits continuous health monitoring for websites, internal services, and containerized infrastructure.

metadata.name: obsidian-remote
metadata.description: Run Obsidian.md in a browser via a docker container.

summary.zh: obsidian-remote 将桌面版 Obsidian 封装进 Docker 容器，并通过浏览器提供远程访问能力，适合家庭服务器、自托管知识库与跨设备笔记场景。项目亮点在于卷映射持久化 vault 与配置、支持多架构部署、可配合反向代理与 obsidian-git 插件实现远程编辑和同步。
summary.en: obsidian-remote packages the desktop Obsidian app into a Docker container and exposes it through a browser, enabling self-hosted remote note access across devices. It targets homelab, personal knowledge management, and lightweight remote workspace use cases, with key strengths including persistent volume mapping for vaults and config, multi-architecture support, reverse-proxy deployment, and compatibility with the obsidian-git plugin.

metadata.name: minimind-v
metadata.description: 👀 Train a 65M-parameter VLM from scratch in just 2h!

summary.zh: MiniMind-V 是一个面向个人 GPU 的极简视觉语言模型实现，支持从零训练 65M 级多模态 VLM，并覆盖数据清洗、预训练、SFT 到推理全流程。项目以低成本、短时训练和轻量架构为亮点，采用 SigLIP 视觉编码器与精简投影设计，兼具教学价值与实验复现价值，适合多模态入门、模型研究和小规模部署。
summary.en: MiniMind-V is a lightweight vision-language model framework designed for training a 65M-parameter multimodal VLM from scratch on consumer-grade GPUs. It includes the full pipeline from dataset cleaning and pretraining to SFT and inference. Key strengths are low training cost, fast iteration, and a minimalist architecture built around SigLIP vision encoding and streamlined projection modules, making it valuable for VLM education, rapid experimentation, and small-scale deployment.

metadata.name: browser-use
metadata.description: 🌐 Make websites accessible for AI agents. Automate tasks online with ease.

summary.zh: browser-use 通过 Python API、Rust 核心与浏览器执行层，为大模型提供真实网页操作能力，支持点击、输入、恢复重试与持久化工具调用。适用于网页自动化、AI Agent 在线任务执行和复杂工作流编排，亮点是原生核心运行时、面向前沿模型的浏览器 harness，以及可扩展的云端与本地部署模式。
summary.en: browser-use equips LLM agents with a real browser action space through a Python API, a native Rust core, and a browser harness designed for frontier models. It targets web automation, autonomous online task execution, and multi-step agent workflows, with strengths in persistent tooling, recovery loops, native runtime performance, and flexible deployment across local environments and Browser Use Cloud.

metadata.name: playwright
metadata.description: Playwright is a framework for Web Testing and Automation. It allows testing Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with a single API.

summary.zh: Playwright 是面向 Web 测试与自动化的跨浏览器框架，统一驱动 Chromium、Firefox 和 WebKit，适合端到端测试、浏览器脚本与 AI 代理自动化。其亮点包括自动等待、强定位器、测试隔离、追踪调试与多浏览器并行执行。
summary.en: Playwright is a cross-browser framework for web testing and automation, driving Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit through one API. It fits end-to-end testing, browser scripting, and AI-agent automation, with highlights such as auto-waiting, resilient locators, test isolation, tracing, and parallel execution.

metadata.name: echo-url
metadata.description: 边缘计算实现在线 Mock 小工具.

summary.zh: echo-url 是一个部署在边缘计算环境的轻量级 Serverless Mock 工具，通过 `/edit` 提供可视化配置页面、`/echo` 实时返回自定义响应，适合接口联调、Webhook 调试与请求回显测试。其亮点在于开箱即用、在线可访问，以及以极低运维成本实现快速 HTTP Mock 能力。
summary.en: echo-url is a lightweight serverless mocking utility designed for edge environments. It offers a visual editing page at `/edit` and a response endpoint at `/echo`, enabling fast HTTP echoing and custom response simulation. Ideal for API debugging, webhook verification, and integration testing, its main strengths are zero-friction setup, online accessibility, and low-ops deployment on edge infrastructure.

metadata.name: EGM96
metadata.description: Java standalone EGM96 offset calculation

summary.zh: 这是一个用于计算 EGM96 大地水准面相对 WGS84 椭球高偏移的 Java 独立库，适合将 GPS/Android 返回的椭球高转换为更贴近日常使用的海拔高。项目亮点在于内置 EGM96 网格数据、本地离线计算与简单调用接口，但插值与数据校验仍较基础，更适合作为移动定位、GIS 应用和原型系统的高程换算组件。
summary.en: This repository provides a standalone Java library for computing EGM96 geoid offsets relative to WGS84 ellipsoidal heights, mainly to convert raw GPS or Android altitude readings into mean-sea-level style elevations. Its key strengths are embedded geoid grid data, offline execution, and a minimal API for altitude correction. The project is especially useful for mobile location apps, GIS utilities, and prototypes, though interpolation, validation, and test coverage remain intentionally lightweight.

metadata.name: markitdown
metadata.description: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.

summary.zh: MarkItDown 是微软推出的轻量级 Python 文档转换工具，面向 LLM 与文本分析流程，将 PDF、Office、图片、音频、HTML、结构化文本等多种输入统一转为保留标题、表格、列表与链接语义的 Markdown。其亮点在于面向机器消费的结构保真、可选依赖扩展、多格式覆盖及命令行/管道友好集成能力。
summary.en: MarkItDown is a lightweight Python conversion utility from Microsoft that turns PDFs, Office documents, images, audio, HTML, and structured text into Markdown optimized for LLM and text-analysis workflows. Its core strength is preserving useful document semantics such as headings, tables, lists, and links rather than chasing pixel-perfect rendering, while offering optional dependency-based format support and clean CLI or pipeline integration.

metadata.name: newsnow
metadata.description: Elegant reading of real-time and hottest news

summary.zh: NewsNow 是一个面向热点资讯聚合的实时阅读平台，强调简洁优雅的阅读体验与高频更新能力。项目基于自适应抓取与缓存机制平衡时效、性能和反爬风险，支持 GitHub OAuth、数据同步、Cloudflare D1 部署及 MCP Server 接入，适合构建新闻聚合、趋势监测与轻量化资讯门户。
summary.en: NewsNow is a real-time news aggregation platform focused on elegant reading and fast access to trending stories. It combines adaptive scraping intervals, caching, and refresh controls to balance freshness, performance, and anti-ban constraints. The project also supports GitHub OAuth, synced user data, Cloudflare D1 deployment, and MCP server integration, making it well suited for news portals, trend monitoring, and lightweight content aggregation services.

metadata.name: spring-boot-init-template
metadata.description: 基于 Java Web 项目的 SpringBoot 框架初始化模板，适配最新版本Spring AI，该模板整合了常用的框架（Mybatis-Plus、ShardingSphere、Redis、RabbitMQ、Elasticsearch、SaToken、OSS、Caffeine以及MongoDB等），广泛支持JDK11和JDK17，部分版本兼容JDK8，同时该模板适用于前后端分离项目启动开发，保证大家在此基础上能够快速开发自己的项目，同时也适合入门学习，本项目会由作者持续更新。

summary.zh: SpringBoot 初始化模板，面向前后端分离项目快速起步，集成 MyBatis-Plus、ShardingSphere、Redis、RabbitMQ、Elasticsearch、SaToken、MongoDB、Caffeine 与 Spring AI，覆盖数据库、缓存、消息、搜索、认证和对象存储等常见能力，适合二次开发与入门学习。
summary.en: A Spring Boot starter template for rapid development of front-end/back-end separated web apps. It integrates MyBatis-Plus, ShardingSphere, Redis, RabbitMQ, Elasticsearch, SaToken, MongoDB, Caffeine, and Spring AI, covering data access, caching, messaging, search, auth, and object storage for both learning and production bootstrapping.

metadata.name: glance
metadata.description: A self-hosted dashboard that puts all your feeds in one place

summary.zh: Glance 是一个面向自托管场景的轻量级信息仪表盘，通过 YAML 配置将 RSS、Reddit、YouTube、天气、市场、Docker 与服务器监控等多源内容聚合到统一界面。其亮点在于单一小体积二进制、低依赖与快速加载，同时支持多页面布局、主题定制、移动端适配和丰富小组件扩展。
summary.en: Glance is a lightweight self-hosted dashboard that consolidates diverse feeds and status data—such as RSS, Reddit, YouTube, weather, markets, Docker, and server metrics—into a single customizable interface driven by YAML configuration. Its main strengths are a tiny single-binary deployment model, low resource usage, fast page loads, flexible multi-page layouts, theme support, mobile-friendly design, and an extensible widget ecosystem.

metadata.name: go-cursor-help
metadata.description: 解决Cursor在免费订阅期间出现以下提示的问题:  Your request has been blocked as our system has detected suspicious activity / You've reached your trial request limit.  /  Too many free trial accounts used on this machine.

summary.zh: 该仓库提供面向 Windows、macOS 与 Linux 的 Cursor 试用重置脚本，通过修改设备标识、清理本地痕迹与适配 2.x 版本安装路径，缓解免费试用期内因风控、请求限额或机器复用触发的拦截问题。项目以一键执行为卖点，覆盖多平台命令入口，并针对不同系统提供自动定位与兼容处理。
summary.en: This repository delivers cross-platform scripts for resetting Cursor trial state on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It targets common lockout messages caused by suspicious-activity detection, trial quota exhaustion, or too many trial accounts on one machine. Its core value lies in one-click execution, device-ID modification, local footprint cleanup, and platform-specific installation path handling for recent Cursor 2.x releases.

metadata.name: clash-for-linux-install
metadata.description: 😼 优雅地使用基于 clash/mihomo 的代理环境

summary.zh: clashctl 是面向 Linux 的 mihomo/clash 一键部署与运维工具，覆盖内核、Web 面板与依赖安装，兼容 root/普通用户、容器及多种 init 系统。其亮点在于统一管理代理启停、TUN、日志、密钥与升级，并提供多订阅切换、定时更新及 subconverter 格式转换，适合自建代理环境的快速落地与日常维护。
summary.en: clashctl is a Linux-focused one-click deployment and operations toolkit for mihomo/clash proxy environments. It installs the core runtime, web dashboard, and dependencies while supporting root and non-root users, containers, and multiple init systems such as systemd and OpenRC. Key strengths include unified lifecycle management, TUN mode control, log tracing, secret and kernel upgrades, plus multi-subscription switching, scheduled updates, and built-in subconverter-based format conversion.

metadata.name: go-stock
metadata.description: 🦄🦄🦄AI赋能股票分析：AI加持的股票分析/选股工具。股票行情获取，AI热点资讯分析，AI资金/财务分析，涨跌报警推送。支持A股，港股，美股。支持市场整体/个股情绪分析，AI辅助选股等。数据全部保留在本地。支持DeepSeek，OpenAI， Ollama，LMStudio，AnythingLLM，硅基流动，火山方舟，阿里云百炼等平台或模型。

summary.zh: go-stock 是面向 A股、港股、美股的本地化 AI 股票分析工具，基于 Wails 与 NaiveUI 构建，集成行情获取、热点资讯解读、资金与财务分析、情绪研判及涨跌预警。其亮点在于兼容 OpenAI、DeepSeek、Ollama 等多模型生态，支持市场与个股双层分析，并强调数据全程本地保存，兼顾隐私与实用性。
summary.en: go-stock is a local-first AI-powered stock analysis tool for China A-shares, Hong Kong, and U.S. markets, built with Wails and NaiveUI. It combines market data retrieval, news interpretation, capital flow and financial analysis, sentiment evaluation, and price alerting in one desktop application.
