Its key strengths are broad LLM compatibility across OpenAI-style APIs, DeepSeek, and Ollama, plus dual-level analysis for both market-wide and individual stock insights while keeping all data stored locally for privacy.

summary.zh: 该项目是 DJI Cloud API Demo 的 Web 化集成方案，基于 Vue 前端与 Spring Boot 后端，联动 EMQX、MySQL、Redis 构建无人机云管控演示环境。其核心价值在于以 Docker Compose 一键部署完整链路，并通过启动脚本自动注入局域网访问地址，便于本地调试、Pilot 2 对接与企业级 PoC 快速落地。
summary.en: This repository packages the DJI Cloud API demo into a deployable web stack, combining a Vue frontend, Spring Boot backend, EMQX MQTT broker, MySQL, and Redis for drone cloud-management workflows. Its main value is operational simplicity: Docker Compose provisions the full environment, while a startup script auto-detects LAN IP settings for correct HTTP/WebSocket exposure. It is well suited for local development, Pilot 2 integration, and rapid enterprise proof-of-concept deployments.

metadata.name: shell_gpt
metadata.description: A command-line productivity tool powered by AI large language models like GPT-5, will help you accomplish your tasks faster and more efficiently.

summary.zh: ShellGPT 是面向终端用户的 AI 命令行助手，通过接入 GPT 等大语言模型，在 Shell 内直接生成命令、代码片段、文档摘要与日志分析结果。其亮点在于支持 stdin/重定向、多平台多 Shell 适配，以及结合系统环境生成可执行命令，适合开发运维、故障排查与日常效率增强。
summary.en: ShellGPT is an AI-powered command-line assistant that brings large language models directly into the terminal to generate shell commands, code snippets, documentation summaries, and log analysis. Its main strengths are seamless stdin and redirection support, cross-platform compatibility across major shells, and environment-aware command generation tailored to the user’s OS and shell, making it valuable for developers, DevOps workflows, troubleshooting, and everyday terminal productivity.

metadata.name: Mobile-SDK-Android-V5
metadata.description: MSDK V5 Sample

summary.zh: 该仓库是 DJI Mobile SDK V5 的 Android 官方示例，面向无人机行业应用开发，展示飞行器控制、硬件接口调用与场景化 UI 组合方式。项目按 sample 与 uxsdk 分层，支持多款消费级和行业级机型，并通过 aircraft、provided、networkImp 等 AAR 组合实现灵活集成，适合快速验证航拍、巡检与企业无人机应用方案。
summary.en: This repository is the official Android sample for DJI Mobile SDK V5, aimed at developers building drone applications on mobile devices. It demonstrates aircraft control APIs, hardware interface access, and scenario-oriented UI composition through a layered sample and UX SDK structure. Supporting both consumer and enterprise DJI products, it enables flexible integration via modular AAR packages such as aircraft, provided, and networkImp, making it well suited for rapid prototyping of aerial imaging, inspection, and industry drone workflows.

summary.zh: DJI Cloud API Demo 是面向无人机云端集成的官方参考实现，演示如何通过 Pilot2 对接第三方云平台，帮助开发者理解设备接入、接口调用与服务联动流程。其价值在于降低云端开发门槛、避免重复造轮子，并提供 Docker 部署入口；但项目已停止维护，仅适合作为学习和原型参考，不宜直接用于生产环境。
summary.en: DJI Cloud API Demo is an official reference implementation for drone-to-cloud integration, showing how DJI Pilot2 connects with third-party cloud platforms and how developers can build service-side interfaces around device access and API workflows. Its main value is reducing integration effort and accelerating prototyping, with optional Docker-based deployment. However, the repository has been officially discontinued and is intended for learning and evaluation only, not direct production use due to potential security and maintenance risks.

metadata.name: hat-trie
metadata.description: C++ implementation of a fast and memory efficient HAT-trie

summary.zh: hat-trie 是一个面向 C++ 的头文件级 HAT-trie 实现，专注于海量字符串集合与映射的高性能、低内存存储。它通过公共前缀压缩与缓存友好结构提升精确查询效率，同时支持前缀检索、最长前缀匹配、前缀删除及高效序列化，适用于自动补全、字典索引、路由匹配和大规模文本键值存储场景。
summary.en: hat-trie is a header-only C++ implementation of the HAT-trie data structure, designed for fast and memory-efficient storage of large string sets and maps. By combining prefix compression with a cache-conscious trie layout, it delivers strong exact-match performance while also supporting prefix range queries, longest-prefix lookup, prefix erasure, and efficient serialization. It is well suited for autocomplete, dictionary indexing, routing, and large-scale string-keyed data stores.

metadata.name: snail-job
metadata.description: 🔥🔥🔥 灵活，可靠和快速的分布式任务重试和分布式任务调度平台

summary.zh: SnailJob 是面向分布式系统的一体化任务重试与调度平台，支持任务可重放、秒级调度、中断控制与流程编排，适合提升微服务场景下的一致性与可运维性。其核心基于分区式分布式架构，兼顾高扩展、容错、监控告警与权限治理，并提供 Java、Python、Go 多语言客户端接入能力。
summary.en: SnailJob is an integrated platform for distributed task retry and scheduling, designed to improve consistency and operability in microservice systems. It supports replayable retries, second-level scheduling, interruptible execution, and workflow orchestration. Built on a partition-based distributed architecture, it emphasizes scalability, fault tolerance, alerting, access control, and operational visibility, while offering multi-language client support for Java, Python, and Go.

metadata.name: khoj
metadata.description: Your AI second brain. Self-hostable. Get answers from the web or your docs. Build custom agents, schedule automations, do deep research. Turn any online or local LLM into your personal, autonomous AI (gpt, claude, gemini, llama, qwen, mistral). Get started - free.

summary.zh: Khoj 是可自托管的“AI 第二大脑”，将本地或在线大模型与个人文档、网页检索和自动化能力整合到统一平台。它支持多端访问、语义搜索、自定义智能体、定时研究与通知分发，兼顾个人私有部署与企业级扩展，亮点在于多模型兼容、文档增强问答和从本地到云端的平滑伸缩。
summary.en: Khoj is a self-hostable AI “second brain” that unifies local or hosted LLMs with document retrieval, web search, and task automation in one platform. It supports semantic search across personal knowledge sources, custom agents with distinct tools and personas, and multi-channel access from browser to desktop and messaging apps. Its key strengths are broad model interoperability, retrieval-augmented answering over heterogeneous documents, and smooth scaling from private on-device use to enterprise deployments.

metadata.name: GLM-4
metadata.description: GLM-4 series: Open Multilingual Multimodal Chat LMs | 开源多语言多模态对话模型

summary.zh: GLM-4 是一套开源多语言多模态对话模型家族，覆盖 9B 到 32B 参数规模，兼顾聊天、推理、代码生成、函数调用与研究型写作。项目亮点在于 15T 高质量预训练数据、对齐与强化学习联合优化，以及支持本地部署与 Agent 场景，适用于企业助手、搜索问答、复杂分析和工程开发等任务。
summary.en: GLM-4 is an open-source family of multilingual and multimodal chat models spanning 9B to 32B parameters, designed for dialogue, reasoning, code generation, function calling, and research-style writing. Its key strengths include pretraining on 15T high-quality tokens, post-training with alignment and reinforcement learning, and practical support for local deployment and agent workflows. It fits enterprise assistants, search-based QA, software engineering, and complex analytical tasks.

metadata.name: ChatGLM3
metadata.description: ChatGLM3 series: Open Bilingual Chat LLMs | 开源双语对话语言模型

summary.zh: ChatGLM3 是面向中英双语对话的开源大语言模型系列，以 6B 参数实现较低部署门槛与较强综合能力。项目覆盖基础版、8K/32K/128K 长上下文版本，支持多轮对话、Function Call、代码执行与 Agent 场景，适合私有化部署、应用集成和研究评测，亮点在于统一 Prompt 设计与完整开源模型谱系。
summary.en: ChatGLM3 is an open bilingual conversational LLM family that balances strong capability with relatively lightweight 6B deployment. The repository offers base, chat, and extended-context variants up to 128K tokens, while natively supporting multi-turn dialogue, function calling, code execution, and agent-style workflows. It is well suited for private deployment, application integration, and research benchmarking, with standout value in its unified prompt design and comprehensive open model lineup.

metadata.name: ragflow
metadata.description: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs

summary.zh: RAGFlow 是面向企业知识库与智能问答场景的开源 RAG 引擎，将检索增强生成与 Agent 能力融合，提供更强上下文编排层。项目强调文档解析、知识索引、检索召回与推理协同，支持云端与自托管部署，适合构建高质量企业搜索、知识助手和复杂工作流型 LLM 应用。
summary.en: RAGFlow is an open-source RAG engine for enterprise knowledge bases and intelligent Q&A, combining retrieval-augmented generation with agent capabilities to build a stronger context layer for LLM applications. It focuses on document understanding, knowledge indexing, retrieval orchestration, and reasoning workflows, while supporting both cloud and self-hosted deployment. It is well suited for enterprise search, knowledge assistants, and production-grade, workflow-driven AI systems.

metadata.name: vanblog
metadata.description: 一款简洁实用优雅的个人博客系统

summary.zh: VanBlog 是面向个人站长的一体化博客系统，集前台静态生成、后台管理与服务端于一体。项目以 React 为核心，兼顾极致性能、SEO 友好与移动端适配，支持按需自动 HTTPS、增量渲染、内置评论、流量分析和图床能力，适合希望低运维成本快速搭建高可定制个人博客的场景。
summary.en: VanBlog is an all-in-one blogging platform for individual creators, combining a statically generated frontend, admin dashboard, and backend services. Built around React, it emphasizes high performance, SEO friendliness, and responsive design, while offering on-demand automatic HTTPS, incremental rendering, built-in comments, analytics, and image hosting. It suits users who want a low-ops yet highly customizable personal blog system.

metadata.name: monolith
metadata.description: ⬛️ CLI tool and library for saving complete web pages as a single HTML file

summary.zh: Monolith 是一款用 Rust 构建的 CLI 与库，可将网页及其 CSS、图片、JavaScript 等依赖完整内嵌为单一 HTML5 文件，便于离线阅读、归档与分享。相比浏览器“另存为”或 wget 抓取，它通过 Data URL 保留页面原始渲染效果，适合数字存档、知识管理和网页快照场景。
summary.en: Monolith is a Rust-based CLI tool and library that captures a web page and inlines its dependent assets—CSS, images, and JavaScript—into a single self-contained HTML5 file. Unlike browser “Save page as” or `wget -mpk`, it uses data URLs to preserve original rendering for reliable offline viewing. It is well suited for web archiving, knowledge management, reproducible snapshots, and portable page sharing.

metadata.name: DetSql
metadata.description: Burp插件，快速探测可能存在SQL注入的请求并标记，提高测试效率

summary.zh: DetSql 是一款基于 BurpSuite Montoya API 的 Java 安全测试插件，用于从 HTTP 流量中快速筛选和标记疑似 SQL 注入请求。它结合报错、数字、字符、布尔及 ORDER BY 等多类注入判定策略，并通过 Levenshtein、Jaccard 相似度与响应长度阈值联合分析，在减少无效拦截的同时提升手工渗透测试效率。
summary.en: DetSql is a BurpSuite extension built with the Java-based Montoya API to rapidly identify and label HTTP requests that may be vulnerable to SQL injection. It combines multiple detection strategies, including error-based, numeric, string, boolean, and ORDER BY style checks, then correlates response differences using Levenshtein similarity, Jaccard similarity, and response-length thresholds. The result is faster traffic triage with fewer unnecessary interceptions during manual security testing.

metadata.name: metabase
metadata.description: The easy-to-use open source Business Intelligence and Embedded Analytics tool that lets everyone work with data :bar_chart:

summary.zh: Metabase 是面向企业与 SaaS 场景的开源 BI 与嵌入式分析平台，支持无 SQL 自助问答、SQL 深度查询、交互式仪表板、告警订阅与数据建模。其亮点在于兼顾自托管与云部署，提供细粒度权限控制、Git 版本化和可嵌入组件，并结合 AI 助手提升数据探索与分析效率。
summary.en: Metabase is an open-source BI and embedded analytics platform for internal teams and SaaS products. It enables self-service querying without SQL, advanced analysis with a native SQL editor, interactive dashboards, alerts, subscriptions, and data modeling workflows. Key strengths include flexible cloud or self-hosted deployment, granular permissions, Git-based content versioning, embeddable analytics components, and AI-assisted data exploration through Metabot and agent APIs.

metadata.name: mapstruct-plus
metadata.description: MapStruct Plus is an enhancement to the MapStruct framework. It can automatically generate the transformation operation between two classes through an annotation, omitting the operation of defining the interface of MapStruct, makes Java type conversion easy and elegant.

summary.zh: MapStruct Plus 是面向 Java 的对象映射增强框架，基于 MapStruct 通过 `AutoMapper` 注解与注解处理器自动生成类型转换代码，省去手写 Mapper 接口。它适合 DTO、实体、业务对象间高频转换场景，结合 Spring Boot Starter 与统一 `Converter` API，兼顾零反射性能、低侵入集成与更简洁的开发体验。
summary.en: MapStruct Plus is a Java object-mapping enhancement built on top of MapStruct. By using `AutoMapper` annotations and annotation processing, it auto-generates type conversion code without requiring developers to manually define mapper interfaces. It targets frequent conversions among DTOs, entities, and domain models, and provides a unified `Converter` API plus Spring Boot starter integration, delivering compile-time safety, reflection-free performance, and a much cleaner developer experience.

metadata.name: Mybatis-PageHelper
metadata.description: Mybatis通用分页插件

summary.zh: PageHelper 是面向 MyBatis 的通用物理分页插件，通过拦截 SQL 自动生成分页与统计查询，适用于单表、多表及复杂查询场景。其亮点在于支持多种数据库方言与自动识别数据源，可扩展自定义 dialectAlias，兼顾老版本兼容性与企业级集成效率。
summary.en: PageHelper is a general-purpose physical pagination plugin for MyBatis that intercepts SQL to generate paged queries and count statements automatically. It fits single-table, multi-table, and complex query scenarios. Key strengths include broad multi-database dialect support, automatic data source dialect detection, extensible custom dialect aliases, and strong compatibility for enterprise Java persistence stacks.

metadata.name: pagehelper-spring-boot
metadata.description: pagehelper-spring-boot

summary.zh: 该仓库提供 PageHelper 与 Spring Boot 的开箱即用集成，自动完成 MyBatis 分页插件装配与属性映射，适用于需要快速接入数据库分页的企业级 Java 应用。项目持续跟进 PageHelper 6.x、Spring Boot 3/4 与 JDK17+ 生态，支持异步 count、自定义 SQL 解析器与 SPI 扩展，兼顾易用性、兼容性和可扩展性。
summary.en: This repository delivers a plug-and-play Spring Boot starter for integrating PageHelper with MyBatis, enabling rapid adoption of database pagination in Java applications. Its core value lies in auto-configuration and property binding that reduce manual setup while staying aligned with PageHelper 6.x, Spring Boot 3/4, and JDK 17+. Notable highlights include async count support, customizable SQL parser implementations, SPI-based extension points, and strong version compatibility maintenance.

metadata.name: kong
metadata.description: 🦍 The API and AI Gateway

summary.zh: Kong 是面向 API、LLM 与 MCP 的云原生高性能网关，提供路由、负载均衡、健康检查、认证鉴权等核心流量治理能力，并以插件体系实现强扩展。项目同时强化 AI 流量管理，支持多模型接入、语义安全、MCP 安全与分析，适用于微服务、Kubernetes 入口层及企业级 AI 应用统一治理。
summary.en: Kong is a cloud-native, high-performance gateway for APIs, LLMs, and MCP traffic, combining routing, load balancing, health checks, authentication, and policy enforcement in a single control layer. Its plugin-driven architecture makes it highly extensible, while newer AI Gateway capabilities add multi-LLM integration, semantic security, MCP protection, and traffic analytics. It fits microservice platforms, Kubernetes ingress scenarios, and enterprise environments that need unified governance for both traditional API and AI workloads.

metadata.name: automation
metadata.description: 一些青龙自用自动打卡功能：wps、OPPO、贝锐

summary.zh: 该仓库面向青龙面板用户，提供 WPS、OPPO/一加与贝锐等平台的自动签到、积分任务与日常福利领取脚本。项目以 Cookie 驱动的多平台自动化为核心，兼顾部署便捷性与实用性；其中 WPS 场景集成验证码识别方案，并支持自建识别服务，适合个人日常运营、积分累积和账号任务自动执行。
summary.en: This repository targets QingLong users and provides automation scripts for WPS, OPPO/OnePlus, and Oray daily check-ins, point tasks, and reward collection. Its core value lies in cookie-based multi-service automation with lightweight deployment and practical account maintenance workflows. A notable highlight is the WPS captcha-solving flow, which supports an external recognition service and self-hosted deployment, making it useful for personal task automation, benefit collection, and routine account operations.

metadata.name: VideoCaptioner
metadata.description: 🎬 卡卡字幕助手 | VideoCaptioner - 基于 LLM 的智能字幕助手 - 视频字幕生成、断句、校正、字幕翻译全流程处理！- A powered tool for easy and efficient video subtitling.

summary.zh: VideoCaptioner 是一款基于 LLM 的视频字幕全流程工具，覆盖语音识别、智能断句、字幕校正、翻译与烧录合成。项目同时提供 CLI 与桌面 GUI，内置必剪识别、必应/谷歌翻译等免配置能力，并兼容 OpenAI 接口实现高质量字幕优化，适合内容创作、跨语种分发与批量字幕生产场景。
summary.en: VideoCaptioner is an LLM-powered end-to-end video subtitling tool that handles transcription, sentence segmentation, subtitle refinement, translation, and video synthesis. It offers both a CLI and desktop GUI, with zero-config free options such as Bijian ASR and Bing/Google translation, while supporting OpenAI-compatible APIs for higher-quality subtitle polishing. It fits creators, localization workflows, and large-scale multilingual subtitle production.

metadata.name: MinerU
metadata.description: Transforms complex documents like PDFs and Office docs into LLM-ready markdown/JSON for your Agentic workflows.

summary.zh: MinerU 是面向 LLM/Agent 工作流的文档解析工具，可将 PDF、Office 等复杂文档高保真转换为 Markdown 与结构化 JSON。其核心价值在于保留版面、表格等关键信息，降低知识入库、检索增强生成与自动化处理前的清洗成本，适用于企业知识库、数据抽取与文档智能分析。
summary.en: MinerU is a document understanding and conversion toolkit built for LLM and agent workflows, transforming complex PDFs and Office files into high-fidelity Markdown and structured JSON. Its main value lies in preserving layout-aware content such as tables and rich document structure, which reduces preprocessing cost for RAG pipelines, knowledge ingestion, automated extraction, and downstream document intelligence applications.

metadata.name: gunrock
metadata.description: Programmable CUDA/C++ GPU Graph Analytics

summary.zh: Gunrock 是面向 GPU 的 CUDA/C++ 图分析库，采用基于 frontier 的高层数据中心抽象，兼顾性能与可编程性。支持 NVIDIA CUDA 与 AMD ROCm 双后端，适合构建 BFS、PageRank 等可扩展图算法，并支持单机多 GPU 场景。
summary.en: Gunrock is a CUDA/C++ graph analytics library for GPUs, built around a frontier-based, data-centric abstraction that balances performance and programmability. It supports both NVIDIA CUDA and AMD ROCm backends, making it well-suited for scalable graph algorithms such as BFS and PageRank across single-node multi-GPU deployments.

metadata.name: cugraph
metadata.description: cuGraph - RAPIDS Graph Analytics Library

summary.zh: cuGraph 是 RAPIDS 体系中的 GPU 图分析库，面向大规模图构建、操作与高性能算法执行。它以 CUDA/C++ 为核心，提供 Python、C/C++ 与 pylibcugraph 多层接口，可无缝衔接 cuDF、cuML、Dask 及 NetworkX/Pandas 生态，适用于图计算加速、数据科学流水线集成和分布式图分析场景。
summary.en: cuGraph is RAPIDS’ GPU-accelerated graph analytics library for constructing, manipulating, and analyzing large-scale graphs with high performance. Built on CUDA/C++ and exposed through Python, C/C++, and pylibcugraph APIs, it integrates tightly with cuDF, cuML, Dask, and NetworkX/Pandas-compatible workflows. It is well suited for accelerated graph algorithms, end-to-end data science pipelines, and distributed graph processing on modern GPU infrastructure.

metadata.name: pgrouting
metadata.description: Repository contains pgRouting library. Development branch is "develop", stable branch is "master"

summary.zh: pgRouting 是构建于 PostgreSQL/PostGIS 之上的空间网络分析扩展，面向路径规划、配送调度、服务区分析与图论计算场景。项目以 C/C++、Boost Graph 与 SQL 扩展实现，提供 Dijkstra、A*、Yen、TSP、全源最短路等算法，兼顾数据库内计算性能、可扩展性与地理空间数据集成能力。
summary.en: pgRouting is a PostgreSQL/PostGIS extension for geospatial routing and network analysis, designed for route planning, logistics optimization, service area analysis, and graph-based spatial computation. Implemented with C/C++, SQL extension mechanisms, and Boost Graph Library, it delivers algorithms such as Dijkstra, A*, Yen’s K-shortest paths, TSP, driving distance, and all-pairs shortest path while keeping computation close to spatial data for strong performance and extensibility.

metadata.name: pgrx
metadata.description: Build Postgres Extensions with Rust!

summary.zh: pgrx 是面向 PostgreSQL 13-18 的 Rust 扩展开发框架，提供从项目初始化、版本管理、交互调试到打包测试的一体化工具链。它通过宏、类型映射与自动 Schema 生成，降低 UDF、自定义类型和 SPI 开发门槛，并用 panic 到 ERROR 转换、内存上下文封装等机制强化安全性与多版本兼容能力。
summary.en: pgrx is a Rust framework for building PostgreSQL extensions across Postgres 13-18 with an integrated developer toolchain. It streamlines extension scaffolding, local runtime management, cross-version testing, packaging, and schema generation through `cargo-pgrx`, procedural macros, and type mappings. Its core strengths are safety-oriented abstractions over Postgres internals, ergonomic UDF and custom type support, and reliable compatibility for extension teams targeting multiple PostgreSQL releases from one Rust codebase.

metadata.name: A-star-CUDA
metadata.description: A* implementation for NVIDIA GPU

summary.zh: 该仓库实现面向 NVIDIA GPU 的大规模并行 A* 搜索，基于 AAAI 论文复现并扩展通用框架。项目同时提供滑块拼图与二维网格寻路示例，展示如何借助 CUDA 提升启发式搜索吞吐，适用于并行路径规划、组合状态搜索及教学中的 GPU 算法设计分析。
summary.en: This repository implements a massively parallel A* search framework for NVIDIA GPUs with CUDA, based on the AAAI paper “Massively Parallel A* Search on a GPU.” It includes a generic A* core plus sample applications for sliding-puzzle solving and 2D grid pathfinding, demonstrating how GPU parallelism boosts heuristic search throughput for path planning, combinational state-space exploration, and educational study of parallel search design.

metadata.name: tvbox
metadata.description: 自用tvbox源分享，影视仓多仓源分享，tvbox相关资源记录，iptv直播

summary.zh: 该仓库聚焦 TVBox 与影视仓的自用资源整合，提供多仓源接口、单仓源说明及 IPTV 直播源索引，便于电视盒子和手机端快速配置与切换。其亮点在于维护可直连的多仓 JSON 接口，兼顾影视点播、直播与多版本客户端适配，适合家庭影音折腾与资源管理。
summary.en: This repository curates personal TVBox and Yingshicang resources, including multi-source configuration endpoints, single-source references, and IPTV live-stream indexes for quick setup on TV boxes and mobile devices. Its main value lies in maintained multi-repo JSON interfaces, practical source-switching support, and coverage across VOD, live TV, and multiple client variants, making it useful for home media customization and source management.

metadata.name: FreeControl
metadata.description: 在PC上控制Android设备

summary.zh: FreeControl 是一款基于 scrcpy 的 Windows 端安卓控制工具，使用 C# 与 .NET Framework 4.7.2 开发，为 PC 操控手机提供更易用的图形界面。它聚焦设备连接、键盘输入、无线调试与自定义 scrcpy 参数配置，降低 adb/scrcpy 的使用门槛，适合日常投屏操控、远程输入和开发调试场景。
summary.en: FreeControl is a Windows GUI tool for controlling Android devices from a PC, built in C# on .NET Framework 4.7.2 and powered by scrcpy. It simplifies Android screen control and input by wrapping adb/scrcpy capabilities in an accessible desktop interface. Key strengths include configurable scrcpy paths and arguments, USB and wireless debugging support, and improved keyboard input handling, making it practical for screen mirroring, desktop-based phone control, and developer testing workflows.

metadata.name: macos
metadata.description: MacOS inside a Docker container.

summary.zh: dockur/macos 通过 Docker 封装 macOS 虚拟化运行环境，结合 KVM 硬件加速、浏览器访问界面与镜像自动下载，显著降低本地部署门槛。适用于开发测试、远程体验、CI/Codespaces 场景，并支持 Compose、CLI 与 Kubernetes 多种交付方式及版本、磁盘等参数化配置。
summary.en: dockur/macos packages macOS into a Docker-friendly virtualization workflow, combining KVM acceleration, a web-based viewer, and automatic image download to reduce setup friction. It targets development, testing, remote access, and cloud workspace scenarios such as Codespaces, while offering flexible deployment through Docker Compose, CLI, and Kubernetes with tunable macOS version and storage settings.

metadata.name: windows
metadata.description: Windows inside a Docker container.

summary.zh: 将微软 Windows 通过 KVM/QEMU 封装进 Docker 容器，提供自动下载 ISO、Web 远程查看与一键安装体验，适合快速搭建隔离的 Windows 测试环境、兼容性验证或临时桌面。支持多版本 Windows/Server 选择与持久化存储配置。
summary.en: Runs Microsoft Windows inside Docker using KVM/QEMU, with automatic ISO downloading, a web-based viewer, and hands-off installation. It fits isolated Windows test labs, compatibility checks, and disposable desktops, while supporting multiple Windows/Server versions and persistent storage.

metadata.name: decode-js
metadata.description: JS混淆代码的AST分析工具 AST analysis tool for obfuscated JS code

summary.zh: decode-js 是一款基于 Babel AST 的 JavaScript 混淆代码分析与还原工具，面向逆向分析、安全研究和恶意脚本审计场景。它可处理 stringArray、死代码、switch 控制流扁平化、对象表达式与字符串拆分等局部变换，并支持自保护、禁调试、禁控制台输出等自定义对抗逻辑，适合针对 sojson、obfuscator 等常见混淆体系进行自动化解混淆。
summary.en: decode-js is a Babel AST-based deobfuscation toolkit for analyzing and transforming obfuscated JavaScript in reverse engineering, security research, and malicious script auditing workflows. It targets common obfuscation patterns such as stringArray extraction, dead code removal, switch-based control-flow flattening, and localized transformers like object-expression rewrites and split strings. It also handles custom anti-analysis logic including self-defending, debug protection, and console suppression, making it practical for sojson- and obfuscator-style payloads.

metadata.name: chartdb
metadata.description: Database diagrams editor that allows you to visualize and design your DB with a single query.

summary.zh: ChartDB 是一款基于 Web 的开源数据库建模与可视化编辑器，可通过单条 Smart Query 直接导入数据库架构并生成 ER 图，支持交互式编辑、SQL/DDL 导出与多种数据库迁移场景，适合团队协作、文档化和快速理解复杂表结构。
summary.en: ChartDB is an open-source, web-based database diagram editor that imports schemas with a single Smart Query, renders interactive ER diagrams, and exports SQL/DDL for migrations. It targets fast schema visualization, collaborative design, and cross-database workflows without requiring an account or database password.

metadata.name: toBeBetterJavaer
metadata.description: 一份通俗易懂、风趣幽默的Java学习指南，内容涵盖Java基础、Java并发编程、Java虚拟机、Java企业级开发、Java面试等核心知识点。学Java，就认准二哥的Java进阶之路😄

summary.zh: toBeBetterJavaer 是面向 Java 学习与求职进阶的系统化知识库，以原创教程串联 Java 基础、并发、JVM、企业级开发、数据库与面试题，兼顾学习路线与实战导向。其亮点在于内容覆盖完整、表达通俗幽默，并提供在线阅读与离线资料，适合自学者、高校学生及校招社招求职人群。
summary.en: toBeBetterJavaer is a comprehensive Java learning knowledge base designed for self-learners and job seekers advancing toward real-world development roles. It connects original tutorials across Java fundamentals, concurrency, JVM, enterprise development, databases, and interview preparation, while also offering structured learning paths. Its key strengths are broad coverage, approachable and humorous explanations, and dual access through online reading and downloadable materials for efficient, long-term study.

metadata.name: beanshell
metadata.description: Beanshell scripting language

summary.zh: BeanShell 是可嵌入 JVM 的轻量级 Java 脚本解释器，支持动态执行标准 Java 语法，并扩展宽松类型、命令式调用与闭包能力。适用于应用扩展、规则引擎、配置、测试、调试和教学场景；以纯 Java 实现、可与宿主对象直接交互，是面向运行时脚本化与快速原型的成熟方案。
summary.en: BeanShell is a lightweight embeddable JVM scripting interpreter that executes standard Java syntax dynamically while adding scripting features such as loose typing, commands, and closure-style methods. It fits application extensibility, rules engines, configuration, testing, debugging, and education. Implemented in pure Java and running inside the same VM, it can operate directly on live application objects, making it a practical runtime scripting and rapid prototyping solution.

metadata.name: oha
metadata.description: Ohayou(おはよう), HTTP load generator, inspired by rakyll/hey with tui animation.

summary.zh: oha 是一款基于 Rust 的轻量级 HTTP 压测工具，面向接口性能测试、服务基准评估与容量验证场景。它以 tokio 提供高并发请求能力，结合 ratatui 输出实时终端动画与统计信息，并支持 native-tls、rustls、VSOCK 及实验性 HTTP/3，兼顾性能、可观测性与多平台分发体验。
summary.en: oha is a lightweight HTTP load generator written in Rust for API benchmarking, performance testing, and capacity validation. It delivers high-concurrency request execution with Tokio and a realtime terminal dashboard powered by Ratatui, combining speed with strong observability. The tool also supports flexible TLS backends, VSOCK, and experimental HTTP/3, making it a modern cross-platform alternative to traditional CLI load testers.

metadata.name: Bulk-Crap-Uninstaller
metadata.description: Remove large amounts of unwanted applications quickly.

summary.zh: BCUninstaller 是面向 Windows 的批量卸载与残留清理工具，适合 IT 运维、装机维护及个人环境治理。它支持静默批处理卸载、孤立程序识别，并兼容 Store 应用、Steam、Windows 功能及 NSIS/MSI/InnoSetup 等安装体系，结合 .NET 8 与便携版分发提升部署灵活性。
summary.en: BCUninstaller is a Windows-focused bulk uninstallation and cleanup tool built for IT administrators, technicians, and power users who need to remove many applications efficiently. Its strengths include unattended batch uninstalling, leftover file cleanup, orphaned entry detection, and compatibility with Microsoft Store apps, Steam, Windows Features, and installers such as MSI, NSIS, and Inno Setup, with flexible .NET 8 and portable distribution options.

metadata.name: SpringBootVul-GUI
metadata.description: 一个半自动化springboot打点工具，内置目前springboot所有漏洞

summary.zh: SpringBootVul-GUI 是一款面向授权安全测试的半自动化 Spring Boot 漏洞验证与利用工具，基于 JavaFX 提供图形化操作，覆盖配置泄露、密码脱敏明文、SpEL/Groovy/JNDI/H2/Eureka 等高危场景。其亮点在于集成多类 POC/RCE 利用、交互式命令执行、heapdump 下载分析及部分痕迹清理，适合安全研究、漏洞复现与内网攻防演练。
summary.en: SpringBootVul-GUI is a semi-automated Spring Boot security testing tool for authorized research and assessment. Built with JavaFX, it provides a GUI to validate and exploit a broad range of Spring Boot issues, including misconfiguration leaks, credential disclosure, SpEL, Groovy, JNDI, H2, Eureka, and Gateway-related RCE paths. Its main strengths are integrated POC and exploitation workflows, interactive command execution, heapdump retrieval, and limited artifact cleanup for practical vulnerability reproduction and red-team style testing.

metadata.name: yazi
metadata.description: 💥 Blazing fast terminal file manager written in Rust, based on async I/O.

summary.zh: Yazi 是一款以 Rust 构建的高性能终端文件管理器，基于异步 I/O 与多线程任务调度，实现快速浏览、预览和批量操作。它面向重度 CLI 用户，支持图片协议、代码高亮、Lua 并发插件、虚拟文件系统及跨实例通信，并集成 ripgrep、fzf、zoxide 等工具，兼顾可扩展性与日常可用性。
summary.en: Yazi is a high-performance terminal file manager written in Rust, built on non-blocking async I/O and multi-threaded task scheduling for fast navigation, previews, and bulk operations. Designed for power CLI users, it combines image protocol support, syntax highlighting, concurrent Lua plugins, a virtual filesystem, and cross-instance communication. Tight integration with tools like ripgrep, fd, fzf, and zoxide makes it both extensible and practical as a daily driver.

metadata.name: CF-Workers-docker.io
metadata.description: 这个项目是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 的 Docker 镜像代理工具。它能够中转对 Docker 官方镜像仓库的请求，解决一些访问限制和加速访问的问题。

summary.zh: 该项目利用 Cloudflare Workers/Pages 实现轻量级 Docker Hub 镜像代理，转发官方仓库请求以缓解访问受限和提升拉取速度。支持自部署、自定义域名、首页伪装与 302 跳转，可兼容 Docker、containerd、Podman 等多种容器运行时，亮点在于免服务器部署、配置简单，但需关注 Cloudflare 合规与封禁风险。
summary.en: This project builds a lightweight Docker Hub proxy on Cloudflare Workers and Pages, forwarding requests to official registries to bypass access limitations and improve image pull speed. It supports self-hosting, custom domains, homepage masquerading, and 302 redirects, and works with Docker, containerd, and Podman mirror configurations. Its main strengths are serverless deployment and minimal setup, while the key tradeoff is compliance and account suspension risk under Cloudflare’s proxy-related policies.

metadata.name: Bili.Copilot
metadata.description: B站第三方 Windows 桌面客户端，使用 Windows App SDK 构建的原生应用

summary.zh: Bili.Copilot 是面向 Windows 11 的 B 站第三方原生桌面客户端，基于 Windows App SDK 重构，兼顾播放、下载与 AI 辅助体验。项目以 WinUI 3 为界面基础，集成 MPV 播放、BBDown/ffmpeg 下载链路，并通过共享 agent-kernel 接入多种大模型，适合追求原生性能、开放生态与可扩展能力的哔哩哔哩重度用户。
summary.en: Bili.Copilot is a native third-party Bilibili desktop client for Windows 11, rebuilt with Windows App SDK to deliver a modern playback, download, and AI-assisted experience. It uses WinUI 3 for the UI, integrates MPV for stable video playback, bundles BBDown and ffmpeg for downloading workflows, and connects to multiple LLM services through a shared agent-kernel. It is well suited for users seeking native performance, extensibility, and an open community-driven Bilibili client.

metadata.name: spring-startup-analyzer
metadata.description: spring-startup-analyzer generates an interactive spring application startup report that lets you understand what contributes to the application startup time and helps to optimize it.🚀

summary.zh: Spring Startup Analyzer 面向 Spring 应用启动性能诊断与优化，能采集 Bean 初始化、方法调用、线程壁钟耗时及未使用 Jar 等数据，生成可交互分析报告与火焰图，帮助快速定位启动瓶颈；同时提供 Bean 异步初始化能力，用于缩短生产及预发环境启动时间，适合 Spring Boot 服务治理与启动优化场景。
summary.en: Spring Startup Analyzer targets startup performance diagnostics and optimization for Spring applications. It collects bean initialization metrics, method invocation statistics, thread wall-clock profiling data, and unused JAR insights, then renders an interactive report with timelines and flame graphs to pinpoint startup bottlenecks quickly. It also provides asynchronous bean initialization to reduce startup time in production and staging environments, making it valuable for Spring Boot service governance and startup tuning.

metadata.name: deobfuscator
metadata.description: The real deal

summary.zh: Java Deobfuscator 是面向 Java 字节码逆向的去混淆工具，聚焦处理多种商业级混淆器，如 Zelix、Stringer、Allatori 与 DashO。它通过可配置 transformer 链与自动检测机制定位混淆类型，支持分层清理、依赖补全和自定义扩展，适用于安全研究、恶意代码分析、样本还原与逆向工程流程。
summary.en: Java Deobfuscator is a Java bytecode deobfuscation framework designed to reverse protections used by commercial obfuscators such as Zelix Klassmaster, Stringer, Allatori, and DashO. Its core strength lies in configurable transformer pipelines plus automatic obfuscator detection, enabling layered cleanup across complex JARs. The project is well suited for malware analysis, security research, reverse engineering, and recovering analyzable program structure from heavily obfuscated Java artifacts.

metadata.name: jCat
metadata.description: java development Console

summary.zh: jCat 是面向 Java 开发者的运行时控制台，通过 Java Agent 注入目标 JVM，并提供 Web 管理界面执行 Groovy 脚本，实现类似 Chrome DevTools 的在线调试与代码探查。适用于排障、运行时诊断和动态验证逻辑，亮点在于无侵入附着、任意 Java 代码执行及面向生产进程的即时观测能力。
summary.en: jCat is a runtime console for Java developers that attaches to a target JVM via Java Agent and exposes a web UI for executing Groovy scripts. It brings a DevTools-like experience to Java applications, enabling live inspection, troubleshooting, and dynamic logic verification. Its main strengths are non-intrusive process attachment, arbitrary Java code execution, and immediate observability for running services.

metadata.name: delta
metadata.description: A syntax-highlighting pager for git, diff, grep, rg --json, and blame output

summary.zh: delta 是面向 git、diff、grep 与 blame 输出的终端分页器，以语法高亮和可定制排版提升代码审阅效率。它支持逐词差异高亮、并排视图、导航快捷键、改进的冲突与 blame 展示，并兼容 bat 主题、超链接与明暗终端自动检测，适合日常开发、代码评审与命令行取证分析。
summary.en: Delta is a terminal pager for git, diff, grep, and blame output that makes code review faster through syntax highlighting and highly customizable diff rendering. It offers word-level change highlighting, side-by-side views, keyboard navigation, improved merge-conflict and blame presentation, plus bat-compatible themes, terminal hyperlinks, and automatic light/dark background detection for developer-focused CLI workflows.

metadata.name: BinaryEye
metadata.description: Yet another barcode scanner for Android

summary.zh: Binary Eye 是一款基于 ZXing-C++ 的 Android 开源条码工具，支持多种一维/二维条码的扫描与生成。应用无广告、免费，适配横竖屏并可识别反色码，还提供 Deep Link 调起与结果回传能力，适合零售扫码、票券识别、移动录入及系统集成场景。
summary.en: Binary Eye is an open-source Android barcode app built on ZXing-C++, supporting both scanning and generation of a wide range of 1D and 2D codes. It is free and ad-free, works in portrait and landscape, detects inverted barcodes, and exposes deep-link based invocation plus result callbacks, making it useful for retail scanning, ticket validation, mobile data capture, and workflow integration.

metadata.name: Android-DataBackup
metadata.description: DataBackup for Android 7.0+

summary.zh: DataBackup 是一款面向 Android 7.0 以上设备的开源备份工具，依托 Root 权限实现应用与数据的高完整性备份恢复。项目兼容 Magisk、KernelSU、APatch，支持多用户与云端场景，继承高性能脚本方案并提供更易用的图形化体验，适合重装机、迁移和系统维护用户。
summary.en: DataBackup is an open-source backup tool for Android 7.0+ that uses root access to deliver high-integrity app and data backup/restore. It supports Magisk, KernelSU, and APatch, while covering multi-user devices and cloud-oriented workflows. Built on a well-regarded backup script foundation, it adds a more accessible GUI experience for ROM flashing, device migration, and advanced Android maintenance.

metadata.name: xyflow
metadata.description: React Flow | Svelte Flow - Powerful open source libraries for building node-based UIs with React (https://reactflow.dev) or Svelte (https://svelteflow.dev). Ready out-of-the-box and infinitely customizable.

summary.zh: xyflow 是面向 React 与 Svelte 的节点式界面构建框架，提供 React Flow、Svelte Flow 与共享底层系统库。它开箱即用，内置连线、缩放、背景、控制面板等能力，同时支持深度定制，适合工作流编排、可视化编辑器、低代码平台和图形化建模场景。
summary.en: xyflow is a monorepo for building node-based user interfaces in React and Svelte, centered on React Flow, Svelte Flow, and a shared system package. It ships with essential graph interaction features such as connections, minimaps, controls, and backgrounds, while remaining highly customizable. The library is well suited for workflow builders, visual editors, low-code tools, and diagram-driven applications that need flexible, production-ready node graph UX.

metadata.name: lnav
metadata.description: Log file navigator

summary.zh: lnav 是面向终端的智能日志导航器，可自动解压、识别多种日志格式，并按时间合并多文件流，适合运维排障、服务观测与安全审计。其亮点在于支持跟踪轮转日志、错误告警索引、JSON Lines 美化展示，以及在 TUI 内结合正则与 SQLite 对日志进行交互式过滤、检索和分析。
summary.en: lnav is a terminal-native log navigator that automatically decompresses inputs, detects log formats, and merges multiple files into a single time-ordered stream. It is well suited for operations troubleshooting, observability workflows, and security investigations. Key strengths include live tailing with rename discovery, indexed errors and warnings, JSON Lines pretty-printing, and an interactive TUI that combines regex search with SQLite-powered filtering and log analysis.

metadata.name: awesome-fenix
metadata.description: 讨论如何构建一套可靠的大型分布式系统

summary.zh: 该仓库是围绕“如何构建可靠大型分布式系统”展开的开源架构文档，系统梳理单体、微服务、服务网格与无服务等演进路径，并配套示例工程帮助落地。其亮点在于以架构决策为主线，将分布式理论、工程实践与知识地图结合，适合作为架构师与高级工程师的学习参考。
summary.en: This repository is an open-source architecture handbook centered on building reliable large-scale distributed systems. It organizes the evolution path from monoliths to microservices, service mesh, and serverless, and complements the documentation with demo projects for practical adoption. Its key strength is a decision-oriented narrative that connects distributed systems theory, engineering trade-offs, and a structured knowledge map, making it valuable for architects and senior engineers.

metadata.name: AreaCity-JsSpider-StatsGov
metadata.description: 省市区县乡镇三级或四级城市数据，带拼音标注、坐标、行政区域边界范围；2026年04月03日最新采集，提供csv格式文件，支持在线转成多级联动js代码、通用json格式，提供软件转成shp、geojson、sql、导入数据库；带浏览器里面运行的js采集源码，综合了中华人民共和国民政部、中国•国家地名信息库、统计局、高德地图、腾讯地图行政区划数据

summary.zh: 该仓库聚合民政部、统计局、国家地名信息库、高德与腾讯地图数据，提供中国省市区县乡镇三级/四级行政区划数据，含拼音、坐标与边界范围。核心价值在于以 CSV 为底座，配套浏览器端采集脚本、在线 JSON/联动代码生成及 shp、GeoJSON、SQL 转换，适用于地图可视化、行政区查询、数据库入库与 GIS 数据处理。
summary.en: This repository delivers up-to-date Chinese administrative division datasets at 3- and 4-level granularity, covering provinces, cities, districts, counties, and towns with pinyin, coordinates, and polygon boundaries. It integrates sources from the Ministry of Civil Affairs, National Toponym Database, National Bureau of Statistics, AMap, and Tencent Maps. Key strengths include CSV-based distribution, browser-side crawling scripts, online JSON/cascader code generation, and tooling to convert data into SHP, GeoJSON, and SQL for GIS, mapping, and database ingestion workflows.

metadata.name: ChirmyRam-OneDrive-Repository
metadata.description: ChirmyRam OneDrive Repository

summary.zh: 该仓库本质上是一个基于国际版 OneDrive 的超大规模公共资源索引与访问入口，整合九个账号实现多盘聚合、网页浏览、WebDAV 挂载与 Rclone 搬运。README 重点分享目录组织、播放器适配、限流规避和多程序选型经验，技术亮点在于多账号负载、开放式 WebDAV 接入及面向影音/电子书场景的高可用分发实践。
summary.en: This repository is essentially a large-scale public resource index built on international OneDrive accounts, aggregating nine drives for web browsing, WebDAV mounting, and Rclone-based transfer workflows. The README focuses on practical operational knowledge, including directory taxonomy, media player compatibility, throttling mitigation, and drive-index software comparison. Its main technical value lies in multi-account aggregation, open WebDAV access, and resilient content distribution for media and ebook consumption.

metadata.name: CasaOS
metadata.description: CasaOS - A simple, easy-to-use, elegant open-source Personal Cloud system.

summary.zh: CasaOS 是面向家庭与个人场景的开源私有云系统，提供简洁统一的 Web 控制台，用于集中管理应用、存储与设备服务。其核心价值在于降低自托管门槛，帮助用户以更低成本替代部分 SaaS，并构建可控的数据与服务中枢，兼顾易用性、社区生态与个性化扩展能力。
summary.en: CasaOS is an open-source personal cloud platform built for home and individual self-hosting scenarios. It offers a clean, unified web interface for managing apps, storage, and device services from one place. Its main value lies in lowering the barrier to private infrastructure, helping users replace parts of SaaS with a more controllable, cost-efficient hub while retaining usability, extensibility, and strong community-driven ecosystem support.

metadata.name: diff-pdf
metadata.description: A simple tool for visually comparing two PDF files

summary.zh: diff-pdf 是一款用于比较两份 PDF 视觉差异的轻量工具，支持命令行返回差异状态、生成高亮差异 PDF，并提供可缩放对照 GUI 以人工检查细节。项目基于 Poppler、Cairo 与 wxWidgets，适合文档回归测试、版式校对、排版迁移和 PDF 生成结果验证，特点是聚焦页面级可视化比对而非文本语义分析。
summary.en: diff-pdf is a lightweight utility for visually comparing two PDF files. It can return a diff status in CLI workflows, generate a PDF with highlighted visual differences, and launch a simple zoomable GUI for manual inspection and page alignment. Built on Poppler, Cairo, and wxWidgets, it is well suited for document regression testing, layout QA, publishing workflows, and validating PDF rendering outputs, with a focus on page-level visual diffing rather than semantic text comparison.

metadata.name: xl-lighthouse
metadata.description: 新一代全景式实时业务监控系统，承载1000万个监控项，每天可高效处理5000亿条消息。XL-LightHouse是一套支持超大数据量、支持超高并发的实时业务指标监控系统【同时支持单机版】。常见的应用场景包括：PV、UV统计；电商销售额、下单用户数统计；日志量统计；接口调用量、异常量、耗时情况统计；服务器运维监控等功能，系统支持多维度统计，支持各种复杂的条件筛选和逻辑判断，一键部署，一行代码接入，轻松实现业务全链路数据监控，帮助企业快速搭建数据指标监控体系。

summary.zh: XL-LightHouse 是面向海量实时指标场景的业务监控系统，集数据接入、流式计算、时序存储与可视化查询于一体，可承载千万级监控项并日处理 5000 亿消息。适用于 PV/UV、电商交易、接口性能、日志分析及运维监控，支持多维聚合、复杂条件表达式、API 查询与单机/集群部署。
summary.en: XL-LightHouse is a real-time business observability platform for massive metric workloads, combining data ingestion, streaming computation, time-series storage, and visual analytics. It scales to tens of millions of monitored metrics and processes 500 billion messages per day. Typical use cases include PV/UV analytics, e-commerce KPIs, API performance tracking, log statistics, and infrastructure monitoring, with multidimensional aggregation, expression-based filtering, API access, and both standalone and clustered deployment options.

metadata.name: local-path-provisioner
metadata.description: Dynamically provisioning persistent local storage with Kubernetes

summary.zh: Local Path Provisioner 是面向 Kubernetes 的轻量级本地存储动态供给器，可在节点上按配置自动创建基于 hostPath 或 local 的持久卷。它以比原生 Local Persistent Volume 更低的使用复杂度，解决单机、边缘集群和开发测试环境的本地持久化需求，亮点在于动态供给、部署简单、兼容 kustomize，适合快速落地节点本地存储方案。
summary.en: Local Path Provisioner is a lightweight dynamic storage provisioner for Kubernetes that automatically creates node-local persistent volumes backed by either hostPath or local storage. It simplifies adoption compared with Kubernetes’ built-in Local Persistent Volume workflow, making it well suited for single-node clusters, edge environments, and development or test workloads. Key strengths include dynamic provisioning, minimal deployment overhead, and straightforward integration through standard manifests or kustomize.

metadata.name: helium
metadata.description: Lighter web automation with Python

summary.zh: Helium 是构建于 Selenium 之上的 Python 浏览器自动化库，以用户可见文本而非 XPath/CSS 选择器驱动交互，显著降低脚本复杂度。它适合网页测试、数据采集与流程自动化，并强化了 iFrame 穿透、窗口切换及隐式/显式等待等 Selenium 常见痛点场景。
summary.en: Helium is a Python browser automation library built on top of Selenium, offering a higher-level API that targets elements through user-visible labels instead of brittle XPath or CSS selectors. It is well suited for UI testing, web scraping, and workflow automation, while improving developer productivity with easier iFrame handling, popup/window management, and cleaner implicit and explicit wait semantics.

metadata.name: cryptomator
metadata.description: Cryptomator for Windows, macOS, and Linux: Secure client-side encryption for your cloud storage, ensuring privacy and control over your data.

summary.zh: Cryptomator 是面向 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 的开源客户端加密工具，聚焦云存储场景下的本地透明加密。它以虚拟盘方式提供接近原生的文件操作体验，支持多云同步目录接入，并通过 AES-256、Scrypt、文件名加密与目录混淆提升隐私与一致性，适合个人与团队保护 Dropbox、Google Drive、Nextcloud 等云端数据。
summary.en: Cryptomator is an open-source client-side encryption tool for Windows, macOS, and Linux, designed to secure files stored in cloud-synced folders. It delivers transparent access through a virtual drive while preserving user control and avoiding server-side trust assumptions. Key technical strengths include AES-256 encryption, Scrypt-based key derivation, encrypted filenames, and directory obfuscation, making it a strong fit for privacy-conscious individuals and teams using Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, or self-hosted cloud storage.

metadata.name: gdu
metadata.description: Fast disk usage analyzer with console interface written in Go

summary.zh: gdu 是一款以 Go 编写的高性能磁盘占用分析器，面向 SSD 场景通过并行扫描显著提升目录遍历效率，也兼容 HDD。它提供交互式终端界面与非交互输出，支持归档浏览、忽略规则、数据库持久化、JSON 导入和跨文件系统控制，适合服务器排障、磁盘清理、容量审计与大目录结构分析。
summary.en: gdu is a high-performance disk usage analyzer written in Go, optimized for SSDs by leveraging parallel directory scanning while still working well on HDDs. It combines an interactive terminal UI with non-interactive output, and supports archive browsing, ignore rules, database-backed analysis, JSON import, and filesystem boundary control. It is well suited for server troubleshooting, disk cleanup, storage auditing, and inspecting large directory trees efficiently.

metadata.name: docker-qbittorrent
metadata.description: Containerized qBittorrent NOX (i.e., headless)

summary.zh: 该仓库提供面向 qBittorrent NoX 的轻量级 Docker 镜像，主打无界面远程下载场景。项目基于 Alpine 或 Debian 构建，支持多版本标签，默认开放 Web UI 与 BT 端口，并通过非 root 用户、dumb-init、持久化挂载等设计兼顾安全性、可运维性与部署简易性，适合 NAS、家庭服务器和自托管下载环境。
summary.en: This repository packages qBittorrent NoX into a lightweight Docker image for headless BitTorrent downloading with remote web management. It supports multiple version tags, uses Alpine or Debian as base images, exposes both Web UI and peer ports, and emphasizes secure, practical deployment through non-root execution, dumb-init for proper PID 1 handling, and persistent volume mounts. It is well suited for NAS, home servers, and self-hosted download stacks.

metadata.name: buildg
metadata.description: Interactive debugger for Dockerfile, with support for IDEs (VS Code, Emacs, Neovim, etc.)

summary.zh: buildg 是一个基于 BuildKit 的 Dockerfile 交互式调试器，支持断点、单步执行、源码级检查及在构建步骤中启动调试 Shell，帮助开发者定位镜像构建错误与环境问题。项目同时提供 DAP 接口，可接入 VS Code、Emacs、Neovim 等 IDE，兼顾终端调试、可视化集成与 rootless 场景。
summary.en: buildg is an interactive Dockerfile debugger built on top of BuildKit, designed to troubleshoot image build failures and environment issues with breakpoints, step execution, source-level inspection, and interactive shells inside build steps. It also exposes DAP support for IDE integration with VS Code, Emacs, and Neovim, combining terminal-first debugging, editor-based workflows, and rootless execution support.

metadata.name: sealos
metadata.description: Deploy real projects from GitHub or your AI coding agent, then keep them running with AI-powered operations.

summary.zh: Sealos 是基于 Kubernetes 的 AI 原生云操作系统，打通云端开发、应用部署与运维管理全流程。适合构建 AI 应用、SaaS、微服务及托管数据库，亮点是统一云 IDE、数据库与生产环境，降低从开发到上线的复杂度。
summary.en: Sealos is an AI-native cloud operating system built on Kubernetes, unifying development, deployment, and operations across the application lifecycle. It fits AI apps, SaaS, microservices, and managed databases, with cloud IDEs and production management in one platform to simplify delivery.

metadata.name: oceanbase
metadata.description: OceanBase is the unified distributed database for the AI era — open-source, multi-model, one engine for your most demanding workloads.

summary.zh: OceanBase 是蚂蚁集团自研的分布式关系型数据库，基于 Paxos 和通用服务器集群实现高可用、线性扩展与硬件无关部署。项目面向交易、实时分析及 AI 检索场景，兼具 HTAP、向量索引检索、PB 级数据承载和万亿行扩展能力，并以高性能与低存储成本满足企业级核心业务需求。
summary.en: OceanBase is a distributed relational database developed by Ant Group, built on Paxos and commodity server clusters to deliver high availability, linear scalability, and hardware-independent deployment. It targets transactional processing, real-time analytics, and AI retrieval workloads, combining HTAP capabilities, vector indexing and search, PB-scale storage, and trillion-row scalability. Its standout value lies in enterprise-grade performance, efficient resource usage, and support for unified OLTP, OLAP, and vector search scenarios.

metadata.name: alist
metadata.description: 🗂️A file list/WebDAV program that supports multiple storages, powered by Gin and Solidjs. / 一个支持多存储的文件列表/WebDAV程序，使用 Gin 和 Solidjs。

summary.zh: Alist 是一款面向个人与团队的聚合式文件列表和 WebDAV 服务程序，统一接入本地、对象存储、网盘及 SMB/FTP/SFTP 等多种后端。项目以 Gin 提供高性能服务端能力，结合 SolidJS 构建轻量前端，突出多存储整合、开箱即用部署与跨协议访问，适合自建文件门户、统一资源浏览、分享与远程挂载场景。
summary.en: Alist is a unified file listing and WebDAV platform for individuals and teams, designed to aggregate diverse backends such as local disks, object storage, cloud drives, SMB, FTP, and SFTP. Built with Gin on the backend and SolidJS on the frontend, it emphasizes broad storage interoperability, fast deployment, and protocol-agnostic access. It is well suited for self-hosted file portals, centralized resource browsing, sharing workflows, and remote mounting across heterogeneous storage systems.

metadata.name: KubePi
metadata.description: 🚀 现代化、开源的 K8s 面板，1Panel 官方出品。

summary.zh: KubePi 是 1Panel 团队开源的现代化 Kubernetes 管理面板，支持导入多集群并按 cluster、namespace 进行细粒度权限分配。它面向运维与开发协作场景，集应用管理、集群可视化与故障排查于一体，兼顾快速 Docker 部署与易用性，帮助团队降低 K8s 日常运维复杂度。
summary.en: KubePi is a modern open-source Kubernetes control panel from the 1Panel team, designed for multi-cluster operations and developer-friendly troubleshooting. It supports importing multiple Kubernetes clusters, assigning fine-grained permissions at the cluster and namespace levels, and managing in-cluster applications through a visual interface. With simple Docker-based deployment and strong usability, it helps teams reduce the operational complexity of day-to-day K8s management.

metadata.name: zadig
metadata.description: Zadig: An AI-powered, cloud-native, distributed DevOps platform designed for developers

summary.zh: Zadig 是面向企业研发团队的云原生 DevOps 平台，基于 Kubernetes 提供自助式持续交付能力。它聚焦多服务高并发构建、测试与部署，支持灵活工作流编排、发布策略协同、安全审计及 AI 环境巡检/性能诊断，并通过项目模板和服务治理能力实现大规模微服务的批量接入与统一运维。
summary.en: Zadig is a self-service, cloud-native DevOps platform built on Kubernetes for enterprise engineering teams. It focuses on high-concurrency CI/CD across large-scale microservices, offering flexible workflow orchestration, release strategy coordination, and one-click security auditing. Its AI-powered environment inspection and performance diagnosis, combined with project templates and service governance, help organizations onboard, deliver, and manage thousands of services efficiently.

metadata.name: vector-tile-js
metadata.description: Parses vector tiles with JavaScript

summary.zh: 该库以 JavaScript 解析 Mapbox Vector Tile（MVT）二进制数据，基于 pbf 读取瓦片中的图层、要素、属性与几何信息，并支持 bbox 与 GeoJSON 转换。适合 Web 地图渲染、矢量瓦片分析、地图数据处理等场景，优势在于轻量、贴合 MVT 规范、易于嵌入前后端流程。
summary.en: This library parses Mapbox Vector Tile (MVT) data in JavaScript, using pbf to expose tile layers, features, properties, and geometry from compact binary payloads. It also provides feature bounding boxes and GeoJSON conversion, making it useful for web map rendering, vector tile inspection, and geospatial data pipelines. Its key strengths are lightweight design, direct alignment with the MVT spec, and easy integration in browser or Node.js workflows.

metadata.name: BBLL
metadata.description: 一个第三方哔哩哔哩客户端，A third-party bilibili client。

summary.zh: BBLL 是面向电视与大屏场景的第三方哔哩哔哩客户端，基于官方 API 封装实现视频浏览、会员能力适配与遥控器交互播放。其亮点在于 Android TV/低版本兼容、硬件解码播放、针对 D-Pad 的快进快退与页面刷新等大屏体验优化。
summary.en: BBLL is a third-party Bilibili client built for TV and large-screen Android devices, wrapping official Bilibili APIs to deliver browsing, playback, and member-enabled viewing features. Its main strengths are Android TV-oriented interaction design, compatibility across newer and legacy Android versions, hardware-decoded playback, and remote-friendly controls such as seek, refresh, and navigation optimizations.

metadata.name: istio
metadata.description: Connect, secure, control, and observe services.

summary.zh: Istio 是面向 Kubernetes 与微服务体系的开源 Service Mesh，通过 Envoy Sidecar、Ambient Mesh 的 ztunnel 与 Istiod 控制面，统一实现服务连接、安全认证、流量治理与可观测性。其核心价值在于以极少代码侵入，为分布式应用提供细粒度路由、零信任通信、策略控制和遥测采集能力。
summary.en: Istio is an open-source service mesh for Kubernetes and microservices, delivering connectivity, security, traffic control, and observability through Envoy sidecars, the ambient-mode ztunnel, and the Istiod control plane. Its key value lies in adding fine-grained routing, zero-trust service-to-service authentication, policy enforcement, and telemetry collection to distributed applications with minimal or no application code changes.

metadata.name: hurl
metadata.description: Hurl, run and test HTTP requests with plain text.

summary.zh: Hurl 是一款用纯文本定义并执行 HTTP 场景的命令行工具，兼顾接口调试、端到端验证与自动化测试。它支持请求链路编排、变量捕获、XPath/JSONPath 断言、性能与响应完整性校验，可覆盖 REST、GraphQL、SOAP、HTML/XML/JSON 等场景，并输出 JUnit、TAP、HTML 报告，便于集成到 CI/CD 流水线。
summary.en: Hurl is a command-line tool for defining, running, and validating HTTP scenarios in a plain text format. It combines API exploration with automated HTTP testing through chained requests, variable captures, and assertions on status, headers, body, timing, and checksums. Hurl supports REST, GraphQL, SOAP, HTML, XML, and JSON workflows, and produces JUnit, TAP, text, and HTML reports, making it especially effective for CI/CD-driven API and end-to-end validation.

metadata.name: btop
metadata.description: A monitor of resources

summary.zh: btop 是一款基于 C++23 开发的跨平台终端资源监控工具，面向 Linux、macOS 与多种 BSD 系统，集中展示 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络及进程状态。其核心价值在于以高性能、低开销和彩色交互式 TUI 提供直观运维体验，并支持主题化、自定义配置和多平台持续构建。
summary.en: btop is a high-performance terminal-based resource monitor built with C++23 for Linux, macOS, and several BSD variants. It provides an interactive TUI for observing CPU, memory, disks, network traffic, and process activity in one place. Its main strengths are low-overhead runtime behavior, polished visual dashboards, broad Unix-like platform support, and flexible theming and configuration for daily operations and system diagnostics.

metadata.name: searxng
metadata.description: SearXNG is a free internet metasearch engine which aggregates results from various search services and databases. Users are neither tracked nor profiled.

summary.zh: SearXNG 是一款注重隐私的开源元搜索引擎，聚合多个搜索服务与数据库结果，避免用户被跟踪或画像。项目支持灵活安装与细粒度配置，适合自建搜索入口、企业内部检索与隐私友好型 Web 搜索场景，亮点在于去中心化整合能力、可定制性及社区驱动的持续演进。
summary.en: SearXNG is a privacy-focused open-source metasearch engine that aggregates results from multiple search services and databases without tracking or profiling users. It is well suited for self-hosted search portals, internal enterprise discovery, and privacy-friendly web search. Key strengths include broad result federation, flexible deployment and configuration, and an active community that continually improves extensibility and usability.

metadata.name: china_area
metadata.description: 2024年中国全国5级行政区划（省、市、县、镇、村）

summary.zh: 该仓库整理并发布2024年中国五级行政区划标准数据，覆盖省、市、县、镇、村共665552条记录，提供CSV与SQL格式，适合政务数据治理、区域分析、地址级联选择和地图基础库构建。其亮点在于基于国家统计局来源、层级完整、含城乡分类编码，并附带2010-2024年度结构变化对比，便于长期统计研究与系统集成。
summary.en: This repository publishes China’s 2024 five-level administrative division dataset, covering provinces, prefecture-level cities, counties, towns, and villages with 665,552 records. It provides CSV and SQL exports for use in government data management, regional analytics, address cascading selectors, and geospatial base datasets. Key strengths include authoritative sourcing from the National Bureau of Statistics, full hierarchical coverage, urban-rural classification codes, and year-over-year comparisons from 2010 to 2024 for longitudinal analysis and integration.

metadata.name: nats-server
metadata.description: High-Performance server for NATS.io, the cloud and edge native messaging system.

summary.zh: nats-server 是 NATS 生态的高性能消息服务器，面向云、边缘与本地环境，提供简单、安全、低延迟的分布式通信能力。它支持现代服务、设备与数字系统之间的轻量级消息传递，具备跨平台部署、丰富多语言客户端生态和 CNCF 背书，适合构建实时事件驱动架构、微服务通信与边缘连接场景。
summary.en: nats-server is the high-performance messaging server behind NATS, designed for cloud, edge, and on-prem environments. It delivers simple, secure, and low-latency communication for distributed services, devices, and digital systems. With broad multi-language client support, lightweight deployment from datacenters to Raspberry Pi, and CNCF alignment, it is well suited for real-time event-driven architectures, microservice communication, and resilient edge connectivity.

metadata.name: docker_image_pusher
metadata.description: 使用Github Action将国外的Docker镜像转存到阿里云私有仓库，供国内服务器使用，免费易用

summary.zh: 该项目通过 GitHub Actions 自动拉取 DockerHub、GHCR、gcr.io、k8s.io 等海外镜像，并转存到阿里云容器镜像服务，解决国内服务器拉取慢或失败的问题。其亮点在于零自建中转、配置门槛低、支持最高 40GB 大镜像、多架构指定、私库镜像源及重名自动处理，适合个人开发者与中小团队构建稳定的国内镜像分发链路。
summary.en: This repository uses GitHub Actions to mirror container images from overseas registries such as Docker Hub, GHCR, gcr.io, and k8s.io into Alibaba Cloud Container Registry, improving pull reliability and speed for servers in China. Key strengths include no self-hosted relay, simple secret-based setup, support for images up to 40GB, manual multi-architecture selection, private registry sources, and automatic name conflict handling, making it practical for developers and small teams needing a stable image distribution workflow.

metadata.name: hertzbeat
metadata.description: An AI-powered next-generation open source real-time observability system.

summary.zh: Apache HertzBeat 是面向基础设施、应用与云资源的开源实时可观测平台，集指标采集、日志汇聚、告警分发与智能分析于一体。其核心亮点是无 Agent 监控、Prometheus 兼容、高性能集群能力，以及融合 AI 交互与 MCP Server，适用于统一运维监控、告警治理和状态页构建等场景。
summary.en: Apache HertzBeat is an open-source real-time observability platform for infrastructure, applications, and cloud services, combining metrics collection, log aggregation, alert distribution, and intelligent analysis in one system. Its key strengths include agentless monitoring, Prometheus compatibility, high-performance clustering, and built-in AI interaction with MCP Server capabilities, making it well suited for unified operations monitoring, alert governance, and status page building.

metadata.name: nginx-proxy-manager
metadata.description: Docker container for managing Nginx proxy hosts with a simple, powerful interface

summary.zh: Nginx Proxy Manager 将 Nginx 反向代理、HTTPS 证书管理与访问控制封装为可视化 Docker 服务，适合家庭实验室、中小团队和自托管场景。用户可通过 Web 界面快速配置域名转发、重定向、流代理与 404 主机，并集成 Let’s Encrypt、权限管理和高级 Nginx 自定义，显著降低 SSL 与网关运维门槛。
summary.en: Nginx Proxy Manager packages Nginx reverse proxying, HTTPS certificate automation, and access control into a Dockerized web-based management service. It is well suited for homelabs, self-hosted services, and small teams that need simple gateway operations. Through an intuitive admin UI, users can configure proxy hosts, redirects, streams, and SSL with Let’s Encrypt, while still retaining advanced Nginx customization, user permissions, and audit-oriented administration.

metadata.name: proxy-tools
metadata.description: 自动同步 mihomo 内核、sing-box 内核、sing-box reF1nd 版内核、Dashboard 面板和 AdGuard Home 最新版

summary.zh: 该仓库通过自动化构建与发布流程，按日同步 mihomo、sing-box、reF1nd 分支、Dashboard 面板及 AdGuard Home 最新版本，面向路由器代理环境与旁路网关运维。其亮点在于多上游统一分发、Linux 精简裁剪、UPX 压缩，以及适配 ShellCrash 等场景的直接下载升级链路。
summary.en: This repository automates daily builds and releases of mihomo, sing-box, reF1nd sing-box, multiple dashboard frontends, and AdGuard Home for proxy and gateway environments. Its value lies in unifying upstream sync and distribution, providing trimmed Linux binaries, UPX-compressed artifacts, and ready-to-use upgrade paths for tools like ShellCrash on routers, sidecars, and self-hosted network appliances.

metadata.name: clash-and-dashboard
metadata.description: clash-dashboard的修改版，与clash一起打包成docker镜像

summary.zh: 基于 Dreamacro/clash-dashboard 改造，面向将 Clash 与管理界面打包进同一 Docker 镜像的场景。后台接口固定连接容器内 9090 端口，省去额外配置，实现单容器内的 Clash 与 Dashboard 联动管理，适合一对一部署。
summary.en: A fork of Dreamacro/clash-dashboard tailored for packaging Clash and its admin UI into one Docker image. The backend is hardwired to connect to the container’s local 9090 port, removing extra configuration and enabling a one-container Clash-plus-dashboard deployment for one-to-one management.

metadata.name: carbonyl
metadata.description: Chromium running inside your terminal

summary.zh: Carbonyl 将 Chromium 直接搬进终端，以原生终端分辨率渲染网页，无需窗口服务器，也可经 SSH 运行。项目结合 Rust 核心与改造版 Chromium 运行时，支持 WebGL、WebGPU、音视频与动画，在启动速度、60FPS 流畅度和极低空闲 CPU 占用上表现突出，适合远程运维、终端浏览和受限图形环境。
summary.en: Carbonyl brings Chromium into the terminal by rendering web content directly at terminal resolution, without requiring a window server and even working over SSH. It combines a Rust-based core with a modified Chromium runtime, enabling broad modern Web API support including WebGL, WebGPU, audio, video, and animations. Its key strengths are sub-second startup, smooth 60 FPS rendering, and near-zero idle CPU usage, making it well suited for remote access, terminal-first browsing, and constrained graphical environments.

metadata.name: Aria2-Pro-Docker
metadata.description: Aria2 Pro | A perfect Aria2 Docker image | 更好用的 Aria2 Docker 容器镜像

summary.zh: Aria2 Pro Docker 是面向多架构环境的增强版 Aria2 容器镜像，开箱即用，适合 NAS、家庭服务器与下载机快速部署。项目围绕高速 BT 下载、自动获取 Tracker、断点与任务状态持久化、异常文件自动清理等场景做深度优化，并提供 RPC 接口，便于配合 AriaNg 等 WebUI 实现远程管理。
summary.en: Aria2 Pro Docker is an enhanced, multi-architecture Aria2 container image built for hassle-free deployment on NAS devices, home servers, and self-hosted download boxes. It extends standard Aria2 with optimized BitTorrent performance, automatic tracker fetching, persistent task state, and cleanup of failed or canceled download artifacts. With built-in RPC support, it integrates smoothly with WebUIs like AriaNg for lightweight remote download management.

metadata.name: docs-linux-kernel-labs-zh-cn
metadata.description: Linux 内核实验（Linux kernel labs）中文翻译

summary.zh: 该仓库是 Linux Kernel Labs 教程的中文文档上游仓库，面向希望系统学习 Linux 内核与驱动开发的读者。内容以实验为核心，结合 QEMU 虚拟机、Docker/手动环境配置，提供从基础到实践的内核教学路径。其亮点在于高质量中文翻译、清晰的课程/实验分层，以及与网站发布链路联动的文档工程化流程。
summary.en: This repository is the upstream Chinese translation source for Linux Kernel Labs, aimed at learners studying Linux kernel internals and device driver development through hands-on labs. It centers on practical exercises, using QEMU-based virtual machines and Docker or manual setup paths to build a progressive learning experience. Key strengths include high-quality localization, a clear course-versus-lab structure, and an automated documentation-to-website publishing pipeline.

metadata.name: plane
metadata.description: 🔥🔥🔥 Open-source Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp alternative. Plane is a modern project management platform to manage tasks, sprints, docs, and triage.

summary.zh: Plane 是面向产品、研发与跨职能团队的开源项目管理平台，对标 Jira、Linear 与 ClickUp，覆盖任务跟踪、冲刺周期、模块拆分、文档协作和实时分析。其亮点在于 React Router + Django + Node.js 组合架构，既支持云端快速开箱，也支持 Docker、Kubernetes 自托管，兼顾团队协同效率与企业级部署灵活性。
summary.en: Plane is an open-source project management platform built for product, engineering, and cross-functional teams, positioned as an alternative to Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp. It combines issue tracking, sprint cycles, modular planning, collaborative docs, and real-time analytics in one workflow. Key strengths include a modern React Router, Django, and Node.js stack, plus flexible deployment through Plane Cloud or self-hosting with Docker and Kubernetes.

metadata.name: papermark
metadata.description: Papermark is the open-source DocSend alternative  and secure data rooms with built-in analytics and custom domains.

summary.zh: Papermark 是面向销售、融资与客户协作场景的开源文档分享平台，对标 DocSend，支持安全链接分发、自定义域名与品牌化展示。项目基于 Next.js、TypeScript、Prisma 与 PostgreSQL 构建，集成 NextAuth、Tinybird、Stripe 和 Resend，兼顾自托管能力、访问分析与商业化扩展，适合打造可控的文档交付与追踪系统。
summary.en: Papermark is an open-source DocSend alternative for secure document sharing in sales, fundraising, and client collaboration workflows. It offers branded shareable links, custom domains, self-hosting, and built-in analytics for tracking engagement. Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, and PostgreSQL, it also integrates NextAuth, Tinybird, Stripe, and Resend, making it a strong foundation for document delivery platforms with observability, authentication, and monetization.

metadata.name: blossom
metadata.description: A markdown editor that you can deploy on your own servers to achieve cloud storage and device synchronization（支持私有部署的云端存储双链笔记软件）

summary.zh: Blossom 是一款支持私有部署的云端双链 Markdown 笔记系统，集笔记、图片管理、博客发布与多端实时同步于一体。其亮点在于不依赖第三方存储、具备文章与图片双向关联、一键备份迁移，并扩展待办、计划、便签等能力，适合个人知识管理与团队协作场景。
summary.en: Blossom is a self-hosted cloud-based bidirectional-link Markdown note system that combines note-taking, image management, blog publishing, and cross-device synchronization. Its key strengths include independence from third-party storage, strong article-image relationship management, one-click backup and migration, and built-in productivity modules such as todos, planning, and sticky notes, making it suitable for personal knowledge management and lightweight team collaboration.

metadata.name: fscan
metadata.description: 一款内网综合扫描工具，方便一键自动化、全方位漏扫扫描。(An intranet comprehensive scanning tool, enabling one-click automated, all-round vulnerability scanning)

summary.zh: Fscan 是面向内网攻防与安全运维的综合扫描工具，覆盖主机发现、端口与服务识别、Web 指纹、弱口令爆破、未授权访问、高危漏洞检测及部分利用链。项目以 Go 实现，采用插件化架构、可嵌入 SDK、多格式 POC 兼容与并发性能优化，适用于内网资产测绘、自动化漏扫和渗透测试前期侦察。
summary.en: Fscan is a Go-based intranet security scanner for red teaming and internal security assessment. It combines host discovery, port and service identification, web fingerprinting, password attacks, unauthorized-access checks, high-risk vulnerability detection, and selected exploitation capabilities in one workflow. Its key strengths include a plugin-oriented architecture, embeddable Go SDK, compatibility with Xray-style POCs, and substantial concurrency and performance optimizations for automated internal asset mapping and vulnerability reconnaissance.

metadata.name: remotely-save
metadata.description: Sync notes between local and cloud with smart conflict: S3 (Amazon S3/Cloudflare R2/Backblaze B2/...), Dropbox, webdav (NextCloud/InfiniCLOUD/Synology/...), OneDrive, Google Drive (GDrive), Box, pCloud, Yandex Disk, Koofr, Azure Blob Storage.

summary.zh: Remotely Save 是一款面向 Obsidian 的非官方跨云同步插件，支持 S3 兼容存储、WebDAV、Dropbox、OneDrive 等多种后端，在桌面与移动端间同步笔记。其亮点是端到端加密、定时自动同步、可跳过大文件与路径规则过滤，并提供基础冲突检测及进阶智能冲突处理，适合自托管或多云笔记管理场景。
summary.en: Remotely Save is an unofficial Obsidian sync plugin that connects local vaults with multiple cloud backends, including S3-compatible storage, WebDAV, Dropbox, and OneDrive, across desktop and mobile devices. Its core strengths include end-to-end encryption, scheduled and manual sync, configurable large-file and path skipping, and built-in conflict detection with advanced smart conflict handling in the Pro tier, making it well suited for privacy-conscious, multi-cloud note synchronization workflows.

metadata.name: obsidian-excalidraw-plugin
metadata.description: A plugin to edit and view Excalidraw drawings in Obsidian

summary.zh: 该插件将 Excalidraw 深度集成进 Obsidian，把手绘白板、文档链接与知识库管理合并到本地优先工作流中。用户可在库内创建、编辑、嵌入与双向链接图稿，适合视觉化笔记、PKM、流程梳理与演示场景。技术亮点在于对 Excalidraw 能力的原生封装、丰富的 Obsidian 集成、强调离线运行与隐私优先的设计取向。
summary.en: This plugin deeply embeds Excalidraw into Obsidian, combining sketch-based whiteboarding, document linking, and knowledge management in a local-first workflow. Users can create, edit, embed, and bi-directionally link drawings directly inside their vault, making it well suited for visual note-taking, PKM, ideation, and workflow mapping. Its key strengths are tight native-style integration with Obsidian, rich Excalidraw functionality, and a privacy-focused architecture designed to work primarily offline.

metadata.name: UE-DDNS
metadata.description: Universal Embedded DDNS Shell Script

summary.zh: UE-DDNS 是面向嵌入式与类 Unix 环境的通用 DDNS POSIX Shell 脚本，通过交互式向导生成可直接运行的定制更新脚本。项目强调低依赖、BusyBox 兼容、IPv4/IPv6 双栈支持，并集成 Cloudflare、DNSPod、GoDaddy 等多家 DNS 服务商，支持从 URL 或网卡获取 IP、代理与接口绑定、重复更新抑制及消息通知，适合 OpenWrt、路由器和轻量服务器动态解析场景。
summary.en: UE-DDNS is a POSIX shell-based dynamic DNS solution built for embedded and Unix-like environments, especially devices with minimal tooling such as BusyBox. It uses an interactive wizard to generate provider-specific DDNS scripts with very low dependency overhead. Key strengths include IPv4/IPv6 support, IP discovery via URL or network interface, strict duplicate-update avoidance, proxy and interface routing options, OpenWrt-aware deployment, and notification integrations. It currently supports Cloudflare, DNSPod, and GoDaddy, making it well suited for routers, lightweight servers, and edge devices.

metadata.name: nvm
metadata.description: Node Version Manager - POSIX-compliant bash script to manage multiple active node.js versions. $nvm: 3ArcxqLtXMmBnWbbtfwQgVL3MNnDsggzgGDtXMnjpump

summary.zh: nvm 是面向 POSIX Shell 的 Node.js 版本管理工具，通过 Bash 脚本在命令行中安装、切换和隔离多个 Node 版本，适合本地开发、CI/CD、跨项目运行时治理。其亮点在于零侵入 shell 集成、`.nvmrc` 自动化工作流、支持 LTS 与镜像源配置，并兼顾 macOS、Linux、Docker 等环境。
summary.en: nvm is a POSIX-compliant shell-based Node.js version manager that lets developers install, switch, and isolate multiple Node runtimes from the command line. It is widely used for local development, CI/CD pipelines, and maintaining consistent per-project environments. Key strengths include lightweight Bash implementation, seamless shell integration, `.nvmrc`-driven workflows, LTS support, mirror configuration, and broad compatibility across macOS, Linux, and Docker setups.

metadata.name: jumpserver
metadata.description: JumpServer is an open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform that provides DevOps and IT teams with on-demand and secure access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, Database and RemoteApp endpoints through a web browser.

summary.zh: JumpServer 是开源特权访问管理（PAM）与堡垒机平台，面向 DevOps 和 IT 场景，统一纳管 SSH、RDP、Kubernetes、数据库及 RemoteApp 访问。其核心亮点是基于浏览器的按需远程接入、细粒度权限控制与审计能力，兼顾多协议资产运维效率与安全合规要求。
summary.en: JumpServer is an open-source Privileged Access Management (PAM) and bastion host platform for DevOps and IT teams. It centralizes secure, on-demand browser-based access to SSH, RDP, Kubernetes, databases, and RemoteApp endpoints. Key strengths include multi-protocol access consolidation, fine-grained permission control, and auditing capabilities that improve operational efficiency while meeting security and compliance requirements.

metadata.name: 1Panel
metadata.description: 🔥 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel and a lightweight AI management platform.

summary.zh: 1Panel 是面向自托管与运维场景的开源 VPS 控制面板，将网站部署、Docker 管理、应用市场与 AI Agent 运行时整合到统一 Web 界面。其亮点在于原生支持 Ollama 与 OpenClaw，可直接部署大模型和智能体并监控 GPU，显著降低服务器管理与 AI 基础设施运维门槛。
summary.en: 1Panel is an open-source VPS control panel for self-hosting and operations, unifying website deployment, Docker management, an app marketplace, and an AI agent runtime in a single web UI. Its standout capability is native support for Ollama and OpenClaw, enabling users to run LLMs, deploy agents, and monitor GPU usage directly from the dashboard, dramatically lowering the barrier to both server administration and AI infrastructure operations.

metadata.name: thingsboard-gateway
metadata.description: Open-source IoT Gateway - integrates devices connected to legacy and third-party systems with ThingsBoard IoT Platform using Modbus, CAN bus, BACnet, BLE, OPC-UA, MQTT, ODBC and REST protocols.

summary.zh: ThingsBoard Gateway 是面向工业与物联网场景的开源 Python 网关，用于将 Modbus、OPC-UA、BACnet、CAN、BLE、MQTT、REST、ODBC 等异构设备与系统统一接入 ThingsBoard。其核心价值在于以可扩展连接器架构完成协议适配、数据采集、格式转换与上云，适合工业监控、楼宇自动化、能源管理及 PoC 快速集成。
summary.en: ThingsBoard Gateway is an open-source, Python-based IoT gateway that bridges legacy and third-party devices to the ThingsBoard platform through a unified ingestion model. It supports diverse protocols such as Modbus, OPC-UA, BACnet, CAN, BLE, MQTT, REST, and ODBC, enabling protocol adaptation, data normalization, and cloud delivery. Its extensible connector architecture makes it well suited for industrial monitoring, building automation, energy systems, and rapid proof-of-concept integrations.

summary.zh: 该仓库面向青龙面板用户，汇集多平台签到、抽奖、续费与预约类自动化脚本，覆盖网盘、社区、代理与云服务等场景。核心价值在于通过环境变量集中配置实现低门槛批量运行，适合个人日常任务托管；技术亮点是围绕 Python 脚本与青龙任务编排形成可持续更新的自动签到脚本集合。
summary.en: This repository targets QingLong users and packages a broad set of automation scripts for daily check-ins, renewals, reservations, and reward tasks across cloud drives, forums, proxy services, and community platforms. Its main value lies in centralized environment-variable configuration and batch task scheduling, making personal routine automation easy to operate. The technical highlight is a continuously updated Python-based script collection designed to run within the QingLong automation ecosystem.

metadata.name: SSR-V2ray-Trojan
metadata.description: 2026机场推荐与机场评测

summary.zh: 该仓库聚焦中文“机场”推荐与评测，围绕 SSR、V2Ray、Trojan 及 Clash 生态，持续整理不同线路类型、带宽稳定性、解锁能力、资费与适用人群。其价值在于把分散的代理服务经验沉淀为可检索的选购指南，强调中转/专线差异、避坑策略、客户端兼容性与长期更新，适合科学上网用户做决策参考。
summary.en: This repository is a curated Chinese guide to proxy service recommendations and reviews, centered on the SSR, V2Ray, Trojan, and Clash ecosystem. It compares routing types, bandwidth stability, streaming and OpenAI unlock capability, pricing tiers, and target user scenarios. Its main value lies in turning scattered operational experience into a structured buyer’s guide, with practical risk warnings, client compatibility notes, and continuously updated benchmarks for users evaluating network acceleration services.

metadata.name: modbus4j
metadata.description: A high-performance and ease-of-use implementation of the Modbus protocol written in Java. Supports ASCII, RTU, TCP, and UDP transports as slave or master, automatic request partitioning and response data type parsing.

summary.zh: modbus4j 是面向工业通信场景的 Java Modbus 协议库，兼顾高性能与易用性。项目同时支持 ASCII、RTU、TCP、UDP 传输，以及主站/从站双角色，适用于 PLC、仪表与 SCADA 集成。其亮点在于自动请求分片、响应数据类型解析和 Maven 依赖集成，能显著降低 Modbus 设备接入与轮询开发复杂度。
summary.en: modbus4j is a Java Modbus library built for industrial communication scenarios, balancing performance with developer usability. It supports ASCII, RTU, TCP, and UDP transports, and can operate as either a master or slave, making it suitable for PLC, meter, and SCADA integrations. Key strengths include automatic request partitioning, response data type parsing, and straightforward Maven integration, which reduce the complexity of connecting and polling Modbus devices at scale.

metadata.name: nifi-minifi-cpp
metadata.description: Apache NiFi - MiNiFi C++

summary.zh: Apache NiFi MiNiFi C++ 是面向边缘侧与数据源近端的数据采集代理，强调轻量化、低资源占用与原生 C++ 部署能力。它继承 NiFi 的数据流管理理念，支持集中管理、数据溯源与表达式语言子集，适合工业设备、传感器、服务器等场景，在源头完成采集、预处理并无缝接入 NiFi 主数据流体系。
summary.en: Apache NiFi MiNiFi C++ is a native, lightweight edge data collection agent designed to run close to data sources with minimal resource usage. It extends NiFi’s flow-based paradigm into constrained environments, providing centralized agent management, data provenance, and partial NiFi Expression Language support. The project is well suited for sensors, industrial systems, and servers that need on-source ingestion, preprocessing, and seamless integration with downstream NiFi dataflows.

metadata.name: nifi-minifi
metadata.description: Apache MiNiFi (a subproject of Apache NiFi)

summary.zh: Apache MiNiFi 是面向边缘侧与数据源头的轻量级数据采集代理，延续 NiFi 的数据流管理理念，将采集、传输与数据溯源前移到传感器、系统或服务器附近。项目强调小体积、集中化管理、数据血缘追踪，并与 Apache NiFi 无缝集成，适用于物联网、边缘计算及分布式数据入口场景。
summary.en: Apache MiNiFi is a lightweight edge data collection agent built to extend Apache NiFi’s flow-based programming model to the point of data creation. It focuses on source-side ingestion near sensors, systems, and servers, while preserving centralized management, provenance generation, and seamless handoff to NiFi for downstream flow orchestration. It is well suited for IoT, edge computing, and distributed data acquisition scenarios.

metadata.name: nifi
metadata.description: Apache NiFi

summary.zh: Apache NiFi 是面向数据流自动化的分布式集成平台，支持可视化编排、实时采集、路由、转换与系统间传输。其核心优势在于高扩展处理器体系、可追踪数据血缘、可靠背压与集群能力，适用于企业数据集成、IoT 数据管道与混合云流转场景。
summary.en: Apache NiFi is a distributed dataflow automation platform for visually designing, ingesting, routing, transforming, and transferring data across systems in real time. Its key strengths include an extensible processor architecture, end-to-end data provenance, reliable backpressure control, and clustered scalability, making it well suited for enterprise integration, IoT pipelines, and hybrid-cloud data movement.

metadata.name: tabby
metadata.description: A terminal for a more modern age

summary.zh: Tabby 是一款面向 Windows、macOS 与 Linux 的现代终端模拟器，集成 SSH、Telnet、串口与 SFTP/Web 能力，适合开发、运维和远程设备管理。其亮点在于高度可配置的快捷键与分屏、跨平台 Shell 兼容、加密凭据管理、Zmodem 文件传输，以及对高吞吐输出和完整 Unicode 的稳健支持。
summary.en: Tabby is a modern cross-platform terminal emulator for Windows, macOS, and Linux, combining terminal, SSH, Telnet, serial, and web-based remote access workflows in one tool. It targets developers, operators, and infrastructure teams with highly configurable keybindings, split panes, broad shell integration, encrypted secret storage, Zmodem file transfer, and reliable handling of fast output streams and full Unicode rendering.

metadata.name: grex
metadata.description: A command-line tool and Rust library with Python bindings for generating regular expressions from user-provided test cases

summary.zh: grex 是一个用 Rust 构建的正则生成工具与库，可根据用户提供的测试样例自动合成高精度正则表达式，并提供 Python 绑定扩展多语言集成。其核心价值在于降低手写复杂正则的成本，适用于测试数据归纳、输入校验、日志匹配等场景，技术亮点是默认生成尽可能具体的表达式，并可通过参数逐步泛化匹配范围。
summary.en: grex is a Rust-based command-line tool and library that automatically synthesizes precise regular expressions from user-provided test cases, with Python bindings for cross-language integration. It helps reduce the effort of crafting complex regexes manually in scenarios such as input validation, log parsing, and test-data generalization. Its key technical strength is generating the most specific possible pattern by default, while allowing users to gradually relax and generalize matching behavior through configurable options.

metadata.name: breezy-weather
metadata.description: A feature-rich weather app with good visualizations and more than 50 sources.

summary.zh: Breezy Weather 是一款面向 Android 的开源天气应用，基于 Kotlin 与 Jetpack Compose 构建，采用 Material 3 Expressive 设计。其核心优势在于聚合 50+ 气象数据源，提供预报、实况、临近预报、空气质量、花粉与预警等能力，并通过精心设计的可视化界面提升多维天气信息的可读性与决策效率。
summary.en: Breezy Weather is an open-source Android weather app built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, and Material 3 Expressive. Its standout strength is broad data aggregation across 50+ weather providers, covering forecasts, observations, nowcasting, air quality, pollen, and alerts. The project emphasizes polished visualizations and a modern mobile UI, making dense multi-source weather data easier to interpret for daily use and weather-aware planning.

metadata.name: sl651-2014
metadata.description: sl651-2014水文通讯协议netty服务端实现

summary.zh: 该仓库基于 Netty 实现 SL651-2014 水文通信协议服务端，支持 TCP/UDP 下的 M1、M2、M4 三种通信方式，并内置 2F 链路维持与 32 定时报文上报处理。项目提供 CRC 校验、粘包分包控制、模拟客户端与可扩展业务接口，适用于水文遥测站接入、报文解析和行业协议服务端快速落地。
summary.en: This repository implements an SL651-2014 hydrological communication protocol server on top of Netty, supporting M1, M2, and M4 modes over TCP or UDP. It includes built-in handling for 2F link maintenance and 32 scheduled reporting, along with optional CRC verification and packet framing controls. With a mock client and extensible business service interface, it is well suited for telemetry station integration, message parsing, and rapid delivery of industry-specific protocol backends.

metadata.name: IoT-Technical-Guide
metadata.description: :honeybee: IoT Technical Guide --- 从零搭建高性能物联网平台及物联网解决方案和Thingsboard源码分析 :sparkles: :sparkles: :sparkles: (IoT Platform, SaaS, MQTT, CoAP, HTTP, Modbus, OPC, WebSocket, 物模型，Protobuf, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Spring Security, OAuth2, RuleEngine, Kafka, Docker)

summary.zh: 该仓库是一套面向 IoT 开发者的系统化技术指南，覆盖协议基础、术语体系、MQTT/CoAP 通信、设备建模、消息削峰、数据库选型与高性能平台架构设计，并延伸到 ThingsBoard 源码分析。其价值在于将分散的物联网知识串成从入门到平台落地的学习路径，适合构建 SaaS 化物联网平台、设备接入与规则引擎解决方案。
