summary.en: This repository is a structured IoT learning guide for developers, covering protocol fundamentals, industry terminology, MQTT/CoAP communication, device modeling, traffic buffering, database selection, and high-performance platform architecture. It also extends into ThingsBoard source code analysis, helping readers connect theory with real-world platform implementation. Its core value lies in turning fragmented IoT knowledge into an end-to-end roadmap for building SaaS-style IoT platforms, device connectivity pipelines, and rule-engine-driven solutions.

metadata.name: thingsboard
metadata.description: Open-source IoT Platform - Device management, data collection, processing and visualization.

summary.zh: ThingsBoard 是面向物联网场景的开源平台，覆盖设备接入、遥测采集、规则处理、告警通知与可视化看板。其核心价值在于以统一平台打通设备管理、数据流转和业务监控，适用于工业监测、SCADA、智慧设备运营等场景，并支持本地部署与云端使用。
summary.en: ThingsBoard is an open-source IoT platform that unifies device provisioning, telemetry ingestion, rule-based processing, alerting, and dashboard visualization. Its key value lies in connecting device management, data pipelines, and operational monitoring within a single platform. It fits industrial monitoring, SCADA, and smart device operations, while supporting both on-premises deployment and cloud-based adoption.

metadata.name: genact
metadata.description: 🌀 A nonsense activity generator

summary.zh: genact 是一个用 Rust 构建的跨平台“伪忙碌”终端工具，通过模拟编译、容器构建、日志滚动、内存转储等场景，制造高负载工作的视觉效果。项目提供多模块切换、速度控制、定时退出与 Shell 补全，并支持 WebAssembly 网页版，适合演示、整活和轻量桌面摸鱼场景。
summary.en: genact is a cross-platform Rust utility that fakes high-intensity terminal activity by simulating tasks such as compilation, Docker builds, log streaming, and memory dumps. It offers multiple switchable modules, speed tuning, timed exit controls, and shell completion generation. With native binaries plus a WebAssembly web version, it is well suited for demos, playful terminal theatrics, and harmless “busy-looking” desktop scenarios.

metadata.name: taipy
metadata.description: Turns Data and AI algorithms into production-ready web applications in no time.

summary.zh: Taipy 是面向数据科学家与机器学习工程师的 Python 框架，用于将数据分析、机器学习和业务流程快速封装为生产级 Web 应用。其亮点在于集成 UI 生成、数据接入、流程编排、情景模拟、定时调度及部署运维能力，帮助团队以纯 Python 兼顾开发效率、可扩展性与落地运维。
summary.en: Taipy is a Python framework for data scientists and ML engineers to turn analytics, AI models, and business workflows into production-ready web applications. Its key strengths are integrated UI generation, data integration, pipeline orchestration, scenario and what-if analysis, scheduling, and deployment support. By keeping the stack Python-first, Taipy reduces full-stack complexity while improving delivery speed, scalability, and operational readiness for enterprise data and AI apps.

metadata.name: marker
metadata.description: Convert PDF to markdown + JSON quickly with high accuracy

summary.zh: Marker 是一套面向文档智能的高精度转换工具，支持将 PDF、图片、PPTX、DOCX 等文件快速转为 Markdown、JSON、HTML 和分块结果。它强调表格、公式、表单、代码块与图片抽取，并可通过 LLM 混合模式进一步提升复杂文档解析质量，适合批处理与本地部署。
summary.en: Marker is a high-accuracy document intelligence pipeline that converts PDFs, images, PPTX, DOCX, and more into Markdown, JSON, HTML, and chunks. It focuses on preserving tables, equations, forms, code blocks, and images, while offering an optional LLM hybrid mode for tougher layouts and structured extraction at scale.

metadata.name: MyIP
metadata.description: The best IP Toolbox. Check your IP address & geolocation, test IP for WebRTC and DNS IP leaks, run an IP quality check, browser fingerprint check, website availability check, network speed test, global latency test, MTR test, Whois search, and more.

summary.zh: MyIP 是面向个人用户与运维场景的一体化 IP 网络诊断工具箱，集成 IP/地理位置查询、WebRTC 与 DNS 泄漏检测、网站可用性与服务状态监测、测速、全球延迟与 MTR、Whois 和浏览器指纹分析等能力。其亮点在于覆盖从隐私泄漏排查到跨区域网络质量诊断的完整链路，并支持 PWA 与自部署。
summary.en: MyIP is an all-in-one IP and network diagnostics toolbox for end users, privacy-conscious users, and operators. It combines IP and geolocation lookup, WebRTC and DNS leak detection, website availability and service status checks, speed testing, global latency and MTR diagnostics, Whois search, and browser fingerprint analysis. Its key strength is the end-to-end workflow spanning privacy verification, network path troubleshooting, and cross-region connectivity assessment, with both PWA support and self-hosted deployment.

metadata.name: source-code-hunter
metadata.description: 😱 从源码层面，剖析挖掘互联网行业主流技术的底层实现原理，为广大开发者 “提升技术深度” 提供便利。目前开放 Spring 全家桶，Mybatis、Netty、Dubbo 框架，及 Redis、Tomcat 中间件等

summary.zh: 该仓库聚焦互联网常用框架与中间件的源码解读，以 Spring 全家桶为核心，延伸到 MyBatis、Netty、Dubbo、Redis、Tomcat 等。内容按 IoC、AOP、事务、SpringMVC 等主题系统拆解底层实现，适合开发者进行源码入门、原理进阶与架构认知提升，兼具体系化与实战导向。
summary.en: This repository delivers systematic source-code analysis of widely used backend frameworks and middleware, centered on the Spring ecosystem and extended to MyBatis, Netty, Dubbo, Redis, and Tomcat. It organizes deep dives by themes such as IoC, AOP, transactions, and Spring MVC, helping developers move from API usage to implementation-level understanding. Its main strengths are structured knowledge curation, framework internals interpretation, and practical support for advanced engineering learning.

metadata.name: teleport
metadata.description: The easiest, and most secure way to access and protect all of your infrastructure.

summary.zh: Teleport 是面向现代基础设施的统一身份感知访问平台，以单一 Go 二进制整合认证代理、短期证书 CA、审计与安全隧道。它覆盖 SSH、Kubernetes、数据库、RDP、Web 与云 API，适用于零信任接入、SSO、细粒度 RBAC/ABAC、JIT 提权和跨内外网资源安全运维。
summary.en: Teleport is a unified identity-aware access platform for modern infrastructure, delivered as a single Go binary that combines an access proxy, short-lived certificate authority, auditing, and secure tunneling. It secures SSH, Kubernetes, databases, RDP, web apps, and cloud APIs, making it well suited for zero-trust access, SSO, fine-grained RBAC/ABAC, just-in-time elevation, and secure operations across on-prem and cloud environments.

metadata.name: focalboard
metadata.description: Focalboard is an open source, self-hosted alternative to Trello, Notion, and Asana.

summary.zh: Focalboard 是一款开源自托管的项目与任务管理工具，面向个人和小团队提供看板式工作组织能力，可替代 Trello、Notion 与 Asana。项目支持桌面端与多用户服务器部署，具备多语言、SQLite 本地运行及 Boards API 等特性，亮点在于离线可控、轻量自部署和前后端一体化交付；但仓库当前已处于未维护状态。
summary.en: Focalboard is an open-source, self-hosted project and task management platform designed for individuals and small teams as an alternative to Trello, Notion, and Asana. It offers both standalone desktop and multi-user server editions, with multilingual support, local SQLite-backed deployment, and a Boards API. Its main strengths are data ownership, lightweight self-hosting, and integrated desktop-server packaging, though the standalone repository is currently unmaintained.

metadata.name: cosmopolitan
metadata.description: build-once run-anywhere c library

summary.zh: Cosmopolitan Libc 通过重构 GCC/Clang 输出格式，把 C/C++ 编译为可原生运行于 Linux、macOS、Windows、BSD 乃至 BIOS 的多态可执行文件，实现“一次构建，到处运行”。项目亮点在于 APE/Polyglot 可执行格式、极小体积、高性能，以及自带 strace/ftrace 等调试能力，适合跨平台基础工具、系统软件与便携式命令行程序开发。
summary.en: Cosmopolitan Libc turns C/C++ into a build-once, run-anywhere native platform by retooling GCC and Clang to emit a POSIX-compliant polyglot executable format. The same binary can run across Linux, macOS, Windows, BSD variants, and even BIOS, without a VM or interpreter. Its standout strengths include the APE polyglot executable model, tiny binary sizes, near-native performance, and built-in debugging features such as `--strace` and `--ftrace`, making it well suited for portable system utilities and cross-platform native tooling.

metadata.name: Java-Interview-Tutorial
metadata.description: 请star，勿fork，因为爱force push！涵盖国际大厂Java/数据库/DDD/设计模式/微服务/中间件/AI大模型应用/区块链开发最佳实践。关注公众号【JavaEdge】，一起交流学习！

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 Java 开发者与求职者的系统化知识库，覆盖 Java 核心、数据库、DDD、设计模式、微服务、中间件、AI 大模型应用与区块链开发实践。项目基于 VuePress 构建，强调可本地运行、可持续投稿和栏目化组织，适用于面试准备、工程进阶与技术专题学习，亮点在于内容广度高、工程实践导向强、知识体系结构化。
summary.en: This repository is a structured learning hub for Java engineers and interview preparation, covering Java fundamentals, databases, DDD, design patterns, microservices, middleware, LLM application practices, and blockchain development. Built with VuePress, it supports local preview, article contribution, and category-based knowledge organization. It is well suited for interview prep, skill advancement, and topic-driven study, with strengths in broad coverage, practical engineering focus, and a clearly structured knowledge system.

metadata.name: redis
metadata.description: Native port of Redis for Windows. Redis is an in-memory database that persists on disk. The data model is key-value, but many different kind of values are supported: Strings, Lists, Sets, Sorted Sets, Hashes, Streams, HyperLogLogs. This repository contains unofficial port of Redis to Windows.

summary.zh: 这是 Redis 4.0.14/5.0.14 的非官方 Windows x64 原生移植版，面向需要在 Windows 环境部署高性能内存数据库、缓存与消息处理能力的场景。项目在合并 MS Open Tech 历史分支基础上，适配 Visual Studio 2019 与 Windows SDK，并定制 jemalloc 结合 WinAPI 内存管理，以支持持久化相关子进程内存跟踪，兼顾兼容性、稳定性与可维护性。
summary.en: This repository delivers an unofficial native Windows x64 port of Redis 4.0.14 and 5.0.14 for teams needing Redis on Windows for caching, in-memory data storage, and lightweight messaging workloads. It merges the archived MS Open Tech Windows port with newer upstream Redis releases, updates the codebase for Visual Studio 2019, and customizes jemalloc around WinAPI memory allocation to track regions shared with child processes for RDB/AOF persistence, emphasizing platform compatibility and stability.

metadata.name: openwrt
metadata.description: This repository is a mirror of https://git.openwrt.org/openwrt/openwrt.git It is for reference only and is not active for check-ins.  We will continue to accept Pull Requests here. They will be merged via staging trees then into openwrt.git.

summary.zh: OpenWrt 是面向嵌入式设备的可定制 Linux 发行版与固件构建框架，核心优势在于可写文件系统、`opkg` 包管理和跨平台交叉编译体系。它既适用于路由器等网络设备刷机，也支持开发者按目标硬件裁剪系统、集成内核与应用，快速构建可维护的定制固件。
summary.en: OpenWrt is a Linux distribution and firmware build framework for embedded devices, centered on a writable filesystem, `opkg` package management, and a mature cross-compilation toolchain. It is widely used for routers and network appliances, while also enabling developers to tailor kernels, packages, and system images for specific hardware, producing highly customizable and maintainable firmware.

metadata.name: grok-1
metadata.description: Grok open release

summary.zh: Grok-1 是 xAI 开源的 314B 参数大语言模型示例仓库，提供基于 JAX 的权重加载、推理采样与运行验证代码。其核心亮点是 8 专家 MoE 架构、每 token 激活 2 个专家、支持 RoPE、激活分片与 8-bit 量化，适用于超大模型研究、推理验证和分布式系统适配，但对 GPU 显存要求极高。
summary.en: Grok-1 is xAI’s open release example repository for loading and running a 314B-parameter large language model with JAX. It focuses on checkpoint loading, inference sampling, and correctness validation rather than production-grade serving. Key technical highlights include an 8-expert Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 2 experts activated per token, RoPE, activation sharding, and 8-bit quantization support, making it relevant for frontier-model research, large-scale inference experiments, and distributed systems adaptation on high-memory GPU infrastructure.

metadata.name: weixin4j
metadata.description: (微信开发工具包)weixin sdk for Java

summary.zh: weixin4j 是面向 Java 的微信生态开发 SDK，覆盖公众号、企业号、小程序、支付与回调消息处理。项目按模块拆分，既提供 API 封装，也内置 HTTP Client、Token 管理、Netty 消息服务器及多场景微信支付能力，适合企业级接入微信业务、支付链路与服务端事件分发。
summary.en: weixin4j is a Java SDK for building against the WeChat ecosystem, covering Official Accounts, Enterprise accounts, Mini Programs, payment, and callback message handling. Its modular design includes API wrappers, an HTTP client, token management, a Netty-based callback server, and broad WeChat Pay support across scan, JSAPI, APP, WAP,红包, and enterprise payouts, making it suitable for enterprise-grade integrations.

metadata.name: o2oa
metadata.description: 开源OA系统 - 码云GVP|Java开源oa|企业OA办公平台|企业OA|协同办公OA|流程平台OA|O2OA|OA，支持国产麒麟操作系统和国产数据库（达梦、人大金仓），政务OA，军工信息化OA

summary.zh: O2OA 是面向企业、政务与国产化环境的开源低代码 OA/协同办公平台，基于 JavaEE 分布式架构，提供流程引擎、表单与页面定制、业务数据服务及完整前后端 API。其核心价值在于支持白标二开、跨平台移动办公及麒麟/达梦等信创适配，适合快速构建安全可控的办公与流程系统。
summary.en: O2OA is an open-source low-code OA and collaborative workplace platform for enterprises, government, and localization-focused deployments. Built on a distributed JavaEE architecture, it offers workflow engines, form and page customization, business data services, and full front-end/back-end APIs. Its key strengths include white-label extensibility, mobile cross-platform collaboration, and compatibility with domestic ecosystems such as Kylin OS and Dameng, enabling secure, customizable office automation systems.

metadata.name: wsl2-distro-manager
metadata.description: A GUI to quickly manage your WSL2 instances

summary.zh: WSL Manager 是面向 Windows 用户的 WSL2 图形化管理工具，支持发行版安装、卸载、更新、备份恢复与一键启动，降低命令行运维门槛。其亮点在于可直接将 Docker 镜像和 LXC 容器转为 WSL 实例，并通过 Quick Actions 与自定义 rootfs 仓库提升跨设备复用和批量配置效率。
summary.en: WSL Manager is a GUI-driven management tool for Windows Subsystem for Linux that simplifies installing, removing, updating, backing up, restoring, and launching WSL2 distributions. Its standout capability is turning Docker images and LXC containers into WSL instances without relying on Docker itself, while Quick Actions and custom rootfs repositories improve automation, repeatable setup, and cross-machine distro portability.

metadata.name: system-design-101
metadata.description: Explain complex systems using visuals and simple terms. Help you prepare for system design interviews.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向系统设计学习与面试准备的知识型仓库，通过可视化图解和通俗表达拆解 API、网络协议、负载均衡、浏览器渲染、GraphQL 等核心主题。其价值在于把分散的底层概念结构化，帮助读者快速建立系统设计认知框架，并理解真实工程场景中的技术取舍。
summary.en: This repository is a visual learning resource for system design fundamentals and interview preparation. It explains complex topics such as APIs, networking, load balancing, browser rendering, gRPC, and GraphQL through simple language and diagrams. Its key strength is turning scattered infrastructure concepts into a structured knowledge map, helping engineers build intuition, compare architectural trade-offs, and understand how real-world distributed systems work beneath the surface.

metadata.name: jsoneditor
metadata.description: A web-based tool to view, edit, format, and validate JSON

summary.zh: JSONEditor 是面向浏览器的 JSON 可视化编辑组件，支持树形、代码、文本与大文件预览等多种模式，适合后台配置、接口调试和数据清洗场景。其亮点在于集成 JSON Schema 校验、JMESPath 查询、格式化与修复能力，并兼容 CommonJS、AMD 与原生脚本嵌入。
summary.en: JSONEditor is a browser-based JSON editing component for visual inspection, modification, formatting, and validation. It supports tree, code, text, and large-document preview modes, making it useful for admin consoles, API debugging, and data cleanup workflows. Key strengths include JSON Schema validation via Ajv, JMESPath-powered transformations, JSON repair/formatting, and flexible integration through CommonJS, AMD, or plain script usage.

metadata.name: excalidraw
metadata.description: Virtual whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn like diagrams

summary.zh: Excalidraw 是一款开源虚拟白板与可嵌入式绘图编辑器，面向流程图、线框图、教学演示和协作草图场景。其核心亮点在于手绘风画布、无限白板、开放 `.excalidraw` 格式，以及实时协作与端到端加密能力；同时提供 React npm 包，便于开发者快速集成自定义绘图体验。
summary.en: Excalidraw is an open-source virtual whiteboard and embeddable diagram editor for sketching flows, wireframes, teaching visuals, and collaborative ideation. Its key strengths include a hand-drawn canvas aesthetic, infinite whiteboard UX, open `.excalidraw` JSON format, and real-time collaboration with end-to-end encryption. It also ships as a React npm package, making it easy for developers to integrate customizable drawing capabilities into their own products.

metadata.name: xp_module
metadata.description: 备份午夜神大佬分享的应用集 【下面是Gitee仓库链接】https://gitee.com/grbnb/xp_module.git

summary.zh: 该仓库聚合并备份安卓 Root 与 Xposed 生态资源，覆盖 Magisk 多分支、APatch、LSPosed、EdXposed 及免 Root 框架，并提供下载入口与使用指引。其核心价值在于集中整理分散工具链，便于刷机、模块管理、系统增强与隐私隐藏等场景快速检索和部署。
summary.en: This repository serves as a curated backup hub for the Android root and Xposed ecosystem, aggregating Magisk variants, APatch, LSPosed, EdXposed, and rootless framework resources with download links and usage references. Its main value lies in consolidating scattered tooling for ROM modding, module management, system customization, and root-hiding workflows, making discovery and deployment significantly more efficient for advanced Android users.

metadata.name: WindTerm
metadata.description: A professional cross-platform SSH/Sftp/Shell/Telnet/Tmux/Serial terminal.

summary.zh: WindTerm 是面向 DevOps 与运维场景的跨平台专业终端工具，集成 SSH、SFTP/SCP、Telnet、Serial、Shell 与 tmux 协同能力。其价值在于以单一客户端覆盖远程登录、端口转发、文件传输和多会话管理，并提供自动补全、多语言界面、分屏及高性能终端体验，适合复杂主机与网络运维工作流。
summary.en: WindTerm is a professional cross-platform terminal client for DevOps and infrastructure workflows, combining SSH, SFTP/SCP, Telnet, Serial, local shells, and tmux integration in one tool. Its core value lies in unifying remote access, port forwarding, file transfer, and multi-session management behind a high-performance UI. Notable strengths include multilingual support, split views, auto-completion, SSH agent and proxy features, making it well suited for complex administration environments.

metadata.name: zhparser
metadata.description: zhparser is a PostgreSQL extension for full-text search of Chinese language

summary.zh: zhparser 是面向 PostgreSQL 的中文全文检索扩展，基于 SCWS 实现普通话分词解析，可无缝接入 ts_parse、to_tsvector 与 to_tsquery。它支持自定义词典、分词策略调优及 Docker 快速体验，适用于内容检索、站内搜索与中文数据分析场景，核心亮点是将中文分词能力深度嵌入 PostgreSQL 原生全文检索体系。
summary.en: zhparser is a PostgreSQL extension for Mandarin Chinese full-text search, built on top of SCWS for word segmentation. It integrates directly with PostgreSQL text search primitives such as ts_parse, to_tsvector, and to_tsquery, enabling native Chinese indexing and querying workflows. The project also supports custom dictionaries, configurable segmentation behavior, and Docker-based setup, making it a practical choice for search-heavy applications, content platforms, and analytics systems handling large volumes of Chinese text.

metadata.name: keepassxc
metadata.description: KeePassXC is a cross-platform community-driven port of the Windows application “KeePass Password Safe”.

summary.zh: KeePassXC 是面向 Windows、macOS 与 Linux 的离线开源密码管理器，兼容 KeePass KDBX3/4 数据库，强调本地加密存储与跨平台一致体验。项目集成密码生成、TOTP、浏览器扩展、Passkey、SSH Agent、硬件密钥挑战响应及健康报告，适合高安全要求的个人凭证管理与自托管密钥库场景。
summary.en: KeePassXC is a cross-platform, offline-first open-source password manager for Windows, macOS, and Linux, built around KeePass-compatible KDBX3/4 databases and strong local encryption. It combines password generation, TOTP, browser integration, passkey support, SSH agent features, hardware key challenge-response, and security reporting. The project is well suited for users who need portable, privacy-focused credential management without relying on cloud-only architectures.

metadata.name: keepass2android
metadata.description: Password manager app for Android

summary.zh: Keepass2Android 是一款 Android 密码管理器，支持安全保存与检索密码、敏感信息，并可通过云端或第三方工具同步数据库。兼容 KeePass 2.x、KeePassXC 等生态，适合跨设备统一管理凭据与私密数据。
summary.en: Keepass2Android is an Android password manager for securely storing and retrieving passwords and other sensitive data. It syncs encrypted databases across devices via built-in cloud or third-party storage options, and stays compatible with KeePass 2.x, KeePassXC, and other KeePass clients.

metadata.name: eSearch
metadata.description: 截屏 离线OCR 搜索翻译 以图搜图 贴图 录屏 万向滚动截屏 屏幕翻译   Screenshot  Offline OCR   Search   Translate   Search for picture   Paste the picture on the screen   Screen recorder   Omnidirectional scrolling screenshot   Screen translator  支持Windows Linux macOS

summary.zh: eSearch 是一款跨平台桌面截图与屏幕搜索工具，集离线 OCR、翻译、以图搜图、贴图、录屏和滚动截屏于一体。面向 Windows、Linux、macOS，强调本地化处理、快捷操作与丰富标注能力，适合文档整理、信息检索和屏幕内容快速提取。
summary.en: eSearch is a cross-platform desktop screenshot and screen-search app that combines offline OCR, translation, visual search, pin-on-screen notes, screen recording, and scrolling screenshots. Built for Windows, Linux, and macOS, it emphasizes local processing, fast workflows, and rich annotation tools for capturing and extracting on-screen information.

metadata.name: my-tv
metadata.description: 我的电视 电视直播软件，安装即可使用

summary.zh: my-tv 是一款面向安卓电视与机顶盒的开箱即用直播软件，主打免配置安装后直接观看。项目聚焦电视端使用体验，支持 U 盘、ADB 等多种安装方式，适合家庭大屏和盒子设备。其亮点在于轻量部署、低门槛使用及持续补充频道、收藏夹、自动更新等电视直播能力。
summary.en: my-tv is a plug-and-play live TV application for Android TVs and set-top boxes, designed for immediate use after installation without manual configuration. It targets big-screen home entertainment scenarios and supports multiple deployment methods such as USB sideloading and ADB installation. Key strengths include lightweight setup, low user friction, and an evolving feature set around channel coverage, favorites, and auto-update capabilities.

metadata.name: shardingsphere
metadata.description: Empowering Data Intelligence with Distributed SQL for Sharding, Scalability, and Security Across All Databases.

summary.zh: Apache ShardingSphere 是面向企业的数据分布式 SQL 生态，通过分片、弹性扩缩容与安全治理，在异构数据库之上统一数据访问与管控。项目亮点在于以数据库中间件和分布式数据库能力兼容多种存储，帮助业务平滑完成数据库架构升级与数据智能化转型。
summary.en: Apache ShardingSphere is an enterprise-grade distributed SQL ecosystem that unifies access, governance, and scaling across heterogeneous databases. It delivers core capabilities such as sharding, elastic scalability, and security control, enabling applications to evolve beyond single-database limits without abandoning existing storage engines. Its key strength is building middleware and distributed database capabilities on top of diverse backends, helping organizations modernize data architecture and drive smarter, more resilient data operations.

metadata.name: shenyu
metadata.description: Apache ShenYu is a Java native API Gateway for service proxy, protocol conversion and API governance.

summary.zh: Apache ShenYu 是面向微服务体系的高性能 Java 原生 API 网关，聚焦服务代理、协议转换与 API 治理。它支持 Dubbo、Spring Cloud、gRPC、WebSocket、MQTT 等多协议接入，提供鉴权、限流、熔断、参数映射、追踪监控等能力，并通过插件热插拔与动态加载实现高扩展性，适合构建统一流量入口与治理中枢。
summary.en: Apache ShenYu is a high-performance, Java-native API gateway built for microservice traffic entry, protocol conversion, and API governance. It supports multiple ecosystems and protocols including Dubbo, Spring Cloud, gRPC, WebSocket, and MQTT, while providing security, rate limiting, circuit breaking, parameter mapping, tracing, and metrics. Its plugin hot-swapping and dynamic loading architecture make it a strong fit for extensible, centrally governed gateway platforms.

metadata.name: Perlite
metadata.description: A web-based markdown viewer optimized for Obsidian

summary.zh: Perlite 是面向 Obsidian 笔记仓库的 Web Markdown 浏览器，可直接基于文件夹结构自动生成站点，无需数据库或预转换流程。项目支持 Obsidian 主题、双向链接、标签、搜索、Mermaid、LaTeX 与交互式知识图谱，适合个人知识库发布、团队文档镜像和自托管 Obsidian Publish 替代方案。
summary.en: Perlite is a web-based Markdown viewer tailored for Obsidian vaults, turning a folder-based note collection into a browsable site without a database or pre-conversion pipeline. It supports Obsidian themes, wikilinks, tags, search, Mermaid, LaTeX, and an interactive knowledge graph, making it a strong self-hosted alternative to Obsidian Publish for personal knowledge bases, documentation portals, and note publishing.

metadata.name: pyvideotrans
metadata.description: Translate the video from one language to another and embed dubbing & subtitles.

summary.zh: pyVideoTrans 是面向视频跨语种本地化的全流程工具，打通 ASR、字幕翻译、AI 配音与音视频合成，支持一键处理与人工校对。项目兼容 Whisper、DeepSeek、GPT、Edge-TTS 等多类模型与云 API，并提供说话人分离、多角色配音、零样本声音克隆和 CLI 批处理，适合内容出海、课程翻译与媒资转录场景。
summary.en: pyVideoTrans is an end-to-end video localization toolkit that automates speech recognition, subtitle translation, AI dubbing, and final audio-video synthesis. It supports both offline deployment and mainstream cloud APIs, integrating Whisper-class ASR, LLM-based translation, and multiple TTS engines. Key strengths include speaker diarization, multi-speaker voice assignment, zero-shot voice cloning, manual proofreading checkpoints, and CLI batch processing, making it well suited for media localization, course translation, and transcription workflows.

metadata.name: AnyText
metadata.description: Official implementation code of the paper <AnyText: Multilingual Visual Text Generation And Editing>

summary.zh: AnyText 是面向多语言视觉文本生成与编辑的扩散模型方案，可在海报、广告、封面等图像中精准生成或替换文字，并保持背景融合与排版一致。其核心结合辅助潜变量模块与 OCR 文本嵌入模块，联合字形、位置、遮罩图像进行控制，兼顾书写准确性、编辑可控性与跨语言泛化，且已开放训练、评测与数据集生态。
summary.en: AnyText is a diffusion-based framework for multilingual visual text generation and editing, designed for scenarios such as posters, ads, covers, and meme-style image creation. It combines an auxiliary latent module with an OCR-driven text embedding module to control glyphs, positions, and masked images, enabling accurate text rendering that blends naturally with backgrounds. The project stands out for its controllability, multilingual support, and open ecosystem covering inference, training, benchmarking, and the AnyWord-3M dataset.

metadata.name: tiny-rdm
metadata.description: Tiny RDM (Tiny Redis Desktop Manager) - A modern, colorful, super lightweight Redis GUI client for Mac, Windows, and Linux. It also provides a web version that can be deployed via Docker.

summary.zh: Tiny RDM 是面向 Mac、Windows、Linux 的轻量级 Redis 图形客户端，并提供可通过 Docker 部署的 Web 版本。项目基于 Wails/WebView2，兼顾原生体积与现代界面，支持 SSH/SSL/Sentinel/Cluster/代理连接、百万级键 SCAN 分段加载、实时命令监控、发布订阅、慢日志及多类型数据可视化编辑。
summary.en: Tiny RDM is a lightweight cross-platform Redis GUI for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with an optional web edition deployable via Docker. Built with Wails and WebView2, it delivers a native-feeling, low-footprint experience while supporting SSH/SSL/Sentinel/Cluster connections, proxy access, SCAN-based browsing for massive keyspaces, real-time command monitoring, Pub/Sub, slow logs, import/export, and visual editing for major Redis data structures.

metadata.name: Waifu2x-Extension-GUI
metadata.description: Video, Image and GIF upscale/enlarge(Super-Resolution) and Video frame interpolation. Achieved with Waifu2x,  Real-ESRGAN, Real-CUGAN, RTX Video Super Resolution VSR, SRMD, RealSR, Anime4K, RIFE, IFRNet, CAIN, DAIN,  and ACNet.

summary.zh: Waifu2x-Extension-GUI 是面向 Windows 的 AI 超分与补帧桌面工具，支持图片、GIF、APNG、WebP 与视频处理，兼容 AMD/NVIDIA/Intel GPU。项目集成 Waifu2x、Real-ESRGAN、Real-CUGAN、Anime4K、RIFE 等多种引擎，提供多 GPU、线程调优、硬件自适应与一键预设，适合动漫素材修复、老视频增强及通用多媒体画质提升。
summary.en: Waifu2x-Extension-GUI is a Windows desktop application for AI-powered super-resolution and frame interpolation across images, GIFs, APNG, WebP, and videos, with support for AMD, NVIDIA, and Intel GPUs. It integrates multiple upscale and interpolation backends including Waifu2x, Real-ESRGAN, Real-CUGAN, Anime4K, and RIFE, while offering multi-GPU execution, thread-level tuning, hardware-aware auto configuration, and one-click presets. It is well suited for anime enhancement, legacy video restoration, and general media quality improvement workflows.

metadata.name: portainer
metadata.description: Making Docker and Kubernetes management easy.

summary.zh: Portainer 是面向 Docker、Swarm、Kubernetes 与 ACI 的轻量级容器管理平台，以单容器部署和可视化界面降低集群运维门槛。它通过统一 GUI 与 API 管理容器、镜像、网络和存储资源，并结合基于 Go Swagger 生成的 TypeScript API SDK，兼顾易用性、跨环境支持与前后端接口一致性。
summary.en: Portainer is a lightweight container management platform for Docker, Swarm, Kubernetes, and ACI, designed to simplify cluster operations through single-container deployment and a smart web UI. It provides unified GUI and API access for managing containers, images, networks, and volumes, while using Go Swagger-driven TypeScript SDK generation to keep frontend-backend contracts consistent across multi-orchestrator environments.

metadata.name: pm2
metadata.description: Node.js/Typescript/Bun Production Process Manager with a built-in Load Balancer.

summary.zh: PM2 是面向 Node.js 与 Bun 生产环境的进程管理器，提供守护运行、异常拉起、日志监控与零停机重载能力。其内置集群负载均衡可充分利用多核资源，适用于 Web 服务、API、容器化部署及通用后台任务的稳定运行与运维自动化。
summary.en: PM2 is a production-grade process manager for Node.js and Bun applications, offering daemonization, auto-restart, log monitoring, and zero-downtime reloads. Its built-in cluster load balancer helps services scale across CPU cores, making it well suited for web apps, APIs, containerized workloads, and long-running background processes that require resilience and operational simplicity.

metadata.name: benchbase
metadata.description: Multi-DBMS SQL Benchmarking Framework via JDBC

summary.zh: BenchBase 是面向 JDBC 兼容关系型数据库的多基准 SQL 压测框架，支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL、CockroachDB 等多种 DBMS。它提供多线程负载生成、可控请求速率与事务混合、延迟与吞吐采集，并内置 TPC-C、TPC-H、YCSB 等经典工作负载，适用于数据库性能评测、系统调优与学术实验扩展。
summary.en: BenchBase is a JDBC-based SQL benchmarking framework for relational databases, supporting multiple DBMSs such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, CockroachDB, and Spanner. It offers multi-threaded load generation, controllable request rates and transaction mixes, plus detailed latency and throughput collection. With built-in workloads like TPC-C, TPC-H, and YCSB, it is well suited for database performance evaluation, tuning, comparative testing, and extensible research experiments.

metadata.name: gpt4all
metadata.description: GPT4All: Run Local LLMs on Any Device. Open-source and available for commercial use.

summary.zh: GPT4All 是一个面向桌面与笔记本的本地大语言模型运行平台，支持无需云端 API、无需独立 GPU 即可私有部署和对话。项目提供跨平台桌面应用与 Python SDK，基于 llama.cpp 生态支持 GGUF 模型、DeepSeek R1 蒸馏模型及 LocalDocs 工作流，适用于离线问答、个人知识库和轻量级本地 AI 集成。
summary.en: GPT4All is a local LLM runtime platform for desktops and laptops, enabling private inference without cloud APIs or dedicated GPUs. It ships with a cross-platform desktop app and a Python SDK built around the llama.cpp ecosystem, supporting GGUF models, DeepSeek R1 distillations, and LocalDocs-style retrieval workflows. It is well suited for offline chat, personal knowledge assistants, and lightweight on-device AI integration in commercial or developer environments.

summary.zh: WeChatMsg 是一款面向个人数据主权的微信留痕与记忆资产化工具，聚焦聊天记录的留存、整理与回顾，支撑个人年度报告、长期记忆沉淀及个体化 AI 数据供给。其核心价值在于把分散在微信中的真实生活轨迹转化为可分析、可叙事、可再利用的私有数据资产。
summary.en: WeChatMsg is a personal data sovereignty tool focused on preserving, organizing, and revisiting WeChat chat history as long-term memory assets. It enables scenarios such as personal annual reports, life-log reconstruction, and future individualized AI data pipelines. Its key strength lies in turning fragmented conversations into analyzable, narrative-ready, and reusable private datasets centered on emotional and real-life context.

metadata.name: rust-web-app
metadata.description: Code template for a production Web Application using Axum: The AwesomeApp Blueprint for Professional Web Development.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向生产环境的 Axum Web 应用蓝图，提供从路由、JSON-RPC 到数据访问层的完整分层范式。项目以 Rust 工作区组织代码，结合 Sea-Query、modql、事务化 ModelManager 与声明式宏，降低 CRUD 与业务建模样板成本，适合构建多租户、AI 会话型或通用企业级后台系统。
summary.en: This repository is a production-oriented Axum web application blueprint that demonstrates a full-stack backend architecture, from routing and JSON-RPC APIs to a layered data-access model. Organized as a Rust workspace, it combines Sea-Query, modql, transactional ModelManager support, and declarative macros to reduce CRUD boilerplate. It is especially suitable for multi-tenant SaaS backends, AI conversation-style systems, and other structured enterprise web applications.

metadata.name: SQLPage
metadata.description: Fast SQL-only data application builder. Automatically build a UI on top of SQL queries.

summary.zh: SQLPage 是一个以 SQL 为唯一开发接口的数据应用构建器，开发者通过编写 `.sql` 查询即可自动生成列表、图表、表单、标签页等交互式 Web 界面。它面向后台管理、数据展示和轻量业务系统场景，兼容 SQLite、PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQL Server 及 ODBC 生态，亮点在于极低门槛、跨数据库支持与将查询结果直接映射为可用 UI 组件的能力。
summary.en: SQLPage is a SQL-first web application builder that turns plain `.sql` files into interactive, data-centric user interfaces. Developers can generate lists, charts, forms, tabs, and CRUD workflows directly from database queries without building a separate frontend. It is well suited for internal tools, admin panels, dashboards, and lightweight business apps. Key strengths include broad multi-database support, ODBC extensibility, rapid delivery, and a declarative model that maps SQL query results straight into polished UI components.

metadata.name: git-cliff
metadata.description: A highly customizable Changelog Generator that follows Conventional Commit specifications ⛰️

summary.zh: git-cliff 是一款基于 Rust 的变更日志生成器，直接解析 Git 历史，结合 Conventional Commits 与正则自定义解析规则，自动产出结构化 Changelog。其核心优势在于高度可配置的模板与配置体系，适合发布自动化、团队规范化提交、Monorepo 版本管理等场景，能灵活适配不同项目的输出格式与发布流程。
summary.en: git-cliff is a Rust-based changelog generator that turns Git history into structured release notes using Conventional Commits and regex-driven custom parsers. Its standout strength is a highly configurable templating and configuration system, allowing teams to tailor changelog output to their own release workflow and formatting needs. It is especially useful for release automation, standardized commit practices, and monorepo version management where flexible, reproducible changelog generation matters.

metadata.name: cheat
metadata.description: cheat allows you to create and view interactive cheatsheets on the command-line. It was designed to help remind *nix system administrators of options for commands that they use frequently, but not frequently enough to remember.

summary.zh: cheat 是面向命令行用户的交互式速查工具，用于创建、编辑、检索和分类管理纯文本 cheatsheet，适合 Unix/Linux 运维与开发场景。其亮点在于多 cheatpath 组织、标签与正则搜索、YAML frontmatter 元数据，以及基于 Chroma 的语法高亮，兼顾个人知识沉淀与社区内容复用。
summary.en: cheat is an interactive command-line cheatsheet tool for creating, editing, searching, and organizing plaintext reference sheets, especially useful for Unix/Linux administrators and developers. Its key strengths include multi-cheatpath management, tag and regex-based discovery, YAML frontmatter metadata, and Chroma-powered syntax highlighting, making it effective for both personal knowledge capture and reuse of community-maintained command references.

metadata.name: cassandra
metadata.description: Open source transactional distributed database. Linear scalability and proven fault-tolerance on commodity hardware or cloud infrastructure without compromising performance.

summary.zh: Apache Cassandra 是面向大规模集群的开源分布式事务型数据库，采用分区式行存模型与 CQL 接口，在通用硬件或云环境中实现线性扩展和高容错。其核心价值在于跨节点透明分片、自动重分区及持续高性能，适用于高可用业务、海量写入、全球多节点部署等场景。
summary.en: Apache Cassandra is an open-source distributed transactional database built for massive scale, using a partitioned wide-row model and CQL interface. It delivers linear scalability and strong fault tolerance across commodity hardware or cloud environments without sacrificing performance. Its key strengths are transparent data partitioning, automatic rebalancing as nodes change, and resilient high-throughput operations for always-on, write-intensive, multi-region applications.

metadata.name: it-tools
metadata.description: Collection of handy online tools for developers, with great UX.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向开发者与 IT 从业者的在线工具集合，主打开箱即用与优秀交互体验，覆盖编码转换、网络、加密、文本处理等高频场景。项目基于 Vue 3 与 TypeScript 构建，支持自托管与 Docker 部署，兼顾本地化扩展、组件化开发和快速新增工具，适合个人效率平台与团队内部工具箱。
summary.en: It-Tools is a polished web toolbox for developers and IT professionals, offering practical utilities for encoding, networking, cryptography, text processing, and other everyday workflows. Built with Vue 3 and TypeScript, it emphasizes fast interaction, clean UX, and modular extensibility. The project supports self-hosting via Docker, includes a streamlined workflow for adding new tools, and fits both personal productivity hubs and internal engineering utility portals.

metadata.name: screenshot-to-code
metadata.description: Drop in a screenshot and convert it to clean code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue)

summary.zh: 该项目通过多模态大模型将截图、Figma 设计稿和网页录屏直接转为可运行前端代码，支持 HTML/Tailwind、React、Vue、Bootstrap 与 Ionic 等栈。其核心亮点是前后端分离架构、可切换多模型推理，以及结合 Gemini 资产提取与 Replicate 图像编辑，实现更接近真实页面的高保真代码生成与原型还原。
summary.en: Screenshot-to-code is an AI-powered system that turns screenshots, Figma mockups, and browser recordings into production-like frontend code across HTML/Tailwind, React, Vue, Bootstrap, and Ionic. Its key strengths are a React/Vite plus FastAPI architecture, flexible multi-model orchestration, and high-fidelity reconstruction powered by Gemini-based asset extraction and Replicate-backed image editing, enabling cleaner UI code generation, faster prototyping, and customizable self-hosted workflows.

metadata.name: signoz
metadata.description: SigNoz is an open-source, OpenTelemetry-native observability platform for your team and their AI agents. Get logs, metrics, and traces in one tool with features like APM, distributed tracing, log management, infra monitoring, etc. Combined with SigNoz MCP and a native AI teammate (in SigNoz Cloud) it helps you build more resilient apps.

summary.zh: SigNoz 是基于 OpenTelemetry 的开源可观测性平台，将日志、指标与分布式追踪统一到单一系统中，面向 APM、微服务排障与基础设施监控场景。其亮点在于以 ClickHouse 支撑高性能日志分析，提供开箱即用的延迟、错误率、Apdex 等观测能力，并以仪表盘、Flamegraph 与 Gantt 图提升问题定位效率。
summary.en: SigNoz is an open-source observability platform built around OpenTelemetry, unifying logs, metrics, and distributed traces in a single system. It targets APM, microservice troubleshooting, and infrastructure monitoring with out-of-the-box insights such as p99 latency, error rate, and Apdex. Key technical strengths include ClickHouse-backed high-performance log analytics, rich dashboards, and trace visualizations like flamegraphs and Gantt charts for faster root-cause analysis.

metadata.name: Clash-for-Windows_Chinese
metadata.description: clash for windows汉化版. 提供clash for windows的汉化版, 汉化补丁及汉化版安装程序

summary.zh: 该仓库提供 Clash for Windows 的非官方中文化发行版、汉化补丁与安装包，面向希望直接获取中文界面的桌面代理工具用户。其技术亮点在于通过修改 Electron 应用的 `app.asar`、`renderer.js` 与 `main.js` 实现界面汉化，并对安装版更新链路做兼容处理，支持多版本持续分发与替换式部署。
summary.en: This repository delivers an unofficial Chinese-localized distribution of Clash for Windows, including translated installers, patches, and packaged releases for users who want a ready-to-use Chinese desktop proxy client. Its technical focus lies in patching the Electron app bundle, especially `app.asar`, `renderer.js`, and `main.js`, to localize the interface while maintaining installer-based update compatibility across multiple supported Clash for Windows versions.

metadata.name: ZLMediaKit
metadata.description: WebRTC/RTSP/RTMP/HTTP/HLS/HTTP-FLV/WebSocket-FLV/HTTP-TS/HTTP-fMP4/WebSocket-TS/WebSocket-fMP4/GB28181/SRT/STUN/TURN server and client framework based on C++11

summary.zh: ZLMediaKit 是基于 C++11 的高性能流媒体服务框架，覆盖 RTSP/RTMP/WebRTC/HLS/HTTP-FLV/GB28181/SRT 等协议，支持互转、按需拉推流与集群部署。适合商用级直播、监控与跨平台媒体网关，亮点是低延迟、海量并发和完整标准 C API。
summary.en: ZLMediaKit is a C++11-based high-performance streaming framework covering RTSP, RTMP, WebRTC, HLS, HTTP-FLV, GB28181, and SRT, with protocol bridging, on-demand relay, and clustering support. It targets commercial live streaming, surveillance, and cross-platform media gateways, emphasizing ultra-low latency, massive concurrency, and a full standard C API.

metadata.name: sensitive
metadata.description: 🔐Sensitive log tool for java, based on java annotation. (基于注解的 java 日志脱敏工具框架，更加优雅的日志打印。支持自定义哈希、支持基于 log4j2 插件的统一脱敏、支持 logback 插件统一脱敏)

summary.zh: sensitive 是面向 Java 的注解式日志脱敏框架，聚焦手机号、邮箱、身份证、银行卡等敏感字段的安全输出。它支持内置与自定义脱敏策略、深拷贝无侵入处理，并提供 FastJSON、log4j2、logback 统一脱敏插件；通过插件机制规避正则长文本回溯，兼顾性能、可扩展性与工程落地性。
summary.en: Sensitive is a Java annotation-driven log desensitization framework for securely masking fields such as phone numbers, emails, ID cards, bank cards, and passwords. It offers built-in and custom masking strategies, non-intrusive deep-copy processing, and unified integration with FastJSON, Log4j2, and Logback. Its plugin-based approach avoids regex backtracking on long log messages, delivering stronger performance, extensibility, and production-ready observability security.

metadata.name: hikvision-spring-boot-starter
metadata.description: 海康威视sdk接入

summary.zh: 该项目将海康威视摄像机与NVR SDK封装为 Spring Boot Starter，提供实时预览、录像回放、抓图及 RTSP/SDK 转 FLV 推流能力，解决官方 Web 播放控件浏览器兼容差、RTSP 回放高延迟与多端播放适配问题，适用于安防视频接入、监控平台与设备流媒体转发场景。
summary.en: This project packages Hikvision camera and NVR SDK integration as a Spring Boot Starter, delivering live preview, playback, snapshot capture, and RTSP/SDK-to-FLV streaming. It targets common pain points of the official web control, including poor browser compatibility, high RTSP playback latency, and multi-client playback adaptation. It is well suited for security surveillance platforms, device access layers, and lightweight video streaming services.

metadata.name: rest-assured
metadata.description: Java DSL for easy testing of REST services

summary.zh: REST Assured 是面向 Java 的 REST 接口测试 DSL，显著降低接口验证与响应断言的编写复杂度。它以链式语法统一请求构造、状态码校验、Header/Cookie/参数断言，并原生支持 JSONPath、XPath、认证及 MockMvc 等场景，适合 API 自动化测试、集成测试与服务回归验证，兼顾可读性与扩展性。
summary.en: REST Assured is a Java DSL that simplifies testing and validation of REST APIs with fluent, highly readable syntax. It streamlines request building, status and payload assertions, and supports headers, cookies, authentication, JSONPath, XPath, and Spring MockMvc integration. The project is well suited for API automation, integration testing, and regression validation, bringing expressive, dynamic-language-style API testing into modern Java ecosystems.

metadata.name: forest
metadata.description: A high-level and lightweight declarative HTTP client framework for Java. it makes sending HTTP requests in Java easier.

summary.zh: Forest 是面向 Java 的轻量级声明式 HTTP 客户端框架，以注解驱动方式将远程调用抽象为本地接口方法，显著降低样板代码。项目支持 Spring Boot 集成、异步调用、SSE、拦截器、OAuth2，以及 JSON/XML/Protobuf 序列化，并可切换 HttpClient 与 OkHttp 作为底层实现，适合对接第三方 API、构建企业级服务集成层。
summary.en: Forest is a lightweight declarative HTTP client framework for Java that turns remote HTTP calls into local interface-style method invocations through annotations, greatly reducing boilerplate. It supports Spring Boot integration, async requests, SSE, interceptors, OAuth2, and JSON/XML/Protobuf serialization, while allowing Apache HttpClient or OkHttp as the transport backend. It is well suited for third-party API integration and building clean enterprise service communication layers.

metadata.name: dante-cloud
metadata.description: 🐉 Dante Cloud 国内首个支持阻塞式和响应式服务并行的微服务云原生基座。采用领域驱动模型(DDD)设计思想，以「高质量代码、低安全漏洞」为核心，高度模块化和组件化设计，支持IoT等物联网设备认证，满足国家三级等保要求、支持接口国密数字信封加解密等系列安全体系的多租户微服务解决方案。独创的“一套代码实现微服务和单体两种架构灵活切换”的企业级微服务平台。🔝🔝 点个star 持续关注更新！

summary.zh: Dante Cloud 是面向企业级场景的云原生微服务基座，基于 Spring Boot 4、Spring Cloud 与 DDD 构建，支持阻塞式与响应式服务并行开发。其核心价值在于以一套代码灵活切换微服务与单体架构，结合多租户、IoT 设备认证、国密数字信封及等保三级安全体系，适用于政企、物联网与高安全行业的分布式业务平台建设。
summary.en: Dante Cloud is an enterprise-grade cloud-native microservice foundation built with Spring Boot 4, Spring Cloud, and DDD principles. It uniquely supports both blocking and reactive services in parallel, while enabling flexible switching between microservice and monolithic architectures from a single codebase. With multi-tenancy, IoT device authentication, commercial cryptography support, and compliance-oriented security design, it fits government, industrial IoT, and other security-sensitive distributed platform scenarios.

metadata.name: DeepSeek-Coder
metadata.description: DeepSeek Coder: Let the Code Write Itself

summary.zh: DeepSeek-Coder 是面向代码生成与补全的大模型系列，基于 2T token、87% 代码数据从零训练，覆盖 1B 到 33B 多种规模。其 16K 上下文与 Fill-in-the-Blank 训练使其擅长项目级补全、跨文件推断和代码插入，在 HumanEval、MBPP、DS-1000 等基准上达到开源代码模型领先水平，适用于智能编程助手、IDE 补全与多语言软件开发。
summary.en: DeepSeek-Coder is a family of code-centric LLMs trained from scratch on 2T tokens, with 87% code and bilingual natural language data, spanning 1B to 33B parameters. With a 16K context window and fill-in-the-blank training, it is optimized for project-level completion, code infilling, and cross-file reasoning. The models achieve state-of-the-art results among open-source code models on benchmarks such as HumanEval, MBPP, DS-1000, and MultiPL-E, making them well suited for coding assistants, IDE integration, and multilingual software development.

metadata.name: localstack
metadata.description: 💻 A fully functional local AWS cloud stack. Develop and test your cloud & Serverless apps offline

summary.zh: LocalStack 是面向本地开发与 CI 的 AWS 云服务模拟平台，以单容器方式提供高保真云环境，支持离线运行和测试 Serverless、Lambda、CDK、Terraform 等应用。其核心价值在于缩短云应用反馈回路、降低联调成本，并以统一镜像整合能力覆盖，适合云原生开发、集成测试与教学实验场景。
summary.en: LocalStack is a high-fidelity AWS cloud emulator for local development and CI, packaging a broad set of AWS-like services into a single containerized runtime. It enables developers to build and test Serverless apps, Lambda functions, CDK stacks, and Terraform infrastructure offline without relying on live AWS accounts. Its main value lies in shortening feedback loops, reducing cloud testing costs, and providing a unified emulation layer for cloud-native development, integration testing, and learning workflows.

metadata.name: QLExpress
metadata.description: QLExpress is a powerful, lightweight, dynamic language for the Java platform aimed at improving developers’ productivity in different business scenes.

summary.zh: QLExpress 是面向 Java 的轻量级动态规则与表达式引擎，适用于电商优惠、流程条件、表单联动、广告计费等业务规则场景。项目基于 Antlr4 重写解析器，支持自定义函数与操作符、原生 JSON、表达式执行追踪、函数式编程与安全隔离，在保持低依赖和高兼容性的同时，兼顾规则可扩展性、可观测性与线上解释执行性能。
summary.en: QLExpress is a lightweight dynamic rule and expression engine for Java, designed for business-rule scenarios such as e-commerce promotions, workflow conditions, form linkage, and ad pricing. Its latest version rebuilds the parser on Antlr4 and adds native JSON syntax, custom functions and operators, expression tracing, functional programming support, and secure sandbox-style isolation. The project stands out for low dependency overhead, JVM-friendly interpreted execution, strong extensibility, and better observability for debugging and attribution analysis.

metadata.name: sd-webui-prompt-all-in-one
metadata.description: This is an extension based on sd-webui, aimed at improving the user experience of the prompt/negative prompt input box. It has a more intuitive and powerful input interface function, and provides automatic translation, history record, and bookmarking functions.    这是一个基于 sd-webui 的扩展，旨在提高提示词/反向提示词输入框的使用体验。它拥有更直观、强大的输入界面功能，它提供了自动翻译、历史记录和收藏等功能。

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 Stable Diffusion WebUI 的提示词增强扩展，重构正向/反向提示输入体验，集成自动翻译、历史记录、收藏管理与多语言支持。其价值在于提升提示编写、整理与复用效率，适合高频生成与跨语言创作场景，并已延伸出可独立运行的轻量版思路。
summary.en: This extension enhances the prompt and negative-prompt workflow in Stable Diffusion WebUI with a more capable input interface, built-in auto translation, history tracking, bookmarking, and multilingual support. Its core value is improving prompt authoring, organization, and reuse for frequent image generation and cross-language creativity, while also inspiring a lightweight standalone version focused on prompt editing.

metadata.name: stable-diffusion-webui-wd14-tagger
metadata.description: Labeling extension for Automatic1111's Web UI

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 Automatic1111 Stable Diffusion WebUI 的图像标签扩展，可对单张或批量图片进行 booru 风格标签反推。项目支持 WD14 Tagger 与 DeepDanbooru 等多种模型，具备自动下载、批处理和模型切换能力，适用于数据集标注、提示词回推与二次元图像整理场景。
summary.en: This repository is a tagging extension for Automatic1111 Stable Diffusion WebUI that interrogates single or batch images into booru-style tags. It supports multiple interrogators, including WD14 Tagger and DeepDanbooru, with model switching and automatic model download for a smoother workflow. The project is especially useful for dataset annotation, prompt reverse-engineering, and anime image organization within Stable Diffusion pipelines.

metadata.name: docker-graalvm-maven
metadata.description: Docker image to build native Linux binaries from Java Maven projects using GraalVM native-image feature.

summary.zh: 该仓库提供面向 Java Maven 项目的 GraalVM 构建镜像，帮助开发者在容器内稳定产出原生 Linux 可执行文件。镜像基于 Debian slim，预装 Maven、GraalVM native-image、Docker CLI 与常用运维工具，支持多 JDK 版本与版本化标签，并通过每周自动构建持续纳入安全更新，适合本地构建、CI/CD 与跨环境一致性编译。
summary.en: This repository delivers an opinionated Docker image for building native Linux binaries from Java Maven projects with GraalVM Native Image. Based on Debian slim, it bundles Maven, GraalVM CE, the native-image extension, Docker CLI, and practical shell utilities to provide a consistent build environment. With support for multiple JDK tracks, versioned image tags, non-root usage, and weekly automated rebuilds for security updates, it fits local development, CI pipelines, and reproducible native compilation workflows.

metadata.name: MooTool
metadata.description: Handy tool set for developers

summary.zh: MooTool 是面向开发者的跨平台桌面工具箱，集成速记、文本批处理、JSON/HTTP/编码加解密、正则、Cron、网络、二维码等高频能力。其亮点在于模块覆盖广、离线可用、界面集成度高，并提供 Markdown 预览、代码格式化、历史记录与批量替换，适合日常研发、调试与效率增强场景。
summary.en: MooTool is a cross-platform desktop toolbox for developers, combining quick notes, batch text processing, JSON/HTTP utilities, encoding and cryptography, regex, Cron, networking, QR code tools, and more. Its key strengths are broad module coverage, offline-friendly workflows, and a highly integrated UI with Markdown preview, code formatting, history tracking, and quick replace features, making it well suited for daily development, debugging, and productivity tasks.

metadata.name: Stable-Diffusion-Webui-Civitai-Helper
metadata.description: Stable Diffusion Webui Extension for Civitai, to manage your model much more easily.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 Stable Diffusion WebUI 的 Civitai 扩展，核心用于本地模型与 Civitai 资产的关联、扫描和下载管理。它可批量为模型生成 SHA256 并拉取元数据、预览图，支持断点续传、版本更新检测及按 URL 直接下载到模型目录，还增强 Extra Network 卡片，提供一键跳转、触发词注入与提示词复用，显著提升大规模模型库维护效率。
summary.en: This extension enhances Stable Diffusion WebUI with deep Civitai integration for model discovery, synchronization, and lifecycle management. It scans local models via SHA256 to fetch metadata and preview images, links models to Civitai pages, supports resumable downloads, checks for newer model versions, and downloads updates directly into SD model folders. It also augments Extra Network cards with quick actions for opening Civitai pages, injecting trigger words, and reusing preview prompts, making large model libraries far easier to manage.

metadata.name: rocksdb
metadata.description: A library that provides an embeddable, persistent key-value store for fast storage.

summary.zh: RocksDB 是面向闪存与内存场景的嵌入式持久化键值存储库，采用 LSM-Tree 架构，在写放大、读放大与空间放大之间提供可调权衡。其多线程 Compaction 与 TB 级单库承载能力，使其适合数据库内核、缓存持久化、日志与状态存储等高性能基础设施场景。
summary.en: RocksDB is an embeddable persistent key-value store optimized for flash and RAM workloads. Built on an LSM-tree design, it offers tunable trade-offs among write, read, and space amplification, enabling performance optimization for diverse storage profiles. With multi-threaded compaction and single-instance scalability to terabytes of data, it serves as a core engine for databases, state stores, caching layers, and other high-performance storage infrastructure.

metadata.name: rocketmq-flink
metadata.description: RocketMQ integration for Apache Flink. This module includes the RocketMQ source and sink that allows a flink job to either write messages into a topic or read from topics in a flink job.

summary.zh: rocketmq-flink 是 Apache Flink 与 RocketMQ 的流式集成连接器，提供 Source 与 Sink，支持作业从 RocketMQ 订阅读取或将处理结果写回主题。其亮点在于基于拉取消费模式实现 Source，并在开启 checkpoint 时提供 exactly-once 或 at-least-once 语义，同时通过可扩展的序列化接口与 TopicSelector 支持灵活的消息键值、标签和主题路由。
summary.en: rocketmq-flink is a streaming connector that integrates Apache Flink with RocketMQ, enabling Flink jobs to consume from and publish messages to RocketMQ topics. Its main strengths are a pull-based source design, checkpoint-aware delivery guarantees such as exactly-once for sources and at-least-once for sinks, and extensible serialization plus topic-selection APIs that support flexible key/value encoding, tag handling, and dynamic topic routing in real-time data pipelines.

metadata.name: flink-cdc
metadata.description: Flink CDC is a streaming data integration tool

summary.zh: Flink CDC 是构建于 Apache Flink 之上的分布式流批一体数据集成工具，面向数据库实时同步、全量+增量一体迁移及湖仓入湖场景。其亮点在于提供 YAML 零代码管道编排，并支持分库分表同步、路由转换、端到端高效传输与 Schema Evolution，适合实时数仓与数据平台建设。
summary.en: Flink CDC is a distributed data integration platform built on Apache Flink for real-time and batch synchronization across databases, warehouses, and lakehouse systems. It stands out with a declarative YAML pipeline API, enabling zero-code orchestration of sources, sinks, routing, transformations, and schema evolution. Key strengths include full plus incremental sync, sharded table replication, efficient end-to-end delivery, and strong suitability for real-time data warehousing and modern data platform pipelines.

metadata.name: tech-interview-handbook
metadata.description: Curated coding interview preparation materials for busy software engineers

summary.zh: Tech Interview Handbook 面向时间有限的软件工程师，提供覆盖求职、算法刷题、行为面试、简历优化到谈薪的系统化面试资料。其核心亮点是以 Blind 75、Grind 75 和专题速查表为代表的高质量精选内容，强调少而精、可直接执行，帮助候选人以更高效率建立完整的技术面试准备路径。
summary.en: Tech Interview Handbook is a curated interview prep resource for time-constrained software engineers, covering the full journey from job applications and coding interviews to resume writing, behavioral rounds, and offer negotiation. Its key strength lies in high-signal, immediately usable content such as Blind 75, Grind 75, and topic-based cheatsheets, helping candidates focus on proven question patterns and build an efficient, end-to-end technical interview preparation workflow.

metadata.name: KeyDB
metadata.description: A Multithreaded Fork of Redis

summary.zh: KeyDB 是 Redis 的高性能多线程兼容分支，面向缓存、会话存储、实时数据处理等高吞吐场景。项目以 MVCC 架构实现 KEYS/SCAN 非阻塞查询，支持 Active Replication、FLASH Storage 与 Subkey Expires，在保持 Redis 协议、模块与脚本兼容的同时，提供更高吞吐、更优内存效率与更低运维复杂度。
summary.en: KeyDB is a high-performance, multithreaded fork of Redis designed for high-throughput caching, session storage, and real-time data workloads. Built on an MVCC architecture, it enables non-blocking operations such as KEYS and SCAN while adding capabilities like Active Replication, FLASH Storage, and Subkey Expires. Fully compatible with the Redis protocol, modules, and scripts, KeyDB serves as a drop-in replacement that delivers higher throughput, better memory efficiency, and simpler operational scaling.

metadata.name: WinMemoryCleaner
metadata.description: This free RAM cleaner uses native Windows features to optimize memory areas. It's a compact, portable, and smart application.

summary.zh: WinMemoryCleaner 是一款面向 Windows 的便携式内存优化工具，利用原生 Windows API 清理和整理内存区域，适合程序泄漏或占用异常时快速释放 RAM。支持自动优化、全局热键、进程排除、托盘驻留与多语言界面，强调轻量、智能、免安装。
summary.en: WinMemoryCleaner is a portable Windows memory optimizer that uses native Windows APIs to clean and compact memory areas, helping free RAM when apps leak or retain memory poorly. It targets quick desktop recovery with auto optimization, global hotkeys, process exclusion, tray support, and a multilingual UI, while remaining lightweight and install-free.

metadata.name: vector
metadata.description: A high-performance observability data pipeline.

summary.zh: Vector 是用 Rust 构建的高性能可观测性数据管道，面向日志、指标等数据的采集、转换与路由，可作为 agent 或 aggregator 部署，帮助企业降本、提效并实现跨厂商迁移与数据治理。
summary.en: Vector is a high-performance observability data pipeline built in Rust for collecting, transforming, and routing logs and metrics. It runs as an agent or aggregator, helping teams cut costs, improve data quality, and move between vendors with minimal disruption.

metadata.name: debezium
metadata.description: Change data capture for a variety of databases. Please log issues at https://github.com/debezium/dbz/issues.

summary.zh: Debezium 是基于 Kafka 与 Kafka Connect 的低延迟 CDC 平台，可持续捕获 MySQL、PostgreSQL 等数据库的行级变更并输出为统一事件流。它支持只暴露已提交事务、持久化变更历史、故障后断点续传，适用于数据同步、实时分析、事件驱动架构与微服务数据集成。
summary.en: Debezium is a low-latency change data capture platform built on Kafka and Kafka Connect, streaming row-level changes from databases such as MySQL and PostgreSQL as a unified event model. It exposes only committed transactions, preserves durable change history, and supports reliable resume after failures, making it well suited for data synchronization, real-time analytics, event-driven systems, and microservice data integration.

metadata.name: dynamic-datasource
metadata.description: dynamic datasource for springboot 多数据源 动态数据源 主从分离 读写分离 分布式事务

summary.zh: dynamic-datasource 是面向 Spring Boot 的多数据源集成组件，聚焦动态切换、读写分离与主从场景。它支持数据源分组、懒加载、运行时增删、SpEL 解析、自定义注解及 Seata 分布式事务，并兼容多版本 Spring Boot，适合中大型企业应用统一管理复杂数据库访问策略。
summary.en: dynamic-datasource is a Spring Boot starter for managing multiple data sources with runtime switching, read/write splitting, and master-slave architectures. It supports datasource grouping, lazy initialization, dynamic add/remove operations, SpEL-based routing, custom annotations, and Seata-powered distributed transactions. With broad Spring Boot version compatibility, it fits enterprise applications that need flexible and centralized database access governance.

metadata.name: rocketmq-mqtt
metadata.description: Apache rocketmq

summary.zh: Apache RocketMQ MQTT 为 RocketMQ 提供 MQTT 协议接入层，面向 IoT 终端与移动应用构建统一消息收发通道。项目基于 RocketMQ 统一存储引擎，并依赖轻量消息队列 LMQ 实现 MQTT 队列模型，兼顾终端与服务端通信、集群元数据配置及高吞吐消息接入，适合需要 MQTT 与消息中间件深度融合的场景。
summary.en: Apache RocketMQ MQTT adds an MQTT protocol access layer to RocketMQ, enabling unified messaging for IoT devices and mobile applications. Built on RocketMQ’s unified storage engine, it relies on Light Message Queue (LMQ) to implement the MQTT queue model while supporting both terminal-side and server-side publish/subscribe flows. It is designed for scenarios that need MQTT connectivity, clustered metadata management, and deep integration with high-throughput RocketMQ messaging infrastructure.

metadata.name: jetcache
metadata.description: JetCache is a Java cache framework.

summary.zh: JetCache 是面向 Java 与 Spring 生态的统一缓存抽象框架，屏蔽 Redis、Caffeine 等后端差异，并提供比 Spring Cache 更强的注解式能力。其核心亮点包括原生 TTL、双级缓存、分布式自动刷新、本地缓存失效同步、穿透保护与异步访问，适合构建高性能、低延迟且易治理的企业级缓存体系。
summary.en: JetCache is a Java cache abstraction framework for the Java and Spring ecosystem, unifying access to backends such as Redis and Caffeine through a consistent API. It goes beyond Spring Cache with native TTL, two-level caching, distributed auto-refresh, local cache invalidation across JVMs, penetration protection, and async access. It is well suited for building high-performance, low-latency, and operationally manageable enterprise caching layers.

metadata.name: influxdb
metadata.description: Scalable datastore for metrics, events, and real-time analytics

summary.zh: InfluxDB 3 Core 是面向指标、事件与实时分析的开源时序数据库，适合监控、可观测性、传感器与金融行情等高吞吐低延迟场景。项目基于 Rust、Apache Arrow、DataFusion 与 Parquet，采用支持对象存储的轻量架构，兼容 InfluxDB 1.x/2.x 写入接口，并同时提供 SQL、InfluxQL 与 Flight SQL 查询能力，兼顾实时摄取、快速查询与现代分析生态集成。
summary.en: InfluxDB 3 Core is an open source time-series database built for metrics, events, monitoring, and real-time analytics. It targets low-latency, high-ingest workloads such as observability, sensor telemetry, application monitoring, and market data. Built with Rust, Apache Arrow, DataFusion, and Parquet, it combines fast query performance with object-storage-friendly architecture. It also preserves ecosystem compatibility through InfluxDB 1.x/2.x write APIs while supporting SQL, InfluxQL, Flight SQL, and an embedded Python VM for extensibility.

metadata.name: iot-benchmark
metadata.description: IoT-benchmark is a tool for benchmarking TSDB in IoT scenario.

summary.zh: IoT-Benchmark 是面向工业物联网场景的时序数据库基准测试工具，支持 IoTDB、InfluxDB、QuestDB、TDengine 等多类数据库。它可生成周期性时序数据、执行写入与查询压测、校验结果正确性，并将结果输出到文件或 MySQL，结合 Tableau 实现可视化，适合 TSDB 选型、性能对比与回归评估。
summary.en: IoT-Benchmark is a benchmarking tool for evaluating time-series and real-time databases in Industrial IoT scenarios. It supports multiple engines including IoTDB, InfluxDB, QuestDB, and TDengine, and provides configurable data generation, ingestion and query workloads, correctness verification, and result export to files or MySQL. With cross-platform execution and Tableau-based visualization, it is well suited for TSDB comparison, capacity planning, and regression performance evaluation.

metadata.name: openjob
metadata.description: Distributed high performance task scheduling framework

summary.zh: Openjob 是面向企业级场景的分布式高性能任务调度框架，覆盖 Cron、延迟任务、工作流与轻量级分布式计算。其基于无状态 Master/Worker、分片一致性与无锁调度设计，实现秒级精度、横向无限扩展及高容错；并提供可视化 DAG、权限体系、告警监控及多语言 Worker 生态，适合复杂作业编排与大规模任务执行。
summary.en: Openjob is a distributed, high-performance scheduling framework for enterprise workloads, combining cron jobs, delay queues, workflow orchestration, and lightweight distributed computing in one platform. Built on a stateless Master/Worker architecture with consistent sharding and lock-free scheduling, it delivers second-level precision, strong fault tolerance, and near-unlimited horizontal scalability. It also includes visual DAG workflow design, permission management, alerting, monitoring, and multi-language worker support, making it well suited for complex job orchestration and large-scale task execution.

metadata.name: airflow
metadata.description: Apache Airflow - A platform to programmatically author, schedule, and monitor workflows

summary.zh: Apache Airflow 是面向数据与业务流程编排的开源工作流平台，支持以 Python 代码定义 DAG，实现任务调度、依赖管理、重试监控与可视化运维。其亮点在于可编程编排模型、丰富的执行器与插件生态，适用于 ETL、数据管道、机器学习流程及跨系统自动化作业。
summary.en: Apache Airflow is an open-source workflow orchestration platform for defining, scheduling, and monitoring pipelines as Python-based DAGs. It excels at dependency management, retries, observability, and operational control through a web UI and extensible executors. With a strong plugin and integration ecosystem, it is widely used for ETL, data engineering, machine learning workflows, and cross-system job automation at scale.

metadata.name: azkaban
metadata.description: Azkaban workflow manager.

summary.zh: Azkaban 是面向批处理与数据流水线的工作流调度平台，提供任务编排、依赖管理、定时执行与可视化运维能力。项目基于 Java 与 Gradle 构建，适合 Hadoop 生态、ETL 及企业级作业自动化场景，亮点在于稳定的多任务流控制、易部署的 Web 管理界面，以及对复杂作业链路的统一调度。
summary.en: Azkaban is a workflow scheduling platform for batch processing and data pipelines, offering job orchestration, dependency management, scheduled execution, and operational visibility through a web UI. Built with Java and Gradle, it fits Hadoop ecosystems, ETL pipelines, and enterprise job automation. Its key strengths are reliable multi-step flow control, centralized scheduling for complex job chains, and straightforward deployment for production workflow operations.

metadata.name: dolphinscheduler
metadata.description: Apache DolphinScheduler is the modern data orchestration platform. Agile to create high performance workflow with low-code

summary.zh: Apache DolphinScheduler 是面向数据管道与复杂任务依赖的现代工作流编排平台，支持通过 Web UI、Python SDK 和 OpenAPI 以低代码方式构建高性能流程。其核心亮点在于去中心化多 Master/Worker 高可用架构、横向扩展能力、丰富内置任务类型，以及对 Docker、Kubernetes、多云和多租户场景的原生支持，适合企业级数据开发与调度治理。
summary.en: Apache DolphinScheduler is a modern workflow orchestration platform designed for data pipelines and complex task dependencies. It enables low-code workflow development through a Web UI, Python SDK, and OpenAPI, while delivering high throughput and enterprise-grade reliability. Key strengths include its decentralized multi-master/multi-worker architecture, horizontal scalability, extensive built-in task types, and native support for Docker, Kubernetes, multi-cloud, and multi-tenant deployments, making it well suited for large-scale data engineering and scheduling governance.

metadata.name: AnotherRedisDesktopManager
metadata.description: 🚀🚀🚀A faster, better and more stable Redis desktop manager [GUI client], compatible with Linux, Windows, Mac.

summary.zh: Another Redis Desktop Manager 是一款跨平台 Redis 图形化管理工具，面向开发、运维与数据排障场景。项目强调高性能与稳定性，尤其针对海量 key 加载不易崩溃，支持 Linux、Windows、macOS 多端分发，并提供安装包、包管理器与应用商店渠道，降低 Redis 连接管理、数据浏览与命令执行门槛。
summary.en: Another Redis Desktop Manager is a cross-platform GUI client for Redis, built for developers, operators, and troubleshooting workflows. Its core value lies in faster interaction, improved stability, and reliable handling of massive keyspaces without crashing. The project supports Linux, Windows, and macOS, with broad distribution through installers, package managers, and app stores, making Redis connection management, key browsing, and command execution more accessible.

metadata.name: magic-api
metadata.description: magic-api 是一个接口快速开发框架，通过Web页面编写脚本以及配置，自动映射为HTTP接口，无需定义Controller、Service、Dao、Mapper、XML、VO等Java对象

summary.zh: magic-api 是面向 Java/Spring Boot 的低代码接口开发框架，借助可视化 Web IDE 编写脚本并即时发布为 HTTP API，省去传统 Controller、Service 与 Mapper 分层开发。其亮点在于基于 magic-script 的动态编译、在线调试、多数据源与数据库/Redis/MongoDB 支持，以及权限、Swagger、集群同步和历史版本管理能力，适合中后台接口快速交付。
summary.en: magic-api is a Java/Spring Boot rapid API development framework that turns scripts and visual configuration from a web IDE directly into HTTP endpoints, eliminating the usual Controller, Service, Mapper, and XML layers. Its key strengths include dynamic compilation via magic-script, real-time publishing without restart, online debugging, multi-datasource support, JDBC/Redis/MongoDB integration, plus Swagger generation, permission control, cluster synchronization, and script history management for fast internal API delivery.

metadata.name: RedisInsight
metadata.description: Redis GUI by Redis

summary.zh: Redis Insight 是 Redis 官方推出的可视化开发与运维工具，面向 Redis OSS、Redis Cloud 及托管服务。它集成键值浏览、CRUD、Profiler、Slow Log、Pub/Sub 与智能 Workbench，支持 JSON、Search、Time Series 等模块，并提供向量检索与可扩展可视化插件，适合调试、性能分析和数据探索。
summary.en: Redis Insight is Redis’s official visual GUI for developing, operating, and optimizing Redis workloads across Redis OSS, Redis Cloud, and managed services. It combines key browsing, CRUD editing, profiling, Slow Log analysis, Pub/Sub, and an intelligent workbench with module-aware support for RedisJSON, Search, and Time Series. With vector-search-oriented workflows and extensible visualization plugins, it fits debugging, performance tuning, and interactive data exploration.

metadata.name: hcaptcha-challenger
metadata.description: 🥂 Gracefully face hCaptcha challenge with multimodal large language model.

summary.zh: hcaptcha-challenger 是一个面向 hCaptcha 自动化应对的多模态 AI 框架，不依赖油猴脚本或第三方打码平台。项目以可插拔模型设计整合 ResNet、YOLOv8、CLIP-ViT 与 ONNX 推理能力，覆盖二分类、点选、拖拽等挑战场景，并结合 Agentic Workflow 与数据采集流水线，适合浏览器自动化、安全研究与验证码挑战建模。
summary.en: hcaptcha-challenger is a multimodal AI framework for handling hCaptcha challenges without Tampermonkey scripts or third-party solving services. It uses a pluggable architecture combining ResNet, YOLOv8, CLIP-ViT, and ONNX inference to support binary classification, point selection, and drag-drop tasks. With agentic workflows, dataset collection pipelines, and model-zoo extensibility, it targets browser automation, captcha research, and adaptive challenge-solving systems.

metadata.name: TechStack
metadata.description: The extension will display the tech stack of the Repo when the user visits a GitHub Public Repo. The user can easily get more info about the repo. 当用户访问 GitHub 公共存储库时，该扩展将显示存储库的技术栈。 用户可以更轻松地获取有关存储库的更多信息。

summary.zh: Tech Stack 是一款面向 GitHub 公共仓库的浏览器扩展，可在访问仓库页面时自动识别并展示项目所用技术栈，帮助开发者快速理解依赖生态、框架选型与实现方向。其亮点在于无缝嵌入 GitHub 浏览体验、支持多浏览器分发，并提供技术栈补充提交通道，适合代码调研、技术选型与开源项目分析。
summary.en: Tech Stack is a browser extension that detects and displays the technology stack of a GitHub public repository directly on the repo page. It helps developers quickly understand frameworks, dependencies, and implementation direction without leaving GitHub. Key strengths include seamless in-page integration, multi-browser availability, and a submission workflow for adding missing stacks, making it useful for repository research, technical evaluation, and open-source due diligence.

metadata.name: keyviz
metadata.description: Keyviz is a free and open-source tool to visualize your keystrokes ⌨️ and 🖱️ mouse actions in real-time.

summary.zh: Keyviz 是一款基于 Tauri 构建的跨平台按键与鼠标操作实时可视化工具，适用于教程录制、直播演示、远程协作和培训场景。项目支持组合键、点击、拖拽与滚轮动作展示，并提供样式、过滤、历史轨迹、位置与动画等细粒度自定义，兼顾桌面原生性能与开源可扩展性。
summary.en: Keyviz is an open-source desktop tool for real-time visualization of keyboard shortcuts and mouse actions, built with Tauri for lightweight cross-platform delivery. It is well suited for tutorials, live demos, screen recording, remote collaboration, and technical training. The project highlights combined key-mouse gestures, scroll and drag indicators, plus deep customization for styling, filtering, history, positioning, and animations.

metadata.name: gkd
metadata.description: 基于无障碍，高级选择器，订阅规则的自定义屏幕点击安卓应用 | An Android APP with custom screen tapping based on Accessibility, Advanced Selectors, and Subscription Rules

summary.zh: GKD 是一款基于 Android 无障碍服务的自动化点击工具，通过高级选择器、订阅规则与快照审查机制，实现按界面上下文精准识别并执行点击、跳过或确认等操作。它适用于广告跳过、重复流程自动化和个性化交互编排，亮点在于规则可订阅扩展、定位表达力强、无需内置固定脚本。
summary.en: GKD is an Android automation app built on Accessibility services, combining advanced selectors, subscription-based rules, and snapshot inspection to trigger precise taps or actions based on UI context. It is well suited for skipping splash ads, automating repetitive confirmations, and customizing interaction flows. Its key strengths are expressive rule targeting, remotely updatable subscriptions, and a flexible architecture that avoids hardcoded built-in scripts.

metadata.name: mind-map
metadata.description: SimpleMindMap（思绪思维导图）：一个强大的思维导图。A powerful mind map.

summary.zh: SimpleMindMap 是一个面向 Web 的思维导图库与在线应用方案，核心库基于原生 JavaScript、无框架依赖，便于快速构建可定制的思维导图产品。仓库同时提供基于 Vue2 与 ElementUI 的 Web 端实现，支持本地文件操作、自部署和二次开发，覆盖多结构图、丰富节点内容、导入导出及主题定制等高频场景。
summary.en: SimpleMindMap is a Web-focused mind mapping library and application stack designed for building customizable mind map products quickly. Its core engine is implemented in plain JavaScript with no framework dependency, while the repo also includes a Vue 2 + ElementUI web app for local file handling, self-hosting, and secondary development. It supports multiple diagram structures, rich node content, format import/export, and extensive theme customization for production-grade use cases.

metadata.name: Bangumi
metadata.description: :electron: An unofficial https://bgm.tv ui first app client for Android and iOS, built with React Native. 一个无广告、以爱好为驱动、不以盈利为目的、专门做 ACG 的类似豆瓣的追番记录，bgm.tv 第三方客户端。为移动端重新设计，内置大量加强的网页端难以实现的功能，且提供了相当的自定义选项。 目前已适配 iOS / Android。

summary.zh: Bangumi 是面向 iOS 与 Android 的 React Native 第三方 bgm.tv 客户端，围绕 ACG 追番、条目管理与社区讨论做了移动端重设计。项目覆盖站点核心页面，并通过 CDN 中间层、跨站同步、照片墙与 AI 推荐等增强能力，提升访问稳定性、内容发现效率和高度可定制体验。
summary.en: Bangumi is an unofficial bgm.tv client for iOS and Android built with React Native, redesigned specifically for mobile-first ACG tracking, catalog browsing, and community interaction. It mirrors most core Bangumi pages while extending them with CDN-backed asset delivery, limited cross-site sync, visual collection walls, and AI-powered recommendations, delivering better resilience, richer discovery, and extensive customization beyond the web experience.

metadata.name: Stirling-PDF
metadata.description: #1 PDF Application on GitHub that lets you edit PDFs on any device anywhere

summary.zh: Stirling PDF 是一款面向个人与企业的开源 PDF 平台，支持桌面、浏览器与私有化部署。它集成 50+ PDF 工具，覆盖编辑、签署、脱敏、OCR、转换与压缩，并提供 REST API 与可视化工作流，适合文档处理自动化、内网合规和大规模 PDF 服务集成。
summary.en: Stirling PDF is an open-source PDF platform for individuals and enterprises, available as a desktop app, browser-based UI, and self-hosted service. It offers 50+ capabilities including editing, signing, redaction, OCR, conversion, and compression, while exposing REST APIs and no-code workflows for large-scale document automation. Its key strengths are privacy-first deployment, on-prem enterprise controls, and broad accessibility across devices and languages.

metadata.name: optimizer
metadata.description: The finest Windows Optimizer

summary.zh: Optimizer 是一款已停止维护的 Windows 隐私、安全与系统调优工具，适合在新装系统后集中关闭遥测、Cortana、CoPilot、自动更新及冗余服务，并提供 UWP 卸载、DNS/Hosts 编辑、注册表修复、启动项清理等能力。其亮点在于多语言支持、命令行模板自动化与面向 Windows 7–11/Server 的广泛兼容性。
summary.en: Optimizer is a deprecated but feature-rich Windows privacy, security, and tuning utility aimed at post-install hardening. It centralizes disabling telemetry, Cortana, Copilot, automatic updates, and unnecessary services, while also offering UWP app removal, DNS and HOSTS editing, registry fixes, startup cleanup, and hardware inspection. Key strengths include multilingual support, template-driven silent automation, and broad compatibility across Windows 7–11 and Windows Server.

metadata.name: questdb
metadata.description: QuestDB is a high performance, open-source, time-series database

summary.zh: QuestDB 是面向高吞吐实时场景的开源时序数据库，适合金融行情、传感器遥测、监控看板与流式分析。其核心优势在于零 GC Java/C++ 引擎、列式存储、SIMD 并行执行，以及 WAL 到原生列式再到对象存储 Parquet 的多层存储架构，同时提供时序 SQL 扩展、PGWire 和 REST 接口，兼顾极致写入性能与低延迟查询。
summary.en: QuestDB is an open-source time-series database built for high-ingest, low-latency analytical workloads such as market data, telemetry, monitoring, and streaming dashboards. Its key strengths include a zero-GC Java/C++ core, columnar storage, SIMD-accelerated parallel execution, and a multi-tier pipeline from WAL to native storage to Parquet on object storage. With time-series SQL extensions, PGWire compatibility, and REST APIs, it combines operational efficiency with fast real-time querying at scale.

metadata.name: timescaledb
metadata.description: A time-series database for high-performance real-time analytics packaged as a Postgres extension

summary.zh: TimescaleDB 是面向时序与事件数据的 PostgreSQL 扩展，兼顾事务能力与高性能实时分析。项目以 hypertable、列式存储、自动调优和 Docker 快速部署为亮点，适用于 IoT 监控、指标分析、日志事件处理等场景，帮助团队在熟悉的 Postgres 生态中构建低延迟、可扩展的时序分析平台。
summary.en: TimescaleDB is a PostgreSQL extension built for high-performance real-time analytics on time-series and event data. It combines native Postgres compatibility with core capabilities such as hypertables, columnar storage, fast ingest, and automated tuning. The project fits observability, IoT telemetry, metrics, and event-processing workloads, enabling teams to build scalable, low-latency analytical systems without leaving the familiar PostgreSQL ecosystem.

metadata.name: nginx_upstream_check_module
metadata.description: Health checks upstreams for nginx

summary.zh: 这是一个为 Nginx upstream 提供主动健康检查能力的扩展模块，可基于 TCP、HTTP、SSL Hello、MySQL、AJP、FastCGI 等协议周期性探测后端状态，并按 rise/fall 阈值自动摘除或恢复节点。适用于负载均衡、高可用网关与服务容灾场景，亮点在于多协议探测、可配置请求报文及状态页暴露。
summary.en: This Nginx module adds active health checks for upstream backends, enabling periodic probing over TCP, HTTP, SSL hello, MySQL, AJP, and FastCGI. It automatically marks nodes down or up based on configurable rise/fall thresholds, timeouts, and default state. Ideal for load balancing, high-availability gateways, and failure isolation, its key strengths are multi-protocol checks, customizable probe payloads, and built-in upstream status exposure.

metadata.name: rustdesk
metadata.description: An open-source remote desktop application designed for self-hosting, as an alternative to TeamViewer.

summary.zh: RustDesk 是一款以 Rust 为核心构建的开源远程桌面系统，主打可自托管、开箱即用与数据自主可控，适合作为 TeamViewer 的替代方案。项目支持通过官方或自建 rendezvous/relay 服务实现跨网络远控，桌面端结合 Flutter/Sciter 图形界面，兼顾跨平台部署、连接安全性与二次扩展能力。
summary.en: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop platform built primarily in Rust, positioned as a self-hostable alternative to TeamViewer. Its core value lies in out-of-the-box remote access, full data ownership, and flexible deployment through official or self-operated rendezvous and relay servers. With cross-platform desktop clients powered by Flutter or legacy Sciter, it balances usability, secure connectivity, and extensibility for organizations and individuals needing controlled remote support infrastructure.

metadata.name: hmily
metadata.description: Distributed transaction solutions

summary.zh: Hmily 是面向金融级场景的分布式事务解决方案，主打 TCC 模式，支持异常回滚、超时恢复与防悬挂，适合微服务链路中的强一致性协同。它提供 Spring Boot 零侵入集成、多 RPC 框架适配及可观测管理能力，并支持多种日志存储后端。
summary.en: Hmily is a financial-grade distributed transaction solution centered on the TCC pattern, with rollback on failure, timeout recovery, and suspension prevention for strongly consistent microservice workflows. It offers zero-intrusion Spring Boot integration, broad RPC framework support, observability tooling, and multiple log storage backends.

metadata.name: YgoMaster
metadata.description: Offline Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel

summary.zh: YgoMaster 是面向《游戏王：Master Duel》PC 版的离线运行与增强方案，通过本地客户端/服务端替代在线依赖，支持组卡、开包、单人内容、自定义人机、PvP、好友交易与回放。项目基于 .NET Framework 4.8，并结合原版资源与可移植部署，兼顾离线游玩、数据独立性及较强的可扩展改造能力。
summary.en: YgoMaster is an offline enablement layer for the PC version of Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel, replacing live-service dependencies with a local client/server workflow. It supports deck building, pack opening, solo content, custom CPU duels, PvP, friends, trading, and replay handling. Built around .NET Framework 4.8 and the original game assets, it emphasizes portable deployment, isolated progression, and strong extensibility for modding and custom gameplay scenarios.

metadata.name: hello-algo
metadata.description: 《Hello 算法》：动画图解、一键运行的数据结构与算法教程。支持简中、繁中、English、日本語，提供 Python, Java, C++, C, C#, JS, Go, Swift, Rust, Ruby, Kotlin, TS, Dart 等代码实现

summary.zh: 《Hello 算法》是面向初学者的开源数据结构与算法教程，以动画图解结合可一键运行的多语言示例，降低理解与实践门槛。项目覆盖 Python、Java、C++、Go、Rust、TypeScript 等多种实现，并提供中英日等多语版本，适合自学入门、教学辅助与跨语言算法对照学习。
summary.en: Hello Algo is an open-source, beginner-friendly tutorial on data structures and algorithms that combines animated visual explanations with one-click runnable code examples. It spans multiple languages including Python, Java, C++, Go, Rust, and TypeScript, and offers multilingual editions such as Chinese, English, and Japanese. The project is well suited for self-learning, classroom support, and cross-language comparison of algorithm implementations.

metadata.name: podman
metadata.description: Podman: A tool for managing OCI containers and pods.

summary.zh: Podman 是面向 OCI 容器与 Pod 的守护进程无关容器引擎，提供镜像、容器、卷与 Pod 的完整生命周期管理。其核心优势是支持 rootless 运行、Docker 兼容 CLI 与 REST API，并通过 libpod、Netavark、CRIU 和 podman machine 覆盖本地、远程及跨平台容器场景，兼顾安全性、资源效率与运维灵活性。
summary.en: Podman is a daemonless container engine for OCI containers and pods, delivering full lifecycle management for images, containers, volumes, and multi-container pods. Its key strengths include rootless execution, Docker-compatible CLI and REST APIs, and a modular architecture built around libpod, Netavark, CRIU, and podman machine. This makes it well suited for secure, resource-efficient container operations across Linux, as well as Mac and Windows through managed virtual machines.

metadata.name: clickvisual
metadata.description: A lightweight log analytic and data visualize platform  built on clickhouse.

summary.zh: ClickVisual 是基于 ClickHouse 的轻量级日志分析与可视化平台，提供浏览器端日志检索、SQL 可视化查询、直方图分析与原始日志查看。其亮点在于集成告警流程、DAG 工作流、类似 VS Code 的 fluent-bit 配置界面，以及面向 Kubernetes 的开箱即用部署能力，适合构建云原生日志检索与运营分析平台。
summary.en: ClickVisual is a lightweight log analytics and visualization platform built on ClickHouse, designed for browser-based log search, SQL-driven dashboards, histograms, and raw log inspection. Key strengths include integrated alert workflows, DAG-based processing, a VS Code-like fluent-bit configuration UI, and out-of-the-box Kubernetes deployment, making it well suited for cloud-native observability, centralized log management, and operational analytics scenarios.

metadata.name: ClickHouse
metadata.description: ClickHouse® is a real-time analytics database management system

summary.zh: ClickHouse 是面向实时分析的开源列式数据库，专注高吞吐写入、低延迟聚合查询与大规模数据报表生成。适用于日志分析、可观测性、商业智能和数据仓库场景，核心亮点在于列式存储、向量化执行、分布式扩展能力，以及兼顾自建与云服务的成熟生态。
summary.en: ClickHouse is an open-source column-oriented database built for real-time analytics, combining high-ingest throughput with low-latency aggregation over large datasets. It fits workloads such as observability, log analytics, BI dashboards, and data warehousing. Key strengths include its columnar storage engine, efficient analytical query execution, distributed scalability, and a mature ecosystem spanning self-managed deployments and ClickHouse Cloud.

metadata.name: Jpom
metadata.description: 【dromara】🚀简而轻的低侵入式在线构建、自动部署、日常运维、项目监控软件

summary.zh: Jpom 是面向中小团队的轻量级原生 Ops 平台，聚焦在线构建、自动部署、项目监控与日常运维。它以低侵入方式整合 Git/SVN 拉取、Docker/SSH 发布、WebHook 与定时任务、在线 SSH 终端、Nginx 与证书管理及告警自愈，适合缺少专职运维但需多环境、多节点持续交付的场景。
