summary.en: Jpom is a lightweight, low-intrusion native Ops platform for small and mid-sized teams, focused on online build pipelines, automated deployment, runtime monitoring, and daily operations. It combines Git/SVN-based builds, Docker and SSH delivery, scheduled jobs and WebHooks, web-based SSH access, Nginx and certificate management, plus alerting and self-recovery. It is well suited for teams without dedicated DevOps staff that still need multi-environment, multi-node continuous delivery.

metadata.name: SMS4J
metadata.description: 让简单的事情回归简单的本质。 SMS4J为短信聚合框架，帮您轻松集成多家短信服务，解决接入多个短信SDK的繁琐流程。 目前已接入数家常见的短信服务商，后续将会继续集成。后续的版本中我们还将推出更多的相关功能 你的 ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️Star⭐️⭐️ ⭐️，是我的动力！如果你觉得还不错，请点上一颗小星星

summary.zh: SMS4J 是面向 Java/Spring Boot 的短信聚合框架，通过统一抽象和配置驱动方式接入多家短信服务商，显著降低多 SDK 集成、切换与维护成本。项目支持丰富国内厂商，开发者可仅通过 Maven 与 YAML 配置快速完成模板短信发送，适合企业通知、验证码、营销触达等多通道短信场景。
summary.en: SMS4J is a Java and Spring Boot SMS aggregation framework that unifies access to multiple SMS providers through a consistent abstraction and configuration-driven integration model. It reduces the complexity of handling different vendor SDKs, APIs, and switching costs. With broad support for mainstream Chinese SMS providers, developers can quickly enable templated messaging via Maven and YAML, making it well suited for verification codes, transactional alerts, and multi-provider messaging strategies.

metadata.name: kuboard-press
metadata.description: Kuboard 是基于 Kubernetes 的微服务管理界面。同时提供 Kubernetes 免费中文教程，入门教程，最新版本的 Kubernetes v1.23.4 安装手册，(k8s install) 在线答疑，持续更新。

summary.zh: Kuboard 是面向 Kubernetes 的可视化管理与运维平台，兼顾多集群治理与中文教程交付。项目以图形化工作负载编排、细粒度权限控制、多认证集成及日志监控套件为亮点，适用于企业在生产环境中进行微服务运维、集群审计、资源观测与日常故障诊断。
summary.en: Kuboard is a Kubernetes-focused visual management and operations platform that combines multi-cluster administration with extensive Chinese learning resources. Its key strengths include graphical workload orchestration, fine-grained RBAC, multiple authentication integrations, and built-in observability extensions for monitoring and logging. It is well suited for enterprise microservice operations, cluster auditing, resource visibility, and day-to-day troubleshooting in production environments.

metadata.name: seaweedfs
metadata.description: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system for object storage (S3), file systems, and Iceberg tables, designed to handle billions of files with O(1) disk access and effortless horizontal scaling.

summary.zh: SeaweedFS 是面向海量小文件与多协议访问场景的分布式存储系统，统一支持 S3 对象存储、文件系统语义与 Iceberg 表数据管理。其核心优势在于 O(1) 磁盘访问、轻量元数据设计和横向扩展能力，适合构建云原生数据平台、对象存储服务、数据湖及高吞吐文件存储基础设施。
summary.en: SeaweedFS is a distributed storage system built for massive-scale file workloads and multi-protocol access, unifying S3-compatible object storage, filesystem semantics, and Iceberg table data management. Its key strengths are O(1) disk access, lightweight metadata architecture, and effortless horizontal scaling. This makes it well suited for cloud-native storage platforms, object storage services, data lakes, and high-throughput infrastructure handling billions of small files.

metadata.name: juicefs
metadata.description: JuiceFS is a distributed POSIX file system built on top of Redis and S3.

summary.zh: JuiceFS 是面向云原生场景的高性能分布式 POSIX 文件系统，采用“对象存储保存数据 + Redis/MySQL/TiKV 管理元数据”的分离架构。它可将 S3 等海量云存储无缝映射为本地文件系统，适用于大数据、AI、机器学习与 Kubernetes 平台，兼具强一致性、多客户端共享、Hadoop/S3 兼容及高吞吐低延迟优势。
summary.en: JuiceFS is a high-performance distributed POSIX file system designed for cloud-native environments. It separates data and metadata by storing file contents in object storage such as S3 while persisting metadata in engines like Redis, MySQL, or TiKV. This architecture lets applications use massive cloud storage like a local filesystem without code changes, making it well suited for big data, AI/ML, Hadoop ecosystems, and Kubernetes workloads, with strong consistency, multi-client sharing, and scalable throughput.
tags_zh: 分布式 POSIX 文件系统

metadata.name: fastdfs
metadata.description: FastDFS is a high performance distributed file system (DFS). It's major functions include: file storing, file syncing and file accessing, and design for high capacity and load balance. Wechat/Weixin public account (Chinese Language): fastdfs

summary.zh: FastDFS 是面向海量文件场景的高性能分布式文件系统，提供文件存储、同步、上传下载与负载均衡能力。其采用 tracker/storage 解耦架构与组内对等复制，无单点故障，支持小文件合并、多磁盘恢复、断点续传、跨机房容灾及 Nginx 集成，适合图片、视频等文件服务型网站与对象存储场景。
summary.en: FastDFS is a high-performance distributed file system built for massive file workloads, covering storage, replication, upload/download access, and load balancing. Its tracker-storage architecture and peer replication model avoid single points of failure, while features such as small-file merging, multi-disk recovery, resumable transfer, cross-datacenter disaster recovery, and seamless Nginx integration make it well suited for image, video, and lightweight object storage services.

metadata.name: cubefs
metadata.description: cloud-native distributed storage

summary.zh: CubeFS 是 CNCF 毕业的云原生分布式文件与对象存储，面向数据中心文件系统、数据湖、私有/混合云及公有云加速场景。其亮点在于同时支持 POSIX、HDFS、S3 与 REST，多租户隔离、强一致元数据服务，以及复制与纠删码结合的弹性存储策略，适合数据库、搜索和 AI/ML 的存储计算分离架构。
summary.en: CubeFS is a CNCF-graduated cloud-native distributed file and object storage system for datacenter filesystems, data lakes, private or hybrid clouds, and public-cloud acceleration. Its technical strengths include multi-protocol access via POSIX, HDFS, S3, and REST, a strongly consistent and highly scalable metadata service, multi-tenant isolation, and flexible data protection with replication and erasure coding. It is well suited for storage-compute separation in databases, search platforms, and AI/ML workloads.

metadata.name: ozone
metadata.description: Scalable, reliable, distributed storage system optimized for data analytics and object store workloads.

summary.zh: Apache Ozone 是面向大数据分析与对象存储场景的分布式存储系统，支持 S3 与 Hadoop FileSystem 多协议访问，可扩展至数十亿级对象。其核心亮点在于基于 RAFT 的强一致性、高可用复制架构，以及对 Kubernetes、YARN、Kerberos、ACL 与 Ranger 的云原生安全集成。
summary.en: Apache Ozone is a distributed object store built for large-scale analytics and cloud-native storage workloads, offering multi-protocol access through S3 and Hadoop FileSystem APIs. It is designed to scale to tens of billions of objects while delivering strong consistency via RAFT, high availability through replication, and enterprise-grade security with Kerberos, ACLs, Ranger, and encryption support.

metadata.name: githunt
metadata.description: Hunt the most starred projects on any date on GitHub

summary.zh: GitHunt 是一个基于 React 的 Web 应用与 Chrome 扩展，用于按日期追踪 GitHub 上最受欢迎的高星项目。它支持周级趋势浏览、无限滚动、列表/网格视图切换及语言筛选，并能记住用户偏好，适合开发者发现热门开源项目、观察技术趋势与进行项目调研。
summary.en: GitHunt is a React-based web app and Chrome extension for discovering the most starred GitHub repositories by date. It focuses on weekly trending exploration with infinite scrolling, list and grid layouts, and language-based filtering with persisted user preferences. The product is well suited for developers, open-source enthusiasts, and researchers who want to track ecosystem trends and surface notable projects efficiently.

metadata.name: spring-enhanced-cache
metadata.description: Project to enhance spring cache

summary.zh: spring-enhanced-cache 是一个面向 Spring Boot 的缓存增强组件，聚焦高并发下缓存删除不一致问题。它通过无侵入扩展 Spring Cache，在执行 @CacheEvict 后追加延迟二次淘汰，降低脏读与并发回源风险；支持与 Redis 等缓存实现集成，并以自动装配的 EnhancedCacheManager 提供开箱即用能力。
summary.en: spring-enhanced-cache is a Spring Boot cache enhancement library designed for high-concurrency cache consistency scenarios. It extends Spring Cache in a non-invasive way by triggering a delayed second eviction after `@CacheEvict`, reducing stale reads and cache/database inconsistency risks. The project integrates with cache backends such as Redis and exposes an auto-configured `EnhancedCacheManager` for drop-in adoption.

metadata.name: sagacity-sqltoy
metadata.description: Java真正智慧的ORM框架，融合JPA功能和最佳的sql编写及查询模式、独创的缓存翻译、最优化的分页、并提供无限层级分组汇总、同比环比、行列转换、树形排序汇总、sql自适配不同数据库、分库分表、多租户、数据加解密、脱敏、统一数据权限过滤和防越权校验以及面向复杂业务和大规模数据分析等痛点、难点问题项目实践经验分享的一站式解决方案!

summary.zh: Sagacity-SqlToy 是面向复杂业务与分析场景的 Java ORM/SQL 框架，融合 JPA 式 CRUD 与强查询能力，强调手写 SQL 的可维护性和跨库适配。其亮点包括缓存翻译、分页优化、分组汇总、行列转换、树形处理、分库分表、多租户、数据脱敏加密及统一权限过滤，适合 SaaS、ERP 和大规模数据分析系统。
summary.en: Sagacity-SqlToy is a Java ORM and SQL framework built for complex business systems and analytics-heavy workloads. It combines JPA-style CRUD with highly expressive SQL-centric querying, prioritizing maintainability and cross-database adaptability. Key strengths include cache-based translation, advanced pagination, grouping and aggregation, pivot/unpivot, tree processing, sharding, multi-tenancy, data masking and encryption, plus unified data-permission filtering for SaaS, ERP, and large-scale analytical applications.

metadata.name: ip2region
metadata.description: Ip2region is an offline IP-to-Region localization library and IP data management framework with both IPv4 and IPv6 supports, 10-microsecond level query efficiency, xdb search client for many programming languages

summary.zh: ip2region 是面向 IPv4/IPv6 的离线 IP 地理定位库与数据管理框架，基于 xdb 格式提供城市级查询、多语言客户端及统一接口。其亮点在于 10 微秒级查询性能、支持海量 IP 段压缩去重，以及可扩展自定义地域字段，适合风控、日志分析、访问归属识别等场景。
summary.en: ip2region is an offline IP geolocation library and IP data management framework for both IPv4 and IPv6, built around the xdb format. It delivers city-level lookups, unified query APIs, and bindings for many mainstream languages. Key strengths include 10-microsecond query latency, scalable storage for hundreds of millions of IP ranges, automatic deduplication/compression, and customizable region fields for fraud detection, analytics, and traffic attribution.

metadata.name: yudao-cloud
metadata.description: ruoyi-vue-pro 全新 Cloud 版本，优化重构所有功能。基于 Spring Cloud Alibaba + MyBatis Plus + Vue & Element 实现的后台管理系统 + 用户小程序，支持 RBAC 动态权限、多租户、数据权限、工作流、三方登录、支付、短信、商城、CRM、ERP、MES、IM、AI 大模型、IoT 物联网等功能。你的 ⭐️ Star ⭐️，是作者生发的动力！

summary.zh: yudao-cloud 是基于 Spring Cloud Alibaba、MyBatis Plus 与 Vue 的开源云原生后台管理系统，面向企业级业务中台与用户小程序。它突出 RBAC 动态权限、多租户、数据权限、工作流、三方登录、支付、短信、商城、CRM/ERP/MES、IM、AI 与 IoT 集成，适合快速搭建复杂业务系统。
summary.en: yudao-cloud is an open-source cloud-native admin platform built with Spring Cloud Alibaba, MyBatis Plus, and Vue for enterprise back-office systems and mini-programs. It emphasizes RBAC-driven permissions, multi-tenancy, data isolation, workflow, third-party login, payments, messaging, commerce, CRM/ERP/MES, IM, AI, and IoT integration for rapid delivery of complex business systems.

metadata.name: COLA
metadata.description: 🥤 COLA: Clean Object-oriented & Layered Architecture

summary.zh: COLA 是阿里巴巴沉淀的 Java 分层架构与工程化框架，面向复杂业务系统，强调以领域为核心、隔离外部依赖并治理系统复杂度。仓库同时提供可快速生成服务或 Web 应用的 Maven Archetype，以及 DTO、异常、状态机、扩展点、领域实体托管等通用组件，适合构建整洁、可演进的企业级后端应用。
summary.en: COLA is Alibaba’s Java architecture framework for clean, layered, domain-centric enterprise applications. It targets complex business systems by separating business complexity from technical concerns, decoupling external dependencies, and enforcing stable package and layer boundaries. The repository provides Maven archetypes for bootstrapping backend services or web applications, plus reusable components for DTOs, exceptions, state machines, extension points, and domain entity management to improve consistency and development efficiency.

metadata.name: flink
metadata.description: Apache Flink

summary.zh: Apache Flink 是面向实时数据处理的分布式计算框架，以流式优先架构统一流处理与批处理。其核心优势在于高吞吐、低延迟、事件时间与乱序处理、灵活窗口机制，以及 Exactly-Once 容错语义。适用于实时数仓、监控告警、日志分析、复杂事件处理等场景，并可深度集成 Hadoop、YARN、HDFS 等大数据生态。
summary.en: Apache Flink is a distributed data processing framework built around a streaming-first runtime that unifies real-time stream processing and batch workloads. Its key strengths include high throughput, low latency, event-time and out-of-order processing, flexible windowing, and exactly-once fault tolerance. Flink is well suited for real-time analytics, monitoring, log processing, and complex event processing, while integrating deeply with the Hadoop ecosystem such as YARN, HDFS, and HBase.

metadata.name: zfile
metadata.description: 在线云盘、网盘、OneDrive、云存储、私有云、对象存储、h5ai、上传、下载

summary.zh: ZFile 是面向个人与小团队的在线云盘系统，统一聚合本地、S3、OneDrive、Google Drive、FTP/SFTP 等多类存储源，降低跨平台文件管理成本。其亮点在于多用户与目录级权限控制、直链/短链分享、丰富的在线预览能力，以及适配 Docker 与多终端访问的响应式体验，适合私有云盘、团队资料分发与对象存储统一门户场景。
summary.en: ZFile is an online cloud-drive platform for individuals and small teams, designed to unify heterogeneous storage backends such as local storage, S3, OneDrive, Google Drive, FTP, and SFTP under one interface. Its strengths include multi-user and directory-level permission control, direct and short-lived share links, rich in-browser file previews, and responsive multi-device access with Docker deployment support, making it well suited for private cloud drives, team file distribution, and object-storage portal scenarios.

metadata.name: mybatis-plus
metadata.description: An powerful enhanced toolkit of MyBatis for simplify development

summary.zh: MyBatis-Plus 是面向 Java/Spring Boot 的 MyBatis 增强框架，提供条件构造器、分页插件、主键策略、代码生成器与自动配置等开箱即用能力。它在保持 MyBatis 兼容性的同时，显著减少 CRUD 与动态 SQL 开发成本，适用于企业级后台、数据密集型业务系统及快速交付场景，并内置 SQL 注入防护与可扩展插件机制。
summary.en: MyBatis-Plus is an enhancement framework for MyBatis in Java and Spring Boot applications, delivering out-of-the-box capabilities such as conditional query wrappers, pagination, key generation strategies, code generation, and auto-configuration. It stays fully compatible with MyBatis while dramatically reducing boilerplate for CRUD and dynamic SQL. The toolkit fits enterprise backends and data-intensive systems, with built-in SQL injection protection, Lambda-style APIs, and an extensible plugin architecture.

metadata.name: Unify-Sign
metadata.description: 聚合签到-薅羊毛-AutoJS

summary.zh: 该项目是面向 Android 的 Auto.js 聚合签到框架，统一编排京东、支付宝、淘宝、米哈游等多款 App 的日常积分与活动任务。其亮点在于依赖定制版 AutoJS.fake、可视化配置界面、随机化执行计划与分组调度机制，既降低手工维护成本，也通过时间打散和 OCR/无障碍能力提升自动化稳定性与规避检测能力。
summary.en: Unify-Sign is an Android Auto.js-based automation framework that consolidates daily check-in and reward tasks across apps such as JD, Alipay, Taobao, and miHoYo. Its core strengths are the dependency on a customized AutoJS.fake runtime, a visual configuration UI, randomized execution scheduling, and group-based task orchestration. Together, these features reduce manual effort while improving automation reliability, OCR-assisted interaction, and anti-detection resilience for multi-app sign-in workflows.

metadata.name: dbeaver
metadata.description: Free universal database tool and SQL client

summary.zh: DBeaver 是一款基于 Java、Eclipse RCP 与 OSGi 构建的跨平台通用数据库工具，面向开发者、DBA 与数据分析人员。它内置 100+ 驱动并兼容 JDBC/ODBC 数据库，集成 SQL/数据/模式编辑、ER 图、导入导出、迁移、执行计划、空间数据浏览及 AI 补全，适合多源数据库开发、运维与数据治理场景。
summary.en: DBeaver is a cross-platform universal database client built mainly with Java, Eclipse RCP, and OSGi for developers, DBAs, and data analysts. It ships with 100+ database drivers and supports nearly any JDBC/ODBC source, while combining SQL editing, schema and data browsing, ER diagrams, import/export, migration, execution plans, spatial data viewing, SSH/proxy access, and AI-assisted completion for multi-database development and administration workflows.

metadata.name: s3cmd
metadata.description: Official s3cmd repo -- Command line tool for managing S3 compatible storage services (including Amazon S3 and CloudFront).

summary.zh: s3cmd 是面向高级用户与自动化场景的 Python 命令行工具，用于管理 Amazon S3 及各类兼容 S3 协议的对象存储。它覆盖上传、同步、增量备份、多段传输、加密、ACL、元数据和策略管理等核心能力，适合批处理、定时备份与跨云存储运维，优势在于协议兼容性强、功能成熟且脚本集成友好。
summary.en: s3cmd is a Python-based command-line client for managing Amazon S3 and other S3-compatible object storage services. Designed for power users and automation workflows, it supports uploads, sync, incremental backup, multipart transfers, encryption, ACLs, metadata, and bucket policy operations. Its main strengths are broad S3 protocol compatibility, mature operational features, and strong suitability for scripting, cron jobs, backup pipelines, and cross-provider storage administration.

metadata.name: swift
metadata.description: OpenStack Storage (Swift). Mirror of code maintained at opendev.org.

summary.zh: OpenStack Swift 是面向海量非结构化数据的分布式对象存储系统，支持从单机扩展到上千节点，强调多租户、高并发与高可用。项目以 REST API 为核心，结合 proxy、account、container、object 服务与 ring 数据分布机制，适用于备份、媒体分发和云存储场景，并配套完整的单元、功能和集群级探测测试体系。
summary.en: OpenStack Swift is a distributed object storage system for massive unstructured data, scaling from a single node to thousands of servers. It is built for multi-tenancy, high concurrency, and resilient cloud-scale storage. Its core architecture combines a REST-based API with proxy, account, container, and object services, plus the ring-based data placement model. Swift is well suited for backup, media delivery, and cloud storage workloads, and includes unit, functional, and probe tests for cluster-level reliability.

metadata.name: ceph
metadata.description: Ceph is a distributed object, block, and file storage platform

summary.zh: Ceph 是面向云与数据中心的统一分布式存储平台，提供对象、块与文件三类存储能力，适合大规模集群、虚拟化、容器和备份归档场景。其核心亮点在于横向扩展架构、单一集群多协议支持，以及面向开发测试和生产构建的成熟工程体系。
summary.en: Ceph is a unified distributed storage platform for cloud and datacenter environments, delivering object, block, and file storage within a single system. It is well suited for large-scale clusters, virtualization, container platforms, and backup or archival workloads. Key strengths include horizontal scalability, multi-protocol storage in one cluster, and a mature build and engineering workflow for both development and production deployment.

metadata.name: mybatis-flex
metadata.description: mybatis-flex is an elegant Mybatis Enhancement Framework

summary.zh: MyBatis-Flex 是面向 Java 的轻量级 MyBatis 增强框架，仅依赖 MyBatis，即可提供实体 CRUD、分页、无实体 Row Mapping 与类型友好的 SQL 构建能力。它适用于 Spring Boot、Solon 及原生环境，支持多数据库方言、组合主键和多种主键策略，兼顾易用性、扩展性与高开发效率。
summary.en: MyBatis-Flex is a lightweight enhancement framework for MyBatis that depends only on MyBatis while adding entity CRUD, pagination, row mapping without entity classes, and IDE-friendly SQL construction. It fits Spring Boot, Solon, and standalone Java applications, with flexible multi-database dialect support, composite primary keys, and multiple key-generation strategies, making it a practical choice for high-efficiency data access layers.

metadata.name: SpringBootCodeGenerator
metadata.description: 又名大狼狗代码生成器，基于SpringBoot2+Freemarker的JAVA代码生成器，以释放双手为目的，支持mysql/oracle/pgsql三大数据库， 用DDL-SQL语句生成JPA/JdbcTemplate/Mybatis/MybatisPlus/BeetlSQL等相关代码.

summary.zh: 这是一个基于 Spring Boot 3 与 Freemarker 的 Java 代码生成平台，面向 CRUD 与脚手架开发场景，可从 DDL、INSERT、SELECT SQL 及 JSON 快速生成 JPA、MyBatis、MyBatis-Plus、JdbcTemplate 等多套代码。其亮点在于兼容 MySQL/Oracle/PostgreSQL、多模板扩展、JSqlParser 驱动解析，以及一键 ZIP 分组打包下载。
summary.en: SpringBootCodeGenerator is a Java code generation platform built with Spring Boot 3 and Freemarker for CRUD-heavy and scaffolding workflows. It transforms DDL, INSERT SQL, SELECT SQL, and JSON into JPA, MyBatis, MyBatis-Plus, JdbcTemplate, and related code artifacts. Key strengths include support for MySQL, Oracle, and PostgreSQL, extensible template-driven generation, JSqlParser-based SQL parsing, and one-click ZIP packaging for grouped code export.

metadata.name: PDF-Guru
metadata.description: PDF Guru Anki是你整个知识世界的“中枢转换器”，与 Anki 的强大记忆引擎无缝融合，能将来自任何地方、任何格式的知识精华，高效、系统、可持续地转化为牢固的长期记忆资产，打造专属自己的个性化Anki知识库，助你高效学习、轻松记忆。

summary.zh: PDF Guru Anki 是面向高效学习与长期记忆的多源知识制卡平台，围绕 Anki 构建从 PDF、Word、Excel、思维导图、微信读书到视频笔记的统一转化链路。其亮点在于高保真内容保留、增量同步、局域网同步，以及可接入 GPT、Claude、Gemini 等模型实现 AI 提炼与自动制卡。
summary.en: PDF Guru Anki is a multi-source knowledge-to-flashcard platform built around the Anki ecosystem for efficient learning and long-term retention. It unifies content conversion from PDFs, Word, Excel, mind maps, WeChat Reading notes, and video notes into structured Anki cards. Key strengths include high-fidelity capture, incremental sync, LAN-based Anki synchronization, and AI-powered card generation via customizable LLM integrations such as GPT, Claude, and Gemini.

metadata.name: zino
metadata.description: Spec-driven framework for composable applications in Rust.

summary.zh: zino 是面向 Rust 的规范驱动型组合式应用框架，适合快速构建 API 优先的 Web、桌面与云端服务。其亮点在于模块化 crate 体系、基于 sqlx 的 ORM、OpenAPI 生成、任务调度，以及对 actix-web、axum、dioxus 等生态的统一集成，兼顾开发效率、可扩展性与可观测性。
summary.en: Zino is a spec-driven Rust framework for building composable applications across web, desktop, and cloud scenarios. It targets API-first development with a strongly opinionated yet extensible architecture, offering modular crates, sqlx-based ORM, OpenAPI generation, lightweight scheduling, and unified integrations for storage, data sources, observability, and frameworks like actix-web, axum, and dioxus.

metadata.name: FluentHub
metadata.description: A stylish yet powerful GitHub client for Windows

summary.zh: FluentHub 是面向 Windows 的原生 GitHub 客户端，基于 WinAppSDK/WinUI 3 与 Fluent UI 构建，兼顾桌面审美与高频开发操作效率。它支持标签式多任务、历史无损导航，以及创建 Issue、Pull Request 等 GitHub API 写操作，适合希望在 Windows 上以原生体验集中处理仓库协作、代码审查与个人工作流的开发者。
summary.en: FluentHub is a native GitHub client for Windows that combines Fluent UI aesthetics with practical developer workflows. Built with WinAppSDK and WinUI 3, it offers tabbed multitasking, history-preserving navigation, and built-in GitHub API mutations for actions like creating issues and pull requests. It is well suited for developers who want a polished desktop experience for repository collaboration, code review, and day-to-day GitHub operations on Windows.

metadata.name: stable-diffusion-webui-docker
metadata.description: Easy Docker setup for Stable Diffusion with user-friendly UI

summary.zh: 该仓库以 Docker 方式封装 Stable Diffusion 运行环境，降低本地部署门槛，面向个人创作、模型体验与图像生成工作流。其核心价值在于集成 AUTOMATIC1111 与 ComfyUI 等主流界面，提供开箱即用的 WebUI、统一配置思路及较完善的 Wiki 指南，兼顾易用性、灵活性与多前端选择。
summary.en: This repository packages Stable Diffusion into an easy-to-run Docker setup, reducing the friction of local deployment for image generation, experimentation, and creative workflows. Its main strength is the integration of popular frontends such as AUTOMATIC1111 and ComfyUI, giving users a ready-to-use Web UI, consistent containerized environment, and practical wiki-based setup guidance. It stands out for usability, reproducibility, and support for multiple UI experiences.

metadata.name: l2cache
metadata.description: L2Cache 是一个基于 Caffeine + Redis 的二级缓存框架。让缓存的使用在业务开发中更加简单、高效。

summary.zh: L2Cache 是面向高并发业务的分布式二级缓存框架，融合 Caffeine/Guava 本地缓存、Redis 与 Spring Cache，简化多级缓存接入与治理。其亮点在于自动热 Key 探测、批量缓存操作、动态缓存配置，以及基于消息通知的集群一级缓存最终一致性，适用于商品、优惠券、用户等高读流量核心服务。
summary.en: L2Cache is a distributed two-level caching framework for high-concurrency applications, combining Caffeine/Guava local cache, Redis, and Spring Cache to simplify multi-layer cache adoption and operations. Its key strengths include automatic hot-key detection, batch cache operations, dynamic cache configuration, and message-driven eventual consistency for L1 cache across clusters, making it well suited for read-heavy core services such as product, coupon, and user domains.

metadata.name: AgileBoot-Back-End
metadata.description: 🔥   规范易于二开的全栈基础快速开发脚手架。🔥  采用Springboot + Vue 3 + Typescript + Mybatis Plus + Redis + 更面向对象的业务建模 + 面向生产的项目（非玩具项目）。你的 ⭐️ Star ⭐️，是作者更新的动力！ 欢迎小伙伴PR，一起构建一个规范的全栈项目~😆

summary.zh: AgileBoot-Back-End 是面向中小型业务与企业内网场景的后端快速开发脚手架，基于 Spring Boot、MyBatis-Plus、Redis 与 JWT 构建。其核心亮点在于注解式权限/数据权限/限流/防重、主从切换、多级缓存及面向对象的领域建模，并以较高单测与集成测试覆盖支撑生产可用性和二次开发效率。
summary.en: AgileBoot-Back-End is a production-oriented backend scaffold for small to mid-sized business systems and internal enterprise applications. Built with Spring Boot, MyBatis-Plus, Redis, and JWT, it emphasizes clean conventions and extensibility. Key strengths include annotation-driven permission control, data authorization, rate limiting, duplicate-request prevention, read-write splitting, multi-level caching, and domain-centric modeling, backed by solid unit and integration test coverage for reliable customization.

metadata.name: siyuan
metadata.description: An open-source, privacy-first, self-hosted knowledge workspace where humans and AI agents work together 开源、隐私优先、自托管的知识工作空间，让人与智能体在此协作

summary.zh: SiYuan 是一款强调隐私优先与自托管的个人知识管理系统，面向笔记整理、知识沉淀与本地优先协作场景。项目采用 TypeScript 与 Go 构建，兼顾桌面端、Docker 部署和开放生态，突出块级内容组织、开放源码、可扩展架构与数据自主可控，适合重视长期知识资产管理的个人与团队。
summary.en: SiYuan is a privacy-first, self-hosted personal knowledge management platform built for note-taking, long-term knowledge organization, and local-first workflows. Developed with TypeScript and Go, it spans desktop and containerized deployment while maintaining a fully open-source ecosystem. Its key strengths include block-based content organization, extensible architecture, Docker-friendly hosting, and strong data ownership, making it well suited for individuals and teams that value controllable, durable knowledge assets.

metadata.name: ChatALL
metadata.description: Concurrently chat with ChatGPT, Bing Chat, Bard, Alpaca, Vicuna, Claude, ChatGLM, MOSS, 讯飞星火, 文心一言 and more, discover the best answers

summary.zh: ChatALL 是一款面向多模型对比与提示工程的桌面聚合工具，可并发向 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、文心一言、ChatGLM 等多种大模型发送同一问题，帮助用户快速筛选最佳答案。其核心亮点在于统一多机器人接入、网页/API 双通道支持，以及面向研究、评测和开发调优的高效横向比较能力。
summary.en: ChatALL is a desktop aggregation tool for prompt engineering and cross-model evaluation. It sends the same prompt to multiple LLMs—such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, ERNIE, and ChatGLM—at the same time, helping users quickly identify the best response. Its key strengths are unified multi-bot access, support for both web and API-based integrations, and efficient side-by-side comparison for researchers, power users, and LLM application developers.

metadata.name: crane4j
metadata.description: 一个简单易用的关联字段填充框架，通过简单的注解配置快速根据外键/编码值填充相关字段，支持字典，枚举，方法等多种数据源。   A simple and easy-to-use data mapping framework, quickly populate relevant fields according to foreign keys/encoded values through simple annotation configuration, supports dictionaries, enumerations, methods and other data sources.

summary.zh: crane4j 是面向 Java/Spring 场景的注解驱动关联字段填充框架，能够基于外键、编码值或对象属性，自动从枚举、字典、方法及自定义数据源装配目标字段。它兼顾缓存、嵌套对象、一对多映射与自动方法返回值填充，显著减少数据组装样板代码，适合后台服务、DTO 转换与聚合查询结果增强。
summary.en: crane4j is an annotation-driven data assembly framework for Java and Spring applications. It automatically populates related fields from foreign keys, codes, or object properties using enums, dictionaries, methods, and extensible custom data sources. With support for caching, nested object filling, one-to-many mapping, and automatic method return value enrichment, it helps eliminate repetitive DTO assembly code and fits backend services, response composition, and aggregated data views.

metadata.name: localGPT
metadata.description: Chat with your documents on your local device using GPT models. No data leaves your device and 100% private.

summary.zh: LocalGPT 是面向本地私有文档问答的轻量级智能平台，支持在设备端完成检索、摘要与问答，无需上传数据。其亮点在于融合语义检索、关键词匹配与 Late Chunking 的混合搜索，并通过智能路由、上下文裁剪和结果验证提升长文档问答准确率，适用于企业内网知识库、个人离线资料库与合规场景。
summary.en: LocalGPT is a lightweight private document intelligence platform for on-device question answering, summarization, and insight extraction without sending data off the machine. Its key strengths include a hybrid retrieval stack combining semantic search, keyword matching, and Late Chunking, plus smart routing between RAG and direct LLM responses, context pruning, and answer verification to improve accuracy on long-form documents. It fits enterprise knowledge bases, offline personal archives, and privacy-sensitive deployments.

metadata.name: freegpt-webui
metadata.description: GPT 3.5/4 with a Chat Web UI. No API key required.

summary.zh: FreeGPT WebUI 是基于 Python 的聊天界面项目，通过集成 G4F API 提供免官方 API Key 的 GPT-3.5/4 访问能力，适合快速搭建低门槛对话演示、实验性 AI Web 应用与第三方集成原型。其亮点在于开箱即用的 WebUI、Docker 部署支持，以及面向免费模型代理场景的轻量接入方案，但仓库已归档，更适合作为参考实现。
summary.en: FreeGPT WebUI is a Python-based chat interface that connects to the G4F API to offer GPT-3.5/4-style conversations without requiring an official OpenAI API key. It is well suited for rapid demos, experimental AI chat apps, and prototype integrations that need a low-friction web frontend. Key strengths include a ready-to-use WebUI, simple local and Docker deployment, and a lightweight integration path for free model proxy workflows, though the repository is now archived and best used as a reference implementation.

metadata.name: iotdb
metadata.description: Apache IoTDB

summary.zh: Apache IoTDB 是面向工业物联网场景的时序数据库，聚焦海量设备数据的采集、压缩存储与复杂分析。项目以轻量架构、高吞吐读写和低硬件成本为核心优势，支持云边端灵活部署，并可无缝结合 Hadoop、Spark 生态；基于 TsFile 列式时序存储格式，在海量时间序列组织、检索与分析上表现突出。
summary.en: Apache IoTDB is a time-series database built for industrial IoT workloads, focusing on large-scale device data ingestion, compressed storage, and analytical processing. Its core strengths include a lightweight architecture, high-throughput reads and writes, and low hardware cost. IoTDB supports flexible cloud-edge-terminal deployment and integrates smoothly with Hadoop and Spark. Powered by the TsFile columnar time-series format, it excels at organizing, querying, and analyzing massive, complex time-series datasets.

metadata.name: spring-cloud-alibaba
metadata.description: Spring Cloud Alibaba provides a one-stop solution for application development for the distributed solutions of Alibaba middleware.

summary.zh: Spring Cloud Alibaba 是面向 Java 微服务的分布式应用开发套件，深度集成 Spring Cloud 与阿里中间件生态。它覆盖服务注册发现、动态配置、流量治理、消息驱动、分布式事务及云服务接入，借助 Nacos、Sentinel 等组件，以少量注解和配置快速构建可扩展、高可用的企业级微服务系统。
summary.en: Spring Cloud Alibaba is a distributed application development suite for Java microservices, tightly integrating Spring Cloud with Alibaba middleware. It covers service discovery, dynamic configuration, traffic governance, event-driven messaging, distributed transactions, and cloud service integration. With components such as Nacos and Sentinel, developers can build scalable, highly available enterprise microservices using minimal annotations and lightweight configuration.

metadata.name: modbus
metadata.description: Modbus TCP,  Modbus TCP Security, Modbus RTU on Serial, and Modbus RTU on TCP for Java 17+.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 Java 17+ 的现代化 Modbus 通信库，提供高性能且易用的客户端与服务端实现，覆盖 Modbus TCP、TLS 安全版 TCP、串口 RTU 与 TCP 承载 RTU。项目基于可插拔传输层与编解码架构，支持主流功能码、广播消息及原始 PDU 扩展，适用于工业自动化、设备接入、网关与 SCADA/PLC 集成场景。
summary.en: A modern Modbus communication library for Java 17+, offering high-performance, easy-to-use client and server implementations across Modbus TCP, TLS-secured Modbus TCP Security, RTU over serial, and RTU over TCP. Its pluggable transport and codec architecture supports mainstream function codes, broadcast messaging, and raw/custom PDUs, making it well suited for industrial automation, device connectivity, protocol gateways, and SCADA/PLC integration workloads.

metadata.name: SmsForwarder
metadata.description: 短信转发器——监控Android手机短信、来电、APP通知，并根据指定规则转发到其他手机：钉钉群自定义机器人、钉钉企业内机器人、企业微信群机器人、飞书机器人、企业微信应用消息、邮箱、bark、webhook、Telegram机器人、Server酱、PushPlus、手机短信等。包括主动控制服务端与客户端，让你轻松远程发短信、查短信、查通话、查话簿、查电量等。（V3.0 新增）PS.这个APK主要是学习与自用，如有BUG请提ISSUE，同时欢迎大家提PR指正

summary.zh: SmsForwarder 是一款面向 Android 备用机与自动化场景的消息中继工具，可监听短信、来电和应用通知，并按规则转发到企业IM、Webhook、Telegram、邮箱等渠道。项目亮点在于多目标推送、远程主动控制、自动任务与广泛 Android 版本适配，适合告警通知、异地设备管理和个人消息自动化。
summary.en: SmsForwarder is an Android-based message relay tool for spare phones and automation workflows. It monitors SMS, calls, and app notifications, then forwards them through rule-based pipelines to enterprise IM bots, webhooks, Telegram, email, and other channels. Key strengths include multi-channel delivery, remote control capabilities, scheduled automation, and broad Android compatibility, making it useful for alerting, remote device operations, and personal notification orchestration.

metadata.name: xJavaFxTool
metadata.description: 基于JavaFx搭建的实用小工具集合，方便开发过程中的代码编写与调试，想学习javaFx的同学可以参考参考。其中包括文件复制、Cron表达式生成器、编码转换、加密解密、Time转换、路径转换、二维码生成工具、身份证生成器、正则表达式生成工具、网址缩短、转义字符、字符串转换、Mq调试工具、Http调试工具、json格式化编辑工具、图标生成工具、Redis连接工具、网页源码下载工具、切换Hosts工具、Ftp服务器、Cmd调试工具、Ftp/Ftps/Sftp客户端调试工具、Pdf转换工具、文件列表生成器、图片压缩工具、图片转码工具、Kafka调试工具、Email群发工具、颜色代码转换工具、短信群发工具、脚本引擎调试、文件重命名、Json转换、语音转换、Socket调试、图片解析、微信小程序反编译、Zookeeper操作、Excel拆分合并、文件夹监控、文件编码检测、传输、端口扫描、久坐提醒、随机数生成、剪贴板历史、文件搜索、mp3转换、印章生成等工具

summary.zh: xJavaFxTool 是基于 JavaFX 与 JDK17 构建的跨平台桌面工具箱，聚合 HTTP、MQ、Redis、Kafka、FTP、Socket 等开发调试能力，以及编码转换、图片/PDF处理、文件监控等高频效率工具。其亮点在于插件化按需加载、丰富的 JavaFX 界面示例、第三方 UI 集成与可打包多系统安装包，兼具生产实用性与 JavaFX 学习参考价值。
summary.en: xJavaFxTool is a cross-platform desktop toolbox built with JavaFX and JDK 17, combining developer-oriented utilities such as HTTP, MQ, Redis, Kafka, FTP, and Socket debugging with productivity tools for file handling, encoding conversion, image/PDF processing, and monitoring. Its key strengths are a plugin-based modular architecture, rich JavaFX UI examples, integration with libraries like ControlsFX and JFoenix, and packaging support for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

metadata.name: sonar-l10n-zh
metadata.description: Chinese Pack for SonarQube

summary.zh: 该仓库为 SonarQube 提供中文本地化插件，覆盖从 3.1 到 26.5 的多个版本，显著降低中文团队使用代码质量平台的学习与运维门槛。其核心亮点在于长期维护的版本兼容矩阵、与 SonarQube 版本同步发布的汉化包，以及面向企业研发治理场景的稳定语言适配能力。
summary.en: This repository delivers a Chinese localization pack for SonarQube, helping Chinese-speaking teams use the code quality platform with lower onboarding and operational friction. Its main strengths are the long-term maintained compatibility matrix across SonarQube versions 3.1 to 26.5, release alignment with upstream versions, and stable language adaptation for enterprise code quality and governance workflows.

metadata.name: legado
metadata.description: Legado 3.0 Book Reader with powerful controls & full functions❤️阅读3.0, 阅读是一款可以自定义来源阅读网络内容的工具，为广大网络文学爱好者提供一种方便、快捷舒适的试读体验。

summary.zh: 该仓库原为面向网络文学场景的可配置阅读工具，主打自定义书源、内容抓取与阅读控制能力，服务聚合试读与个性化阅读体验。但当前仓库已因侵权风险主动清空并发布法律公告，核心价值已转为合规警示，说明此类抓取式内容分发产品在版权、来源授权与传播边界上存在高法律风险。
summary.en: This repository previously represented a configurable reader for online fiction, emphasizing custom content sources, web content retrieval, and rich reading controls for personalized trial reading. However, the project has now been effectively withdrawn and replaced with a legal notice due to infringement concerns. Its current significance is less technical than cautionary, highlighting the compliance, licensing, and copyright risks inherent in source-driven content aggregation and redistribution tools.

metadata.name: TDengineGUI
metadata.description: A simple TDengine DeskTop Manager

summary.zh: TDengineGUI 是面向 TDengine 的跨平台桌面管理工具，支持 Linux、Windows、macOS。它聚焦数据库连接管理、库表浏览、时间序列数据查询与 SQL 控制台操作，帮助开发者更直观地管理 TDengine 实例。亮点在于轻量易用、本地桌面形态、连接记录持久化，以及针对时序数据库场景的表筛选与时间过滤能力。
summary.en: TDengineGUI is a cross-platform desktop manager for TDengine, available on Linux, Windows, and macOS. It focuses on connection management, database and table browsing, time-series data querying, and an integrated SQL console, making TDengine operations more accessible for developers. Its key strengths are a lightweight desktop experience, persistent connection history, and practical data exploration features such as table inspection, timestamp-based filtering, and direct SQL execution for time-series workflows.

metadata.name: winsw
metadata.description: A wrapper executable that can run any executable as a Windows service, in a permissive license.

summary.zh: WinSW 是一个基于 .NET 的 Windows 服务包装器，可将任意可执行程序快速封装为标准 Windows Service，适用于守护进程托管、遗留应用服务化与自动运维场景。项目支持 XML 配置、安装/启动/状态管理，并提供 .NET Framework 与原生 .NET 7 构建，兼顾兼容性、分发灵活性和生产可用性。
summary.en: WinSW is a .NET-based Windows Service wrapper that turns almost any executable into a manageable Windows service. It is well suited for daemon hosting, legacy application service-enablement, and operations automation on Windows. The project stands out with XML-driven configuration, install/start/status lifecycle commands, and dual distribution options via .NET Framework and native .NET 7 builds, balancing compatibility, deployment flexibility, and production readiness.

metadata.name: intellij-mybaitslog
metadata.description: 用于在IDEA将Mybatis的SQL日志还原为可执行的SQL，Used to restore Mybatis SQL logs to executable SQL in IDEA,

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 IntelliJ IDEA 的 MyBatis 日志增强插件，可将运行期输出的 SQL 日志还原为可直接执行、可格式化的完整语句，显著提升排障、调优与联调效率。项目重点解决参数替换、跨数据库 SQL 格式化及 MyBatis-Plus 兼容问题，支持 IDEA 2020.1+、JDK8+ 与 MyBatis 3.2.0+，适合 Java 后端开发与数据库问题定位场景。
summary.en: This repository provides an IntelliJ IDEA plugin that reconstructs MyBatis runtime SQL logs into executable, well-formatted SQL, helping developers debug, validate, and optimize database interactions faster. Its key strengths are reliable parameter restoration, cross-database SQL formatting, and compatibility improvements for MyBatis-Plus and related extensions. It targets Java backend workflows, supports IDEA 2020.1+, JDK 8+, and MyBatis 3.2.0+, and is especially useful for SQL troubleshooting inside the IDE.

metadata.name: testcontainers-java
metadata.description: Testcontainers is a Java library that supports JUnit tests, providing lightweight, throwaway instances of common databases, Selenium web browsers, or anything else that can run in a Docker container.

summary.zh: Testcontainers 是面向 Java 测试的容器化基础设施库，可在 JUnit 场景中按需拉起数据库、浏览器及各类 Docker 服务实例，提升集成测试的真实性与隔离性。其核心亮点是即开即弃的测试环境、对常见中间件模块化封装，以及将 Docker 能力无缝融入自动化测试流水线。
summary.en: Testcontainers is a Java testing library that provisions lightweight, disposable Docker-based services for JUnit tests, including databases, Selenium browsers, and other infrastructure components. It enables more realistic integration and end-to-end testing by replacing mocks with ephemeral runtime dependencies. Key strengths include seamless Docker integration, reusable modules for common services, and strong alignment with CI pipelines and automated test isolation.

metadata.name: hippo4j
metadata.description: 📌 异步线程池框架，支持线程池动态变更&监控&报警，无需修改代码轻松引入。Asynchronous thread pool framework, support Thread Pool Dynamic Change & monitoring & Alarm, no need to modify the code easily introduced.

summary.zh: Hippo4j 是面向 Java 业务系统的动态可观测线程池框架，解决线程池参数难评估、运行状态不可见、告警缺失与上下文传递等问题。它支持运行时动态调参、监控告警、数据采集、优雅关闭及多框架线程池适配，并提供配置中心模式与无中间件模式，适合高并发服务治理与生产运维场景。
summary.en: Hippo4j is a dynamic and observable thread pool framework for Java applications, designed to address poor thread pool visibility, static configuration, missing alerts, and context propagation issues. It enables runtime tuning of core parameters, real-time monitoring, alarm strategies, telemetry export, graceful shutdown, and integration with containers and middleware such as Tomcat, Dubbo, and MQ frameworks, making it well suited for high-concurrency service governance and production operations.

metadata.name: quarkus
metadata.description: Quarkus: Supersonic Subatomic Java.

summary.zh: Quarkus 是面向云原生与容器场景的 Java 框架，通过将大量工作前移到构建期，实现极速启动、低内存占用与 JVM/原生双运行模式。它统一命令式与响应式开发模型，兼容 JAX-RS、Hibernate、MicroProfile 等主流标准，适合微服务、Kubernetes 部署及高密度容器化应用。
summary.en: Quarkus is a cloud-native, container-first Java framework built for fast startup, low memory usage, and efficient deployment on both JVM and native runtimes. By shifting heavy work to build time, it optimizes microservices and Kubernetes workloads while scaling to larger applications. It unifies imperative and reactive programming and integrates familiar standards such as JAX-RS, Hibernate ORM/JPA, MicroProfile, Netty, and Vert.x.

metadata.name: KCloud-Platform-IoT
metadata.description: KCloud-Platform-IoT（老寇IoT云平台）是一个企业级单体架构和微服务架构的IoT云平台。采用DDD(领域驱动设计)思想，基于Spring Boot 4.1.1、Spring Cloud 2025.1.3、Spring Cloud Alibaba 2025.1.0.0 最新版本开发的云服务多租户IoT平台，家人们，点个star！拜托啦~

summary.zh: KCloud-Platform-IoT 是面向企业级物联网场景的多租户云平台，兼顾单体与微服务架构，适合设备管理、系统监控、数据分析等业务快速落地。项目以 Spring Boot、Spring Cloud Alibaba 与 DDD、COLA 为核心，集成注册发现、配置中心、灰度治理、分布式事务/缓存/调度，并支持 Docker、Kubernetes、GraalVM 与虚拟线程部署。
summary.en: KCloud-Platform-IoT is an enterprise-grade, multi-tenant IoT cloud platform designed for both monolithic and microservices architectures. It fits device management, system monitoring, and data analytics scenarios, helping teams bootstrap production-ready IoT systems quickly. Built with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Spring Cloud Alibaba, DDD, and the COLA framework, it integrates service discovery, configuration management, gray routing, distributed scheduling, caching, transactions, and observability, while supporting Docker, Kubernetes, GraalVM, and virtual threads.

metadata.name: BilibiliDown
metadata.description: (GUI-多平台支持) B站 哔哩哔哩 视频下载器。支持稍后再看、收藏夹、UP主视频批量下载|Bilibili Video Downloader 😳

summary.zh: BilibiliDown 是一款基于 Java 的跨平台 B 站视频下载器，提供 GUI，支持 Windows、Linux、Mac。除单视频下载外，还覆盖稍后再看、收藏夹、UP 主稿件等批量抓取场景，并通过登录态管理、验证码处理、cookie 刷新、ffmpeg 转码与多段合并，提升复杂资源下载与格式转换的可用性。
summary.en: BilibiliDown is a Java-based cross-platform Bilibili video downloader with a desktop GUI for Windows, Linux, and macOS. Beyond single-video downloads, it supports batch acquisition from Watch Later, favorites, and creator libraries. Its technical strengths include authenticated session handling, captcha workflow support, cookie refresh logic, and ffmpeg-powered muxing/transcoding for segmented streams, making large-scale and format-flexible downloads practical.

metadata.name: rust
metadata.description: Empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software.

summary.zh: Rust 主仓库汇集编译器、标准库与官方文档，是构建高性能、内存安全系统软件的核心基础设施。项目以所有权模型、强类型系统和优质诊断为技术亮点，覆盖服务端、嵌入式及跨语言集成场景，并与 Cargo、Clippy、rustfmt 等工具链深度协同。
summary.en: The Rust main repository contains the compiler, standard library, and official documentation that power a memory-safe, high-performance systems language. Its core strengths are the ownership model, strong static typing, and high-quality diagnostics, making it well suited for backend services, embedded development, and FFI-heavy integrations, while tightly integrating with the broader toolchain such as Cargo, Clippy, and rustfmt.

metadata.name: horaedb
metadata.description: Apache HoraeDB (incubating) is a high-performance, distributed, cloud native time-series database.

summary.zh: Apache HoraeDB 是面向云原生场景的高性能分布式时序数据库，聚焦海量指标与时间序列数据的高效写入、存储和查询。项目当前主分支正演进新一代引擎，强调分布式架构、云环境适配与性能优化，适用于可观测性、监控分析及工业时序数据平台建设。
summary.en: Apache HoraeDB is a high-performance, distributed, cloud-native time-series database built for efficient ingestion, storage, and querying of massive metric and time-series workloads. Its main branch is actively evolving a next-generation engine focused on distributed architecture, cloud deployment readiness, and performance optimization, making it well suited for observability, monitoring analytics, and industrial time-series platforms.

metadata.name: cnosdb
metadata.description: A cloud-native open source distributed time series database with high performance, high compression ratio and high availability.

summary.zh: CnosDB 是面向 IoT、工业互联网、车联网与运维场景的云原生分布式时序数据库，采用 Rust 构建，强调高写入吞吐、高压缩率与高可用。其核心亮点包括原生分布式架构、存算分离、分片分区、Quorum 一致性、SQL 与无模式写入支持，以及对乱序补写、时间窗口聚合、多租户和 Kubernetes 部署的良好适配。
summary.en: CnosDB is a cloud-native distributed time-series database built in Rust for IoT, industrial internet, connected vehicles, and IT operations. It focuses on high ingest throughput, strong compression, and high availability. Key strengths include a native distributed architecture, storage-compute separation, sharding and partitioning, Quorum-based consistency, SQL and schema-less ingestion, plus support for out-of-order backfill, time-window analytics, multi-tenancy, and Kubernetes-based horizontal scaling.

metadata.name: rust-course
metadata.description: 什么？你敢放心的把后背交给 AI? 我赌你不敢，那就来学学 AI 时代最酷、最安全、最快的语言吧。本书拥有全面且深入的讲解、生动贴切的示例、德芙般丝滑的内容，这可能是目前最用心的 Rust 中文学习教程 / Book

summary.zh: 这是面向中文开发者的高质量 Rust 学习教程与实践平台，覆盖新手入门到进阶提升，内容系统深入、示例贴近真实开发。项目同时提供在线阅读与交互练习，兼顾语言原理、工程实践和生产力提升，尤其适合希望在系统编程、性能优化与安全开发领域建立扎实 Rust 能力的读者。
summary.en: This repository is a comprehensive Rust learning book tailored for Chinese developers, covering the path from beginner onboarding to advanced productivity. It combines in-depth explanations, practical examples, online reading, and hands-on exercises to connect language fundamentals with real engineering use cases. The project stands out for its systematic structure, strong educational polish, and focus on safe, high-performance development in modern systems and AI-era software contexts.

metadata.name: wrk
metadata.description: Modern HTTP benchmarking tool

summary.zh: wrk 是面向高并发场景的现代 HTTP 压测工具，采用多线程架构并结合 epoll、kqueue 等高扩展事件机制，可在单机多核上持续生成高负载。它支持 LuaJIT 脚本定制请求生成、响应处理与统计报告，适用于 Web 服务性能基准测试、容量评估与接口调优。
summary.en: wrk is a modern HTTP benchmarking tool built for high-concurrency load generation on a single multi-core machine. It combines a multithreaded architecture with scalable event notification backends such as epoll and kqueue to drive substantial request throughput efficiently. With optional LuaJIT scripting for request generation, response handling, and custom reporting, it is well suited for web service benchmarking, capacity planning, and API performance tuning.

metadata.name: hsweb-easy-orm
metadata.description: 简单的orm工具,为动态表单而生

summary.zh: hsweb-easy-orm 是面向动态表单与可变表结构场景的轻量 ORM，强调“轻 SQL、重 Java”，通过链式 DSL 完成 DDL 与 DML 操作。项目支持参数驱动的动态查询条件扩展，可安全透传前端条件以降低 SQL 注入风险，并基于 R2DBC/Reactive 封装提供响应式数据库访问能力，适合低代码、表单引擎和动态数据模型系统。
summary.en: hsweb-easy-orm is a lightweight ORM designed for dynamic forms and evolving table schemas, favoring Java-centric DSL over handwritten SQL. It provides fluent APIs for both DDL and DML, enabling runtime table maintenance and data operations. A key strength is its parameter-driven, extensible query condition model, which supports safe frontend-passed filters with reduced SQL injection risk. Built with reactive database support on top of R2DBC, it fits low-code platforms, form engines, and dynamic data model systems.

metadata.name: JavaSpringBootSamples
metadata.description: SpringBoot、Dubbo、SpringCloud的各种集成例子：Atomikos、gRPC、Thrift、Seata、ShardingSphere、Dubbo、Hmily、Nacos、Consul、Ribbon、Jedis、Lettuce、Redisson等框架

summary.zh: 该仓库汇集 Java 微服务集成样例，围绕 Spring Boot、Dubbo 与 Spring Cloud，覆盖分布式事务、RPC、服务注册发现、配置中心、数据库分片及 Redis 接入。亮点在于以可运行示例串联 Atomikos、Seata、ShardingSphere、gRPC、Thrift、Nacos、Consul 等主流中间件，适合微服务落地、选型对比与教学实践。
summary.en: This repository is a hands-on collection of Java microservice integration samples centered on Spring Boot, Dubbo, and Spring Cloud. It covers distributed transactions, RPC, service discovery, configuration management, database sharding, and Redis clients through runnable examples using Atomikos, Seata, ShardingSphere, gRPC, Thrift, Nacos, Consul, Jedis, Lettuce, and Redisson. It is especially useful for architecture evaluation, framework comparison, onboarding, and practical microservice training.

metadata.name: WSA-Windows-10
metadata.description: This is a backport of Windows Subsystem for Android to Windows 10.

summary.zh: 该仓库通过补丁与安装脚本，将原本面向 Windows 11 的 Windows Subsystem for Android 回移植到 Windows 10，使用户可在旧系统上运行安卓应用。其核心亮点在于结合 WSA 兼容性修补、系统功能依赖配置与一键化部署流程，适用于希望在 Windows 10 保留原生安卓子系统体验的开发者与高级用户。项目虽已归档，但具备明显的系统移植与兼容改造参考价值。
summary.en: This repository backports Windows Subsystem for Android, originally designed for Windows 11, to Windows 10 through compatibility patches and an installation script. Its main value lies in enabling Android app execution on older Windows environments while simplifying setup with prerequisite configuration and automated deployment. The project is especially relevant to power users and developers who want native-like Android subsystem support on Windows 10. Although archived, it remains a useful reference for OS backporting, compatibility engineering, and WSA-related patch workflows.

metadata.name: WSA-Script
metadata.description: Integrate Magisk root and Google Apps into WSA (Windows Subsystem for Android) with GitHub Actions

summary.zh: 该仓库通过 GitHub Actions 自动构建定制版 WSA，将 Magisk Root、Google Play 服务与可选系统组件集成进 Windows 10/11 的 Android 子系统。其核心价值在于降低手工改包与签名门槛，支持按渠道与版本生成可安装发行包，适合需要在桌面环境运行具备 Root 与 GMS 能力的 Android 应用测试、开发和高级使用场景。
summary.en: This repository automates the creation of customized Windows Subsystem for Android builds with Magisk root, Google Play Services, and selectable components via GitHub Actions. Its main value is removing the manual repackaging, patching, and signing burden while letting users generate installable WSA packages by version and release channel. It is especially useful for power users, testers, and developers who need a desktop Android environment on Windows 10/11 with both GMS compatibility and root-level customization.

metadata.name: reloadium
metadata.description: Hot Reloading and Profiling for Python

summary.zh: Reloadium 是面向 Python 开发的高级热重载与性能分析工具，可作为 IDE 插件或命令行库使用。它支持保存即生效、当前函数重执行、跨文件依赖追踪与自动错误恢复，并覆盖 Django、Flask、SQLAlchemy、Pandas 等场景；其亮点在于调试态下联动页面刷新、数据库回滚和上下文增强型 AI 辅助，显著缩短开发反馈回路。
summary.en: Reloadium is an advanced hot reloading and profiling tool for Python, available as both an IDE plugin and a standalone CLI library. It applies code changes on save, re-executes the current function, tracks cross-file dependencies, and handles reload errors gracefully. It also supports Django, Flask, SQLAlchemy, and Pandas workflows, with standout capabilities such as debug-aware live refresh, database rollback during reload, and AI-assisted context enrichment to dramatically shorten development feedback loops.

metadata.name: 7-Zip-zstd
metadata.description: 7-Zip with support for Brotli, Fast-LZMA2, Lizard, LZ4, LZ5 and Zstandard

summary.zh: 7-Zip-zstd 是 7-Zip 的增强发行版，为原生压缩/解压流程引入 Zstandard、Brotli、LZ4、Lizard、Fast LZMA2 等高性能编解码器。它同时提供完整 GUI 安装与兼容现有 7-Zip 的插件式部署，适合需要更高压缩速度、更多格式选择及命令行/桌面集成的 Windows 与跨平台压缩场景。
summary.en: 7-Zip-zstd is an enhanced 7-Zip distribution that adds modern high-performance codecs such as Zstandard, Brotli, LZ4, Lizard, and Fast LZMA2 to standard archive workflows. It supports both a full GUI installer with Explorer integration and a codec-plugin deployment for existing 7-Zip setups, making it well suited for users who need faster compression, broader algorithm choice, and flexible CLI or desktop integration across Windows and packaged cross-platform environments.

metadata.name: shifu
metadata.description: Kubernetes-native IoT gateway

summary.zh: Shifu 是面向边缘与云场景的 Kubernetes 原生 IoT 网关，通过 CRD 与 DeviceShifu 将异构设备抽象为集群中的数字孪生与可编排服务。其核心优势是协议/厂商无关、微服务化扩展快，支持 HTTP、MQTT、RTSP、OPC UA 等协议，适合工业物联网接入、边云协同与设备统一运维。
summary.en: Shifu is a Kubernetes-native IoT gateway for edge and cloud deployments, turning heterogeneous devices into cluster-managed digital twins via CRDs and DeviceShifu pods. Its main strengths are protocol and vendor agnosticism, fast microservice-based extensibility, and support for protocols such as HTTP, MQTT, RTSP, Siemens S7, TCP socket, and OPC UA. It fits industrial IoT onboarding, edge-cloud collaboration, and unified device operations.

metadata.name: gsudo
metadata.description: Sudo for Windows

summary.zh: gsudo 是面向 Windows 的 sudo 替代工具，可在当前终端或新窗口中以管理员权限执行命令，并保持接近 Unix/Linux sudo 的使用体验。它支持 Cmd、PowerShell、WSL 及多种 Bash 变体，能自动识别宿主 Shell、透传管道与退出码，并通过凭据缓存减少 UAC 弹窗，适合脚本自动化、跨 Shell 运维和日常提权操作。
summary.en: gsudo is a Windows-native sudo alternative that elevates commands in the current console or a new window while preserving a familiar Unix/Linux sudo experience. It auto-detects the active shell, supports Cmd, PowerShell, WSL, and multiple Bash variants, and correctly preserves piping, native command behavior, and exit codes. Its credential cache reduces repeated UAC prompts, making it especially useful for automation scripts, cross-shell administration, and streamlined privilege escalation workflows on Windows.

metadata.name: immersive-translate
metadata.description: 沉浸式双语网页翻译扩展 , 支持输入框翻译， 鼠标悬停翻译， PDF, Epub, 字幕文件, TXT 文件翻译 - Immersive Dual Web Page Translation Extension

summary.zh: 该仓库主要承担沉浸式翻译浏览器扩展的发布与用户反馈管理，不提供核心源代码。产品聚焦双语网页沉浸式阅读，覆盖输入框、悬停、PDF、Epub、字幕与TXT等多场景翻译，亮点在于跨内容形态的统一体验与持续迭代的发行支持体系。
summary.en: This repository serves as the release and feedback hub for Immersive Translate rather than an open-source codebase. The product focuses on immersive bilingual web reading and supports translation across input fields, hover actions, PDFs, EPUBs, subtitle files, and TXT documents. Its key strength is a unified cross-format translation experience backed by a structured release channel and active issue-driven user feedback workflow.

metadata.name: lsd
metadata.description: The next gen ls command

summary.zh: lsd 是用 Rust 重写的下一代 `ls` 命令行工具，在兼容传统目录浏览习惯的同时，提供彩色高亮、文件图标、树状视图与更细粒度的输出格式控制。它适合提升终端文件检索与运维效率，亮点在于现代 CLI 体验、跨平台分发，以及依赖 Nerd Font 实现直观的视觉增强。
summary.en: lsd is a Rust-based reimagining of GNU `ls` that upgrades terminal file listing with colorized output, file icons, tree view, and richer formatting controls. It targets developers and power users who want faster, more readable filesystem navigation without leaving the command line. Key strengths include a modern CLI UX, cross-platform packaging, and visual enhancement through Nerd Font-powered icon support.

metadata.name: qinglong
metadata.description: 支持 Python3、JavaScript、Shell、Typescript 的定时任务管理平台（Timed task management platform supporting Python3, JavaScript, Shell, Typescript）

summary.zh: 青龙是面向自动化运维与脚本调度的定时任务管理平台，支持 Python3、JavaScript、Shell、TypeScript 多语言任务统一运行。其核心价值在于提供 Web 化的脚本、环境变量、配置与日志管理，并支持秒级调度、系统通知、移动端和 Docker 部署，适合个人自动化、服务器任务编排与轻量作业平台场景。
summary.en: QingLong is a web-based timed task management platform for automation and script scheduling, supporting Python3, JavaScript, Shell, and TypeScript in one runtime environment. Its core value lies in unifying script editing, environment variable management, configuration handling, and log inspection through a browser-based interface. With second-level scheduling, system notifications, mobile-friendly operation, and Docker-based deployment, it fits personal automation, server-side cron orchestration, and lightweight job platform scenarios.

metadata.name: tile38
metadata.description: Real-time Geospatial and Geofencing

summary.zh: Tile38 是基于 Go 构建的内存型地理空间数据库与实时电子围栏服务器，面向位置检索、轨迹监控、区域告警和地理事件流处理。它支持 GeoJSON、Geohash、XYZ Tile 等多种空间对象，提供 Nearby、Within、Intersects 查询，兼容 HTTP、WebSocket 与 Redis RESP，并具备主从复制、磁盘持久化及 Prometheus 指标能力。
summary.en: Tile38 is a Go-based in-memory geospatial database and real-time geofencing server designed for location search, movement tracking, zone alerts, and spatial event processing. It supports multiple spatial object formats such as GeoJSON, Geohash, bounding boxes, and XYZ tiles, and provides Nearby, Within, and Intersects queries. With HTTP, WebSocket, and Redis RESP interfaces, plus replication, disk persistence, and Prometheus metrics, it fits low-latency location-aware systems.

metadata.name: dragonfly
metadata.description: A modern replacement for Redis and Memcached

summary.zh: Dragonfly 是面向现代业务负载的高性能内存数据存储，兼容 Redis 与 Memcached 协议，可无缝替换现有缓存层。其核心价值在于以多线程架构实现更高吞吐、更低尾延迟和更优资源效率，适用于缓存、会话、排行榜、实时数据处理等场景，尤其适合希望在不改代码前提下提升单机性能与成本效率的系统。
summary.en: Dragonfly is a modern in-memory datastore designed for contemporary application workloads, offering drop-in compatibility with Redis and Memcached. Its key value lies in a multi-threaded architecture that delivers higher throughput, lower tail latency, and significantly better resource efficiency than legacy single-threaded caches. It fits scenarios such as caching, session storage, leaderboards, and real-time data services, especially for teams seeking better performance and lower infrastructure cost without changing application code.

metadata.name: Playnite
metadata.description: Video game library manager with support for wide range of 3rd party libraries and game emulation support, providing one unified interface for your games.

summary.zh: Playnite 是面向 Windows 的开源游戏库管理与启动器，聚合 Steam、Epic、GOG、EA App、Battle.net 等平台，并整合模拟器游戏，实现统一入口管理。其亮点在于本地优先的数据存储、可扩展的插件与主题体系，以及基于 .NET 的扩展开发能力，适合多平台收藏、启动与整理个人游戏资产。
summary.en: Playnite is an open-source game library manager and launcher for Windows that unifies titles from Steam, Epic, GOG, EA App, Battle.net, and emulators into one interface. Its key strengths are local-first data storage, broad third-party library integration, and a flexible extension model supporting .NET plugins, PowerShell scripts, and custom themes, making it ideal for users who want centralized game organization and launch workflows.

metadata.name: Flow.Launcher
metadata.description: :mag: Quick file search & app launcher for Windows with community-made plugins

summary.zh: Flow Launcher 是面向 Windows 的高效启动器与全局搜索工具，支持快速检索应用、文件、书签及在线内容。项目以社区插件生态为核心，兼顾开放扩展与日常效率场景，提供便携安装、多渠道分发和持续迭代能力，适合希望统一本地与网络检索入口的重度桌面用户。
summary.en: Flow Launcher is a Windows productivity launcher focused on fast app and file discovery, while also unifying bookmarks and online content search in one keyboard-driven interface. Its main strength is a community-built plugin ecosystem that keeps the core lightweight yet highly extensible. With portable distribution, multiple package managers, and active community-driven evolution, it suits power users seeking a customizable desktop search hub.

metadata.name: segment-anything
metadata.description: The repository provides code for running inference with the SegmentAnything Model (SAM), links for downloading the trained model checkpoints, and example notebooks that show how to use the model.

summary.zh: Segment Anything 是 Meta FAIR 开源的基础视觉分割模型，支持通过点、框等提示高质量生成目标掩码，也可自动分割整张图像。项目提供 PyTorch 推理代码、预训练权重、Notebook 示例与 ONNX 导出能力，依托 1100 万图像和 11 亿掩码训练，在零样本分割、交互式标注与通用视觉工具链中具备很强实用价值。
summary.en: Segment Anything is Meta FAIR’s foundation model for promptable image segmentation, generating high-quality masks from points, boxes, or full-image automatic proposals. The repository focuses on practical inference with PyTorch, pretrained checkpoints, example notebooks, and ONNX export for broader deployment. Trained on 11 million images and 1.1 billion masks, SAM delivers strong zero-shot generalization, making it valuable for interactive annotation, vision data pipelines, and downstream segmentation workflows across diverse domains.

metadata.name: distrochooser
metadata.description: An orientation guide for Linux newbies

summary.zh: Distrochooser 是面向 Linux 新手的发行版选型导航服务，通过问答式引导帮助用户在众多发行版中快速缩小选择范围。项目以 Vue.js 驱动 Web 应用，兼顾生产版与活跃开发中的下一代版本，并依托多语言社区协作，突出交互式决策、入门友好和持续迭代能力。
summary.en: Distrochooser is a web-based orientation service for Linux beginners, helping users narrow down suitable distributions through a guided questionnaire rather than claiming perfect recommendations. Built around a Vue.js frontend, the project maintains both a production branch and an actively evolving next-generation version. Its key strengths are interactive decision support, newcomer-friendly UX, multilingual community contributions, and iterative platform evolution.

metadata.name: dozzle
metadata.description: Realtime log viewer for containers.  Supports Docker, Swarm and K8s.

summary.zh: Dozzle 是面向 Docker、Swarm 与 K8s 的轻量级实时日志查看器，以 Web 界面提供容器日志流式监控、模糊检索、正则与 SQL 查询及多日志分屏。它不落盘存储日志，资源占用低，并支持多用户认证、远程主机代理与运行时统计，适合运维排障与多容器实时观测场景。
summary.en: Dozzle is a lightweight web-based real-time log viewer for Docker, Swarm, and Kubernetes environments. It focuses on live container log streaming without storing log files, keeping memory usage low while delivering fuzzy container search, regex and SQL-based log queries, split-screen viewing, and live CPU/memory stats. With support for multi-user authentication, remote host monitoring, and agent-based multi-node setups, it fits operational troubleshooting and observability workflows.

metadata.name: DrakeTyporaTheme
metadata.description: 十二种主题风格 - Material Google JetBrains Vue Juejin Purple Ayu Dark

summary.zh: DrakeTyporaTheme 是面向 Typora 的高质量主题集合，提供 Material、JetBrains、Vue、掘金、Ayu Dark 等十二种风格，覆盖写作、技术文档与简历排版场景。项目亮点在于审美统一的界面设计、对开发者友好的等宽字体方案，以及通过 `font.css` 实现字号、行距、字体等细粒度定制，兼顾可读性与个性化输出。
summary.en: DrakeTyporaTheme is a polished Typora theme pack featuring twelve visual styles such as Material, JetBrains, Vue, Juejin, Purple, and Ayu Dark. It targets writing, technical documentation, and résumé publishing with a strong focus on aesthetics and readability. Key strengths include developer-friendly monospace font choices, cohesive visual language, and fine-grained customization of font family, size, and spacing through `font.css`, enabling personalized Markdown editing and elegant export results.

metadata.name: typora-latex-theme
metadata.description: 将Typora伪装成LaTeX的中文样式主题，本科生轻量级课程论文撰写的好帮手。This is a theme disguising Typora into Chinese LaTeX style.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向中文课程论文与实验报告的 Typora 主题，通过 CSS 将 Markdown 编辑与导出效果伪装为接近 LaTeX 的学术排版。项目强调轻量写作、跨平台适配与可定制性，内置封面、摘要、标题层级、表格等论文常用样式，适合本科生快速产出规范、美观的 PDF 文档。
summary.en: This repository provides a Typora theme that makes Markdown documents resemble Chinese LaTeX-style academic papers and lab reports. Built mainly with customizable CSS, it targets lightweight thesis and coursework writing, helping undergraduates focus on content instead of formatting. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, and includes polished layouts for covers, abstracts, headings, tables, and export-ready PDF presentation.

metadata.name: LxRunOffline
metadata.description: A full-featured utility for managing Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL)

summary.zh: LxRunOffline 是一款面向 Windows WSL 的增强管理工具，补足官方发行版安装与迁移能力不足。它支持将任意 Linux 发行版安装到自定义目录，并提供迁移、复制、注册、导出、命令执行及配置管理功能，适合多发行版运维、便携化部署和高级 WSL 环境管理。项目基于 CMake 构建，兼容 Visual C++ 与 MinGW，并集成 Shell 扩展。
summary.en: LxRunOffline is a powerful management utility for Windows Subsystem for Linux that extends beyond the default WSL tooling. It enables installing arbitrary Linux distributions into custom directories, then supports moving, duplicating, registering, exporting, and executing commands within those instances. The tool targets advanced WSL administration, portable distro deployment, and multi-environment management. Built with CMake, it supports both Visual C++ and MinGW, and also includes an optional Windows shell extension.

metadata.name: wsl-distrod
metadata.description: Distrod is a meta-distro for WSL 2 which installs Ubuntu, Arch, Debian, Gentoo, etc. with systemd in a minute for you. Distrod also has built-in auto-start feature on Windows startup and port forwarding ability.

summary.zh: Distrod 是面向 WSL 2 的 systemd 元发行版，可在一分钟内基于 linuxcontainers.org 镜像安装 Ubuntu、Arch、Debian、Gentoo 等发行版，或为现有 WSL 发行版启用 systemd。其亮点在于自动启动、端口转发与多发行版兼容，适合在 Windows 上长期运行 ssh、容器及后台服务的开发与运维场景。
summary.en: Distrod is a systemd-enabled meta-distro for WSL 2 that can install Ubuntu, Arch, Debian, Gentoo, and other distributions from linuxcontainers.org images in about a minute, or retrofit systemd into an existing WSL distro. Its key strengths are Windows startup auto-launch, built-in port forwarding, and broad multi-distro compatibility, making it well suited for developers and operators running persistent services, SSH, and container workloads on Windows.

metadata.name: hsweb-framework
metadata.description: hsweb (haʊs wɛb) 是一个基于spring-boot 2.x开发 ,首个使用全响应式编程的企业级后台管理系统基础项目。

summary.zh: hsweb-framework 是面向企业后台的响应式基础框架，基于 Spring Boot 2、WebFlux、R2DBC 与 easy-orm，提供模块化 CRUD、响应式事务、RBAC 与数据权限等能力。适合前后端分离、可扩展后台系统建设，亮点在于从数据访问到权限控制的全链路响应式设计与安全 DSL 查询模型。
summary.en: hsweb-framework is an enterprise backend foundation built on Spring Boot 2, WebFlux, R2DBC, and easy-orm, delivering modular reactive CRUD, transaction management, RBAC, and data-permission control. It targets extensible admin systems and frontend-backend separation scenarios. Its key strengths are end-to-end reactive architecture, a safe DSL-style query model, and pluggable modules for authorization, system services, and data access.

metadata.name: mqtt
metadata.description: MQTT协议3.1.1中文翻译版，IoT，物联网

summary.zh: 该仓库提供 MQTT 3.1.1 协议的系统化中文翻译，覆盖控制报文、连接流程、QoS 语义、安全与 WebSocket 等核心章节。适合物联网、M2M 与消息中间件开发者快速理解协议细节，亮点在于结构完整、术语统一，并提供 GitBook、Wiki、PDF/ePub 等多种阅读与分发形式。
summary.en: This repository delivers a comprehensive Chinese translation of the MQTT 3.1.1 specification, covering control packets, connection workflows, QoS semantics, security, and WebSocket transport. It is valuable for IoT, M2M, and messaging-system developers who need an accessible yet structured reference to protocol details. Key strengths include full chapter coverage, consistent terminology, and multiple documentation formats such as GitBook, Wiki, PDF, and ePub.

metadata.name: diboot
metadata.description: 写的更少, 性能更好 -> 为开发人员打造的低代码开发框架，基础框架可免写90%的SQL，同时具备极强的零代码模型表单页面流程的设计能力和代码生成能力，可在pro-code、low-code、no-code之间自由选择灵活切换，全方位赋能开发。

summary.zh: Diboot 是面向企业应用开发的 Java 低代码框架，围绕“少写 SQL、少写 CRUD”提供高性能基础能力与代码生成体系。它同时覆盖 pro-code、low-code、no-code 三种模式，支持模型、表单、流程、页面设计及前后端联动生成，适合 CRM、OA 等业务系统的快速交付与灵活扩展。
summary.en: Diboot is a Java low-code framework for enterprise application development, built to minimize handwritten SQL and CRUD while preserving strong runtime performance. It combines a high-efficiency base framework with code generation, model-driven forms, page and workflow design, enabling seamless transitions across pro-code, low-code, and no-code delivery. It is well suited for rapidly building and extending systems such as CRM, OA, and other back-office business platforms.

metadata.name: SpringBlade
metadata.description: SpringBlade 是一个由商业级项目升级优化而来的微服务架构，采用Spring Boot 4 、Spring Cloud 2025、Java 21  等核心技术构建，完全遵循阿里巴巴编码规范。提供基于React和Vue的两个前端框架用于快速搭建企业级的SaaS多租户微服务平台。

summary.zh: SpringBlade 是面向企业级 SaaS 的 Java 微服务开发平台，同时支持 Spring Cloud 分布式与 Spring Boot 单体架构。项目基于 Java 17、Spring Boot 3.5、Spring Cloud 2025 与 MyBatis Plus，集成 Nacos、Sentinel、多租户、JWT 安全与自研认证体系，并提供 React/Vue 前端方案，适合快速搭建多租户业务中台与微服务系统。
summary.en: SpringBlade is an enterprise-oriented Java platform for building SaaS applications, supporting both Spring Cloud distributed microservices and Spring Boot monolithic architectures. Built on Java 17, Spring Boot 3.5, Spring Cloud 2025, and MyBatis Plus, it integrates Nacos, Sentinel, multi-tenancy, JWT-based security, and a custom authentication system. With both React and Vue front-end options, it is well suited for rapidly delivering multi-tenant business platforms and production-grade microservice systems.

metadata.name: HowToCook
metadata.description: Programmer's guide about how to cook at home.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向程序员的家庭烹饪知识库，用结构化、步骤清晰的方式重写常见菜谱，降低做饭理解成本。仓库同时提供食材处理、器具使用与食品安全等实践指南，并可通过 Web 站点或 Docker 本地部署浏览，适合新手入门、居家做饭和社区协作维护。
summary.en: HowToCook is a programmer-friendly home cooking knowledge base that rewrites everyday recipes in a structured, precise, and easy-to-follow format. Beyond dish instructions, it includes practical guides on kitchen setup, cookware usage, food safety, and cooking techniques. The project also offers a visual web viewer and Docker-based local deployment, making it useful for beginners, home cooks, and community-driven recipe collaboration.

metadata.name: TrackersListCollection
metadata.description: 🎈 Updated daily! A list of popular BitTorrent Trackers! / 每天更新！全网热门 BT Tracker 列表！

summary.zh: 该仓库维护按日更新的 BitTorrent Tracker 聚合清单，提供 best、all、http、nohttp 及 Aria2 专用格式，便于直接接入 qBittorrent、Aria2 等客户端。其核心价值在于通过高可用 Tracker 源提升 BT 对等发现效率与下载速度，并借助多镜像分发与分类输出增强可用性和接入便捷性。
summary.en: This repository maintains a daily updated collection of BitTorrent trackers, offering curated outputs such as best, all, HTTP-only, non-HTTP, and Aria2-ready formats for direct use in clients like qBittorrent and Aria2. Its main value lies in improving peer discovery and download performance through high-availability tracker aggregation, while categorized outputs and multiple mirror endpoints make integration simple, resilient, and practical for everyday torrent workflows.

metadata.name: qBittorrent
metadata.description: qBittorrent BitTorrent client

summary.zh: qBittorrent 是基于 C++/Qt 与 libtorrent 构建的跨平台 BitTorrent 客户端，强调高速、稳定与完整功能集。它适用于桌面下载、种子管理与长期做种场景，支持 Unicode、对等节点国家解析等能力，技术亮点在于成熟的原生 GUI 架构、可靠的传输内核以及持续集成与签名发布带来的工程可靠性。
summary.en: qBittorrent is a cross-platform BitTorrent client built with C++/Qt on top of libtorrent, designed for high performance, stability, and a full-featured desktop experience. It fits torrent downloading, seeding, and long-running transfer management scenarios, with Unicode support and peer geo-resolution as notable capabilities. Its key strengths are a mature native GUI architecture, a proven libtorrent-based transfer engine, and solid engineering practices such as CI validation and signed releases.

metadata.name: qBittorrent-Enhanced-Edition
metadata.description: [Unofficial] qBittorrent Enhanced, based on qBittorrent

summary.zh: qBittorrent Enhanced Edition 是基于 qBittorrent 的增强型 BitTorrent 客户端，采用 C++、Qt 与 libtorrent 构建。其核心价值在于面向 PT 和公网下载场景提供自动封禁迅雷、百度网盘离线等异常或吸血 Peer，并支持中国未知来源 Peer 过滤、媒体播放器 Peer 封禁及白黑名单机制，兼顾跨平台分发、稳定性与精细化连接治理能力。
summary.en: qBittorrent Enhanced Edition is an unofficial enhanced BitTorrent client built on qBittorrent with C++, Qt, and libtorrent. Its main value lies in stronger peer governance for PT and public torrenting scenarios: it can automatically ban Xunlei, QQ, Baidu offline downloaders, and other abusive peers, while also offering optional blocking for unknown peers from China, BitTorrent media player peers, plus whitelist/blacklist controls. The project combines cross-platform packaging with practical anti-leeching and traffic hygiene features.

metadata.name: sdnext
metadata.description: SD.Next: All-in-one WebUI for AI generative image and video creation, captioning and processing

summary.zh: SD.Next 是面向 AI 图像与视频生成、字幕标注及后处理的一体化 WebUI，基于 Stable Diffusion 并兼容多类扩散模型。其亮点在于跨平台硬件适配、自动调优安装、SDNQ 量化降显存、Balanced Offload 混合内存调度，以及集成 captioning、tagger 与图像校正工具，适合创作、研究与本地高性能部署。
summary.en: SD.Next is an all-in-one WebUI for AI image and video generation, captioning, and post-processing, built around Stable Diffusion with broad support for advanced diffusion models. Its key strengths include cross-platform hardware support, auto-tuned installation, SDNQ quantization for major VRAM savings, Balanced Offload for constrained devices, and integrated captioning, tagging, and image correction workflows, making it well suited for creators, researchers, and high-performance local deployment.

metadata.name: kubesphere
metadata.description: The container platform tailored for Kubernetes multi-cloud, datacenter, and edge management ⎈ 🖥 ☁️

summary.zh: KubeSphere 是基于 Kubernetes 的企业级容器平台，面向多云、数据中心与边缘场景，提供统一的多集群与多租户管理能力。其核心亮点在于插件化可扩展架构、开箱即用的 Web 控制台、自动化运维与 DevOps 流程，以及支持在线和离线环境的集群部署，适合构建标准化云原生应用管理平台。
summary.en: KubeSphere is an enterprise-grade container platform built on Kubernetes for multi-cloud, datacenter, and edge environments. It delivers unified multi-cluster and multi-tenant management through a centralized control plane. Key strengths include a plug-and-play extensible architecture, developer-friendly web console, automated operations, integrated DevOps workflows, and support for both online and air-gapped cluster deployment, making it well suited for standardized cloud-native platform engineering.

metadata.name: gradio
metadata.description: Build and share delightful machine learning apps, all in Python. 🌟 Star to support our work!

summary.zh: Gradio 是面向机器学习与 Python 应用的开源 Web UI 框架，能把模型、API 或任意函数快速封装成交互式演示与服务。其核心价值在于以极少代码完成界面构建、本地启动与链接分享，适合原型验证、模型展示、内部工具和教学场景，亮点是纯 Python 开发、低前端门槛与内置分享能力。
summary.en: Gradio is an open-source Python web UI framework for turning machine learning models, APIs, or arbitrary Python functions into interactive demos and lightweight apps. Its core value lies in letting developers build, launch, and share interfaces with minimal code and no frontend expertise. It fits rapid prototyping, model showcasing, internal tooling, and educational workflows, with standout strengths in Python-first development, fast local serving, and built-in sharing features.

metadata.name: Typora_Free_Download
metadata.description: Typora _v0.11.18 最新免费版安装包（后面的v1.0就开始收费了）

summary.zh: 该仓库提供 Typora v0.11.18 免费版安装包，面向希望继续使用旧版 Markdown 编辑器且避免订阅付费的用户。其核心价值在于保留 Typora 所强调的所见即所得写作体验与轻量桌面使用方式，但技术创新有限，更偏向软件分发与版本留存场景，而非代码开发型项目。
summary.en: This repository mainly serves as a distribution archive for Typora v0.11.18, the last widely used free release before the product moved to a paid model. It targets users who want a lightweight, WYSIWYG Markdown editor without subscription costs. The repository’s value lies in software preservation and convenient access to a legacy desktop writing tool, rather than in original engineering, source code, or technical architecture.

metadata.name: AutoGPT
metadata.description: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matters.

summary.zh: AutoGPT 是面向 AI 智能体构建与运行的平台，支持自托管部署、持续运行代理和复杂工作流自动化。其核心亮点在于低代码 Agent Builder、积木式流程编排、部署生命周期管理以及可直接复用的预置代理，适合企业自动化、任务编排与 AI 应用快速落地。
summary.en: AutoGPT is a platform for building, deploying, and operating AI agents that automate complex, continuous workflows. Its key strengths include a low-code Agent Builder, block-based workflow orchestration, lifecycle deployment controls, and a library of reusable prebuilt agents. It is well suited for enterprise automation, task orchestration, and fast delivery of production-oriented AI applications.

metadata.name: Airtest
metadata.description: UI Automation Framework for Games and Apps

summary.zh: Airtest 是面向游戏与移动/桌面应用的跨平台 UI 自动化框架，基于图像识别实现无侵入式控件定位，支持 Android、iOS、Windows 等多端脚本复用。其亮点在于命令行与 Python 双接口、适配大规模设备农场执行，并可结合 AirtestIDE 与 HTML 报告完成录制、运行、回溯的完整测试闭环。
summary.en: Airtest is a cross-platform UI automation framework for games and mobile or desktop apps, using image recognition to locate interface elements without code injection. It enables write-once automation across Android, iOS, and Windows, and exposes both Python APIs and CLI workflows. Key strengths include scalable execution on device farms, rich HTML reporting with failure tracing, and seamless integration with AirtestIDE for end-to-end case creation, execution, and analysis.

metadata.name: AutoJs6
metadata.description: 安卓平台 JavaScript 自动化工具 (Auto.js 二次开发项目)

summary.zh: AutoJs6 是基于已停更 Auto.js 延续开发的 Android 自动化工具，借助无障碍服务与 JavaScript 脚本实现界面操作、任务编排和设备自动控制。项目以 Rhino 作为脚本引擎，兼顾开源免费、多语言文档和持续维护，适合移动端自动测试、重复流程执行与个人效率自动化场景。
summary.en: AutoJs6 is a community-driven continuation of the discontinued Auto.js, delivering JavaScript-based automation on Android through Accessibility Service APIs. It enables UI interaction, task scripting, and device control for repetitive workflows, mobile automation, and lightweight testing. Key highlights include its Rhino-powered scripting runtime, ongoing open-source maintenance, and multilingual documentation that lowers adoption barriers for developers and advanced automation users.

metadata.name: Ant-Forest
metadata.description: 基于AutoJS的蚂蚁森林收能量脚本

summary.zh: 这是一个面向支付宝蚂蚁森林的 AutoJS 自动化脚本，覆盖自动收能量、逛一逛、倒计时调度、多账号切换与智能解锁等场景。项目亮点在于图像识别与实验性 YOLO 检测结合、Shizuku/ADB 权限增强、可视化配置和运行统计能力，适合长期稳定的安卓端生态自动化运维。
summary.en: This repository is an AutoJS-based automation script for Alipay Ant Forest, designed for scenarios such as energy collection, friend browsing, countdown-aware scheduling, multi-account switching, and smart device unlocking. Its standout strengths include hybrid image recognition with experimental YOLO detection, Shizuku/ADB-powered permission automation, visual configuration, and runtime analytics, making it a robust Android-side automation toolkit for long-running personal workflows.

metadata.name: QQScreenShot
metadata.description: 电脑QQ截图工具提取版,支持文字提取、图片识别、截长图、qq录屏。默认截图文件名为ScreenShot日期

summary.zh: QQScreenShot 是从电脑 QQ 中提取并增强的截图工具，支持截图、长截图、录屏、文字提取与图片识别，并可接管贴图与自定义热键。其亮点在于复用 QQ 内部消息循环与 OCR/提示能力，同时兼容 PaddleOCR、百度 OCR 等多引擎，适合需要轻量桌面截屏与 OCR 整合的 Windows 用户。
summary.en: QQScreenShot is an extracted and enhanced Windows screenshot utility derived from desktop QQ, offering screen capture, scrolling capture, screen recording, OCR text extraction, and image recognition. Its key strengths are deep reuse of QQ’s internal UI/message loop and built-in OCR hooks, plus support for multiple OCR backends such as PaddleOCR and Baidu OCR. It suits users who need lightweight screenshot and OCR workflows on Windows.

metadata.name: AutoScriptBase
metadata.description: AutoJS项目框架，用于快速构建自动化项目

summary.zh: AutoScriptBase 是面向 AutoJS 的自动化脚本脚手架，提供可视化配置、多脚本调度、日志体系、控件检索、自动解锁与无障碍控制等通用能力。框架集成 OCR、YOLO、SQLite、通知、定时任务与在线更新，适合快速构建安卓端自动化、签到、采集和流程编排类脚本，并兼顾性能优化与可扩展性。
summary.en: AutoScriptBase is an AutoJS automation framework for rapidly building Android scripting projects. It bundles visual configuration, multi-script scheduling, structured logging, widget querying, auto-unlock, and accessibility-driven automation into a reusable foundation. The stack also integrates OCR, YOLO inference, SQLite, notifications, timers, and GitHub Release updates, making it well suited for check-in bots, task automation, data collection, and extensible mobile workflow orchestration.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向《战双帕弥什》的 Auto.js 自动化助手，主要运行于 Auto.js Pro/Autox.js 环境。项目集成截图、找图、OCR 识别、坐标配置与悬浮窗交互，适配不同分辨率及模拟器场景，可用于日常任务执行与界面辅助操作，亮点在于图库管理、坐标预置和模块化脚本架构。
summary.en: PGR Assistant is an Auto.js-based automation toolkit for Punishing: Gray Raven, designed for Auto.js Pro and Autox.js on mobile devices. It combines screenshot capture, template matching, OCR, coordinate presets, and floating-window controls to automate routine in-game interactions. Key strengths include modular script architecture, resolution-aware coordinate profiles, and gallery-based asset management for emulator and multi-device compatibility.

metadata.name: stolon
metadata.description: PostgreSQL cloud native High Availability and more.

summary.zh: Stolon 是面向云原生环境的 PostgreSQL 高可用管理器，基于流复制、哨兵决策与代理转发实现主从切换、故障恢复和动态重配置。它支持 Kubernetes、etcd、Consul 等基础设施，强调分区场景下的一致性优先，并提供同步复制、PITR、备用集群与 pg_rewind 等能力，适合容器化数据库和跨站点容灾部署。
summary.en: Stolon is a cloud-native high availability manager for PostgreSQL that combines streaming replication, sentinel-based cluster orchestration, and a smart proxy layer to automate failover, recovery, and dynamic reconfiguration. It integrates with Kubernetes, etcd, Consul, or the Kubernetes API for state storage and leader election, while prioritizing consistency under network partitions. Key capabilities include synchronous replication, point-in-time recovery, standby clusters, and fast resynchronization with pg_rewind.

metadata.name: fastjson2
metadata.description: 🚄 FASTJSON2 is a Java JSON  library with excellent performance.

summary.zh: FASTJSON2 是面向 Java 的高性能 JSON 库，兼容文本 JSON 与二进制 JSONB，支持 JSONPath、JSON Schema 和 Kotlin 扩展。它针对 JDK 8/11/17/21、Android 与 GraalVM 优化，适合高吞吐服务、数据管道和跨平台序列化场景。
summary.en: FASTJSON2 is a high-performance JSON library for Java with support for text JSON and binary JSONB, plus JSONPath, JSON Schema, and Kotlin extensions. It is optimized for JDK 8/11/17/21, Android, and GraalVM, making it a strong fit for high-throughput services, data pipelines, and cross-platform serialization.

metadata.name: PowerJob
metadata.description: Enterprise job scheduling middleware with distributed computing ability.

summary.zh: PowerJob 是面向企业级场景的分布式任务调度与计算中间件，提供可视化任务管理、在线监控与日志追踪。支持 CRON、固定频率、延迟和 OpenAPI 调度，覆盖单机、广播、Map、MapReduce 与 DAG 工作流，适用于定时任务、延迟处理、集群广播及大规模数据并行计算，具备高可用、横向扩展和容灾重试能力。
summary.en: PowerJob is an enterprise-grade distributed job scheduling and computing middleware for embedding task orchestration into business applications. It offers a web UI for job management, monitoring, and online logs, while supporting CRON, fixed-rate, fixed-delay, and OpenAPI-driven scheduling. The platform covers standalone, broadcast, Map, MapReduce, and DAG workflow execution, making it suitable for timed jobs, delayed processing, cluster-wide operations, and large-scale parallel data tasks with strong scalability, fault tolerance, and high availability.

metadata.name: notepad--
metadata.description: 一个支持windows/linux/mac的文本编辑器，目标是做中国人自己的编辑器，来自中国。

summary.zh: Notepad-- 是面向 Windows、Linux、macOS 的轻量级跨平台文本编辑器，聚焦国产软件替代与信创场景，尤其强调 UOS、各类 Linux 和 Mac 的可用性。项目核心价值在于以统一编辑体验覆盖多系统环境，为中文用户提供本土化选择，其技术亮点是跨平台桌面适配能力与面向国产操作系统的持续投入。
