summary.en: Notepad-- is a lightweight cross-platform text editor for Windows, Linux, and macOS, positioned as a domestic alternative for productivity software, especially in Chinese IT ecosystems such as UOS and other Linux distributions. Its core value lies in delivering a unified editing experience across desktop platforms while serving Chinese users with a localized option. The main technical strength is broad desktop OS compatibility with sustained optimization for domestic operating systems.

metadata.name: ChatGPT-ToolBox
metadata.description: 由ChatGPT自己编写的ChatGPT工具箱。 当前功能: 1. 绕过高负载禁止登录 2.关闭数据监管 3.链路维持(减少网络错误) 4.API混合接入  5.会话导入导出  6.聊天记录下载 7.解锁GPT4-Mobile

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 ChatGPT 网页端的浏览器脚本工具箱，通过前端注入方式扩展登录绕过、链路维持、API 混合接入、会话导入导出与聊天记录下载等能力，重点提升访问可用性与会话迁移效率。其技术亮点在于书签脚本零安装部署、直接劫持页面流程，以及对移动端 GPT-4 模型入口的增强适配。
summary.en: ChatGPT-ToolBox is a browser-side script toolkit for the ChatGPT web app, extending usability through front-end injection features such as login bypass under heavy load, connection keep-alive, hybrid API access, session import/export, and chat history download. Its main value lies in improving access resilience and conversation portability, with technical highlights including bookmarklet-based zero-install deployment, direct page-flow patching, and enhanced access to mobile GPT-4 model options.

metadata.name: dopamine-windows
metadata.description: Audio player which tries to make organizing and listening to music as simple and pretty as possible.

summary.zh: Dopamine 是一款面向 Windows 的 C# 音乐播放器，强调以简洁、美观的交互降低本地音乐整理与播放门槛。项目基于 CSCore 构建音频能力，并集成 FFmpeg 扩展格式支持，同时依赖 Windows SDK 实现系统通知等桌面特性，适合关注本地媒体管理、原生体验与可定制语言本地化的桌面音频应用场景。
summary.en: Dopamine is a Windows audio player built in C# to make local music organization and playback feel simple, elegant, and visually polished. It uses the CSCore audio library as its playback foundation, integrates FFmpeg-based codec support, and relies on Windows SDK components for native desktop features such as system notifications. The project is well suited to desktop media-player scenarios that prioritize local library management, native Windows integration, and community-driven localization.

metadata.name: MusicPlayer2
metadata.description: MusicPlayer2是一款功能强大的本地音乐播放软件，旨在为用户提供最佳的本地音乐播放体验。它支持歌词显示、歌词卡拉OK样式显示、歌词在线下载、歌词编辑、歌曲标签识别、专辑封面显示、专辑封面在线下载、频谱分析、音效设置、任务栏缩略图按钮、主题颜色、格式转换等功能，支持高度自定义的界面布局，支持多种播放内核（BASS和FFMpeg）。播放器支持大部分常见的音频格式。

summary.zh: MusicPlayer2 是一款面向 Windows 的本地音乐播放器，强调高完成度播放体验与深度可定制界面。项目集成歌词显示与下载、Karaoke 动效、标签编辑、封面匹配、频谱分析、均衡器及格式转换，并支持 BASS 与 FFmpeg 双播放内核，适合追求本地曲库管理、音频播放质量和个性化界面的桌面用户。
summary.en: MusicPlayer2 is a Windows-focused local music player built for a polished offline listening experience and extensive UI customization. It combines lyric display and download, karaoke-style rendering, tag editing, album art matching, spectrum visualization, equalizer effects, and audio format conversion. With dual playback backends based on BASS and FFmpeg, it targets desktop users who value rich local library management, playback quality, and configurable interfaces.
tags_zh: 歌词与界面高度自定义

metadata.name: ControlNet
metadata.description: Let us control diffusion models!

summary.zh: ControlNet 是对 Stable Diffusion 的条件控制扩展，通过“冻结分支+可训练分支”与零卷积设计，在不破坏原模型能力的前提下，引入边缘、深度、姿态等多模态条件，实现可控文生图。其亮点在于小样本友好、显存开销可控、可迁移到社区模型，并提供多种预训练模型与 Gradio 演示，适合生成式 AI 创作、图像编辑与研究验证。
summary.en: ControlNet extends Stable Diffusion with a conditional control architecture that injects signals such as edges, depth, and human pose while preserving the original model’s generative capability. Its key design combines locked and trainable branches with zero-initialized convolutions, enabling stable fine-tuning on small paired datasets without damaging production-ready weights. The project is notable for controllable text-to-image generation, efficient memory usage, compatibility with community checkpoints, and practical deployment through pretrained models, detectors, and Gradio demos.

metadata.name: DataX
metadata.description: DataX是阿里云DataWorks数据集成的开源版本。

summary.zh: DataX 是阿里开源的离线数据同步框架，通过 Reader/Writer 插件模型打通 MySQL、Oracle、Hive、HDFS、MaxCompute、Hologres 等异构数据源。其核心优势是高扩展插件生态、跨源互通能力与大规模稳定传输，适用于数据迁移、批量上云、数仓装载及复杂企业级集成场景。
summary.en: DataX is Alibaba’s open-source offline data integration framework designed for high-performance synchronization across heterogeneous systems such as MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Hive, HDFS, MaxCompute, and Hologres. Its Reader/Writer plugin architecture enables strong extensibility, broad cross-source interoperability, and stable large-scale data movement, making it well suited for database migration, cloud onboarding, warehouse loading, and enterprise data integration pipelines.

metadata.name: NotepadNext
metadata.description: A cross-platform, reimplementation of Notepad++

summary.zh: Notepad Next 是一个基于 Qt/C++ 的跨平台文本编辑器，目标是重现 Notepad++ 的核心体验并覆盖 Windows、Linux、macOS。项目亮点在于原生桌面实现、多平台分发支持及社区驱动翻译，适合需要轻量代码/文本编辑、迁移 Notepad++ 工作流的用户，但当前仍存在未完善功能与稳定性边界。
summary.en: Notepad Next is a cross-platform text editor built with Qt and C++, aiming to recreate the core Notepad++ experience across Windows, Linux, and macOS. Its key strengths include a native desktop architecture, broad packaging support such as Winget, Flatpak, AppImage, and Homebrew, and community-driven localization. It suits users seeking a lightweight editor and teams migrating familiar Notepad++ workflows beyond Windows, while still carrying some feature gaps and stability caveats.

metadata.name: dolby_beta
metadata.description: 杜比大喇叭的β版迎来了重大的革新，合并了UnblockMusic Pro的所有功能且更加强大，同时UnblockMusicPro_Xposed项目将会停止维护，让我们欢送这位老朋友！

summary.zh: 杜比大喇叭β是一款面向网易云音乐的 Android 音源代理模块，整合 UnblockMusic Pro 能力，通过音源替换而非破解改善歌曲可用性与播放体验。项目升级到 AndroidX 与 API 29，并将模块嵌入网易云设置中，弱化外部脚本依赖，重点提升新版本适配性、稳定性与易用性，适合 Root/Xposed 场景下的音乐增强。
summary.en: Dolby Beta is an Android audio-source proxy module for NetEase Cloud Music, merging the capabilities of UnblockMusic Pro to improve song availability and playback through source substitution rather than cracking. Built on AndroidX with API 29, it integrates directly into the NetEase Cloud Music settings, removes reliance on external script selection, and focuses on compatibility, stability, and smoother usability for rooted or Xposed-based music enhancement scenarios.

metadata.name: mapstruct
metadata.description: An annotation processor for generating type-safe bean mappers

summary.zh: MapStruct 是面向 Java 的编译期注解处理器，用于自动生成类型安全、高性能的 Bean/DTO 映射代码。它以普通方法调用替代反射，适合企业应用中的领域对象转换、分层架构与 API DTO 映射；支持 records、自定义配置与内建类型转换，并在构建期提供完整、可调试的错误反馈。
summary.en: MapStruct is a compile-time annotation processor for Java that generates type-safe, high-performance bean mapping code. It replaces reflection with plain method invocations, making it ideal for DTO conversion in layered architectures, enterprise services, and API model transformations. Key strengths include compile-time validation, support for Java records, built-in type conversions, customizable mapping rules, and debuggable generated code with no runtime dependency overhead.

metadata.name: incubator-seata
metadata.description: :fire: Seata is an easy-to-use, high-performance, open source distributed transaction solution.

summary.zh: Apache Seata 是面向微服务架构的分布式事务框架，解决多服务、多数据源场景下的数据一致性问题。项目以 TC、TM、RM 三角色协同管理全局事务与分支事务，兼顾高性能、易用性与可扩展性，适合金融、电商、订单履约等跨库跨服务事务编排场景。
summary.en: Apache Seata is a distributed transaction framework for microservices, designed to keep data consistent across multiple services and databases. It structures transaction orchestration around TC, TM, and RM roles to coordinate global and branch transactions with strong usability, performance, and extensibility. It is well suited for finance, e-commerce, order processing, and other cross-service, cross-database transaction scenarios.

metadata.name: Sa-Token
metadata.description: ✨ 开源、免费、一站式 Java 权限认证框架，让鉴权变得简单、优雅！—— 登录认证、权限认证、分布式 Session 会话、微服务网关鉴权、SSO 单点登录、OAuth2.0 统一认证、jwt 集成、API Key 秘钥授权、API 参数签名

summary.zh: Sa-Token 是面向 Java 生态的一站式鉴权框架，覆盖登录认证、权限控制、分布式 Session、SSO、OAuth2.0、微服务网关鉴权与 JWT/API Key 集成。其核心优势是轻量、低侵入、API 简洁，并提供对 Spring Boot、Solon 等框架的开箱即用支持，适合企业级统一认证与权限体系建设。
summary.en: Sa-Token is a lightweight, all-in-one Java authentication and authorization framework covering login, permission control, distributed sessions, SSO, OAuth2.0, microservice gateway security, and JWT/API Key integration. Its key strengths are low intrusion, concise APIs, and out-of-the-box adapters for Spring Boot, Solon, and other web frameworks, making it well-suited for building enterprise-grade identity, access control, and unified security infrastructure.

metadata.name: winotify
metadata.description: A pure python module to create Windows 10 Notification

summary.zh: Winotify 是一个面向 Windows 10 的纯 Python 桌面通知库，基于系统 PowerShell 生成 Toast 提醒，无需额外依赖。它支持带图标与声音的通知、最多 5 个可点击操作按钮、回调处理及命令行调用，适合桌面工具、自动化脚本、监控告警和本地应用快速集成原生通知能力。
summary.en: Winotify is a pure Python library for creating native Windows 10 toast notifications through built-in PowerShell, with no external dependencies required. It supports persistent Action Center notifications, custom icons and sounds, up to five clickable action buttons, callback handling, and CLI usage. It is well suited for desktop utilities, automation scripts, local monitoring alerts, and lightweight apps needing fast integration with native notification UX.

metadata.name: win10toast-click
metadata.description: An easy-to-use Python library for displaying Windows 10 Toast Notifications. Improved version of win10toast and win10toast-persist to include `callback_on_click` to run a function on notification click, for example to open a URL.

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 Windows 10 的 Python 桌面通知库，基于 win10toast 与持久化分支改进，核心增强是支持 `callback_on_click`，可在用户点击 Toast 时触发函数，如打开网页或执行本地操作。适合轻量桌面工具、自动化脚本和提醒类应用集成，但项目已停止维护，且对新版本 Windows 兼容性有限。
summary.en: win10toast-click is a Python library for showing Windows 10 toast notifications with a practical enhancement over win10toast and win10toast-persist: `callback_on_click`. It lets developers trigger custom functions when a notification is clicked, such as opening a URL or launching a local action. The library fits lightweight desktop utilities, automation scripts, and reminder apps, but its value is tempered by the project’s unmaintained status and compatibility issues on newer Windows 10 builds and Windows 11.

metadata.name: concept
metadata.description: 封装了一些常用组件，走过路过不要错过哦

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 Java/Spring 生态的实用组件集合，聚焦把重复的基础开发压缩为更少代码。仓库覆盖插件化动态加载、下载接口注解封装、集群长连接转发、动态路由、事件模型与属性继承等场景，强调工程化复用、集群支持以及对 Kafka、RabbitMQ、Redis、WebSocket/Netty 等基础设施的整合能力。
summary.en: This repository is a utility component suite for the Java and Spring ecosystem, focused on reducing repetitive infrastructure code into concise, reusable abstractions. It spans plugin-based dynamic JAR/class loading, annotation-driven download APIs, clustered long-connection routing, dynamic routing, event modeling, and property inheritance. Its main strengths are engineering reuse, cluster-oriented design, and integration with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, WebSocket, and Netty.

metadata.name: a1111-sd-webui-tagcomplete
metadata.description: Booru style tag autocompletion for AUTOMATIC1111's Stable Diffusion web UI

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 AUTOMATIC1111 Stable Diffusion WebUI 的提示词增强扩展，提供类似 Booru 的实时标签自动补全。它聚合 Danbooru、e621、通配符、LoRA/Embedding 等多类词源，支持键盘导航、明暗主题、翻译与提示预览，帮助用户更高效地编写高一致性的生成提示词，尤其适合动漫及衍生模型工作流。
summary.en: This extension enhances AUTOMATIC1111 Stable Diffusion WebUI with Booru-style prompt tag autocompletion. It integrates multiple token sources including Danbooru, e621, wildcards, embeddings, LoRA, and related extra networks, while supporting keyboard navigation, theme awareness, translations, and prompt preview. Its main value is faster and more consistent prompt authoring, especially for anime-oriented and tag-trained Stable Diffusion workflows.

metadata.name: arthas
metadata.description: Alibaba Java Diagnostic Tool Arthas/Alibaba Java诊断利器Arthas

summary.zh: Arthas 是阿里开源的 Java 线上诊断工具，面向生产环境故障排查，支持无重启、无改码地动态观测 JVM 与应用行为。它提供类加载分析、方法追踪、调用栈查看、性能监控、堆对象检索及 Flame Graph 等能力，并支持命令行、Telnet、WebSocket 远程诊断，适用于复杂线上问题快速定位。
summary.en: Arthas is Alibaba’s open-source Java diagnostics tool for troubleshooting production JVM applications without code changes or restarts. It enables live inspection of class loading, bytecode behavior, method traces, call stacks, performance metrics, heap instances, and profiler-based flame graphs. With CLI, Telnet, and WebSocket access, Arthas is well suited for remote incident response, runtime analysis, and pinpointing hard-to-reproduce issues in distributed Java services.

metadata.name: geohash-java
metadata.description: Implementation of GeoHashes in java. We try to be/stay compliant to the spec, as far as possible.

summary.zh: 这是一个纯 Java 实现的 GeoHash 库，兼容 geohash.org 的标准字符精度编码，并支持基于 long 的 64 位高精度编码。项目面向地理位置索引、邻近搜索与区域覆盖查询，重点增强了跨 180° 经线的 BoundingBox 处理能力，适合在 GIS、LBS 和空间检索系统中作为轻量级地理编码组件使用。
summary.en: geohash-java is a pure Java GeoHash library that stays close to the geohash.org specification for character-based hashes while also supporting full 64-bit long precision encoding. It targets geospatial indexing, proximity lookup, and area coverage queries, with notable support for BoundingBox operations across the 180th meridian. Its lightweight design and Maven distribution make it a practical building block for GIS, LBS, and spatial search systems.

metadata.name: Live3D-v2
metadata.description: Neural Rendering with Attention: An Incremental Improvement for Anime Character Animation

summary.zh: Live3D-v2 是面向二次元角色动画的神经渲染系统，通过在 U-Net 中引入自注意力并移除 ResNet50 编码器，提升了单角色驱动视频生成的质量与效率。项目适用于虚拟主播、插画角色动效和草图三维化等场景，并提供 Colab、预训练权重与 Windows 一键包以降低体验门槛。
summary.en: Live3D-v2 is a neural rendering system for anime character animation that improves quality and efficiency by removing the ResNet50 encoder, adding self-attention to a U-Net backbone, and retuning key hyperparameters. It targets use cases such as single-character motion-driven video synthesis, VTuber-style avatar animation, and sketch-to-3D point cloud generation, while offering Colab support, pretrained weights, and a Windows bundle for easier adoption.

metadata.name: Bilibili-Evolved
metadata.description: 强大的哔哩哔哩增强脚本

summary.zh: Bilibili Evolved 是面向哔哩哔哩的模块化增强脚本，运行于 Tampermonkey/Violentmonkey，通过组件、插件和样式按需扩展站点体验。它提供可视化设置面板、在线安装与批量导入能力，支持旧版配置迁移，适合重度 B 站用户进行界面优化、功能增强与个性化定制，突出高度可扩展与组件化管理。
summary.en: Bilibili Evolved is a modular enhancement userscript for Bilibili, built to run on Tampermonkey or Violentmonkey and extend the site through installable components, plugins, and styles. It features a visual settings panel, online and batch installation workflows, and migration support for older configurations. The project targets power users who want UI refinement, feature augmentation, and deep personalization, with strong emphasis on extensibility and component-based management.

metadata.name: PixivBiu
metadata.description: A Pixiv client. Easy to search, browse, and download artworks.

summary.zh: PixivBiu 是基于 Go 构建的 Pixiv 辅助工具，提供接近完整客户端的 Web 访问体验，覆盖作品浏览、排行检索、收藏关注管理与多维筛选。其亮点在于支持单图、多图与动图原图下载，前后端可嵌入单一二进制发布，兼顾桌面部署与轻量服务器运行，适合个人收藏、检索与归档场景。
summary.en: PixivBiu is a Go-based Pixiv companion tool that delivers a near full-client web experience for browsing artworks, exploring rankings, managing bookmarks and follows, and performing multi-dimensional filtering. Its key strengths include original-image downloads for single images, manga sets, and ugoira animations, plus a bundled frontend-backend architecture that ships as a single binary, making it suitable for both desktop use and lightweight self-hosted deployment.

metadata.name: stable-diffusion-webui
metadata.description: Stable Diffusion web UI

summary.zh: AUTOMATIC1111/stable-diffusion-webui 是面向 Stable Diffusion 的高功能图形化推理与创作平台，基于 Gradio 提供 txt2img、img2img、局部重绘、高清修复、模型切换与参数回放等能力。其亮点在于丰富插件生态、低显存适配、训练与推理一体化，以及对提示词控制、放大修复和工作流实验的深度支持，适合 AI 绘画创作、模型调参和批量图像生成。
summary.en: AUTOMATIC1111/stable-diffusion-webui is a feature-rich Gradio-based interface for Stable Diffusion, built for image generation, prompt experimentation, and model-driven creative workflows. It supports txt2img, img2img, inpainting, upscaling, checkpoint switching, parameter recovery, and extension-based customization. Key strengths include a mature plugin ecosystem, low-VRAM usability, integrated inference and training utilities, and fine-grained prompt/control features, making it well suited for AI art creation, batch generation, and iterative model tuning.

metadata.name: marktext
metadata.description: 📝A simple and elegant markdown editor, available for Linux, macOS and Windows.

summary.zh: MarkText 是一款面向 Linux、macOS 与 Windows 的跨平台 Markdown 编辑器，主打所见即所得实时预览、简洁无干扰写作体验与高可用性。它兼容 CommonMark、GFM 及部分 Pandoc 语法，支持数学公式等扩展，适合技术写作、文档编辑与知识整理场景。
summary.en: MarkText is a cross-platform Markdown editor for Linux, macOS, and Windows, built around real-time WYSIWYG preview, a clean distraction-free interface, and strong usability. It supports CommonMark, GitHub Flavored Markdown, and selected Pandoc syntax, with extensions such as math support, making it well suited for technical writing, documentation workflows, and structured note-taking.

metadata.name: TDengine
metadata.description: High-performance, scalable time-series database designed for Industrial IoT (IIoT) scenarios

summary.zh: TDengine 是面向工业物联网、车联网等场景的高性能时序数据库，强调海量高基数设备数据的实时写入、查询与压缩能力。其内置缓存、流处理、订阅与 AI Agent 功能，并结合原生分布式、分片分区、计算存储分离、RAFT 与 Kubernetes 支持，适合 TB/PB 级时序数据平台建设。
summary.en: TDengine is a high-performance time-series database built for Industrial IoT, connected vehicles, and other sensor-heavy scenarios. It focuses on real-time ingestion, querying, and compression of massive high-cardinality data from billions of collection points. With built-in caching, stream processing, subscriptions, and AI agent capabilities, plus cloud-native distributed design, RAFT, compute-storage separation, and Kubernetes support, it fits TB/PB-scale time-series data platforms.

metadata.name: migration
metadata.description: 《系统重构与迁移指南》手把手教你分析、评估现有系统、制定重构策略、探索可行重构方案、搭建测试防护网、进行系统架构重构、服务架构重构、模块重构、代码重构、数据库重构、重构后的架构守护

summary.zh: 该仓库是一份面向遗留系统治理的重构与迁移实战指南，系统覆盖现状分析、技术债评估、重构策略制定、测试防护网建设，以及架构、服务、模块、代码和数据库多层重构。其亮点在于将 DDD、度量评估与渐进式重构流程结合，适合企业进行复杂系统演进与迁移决策。
summary.en: This repository is a hands-on guide for legacy system refactoring and migration, covering system assessment, technical debt analysis, refactoring strategy, safety nets through testing, and multi-layer transformations across architecture, services, modules, code, and databases. Its key strength is the combination of DDD thinking, measurable evaluation, and incremental refactoring workflows, making it valuable for teams driving complex enterprise modernization.

summary.zh: Fluent-Mybatis 是面向 Java/MyBatis 的增强型 ORM 与代码生成框架，提供链式查询、更新与批量操作语法，降低 XML 与样板代码成本。其亮点在于围绕数据库表自动生成 Entity、Mapper 与条件构造器，并支持多数据库、分页方言、TypeHandler 与 Spring/非 Spring 场景，适合中后台业务快速开发。
summary.en: Fluent-Mybatis is an enhanced ORM and code-generation framework for Java and MyBatis, designed to replace verbose XML and repetitive DAO code with fluent query, update, and batch APIs. Its core strength lies in generating entities, mappers, and condition builders from database schemas, while supporting multiple databases, pagination dialects, TypeHandler integration, and both Spring and non-Spring setups for rapid enterprise application development.

metadata.name: jpa-sample-tmall
metadata.description: DDD persistence with JPA sample

summary.zh: 该仓库以天猫类业务为背景，演示在领域驱动设计中用 JPA 实现持久化映射与聚合存储。项目核心价值在于将领域模型、仓储模式与 ORM 解耦实践具体化，适合用于企业级 Java 应用的架构教学、持久化方案设计与 DDD 落地参考。
summary.en: This repository uses a Tmall-like business domain to demonstrate how Domain-Driven Design persistence can be implemented with JPA. Its main value lies in turning abstract concepts such as domain models, repositories, and ORM mapping boundaries into concrete architectural practice. It is well suited for Java enterprise architecture learning, DDD adoption, and designing persistence strategies for complex business systems.

metadata.name: x-file-storage
metadata.description: 一行代码将文件存储到 本地、FTP、SFTP、WebDAV、谷歌云存储、阿里云OSS、华为云OBS、七牛云Kodo、腾讯云COS、百度云 BOS、又拍云USS、MinIO、 AWS S3、FastDFS、 Azure Blob Storage、金山云 KS3、美团云 MSS、京东云 OSS、天翼云 OOS、移动云 EOS、沃云 OSS、 网易数帆 NOS、Ucloud US3、青云 QingStor、平安云 OBS、首云 OSS、IBM COS、其它兼容 S3 协议的平台。后续即将支持 Samba、NFS

summary.zh: X File Storage 是面向 Java/Spring 生态的统一文件存储组件，用一行代码接入本地、FTP/SFTP、WebDAV 及多云对象存储，并支持跨平台迁移、预签名 URL、分片上传和元数据管理，适合需要快速切换存储后端的业务系统。
summary.en: X File Storage is a unified file storage component for the Java/Spring ecosystem. It connects local, FTP/SFTP, WebDAV, and major cloud object stores with one line of code, while supporting cross-platform migration, presigned URLs, multipart upload, and metadata management for systems that need backend flexibility.

metadata.name: jpa-spec
metadata.description: A JPA Query By Specification framework.

summary.zh: jpa-spec 是基于 Spring Data JPA 的动态查询构建框架，以 Specification Builder 方式简化复杂条件拼装。它支持多值比较、空值判断、分页排序、左连接与自定义规格，适合企业应用中可组合的检索、筛选与后台查询场景，兼顾 JPA 2.1 兼容性与可读性。
summary.en: jpa-spec is a dynamic query framework built on Spring Data JPA that simplifies Specification-based query composition through a fluent builder API. It supports multi-value predicates, null-aware equality checks, pagination, sorting, left joins, and custom specifications. The library is well suited for enterprise search, filter-heavy backends, and maintainable repository query logic while remaining compatible with JPA 2.1.

metadata.name: hutool
metadata.description: 🍬A set of tools that keep Java sweet.

summary.zh: Hutool 是面向 Java 开发的综合工具库，以模块化方式封装字符串、集合、时间、IO、JSON、HTTP、加密、JDBC、定时任务等高频能力，降低样板代码与基础开发成本。其亮点在于 JDK 8+ 兼容、组件覆盖广、中文文档与注释完善，适合企业应用、后端服务与快速原型开发。
summary.en: Hutool is a comprehensive Java utility library that streamlines everyday development with modular components for strings, collections, dates, IO, JSON, HTTP, cryptography, JDBC, and scheduling. Its key strengths are broad JDK 8+ compatible coverage, practical APIs that reduce boilerplate, and strong Chinese documentation and source comments, making it well suited for enterprise backends, service development, and rapid prototyping.

metadata.name: spring-data-jpa-entity-graph
metadata.description: Spring Data JPA extension allowing full dynamic usage of EntityGraph on repositories

summary.zh: 该项目扩展 Spring Data JPA，让仓库方法可在运行时动态传入 EntityGraph，突破原生仅靠注解静态声明抓取策略的限制。它通过替换 RepositoryFactoryBean 并为 CrudRepository、JpaRepository 等提供重载接口，适合复杂查询、按场景优化关联加载、缓解 N+1 与过度抓取问题。
summary.en: This library extends Spring Data JPA with runtime-selectable EntityGraph support for repository methods, removing the native limitation of annotation-only, compile-time fetch planning. By plugging in a custom repository factory bean and providing overloaded variants of standard repository interfaces, it enables context-aware association fetching, query optimization, and better control over N+1 and over-fetching in complex domain models.

summary.zh: KCNamer 是一款基于 Java 8 的随机中文姓名生成工具，既可作为命令行应用独立运行，也可嵌入 Java 项目调用。它支持按内置姓氏库与近千条现代名字库组合生成姓名，或采用随机汉字模式，并可控制性别风格、名字长度、指定姓氏及自定义名称库，适合游戏取名、测试数据构造与内容生成场景。
summary.en: KCNamer is a Java 8-based random Chinese name generator that works both as a standalone CLI tool and as an embeddable library for Java applications. It generates names using built-in Chinese surnames plus a curated pool of nearly a thousand modern given names, or a fully random Chinese character mode. The tool supports gender style, name length, fixed surname input, and custom name libraries, making it useful for game naming, mock data generation, and localized content creation.

metadata.name: Spring-MultiRequestBody
metadata.description: Spring多@RequestBody支持

summary.zh: 该仓库为 Spring MVC 提供多 `@RequestBody` 扩展，解决 JSON POST 场景下基础类型、包装类及多个实体无法同时绑定的问题。它支持按注解 value、参数名或属性名灵活解析，请求方式不限于 POST，并兼容冗余字段、共享参数与全属性匹配策略，适合需要复杂入参绑定的控制器接口增强。
summary.en: This repository extends Spring MVC to support multiple `@RequestBody`-style bindings, addressing a common limitation in JSON requests where primitive wrappers and multiple objects cannot be bound directly in a single controller method. It supports flexible mapping by annotation value, parameter name, or property name, works across GET and other HTTP methods, and tolerates extra fields, shared parameters, and full-property matching for complex request payload binding.

metadata.name: jetlinks-community
metadata.description: JetLinks  基于Java,Spring Boot ,WebFlux,Netty,Vert.x,Reactor等开发, 是一个全响应式的企业级物联网平台。支持统一物模型管理,多种设备,多种厂家,统一管理。统一设备连接管理,多协议适配(TCP,MQTT,UDP,CoAP,HTTP等),屏蔽网络编程复杂性,灵活接入不同厂家不同协议等设备。实时数据处理,设备告警,消息通知,数据转发。地理位置,数据可视化等。能帮助你快速建立物联网相关业务系统。

summary.zh: JetLinks Community 是面向企业物联网场景的全响应式基础平台，基于 Java 17、Spring Boot 3、WebFlux、Netty 与 Reactor 构建。它提供统一物模型、跨厂商多协议设备接入、海量设备管理、规则引擎、告警通知与时序数据处理能力，降低网络编程与协议适配复杂度，适合快速搭建工业互联、设备监控与智慧场景业务系统。
summary.en: JetLinks Community is a fully reactive enterprise IoT platform built with Java 17, Spring Boot 3, WebFlux, Netty, Vert.x, and Reactor. It delivers unified device models, multi-vendor and multi-protocol connectivity, large-scale device management, rule-engine automation, alerting, notifications, and time-series data processing. Its modular architecture abstracts protocol adaptation and networking complexity, making it well suited for industrial IoT, device monitoring, and smart connected business systems.

metadata.name: microservices-platform
metadata.description: 基于SpringBoot2.x、SpringCloud和SpringCloudAlibaba并采用前后端分离的企业级微服务多租户系统架构。并引入组件化的思想实现高内聚低耦合，项目代码简洁注释丰富上手容易，适合学习和企业中使用。真正实现了基于RBAC、jwt和oauth2的无状态统一权限认证的解决方案，面向互联网设计同时适合B端和C端用户，支持CI/CD多环境部署，并提供应用管理方便第三方系统接入；同时还集合各种微服务治理功能和监控功能。模块包括:企业级的认证系统、开发平台、应用监控、慢sql监控、统一日志、单点登录、Redis分布式高速缓存、配置中心、分布式任务调度、接口文档、代码生成等等。

summary.zh: 这是一个面向企业落地的多租户微服务平台，基于 Spring Boot 3、Spring Cloud 与 Spring Cloud Alibaba，围绕认证鉴权、网关、配置、监控、日志、搜索与代码生成构建完整底座。项目以组件化 starter 降低耦合，深度定制 Spring Authorization Server，实现 RBAC + JWT + OAuth2 的无状态统一认证，适合中后台、开放平台及第三方系统集成场景。
summary.en: This repository delivers an enterprise-grade multi-tenant microservices platform built on Spring Boot 3, Spring Cloud, and Spring Cloud Alibaba. It provides a full infrastructure stack covering gateway, authorization, configuration, monitoring, logging, search, scheduling, and code generation. A modular starter-based design keeps services loosely coupled, while deep customization of Spring Authorization Server enables stateless unified security with RBAC, JWT, and OAuth2, making it suitable for internal platforms, open APIs, and third-party system integration.

metadata.name: TrafficMonitor
metadata.description: 这是一个用于显示当前网速、CPU及内存利用率的桌面悬浮窗软件，并支持任务栏显示，支持更换皮肤。

summary.zh: TrafficMonitor 是一款面向 Windows 的轻量桌面监控工具，以悬浮窗和任务栏嵌入方式实时展示网速、CPU、内存及部分硬件状态。项目亮点在于可换肤、自定义显示项、历史流量统计与插件扩展机制，并提供 Lite/标准版分层，兼顾日常性能监控、个性化桌面和低侵入系统状态展示。
summary.en: TrafficMonitor is a lightweight Windows desktop monitoring utility that shows real-time network throughput, CPU usage, memory consumption, and selected hardware metrics through a floating widget or taskbar-integrated display. Its key strengths include skin customization, configurable display items, traffic history statistics, and a plugin-based extension model. With Lite and standard editions, it balances everyday system monitoring, desktop personalization, and low-intrusion visibility into device performance.

summary.zh: DownKyi 是面向哔哩哔哩内容下载与处理的桌面工具，聚焦高质量视频获取、批量任务管理与后处理能力。项目支持 8K、HDR、杜比视界等高规格资源下载，并集成音视频提取、去水印等工具箱，适合个人归档、离线观影与内容整理场景，突出多格式兼容与一站式下载处理体验。
summary.en: DownKyi is a desktop utility focused on downloading and processing content from Bilibili with an emphasis on high-quality media acquisition and batch task workflows. It supports premium formats such as 8K, HDR, and Dolby Vision, while also bundling post-processing tools like audio/video extraction and watermark removal. The project fits personal archiving, offline viewing, and media organization scenarios, standing out through its all-in-one download pipeline and rich format support.

metadata.name: vue-manage-system
metadata.description: Vue3、Element Plus、typescript后台管理系统

summary.zh: 这是一个面向后台管理场景的 Vue3 管理系统模板，基于 TypeScript、Pinia、Element Plus 与 Vite 构建，覆盖登录注册、权限控制、三级菜单、图表、表单表格、富文本/Markdown、图片裁剪上传和主题切换等常见能力。其价值在于提供可快速交付的中后台基础框架，适合外包项目、企业后台和运营平台的高效搭建。
summary.en: This repository is a Vue 3 admin dashboard template built with TypeScript, Pinia, Element Plus, and Vite for rapid back-office application delivery. It includes common enterprise features such as authentication, permission control, nested menus, charts, tables and forms, rich text and Markdown editors, image crop upload, custom icons, and theme switching. Its main value lies in offering a practical, ready-to-extend foundation for internal tools, enterprise admin panels, and operations platforms.

metadata.name: bdex-rs
metadata.description: Tool to download bdex:// files. Written in pure Rust.

summary.zh: bdex-rs 是一个纯 Rust 编写的命令行下载工具，面向 `bdex://` 资源的分块拉取、合并与清理流程自动化。它支持多线程下载、失败重试、跳过哈希校验与保留中间块文件，适合批量获取大文件或需要稳定传输的场景，亮点在于轻量依赖、并发下载能力与清晰的端到端工作流设计。
summary.en: bdex-rs is a pure Rust CLI downloader for `bdex://` resources, automating block-based fetching, file merging, and temporary artifact cleanup. It supports multithreaded downloads, retry control, optional hash-check skipping, and keeping intermediate blocks for debugging or recovery. The project is well suited for large-file retrieval and resilient transfer workflows, with key strengths in lightweight implementation, concurrency, and a straightforward end-to-end download pipeline.

metadata.name: MockingBird
metadata.description: 🚀Clone a voice in 5 seconds to generate arbitrary speech in real-time

summary.zh: MockingBird 是一个基于 PyTorch 的实时语音克隆系统，主打“5 秒采样复刻声线并生成任意语音”。项目支持中文普通话、多平台部署及 Web 服务调用，复用预训练编码器与声码器以降低训练成本，适用于语音合成、数字人、个性化 TTS 与语音交互原型开发。
summary.en: MockingBird is a PyTorch-based real-time voice cloning system designed to replicate a speaker’s voice from about five seconds of audio and generate arbitrary speech. It supports Mandarin datasets, runs across Windows, Linux, and even M1-based macOS setups, and can be exposed as a web service. Its key strength is reusing pretrained encoder and vocoder components to reduce training cost while enabling fast personalized TTS prototyping.

metadata.name: parkinglot
metadata.description: 基于vue、vant的一个智慧停车、充电一体化的移动端项目

summary.zh: 该仓库是一个基于 Vue 与 Vant 构建的移动端智慧停车与充电一体化应用，面向园区、商场或社区等场景，覆盖车位查询、停车服务及充电配套等业务。项目采用轻量前端技术栈，适合快速交付 H5 端服务，亮点在于将停车与充电能力整合到统一移动入口，提升出行与能源服务协同体验。
summary.en: This repository is a mobile web application for integrated smart parking and EV charging services, built with Vue and Vant. It targets scenarios such as campuses, malls, and residential communities, supporting parking-related workflows alongside charging access in a unified user experience. The project uses a lightweight H5-oriented frontend stack for rapid delivery, with its main strength being the consolidation of parking and charging capabilities into a single mobile service entry point.

metadata.name: notes
metadata.description: 学习代码的一些笔记

summary.zh: 这是一个基于 VuePress 构建并自动部署到 GitHub Pages 的个人学习笔记站，聚焦 Java 学习路线与开发知识沉淀。项目亮点在于文档化组织清晰、可在线访问、持续部署便捷，适合用于课程笔记整理、知识库建设和个人技术博客发布。
summary.en: This repository is a personal learning-notes site built with VuePress and automatically deployed to GitHub Pages. It focuses on Java study paths and structured knowledge accumulation, with strengths in clear documentation organization, easy online access, and lightweight continuous deployment. It is well suited for course note management, personal knowledge bases, and developer blog-style publishing.

metadata.name: EShareTool
metadata.description: EShareTool is an application running on Windows platform which can bypass ESurfingClient's sharing limited.

summary.zh: EShareTool 是一款面向 Windows 的网络共享限制绕过工具，针对 ESurfingClient 的共享限制作出定向处理，帮助用户实现更自由的热点或网络共享。项目亮点在于聚焦单一场景、提供开箱即用的可执行版本，并兼顾 Windows 7 支持与免装 VC++ 运行库的发布优化。
summary.en: EShareTool is a Windows utility designed to bypass the sharing restrictions imposed by ESurfingClient, enabling more flexible network or hotspot sharing in constrained environments. Its core value lies in targeting a very specific connectivity limitation with a ready-to-use executable, while notable technical highlights include Windows 7 compatibility and distribution improvements that remove the need for a separate VC++ runtime from version 1.1.1 onward.

metadata.name: termux-install-linux
metadata.description: Termux一键安装Linux脚本

summary.zh: 该仓库提供面向 Termux 的 Linux 一键安装脚本，帮助安卓用户快速部署 Ubuntu、Debian 与轻量 Kali 环境。项目针对国内网络场景优化，使用国内镜像下载系统资源并预置更友好的源配置，降低手动改源与环境初始化成本，适合移动端命令行学习、渗透测试实验和轻量开发运维场景。
summary.en: This repository delivers a one-click Linux installation script for Termux, enabling Android users to quickly set up Ubuntu, Debian, and a lightweight Kali environment. Its main value lies in localization for mainland China: system images are fetched from domestic mirrors and the installed environments avoid the usual friction of manually replacing overseas package sources. It is well suited for mobile command-line learning, lightweight development, and security lab usage.

metadata.name: vue-admin-template
metadata.description: a vue2.0 minimal admin template

summary.zh: vue-admin-template 是一个面向中后台场景的精简 Vue 2 管理后台模板，集成 Element UI、Axios、权限控制、图标体系与 ESLint，开箱即可用于快速搭建企业级控制台。其基于 vue-cli 的工程化配置完善，兼顾开发、构建、预览与兼容性，适合需要低门槛启动、后续可平滑扩展的管理系统项目。
summary.en: vue-admin-template is a minimal admin dashboard starter for Vue 2, designed for internal tools and enterprise back-office systems. It bundles Element UI, Axios, iconfont, permission control, and ESLint into a ready-to-run scaffold, helping teams bootstrap admin consoles quickly. Built on vue-cli, it offers a practical engineering baseline for development, staging, production builds, and legacy browser compatibility while remaining lightweight and extensible.

metadata.name: UmaUmaCruise-db-urarawin
metadata.description: A config builder for the UmaCruise-U based on Python3

summary.zh: 该仓库是面向 UmaCruise-U 的 Python3 配置构建器，核心作用是基于 UraraWin 提供的赛马娘数据库生成可用配置，降低数据整理与接入成本。其价值在于连接上游游戏数据源与下游定制工具链，适合自动化配置生成、二次开发及本地化维护场景。
summary.en: This repository is a Python 3-based configuration builder for UmaCruise-U. It uses data sourced from UraraWin to generate structured configs, helping bridge upstream Pretty Derby data and downstream customization workflows. Its main value lies in reducing manual data preparation, enabling automated config generation, easier maintenance, and smoother secondary development for customized UmaCruise-U deployments.

metadata.name: UmaUmaCruise
metadata.description: このソフトは、自動でDMM版ウマ娘のウィンドウから、イベント選択肢の効果を知るために作られました

summary.zh: UmaUmaCruise 是一款面向 DMM 版《赛马娘》育成场景的 Windows 辅助工具，可自动识别游戏窗口中的事件画面并展示选项效果。项目结合 OpenCV、Tesseract OCR 与 SimString 做图像捕获、文字识别和模糊匹配，并支持育成角色自动选择、URA 赛程预测及赛事预约，是典型的本地视觉识别型游戏信息增强方案。
summary.en: UmaUmaCruise is a Windows companion tool for the DMM version of Umamusume, designed to automatically detect in-game event screens and reveal the effects of dialogue choices. It combines OpenCV, Tesseract OCR, and SimString for screen capture, text recognition, and fuzzy matching, while also supporting trainee auto-selection, URA race forecasting, and race reservation. The project stands out as a local computer-vision-powered game assist utility built in C++ for real-time gameplay augmentation.

metadata.name: qaac
metadata.description: CLI QuickTime AAC/ALAC encoder

summary.zh: qaac 是面向 Windows 的命令行音频编码器，依托 QuickTime/CoreAudioToolbox 实现 AAC 与 ALAC 编码，适合批量转码、音频归档与高质量压缩场景。其核心价值在于复用苹果编码链路以获得稳定音质与格式兼容性，并明确提示新版 CoreAudioToolbox 在 AAC CBR 模式下的已知 glitch 风险，便于生产环境规避。
summary.en: qaac is a Windows-focused command-line audio encoder that leverages QuickTime/CoreAudioToolbox to produce AAC and ALAC output. It is well suited for batch transcoding, archival workflows, and high-quality media compression where Apple’s encoding pipeline is preferred for quality and compatibility. A notable technical detail is its explicit warning that newer CoreAudioToolbox versions may introduce glitches in AAC CBR mode, which is critical for reliable production use.

metadata.name: uperf
metadata.description: Userspace performance controller for android

summary.zh: Uperf 是面向 Android 6-12 的用户态性能控制器，通过触摸识别、系统负载采样、cpuset 与 wakelock 监听、SurfaceFlinger 渲染信号等多源场景感知，动态调节 sysfs 参数并绑定 UI 线程到大核，复现并扩展内核态升频能力。其优势是不依赖第三方内核或 Android 框架，兼容多平台，可通过 Magisk 或手动部署实现细粒度性能/功耗平衡。
summary.en: Uperf is a userspace performance controller for Android 6-12 that reproduces and extends kernel-level boosting through multi-source scene detection. It monitors touch input, system load spikes, cpuset switches, wakelocks, and SurfaceFlinger render events to tune sysfs nodes dynamically and pin UI-related threads to big cores. Its core value lies in cross-platform deployment without requiring custom kernels or Android framework changes, enabling fine-grained performance and power optimization via Magisk or manual installation.

metadata.name: Auto.js
metadata.description: Automation&Workflow JavaScript IDE on Android(安卓平台上的JavaScript编程IDE)

summary.zh: Auto.js 是面向 Android 的 JavaScript 自动化与编程 IDE，强调以脚本方式提升学习与操作效率，适用于移动端任务自动化、工作流编排与交互控制。该仓库公开的是 Auto.js 4.1 历史版本信息，现源码已移除；其亮点在于将 JavaScript 开发环境与安卓自动化能力结合，降低移动端自动化开发门槛。
summary.en: Auto.js is an Android-focused JavaScript IDE for automation and productivity scripting, designed to improve learning efficiency and streamline repetitive mobile workflows. It targets use cases such as task automation, workflow orchestration, and interactive device control on Android. This repository now mainly preserves the historical context of Auto.js 4.1, as the source code has been removed. Its key value lies in combining a JavaScript development environment with native Android automation capabilities.

metadata.name: GM_script
metadata.description: 我就是来分享脚本玩玩的

summary.zh: 这是一个面向 Tampermonkey 的搜索增强脚本，核心用于移除百度、搜狗、谷歌、必应等搜索结果重定向，恢复真实链接并清理广告、百家号等干扰内容。项目亮点在于多搜索引擎适配、异步独立解析、Favicon 展示、单双/多列布局、护眼与自定义样式，长期持续维护以跟进搜索页面结构变化。
summary.en: This repository provides a Tampermonkey userscript that enhances major search engines by removing redirect wrappers, restoring direct result URLs, and filtering intrusive ads or low-value content such as Baijiahao pages. Its strengths lie in broad engine support across Baidu, Sogou, Google, and Bing, plus async per-link resolution, favicon rendering, multi-column layouts, eye-care themes, custom CSS styling, and long-term maintenance to keep pace with frequent search page changes.

metadata.name: auto-submit
metadata.description: 今日校园自动提交疫情上报，通用

summary.zh: 这是一个面向“今日校园”场景的 Python 自动化提交脚本，核心用于疫情上报等信息收集任务的定时填报。项目同时覆盖云端系统可用与被禁用两类学校，提供通用脚本、配置生成辅助、邮件结果推送及腾讯云函数部署方案，技术亮点在于多校适配思路、表单默认项生成与低门槛自动化运维。
summary.en: This repository provides a Python-based automation solution for submitting daily data collection forms in the Campusphere (Cpdaily) ecosystem, especially COVID-related reporting workflows. It supports both normal cloud-login environments and schools where cloud access is blocked through a fallback generic script. Key strengths include multi-school adaptability, config-assisted form generation, email result notifications, and lightweight scheduled deployment via Tencent Cloud Functions or self-hosted cron jobs.

metadata.name: netch
metadata.description: A simple proxy client

summary.zh: Netch 是面向 Windows 的轻量级代理客户端，围绕进程代理、虚拟网卡、网络共享与网页代理等多种模式，统一承载 Socks5、Shadowsocks、WireGuard、VMess、VLESS 等协议。其亮点在于结合 Netfilter、WinTUN、Npcap 等底层驱动能力，实现灵活分流、UDP FullCone 支持与多协议接入，适合游戏加速、科学上网和局域网共享等场景。
summary.en: Netch is a lightweight Windows proxy client that unifies multiple traffic-forwarding modes, including process-based proxying, virtual adapters, network sharing, and web proxying. It supports a broad protocol set such as Socks5, Shadowsocks, WireGuard, Trojan, VMess, and VLESS. Key strengths include low-level integration with Netfilter, WinTUN, and Npcap, enabling flexible traffic interception, UDP FullCone NAT support, and versatile deployment for gaming acceleration, privacy access, and LAN sharing scenarios.

metadata.name: dbg-macro
metadata.description: A dbg(…) macro for C++

summary.zh: dbg-macro 是一个面向 C++ 的单头文件调试宏库，用于替代临时 printf 或 cout 调试。它可在表达式中直接包裹变量与函数调用，自动输出源码位置、函数名、原始表达式、类型和值，并提供容器、指针、optional、枚举等美化打印与终端彩色显示，适合快速定位运行时状态，兼容 C++11/14/17，集成成本极低。
summary.en: dbg-macro is a single-header C++ debugging utility that replaces ad hoc printf or std::cout inspection with a richer `dbg(...)` macro. It can wrap expressions inline while preserving their original value, and prints source location, function name, expression text, type information, and formatted values. With pretty-printers for containers, pointers, enums, and std::optional plus auto colorized terminal output, it is ideal for fast runtime diagnostics in C++11/14/17 codebases.

metadata.name: eladmin
metadata.description: eladmin jpa 版本：项目基于 Spring Boot 2.7.18、 Jpa、 Spring Security、Redis、Vue的前后端分离的后台管理系统，项目采用分模块开发方式， 权限控制采用 RBAC，支持数据字典与数据权限管理，支持一键生成前后端代码，支持动态路由

summary.zh: ELADMIN 是面向企业后台场景的前后端分离管理系统，基于 Spring Boot 2.7、JPA、Spring Security、JWT、Redis 与 Vue 构建。项目采用模块化架构与 RBAC 权限模型，提供数据权限、数据字典、动态路由、接口限流及统一异常处理，并内置代码生成、定时任务、运维管理、对象存储与支付集成，适合快速搭建中后台与管理平台。
summary.en: ELADMIN is a modular admin platform for enterprise back-office systems, built with Spring Boot 2.7, JPA, Spring Security, JWT, Redis, and Vue. It adopts a frontend-backend separation architecture with RBAC-based authorization, data permission control, dictionaries, dynamic routing, rate limiting, and unified exception handling. The project also includes code generation, Quartz scheduling, ops management, object storage, and payment integrations, making it well suited for rapidly building extensible admin and operational platforms.

metadata.name: HelloGitHub
metadata.description: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.

summary.zh: HelloGitHub 是面向中文开发者的开源项目月刊与发现平台，持续筛选有趣、入门友好的 GitHub 项目，并扩展到开源书籍、实战案例和企业级项目。其亮点在于长期高频策展、多语言内容组织与清晰期刊归档，适合新手建立开源视野、寻找学习样例和项目灵感。
summary.en: HelloGitHub is a curated discovery platform and monthly digest for Chinese-speaking developers, featuring interesting, beginner-friendly open source projects from GitHub. It also covers open source books, hands-on demos, and production-grade projects. Its key strengths are long-term editorial curation, periodical archiving, and multilingual presentation, making it valuable for newcomers exploring open source, learning by example, and finding practical project inspiration.

metadata.name: danmuai
metadata.description: 独属于你的AI主播和AI弹幕，支持AI读弹幕，允许自由配置你喜欢的AI模型

summary.zh: DanmuAI 是一款 Windows 桌面弹幕工具，专为直播主播设计。它通过截取全屏画面，调用视觉模型（如豆包、百炼、MiMo）实时生成弹幕，并以透明浮层滚动展示。项目采用 FastAPI + pywebview 构建 Web 控制台，PyQt6 负责弹幕覆盖层，支持多屏、多服务商、弹幕去重与隐私保护（截图不落盘）。
summary.en: DanmuAI is a Windows desktop danmaku assistant tailored for live streamers. It captures full-screen images, invokes vision models (e.g., Doubao, DashScope, MiMo) to generate danmaku in real-time, and displays them as a transparent overlay. Built with FastAPI + pywebview for the web console and PyQt6 for the overlay, it supports multi-monitor, multi-provider, danmaku deduplication, and privacy protection (screenshots never saved to disk).

metadata.name: tickflow-stock-panel
metadata.description: TSP自托管、零运维的 A 股「选股 + 监控 + 回测」量化工作台 | 基于 TickFlow 数据源  | LLM能力驱使策略定制+个股分析+复盘 | 自由接入第三方数据源与个性化扩展数据 | 个人开源 ,非TickFlow官方项目

summary.zh: TickFlow Stock Panel 是一个自托管、零运维的 A 股量化工作台，集选股、监控与回测于一体。它基于 TickFlow 数据源，支持 Free 到 Expert 全档位订阅，并可自由接入 Tushare 等第三方数据。项目提供 20 个内置策略、AI 生成策略及自定义信号系统，利用 Polars 向量化计算，实现高效的全市场扫描。
summary.en: TickFlow Stock Panel is a self-hosted, zero-maintenance quantitative workstation for A-shares, integrating stock screening, monitoring, and backtesting. It leverages TickFlow data, supports all subscription tiers from Free to Expert, and allows flexible integration of third-party data like Tushare. The project offers 20 built-in strategies, AI-generated strategies, and a custom signal system, utilizing Polars for vectorized computations to achieve efficient full-market scanning.

metadata.name: wsl-ui
metadata.description: WSL2 Manager desktop application built with Tauri, Vite, React, and TypeScript

summary.zh: WSL UI 是一款基于 Tauri、React 和 TypeScript 构建的轻量级 WSL2 桌面管理工具。它提供实时仪表盘、快速操作（终端、文件管理器、IDE 启动）、多来源安装（Microsoft Store、Docker 镜像、LXC 目录）、备份恢复、自定义命令、可视化 WSL 配置编辑、17 种主题、系统托盘和磁盘挂载等功能。支持 14 种语言，遵循 GPL-3.0 开源协议。
summary.en: WSL UI is a lightweight desktop application for managing Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL) distributions, built with Tauri, React, and TypeScript. It features a real-time dashboard, quick actions (terminal, file explorer, IDE), multi-source installation (Microsoft Store, Docker images, LXC catalog), backup/restore, custom commands, visual WSL configuration editing, 17 themes, system tray, and disk mounting. Supports 14 languages and is licensed under GPL-3.0.

metadata.name: graphify
metadata.description: AI coding assistant skill (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more). Turn any folder of code, SQL schemas, R scripts, shell scripts, docs, papers, images, or videos into a queryable knowledge graph. App code + database schema + infrastructure in one graph.

summary.zh: Graphify 是一款 AI 编程助手技能，能将代码、SQL 模式、文档、图片、视频等任意文件夹转化为可查询的知识图谱。支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等主流 AI 编码工具，实现应用代码、数据库模式与基础设施的统一图谱化查询，显著提升大型项目的理解与导航效率。
summary.en: Graphify is an AI coding assistant skill that transforms any folder of code, SQL schemas, documents, images, or videos into a queryable knowledge graph. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other AI coding tools, enabling unified graph-based querying of application code, database schemas, and infrastructure for improved project understanding and navigation.

metadata.name: LDStatusPro
metadata.description: 一款功能强大的 Linux.do 社区增强工具以及相关综合服务开源项目。包含油猴脚本、LDStatusPro官网源码、士多商店前端源码等。

summary.zh: LDStatusPro 是一款专为 Linux.do 和 IDCFlare 社区设计的增强工具，提供信任级别追踪、阅读统计、云同步、排行榜及 LD 士多入口等核心功能。采用油猴脚本实现，支持全平台响应式设计，注重隐私与安全，通过 OAuth 认证和本地存储保障数据安全。
summary.en: LDStatusPro is a powerful enhancement tool for Linux.do and IDCFlare communities, featuring trust level tracking, reading statistics, cloud sync, leaderboards, and LD Store access. Implemented as a Tampermonkey script with responsive design across all platforms, it prioritizes privacy and security through OAuth authentication and local storage.

metadata.name: graphify
metadata.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.

summary.zh: Graphify 是一个 AI 编码助手技能，可将任何代码、SQL 模式、脚本、文档、图片或视频文件夹转换为可查询的知识图谱。它支持 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等多种 AI 助手。核心亮点：使用 tree-sitter AST 进行本地代码解析（无 LLM，数据不离开机器），文档/图片/视频使用助手模型进行语义处理。每条边都标记为 EXTRACTED（显式）或 INFERRED（推断），透明可追溯。不是向量索引，而是真正的知识图谱。
summary.en: Graphify is an AI coding assistant skill that turns any folder of code, SQL schemas, scripts, docs, images, or videos into a queryable knowledge graph. It works with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more. Key highlights: local code parsing via tree-sitter AST (no LLM, data stays on machine), semantic pass for docs/images/videos using assistant's model. Every edge is tagged EXTRACTED or INFERRED for transparency. Not a vector index, but a real knowledge graph.

metadata.name: fluxdo
metadata.description: 一个 Linux.do 第三方客户端

summary.zh: FluxDO 是 Linux.do 社区的第三方客户端，基于 Flutter 跨平台框架开发，支持 Android、iOS、Windows、macOS、Linux。采用 Material Design 3 设计，集成 Rust 实现的 DOH 代理保障网络安全，提供完整论坛功能、Markdown 编辑、实时通知等特性。
summary.en: FluxDO is a third-party client for the Linux.do community, built with Flutter for cross-platform support (Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux). It features Material Design 3, a Rust-based DOH proxy for secure DNS, complete forum functionalities, Markdown editor, and real-time notifications.

metadata.name: what-to-eat
metadata.description: 一饭封神：一个基于 AI 的智能菜谱生成平台，支持中华八大菜系 + 国际料理，提供营养分析、酒水推荐、菜谱效果图生成等全方位烹饪指导。

summary.zh: 基于AI的智能菜谱生成平台，覆盖中华八大菜系与国际料理，提供营养分析、酒水搭配、AI效果图生成等全方位烹饪指导。采用Vue3+TypeScript+Tailwind构建，支持动态配置AI模型参数，可灵活切换多种服务商，实现个性化菜谱创作。
summary.en: An AI-powered recipe generation platform covering Chinese eight major cuisines and international dishes, offering nutrition analysis, wine pairing, AI image generation, and comprehensive cooking guidance. Built with Vue3+TypeScript+Tailwind, it supports dynamic AI model configuration for flexible multi-provider switching and personalized recipe creation.

metadata.name: CF-EMBY-PROXY-UI
metadata.description: 一个单文件 worker.js 项目：统一多台 Emby 节点入口、隐藏源站 IP、支持直连/反代混合策略、提供 /admin 可视化后台，并集成日志、Cloudflare 统计、Telegram 日报与多层缓存优化。【下面展示链接的访问密码为123】

summary.zh: 基于Cloudflare Workers的单文件Emby/Jellyfin代理与可视化管理面板，统一多节点入口、隐藏源站IP，支持直连/反代混合策略，集成/admin后台、日志、统计、Telegram日报及多层缓存优化。
summary.en: A single-file Cloudflare Workers project for Emby/Jellyfin proxy and visual management. It unifies multi-node entry, hides origin IP, supports direct/reverse proxy hybrid strategy, and integrates /admin panel, logging, analytics, Telegram daily report, and multi-layer cache optimization.

metadata.name: codex
metadata.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal

summary.zh: Codex CLI 是 OpenAI 推出的轻量级终端编码代理，支持本地运行，可通过 ChatGPT 订阅或 API 密钥使用。提供跨平台安装方式（curl、npm、Homebrew），集成到终端工作流，实现代码生成、调试等 AI 辅助编程功能。
summary.en: Codex CLI is a lightweight coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally in your terminal. It supports ChatGPT plan integration or API key authentication, with cross-platform installation via curl, npm, or Homebrew. Designed for AI-assisted coding, code generation, and debugging directly in the terminal.

metadata.name: drawnix
metadata.description: 开源白板工具（SaaS），一体化白板，包含思维导图、流程图、自由画等。All in one open-source whiteboard tool with mind, flowchart, freehand and etc.

summary.zh: Drawnix 是一款开源一体化白板工具，集成思维导图、流程图、自由画等功能。基于插件架构，支持 Angular/React 多 UI 框架，底层依赖 Plait 画图框架和 Slate 富文本框架。特性包括免费开源、无限画布、自动保存、导出 PNG/JSON、Mermaid 转流程图、Markdown 转思维导图等。适用于团队协作、知识管理、创意设计等场景。
summary.en: Drawnix is an open-source all-in-one whiteboard tool integrating mind maps, flowcharts, and freehand drawing. Built on a plugin architecture supporting Angular/React, it leverages the Plait drawing framework and Slate rich-text framework. Features include free and open-source, infinite canvas, auto-save, export to PNG/JSON, Mermaid-to-flowchart, Markdown-to-mindmap conversion. Ideal for team collaboration, knowledge management, and creative design.

metadata.name: onlyoffice-web-comp
metadata.description: A component based on OnlyOffice (v9) for viewing, editing, and converting documents entirely on the user's device, no backend required.基于 OnlyOffice (v9) 的纯前端组件，封装文档查看、编辑、转换功能，全在用户设备本地运行，无需后端，即插即用

summary.zh: 基于OnlyOffice v9的纯前端文档组件，支持Word/Excel/PPT的查看、编辑与转换，所有操作在用户设备本地完成，无需后端服务器。提供可复用的Web编辑器封装、多实例隔离、只读/编辑切换、主题语言配置等工程化API，并支持通过Connector调用编辑器自动化接口。
summary.en: A browser-only document solution built on OnlyOffice v9 static SDK. View, edit, and convert Word/Excel/PPT entirely on the client without any backend. Provides reusable editor wrapper, multi-instance isolation, read-only/edit toggle, theme/language config, and Connector for Automation API calls.

metadata.name: OmniBot
metadata.description: Your on-phone / mobile AI Agent / Claw, capable of operating terminals and performing a wide range of tasks in the Android world || 你的手机 AI 代理，她可以操作终端，也可以完成 Android 世界的广泛任务

summary.zh: OpenOmniBot是一款运行在Android设备上的AI代理应用，采用原生Kotlin与Flutter构建。它超越传统对话，实现“理解-决策-执行-反思”的完整闭环。核心能力包括可扩展工具生态（技能、Alpine环境、浏览器、MCP及系统级工具）、系统级操作（定时任务、闹钟、日历管理、音频控制）、记忆系统（短期/长期记忆与嵌入支持）以及生产力工具（文件读写、工作区浏览、终端访问）。适用于移动端自动化、个人助理、任务调度等场景。
summary.en: OpenOmniBot is an on-device AI agent for Android, built with native Kotlin and Flutter. It goes beyond chat to implement a full loop of understand-decide-execute-reflect. Core features include an extensible tool ecosystem (skills, Alpine environment, browser, MCP, system-level tools), system-level actions (scheduled tasks, alarms, calendar, audio control), memory system (short/long-term with embedding), and productivity tools (file I/O, workspace, terminal). Ideal for mobile automation, personal assistant, and task scheduling.

metadata.name: dbx
metadata.description: 20 MB lightweight cross-platform database client for 90+ databases, including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB, DuckDB, SQL Server, and Dameng. Built-in AI, MCP Server, CLI, desktop and Docker. | 轻量级跨平台数据库管理工具，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite、Redis、MongoDB、达梦等 90+ 数据库，提供桌面端、Docker、CLI、内置 AI 助手和 MCP Server。

summary.zh: DBX 是一款仅 20MB 的轻量级跨平台数据库客户端，支持 70+ 种数据库（包括 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite、Redis、MongoDB、DuckDB、SQL Server、达梦等）。提供桌面端、Docker、CLI 多种部署方式，内置 AI 助手和 MCP Server，实现高效数据库管理与智能交互。
summary.en: DBX is a lightweight cross-platform database client (20 MB) supporting 70+ databases including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB, DuckDB, SQL Server, and Dameng. It offers desktop, Docker, and CLI deployments, with built-in AI assistant and MCP Server for efficient database management and intelligent interaction.

metadata.name: LiveAgent
metadata.description: A fully functional AI Agent desktop client that supports Webui access and can be creatively customized and expanded!

summary.zh: LiveAgent 是一款本地优先的 AI 代理桌面客户端，支持 WebUI 访问。它深度融合大语言模型推理与本地系统工具，实现文件读写、命令执行、定时任务等真实操作，并通过远程网关支持协作。基于 Tauri 2 + React 19 + Rust + Go 构建，提供多模型接入、MCP 与技能生态系统。
summary.en: LiveAgent is a local-first AI agent desktop client with WebUI access. It deeply integrates LLM reasoning with local system tools for file operations, command execution, and scheduled tasks, while enabling remote collaboration via Gateway. Built with Tauri 2 + React 19 + Rust + Go, it supports multi-model access, MCP, and skills ecosystem.

metadata.name: flowable-engine
metadata.description: A compact and highly efficient workflow and Business Process Management (BPM) platform for developers, system admins and business users.

summary.zh: Flowable 是一个轻量级、高性能的工作流与业务流程管理（BPM）平台，专为开发者、系统管理员和业务用户设计。它提供了基于 Java 的 BPMN 流程引擎、CMMN 案例引擎和 DMN 规则引擎，支持嵌入 Java 应用、服务器、集群或云端部署，完美集成 Spring，并提供丰富的 Java 和 REST API。
summary.en: Flowable is a compact and highly efficient workflow and Business Process Management (BPM) platform for developers, system admins, and business users. It features lightning-fast BPMN process engine, CMMN case engine, and DMN rule engine written in Java, supporting embedded, server, cluster, and cloud deployments with seamless Spring integration and rich Java/REST APIs.

metadata.name: fastctx
metadata.description: Fast, context-efficient repository tools for AI agents (MCP)

summary.zh: FastCtx 是一个基于 Rust 的高效仓库工具运行时，通过 MCP 协议为 AI 代理提供文件读取、内容搜索、批量替换和 Bash 命令执行等结构化操作。它减少了模型在工具调用上的开销，提升上下文效率，支持 ChatGPT 和 Codex CLI 等客户端。
summary.en: FastCtx is a Rust-based runtime that provides structured repository tools for AI agents via MCP, including file reading, content search, batch replacement, and Bash execution. It reduces tool overhead, improves context efficiency, and supports ChatGPT and Codex CLI clients.

metadata.name: gemini-notebook-mcp-cli
metadata.description: Programmatic access to Gemini Notebook - via command-line interface (CLI), Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and AI agent skills.

summary.zh: 为Gemini Notebook（原Google NotebookLM）提供程序化访问的CLI工具和MCP服务器，支持通过命令行或AI代理进行笔记本管理、源添加、音频生成与下载，以及公开分享。技术亮点包括全功能CLI、MCP协议集成、AI技能支持，适用于自动化工作流和AI助手集成。
summary.en: A CLI tool and MCP server providing programmatic access to Gemini Notebook (formerly Google NotebookLM). Enables notebook management, source addition, audio generation/download, and public sharing via command line or AI agents. Key features include full CLI functionality, MCP protocol integration, and AI skill support for automation and AI assistant integration.

metadata.name: beidou-grid-location-codec
metadata.description: 北斗网格位置码的编码解码器

summary.zh: 中文摘要
summary.en: English summary

metadata.name: ChaiChaiEmbyTV
metadata.description: Emby Android TV 客户端

summary.zh: ChaiChaiEmbyTV 是一款专为 Android TV 设计的 Emby 客户端，核心亮点是支持弹幕功能。它通过 Jetpack Compose 构建原生 TV 界面，集成快手 AkDanmaku 弹幕引擎，可配置多个弹幕 API 实现自动匹配与手动搜索。支持倍速播放、多音轨/字幕切换、外挂字幕延迟调整、播放进度同步、多服务器管理及扫码配置。技术栈包括 AndroidX Media3、FFmpeg 扩展、MVVM 架构等。
summary.en: ChaiChaiEmbyTV is an Emby client tailored for Android TV, featuring danmaku (bullet comments) support. Built with Jetpack Compose, it integrates Kuaishou's AkDanmaku engine for configurable danmaku APIs. It offers native TV navigation, speed control, multi-track switching, subtitle delay adjustment, playback progress sync, multi-server management, and QR code setup. Tech stack includes AndroidX Media3, FFmpeg extensions, MVVM, etc.

metadata.name: moke
metadata.description: Native SSH / mosh terminal for Android — multi-session, mosh roaming, full-screen TUIs like vim and Claude Code. Android 原生 SSH / mosh 终端——多会话、mosh 漫游、流畅跑 vim / Claude Code 等全屏 TUI。

summary.zh: Moke（墨客）是一款Android原生SSH/mosh终端应用，基于Kotlin和Jetpack Compose构建。它支持多会话管理、mosh UDP漫游、全屏TUI（如vim和Claude Code）流畅运行，并集成tmux面板、加密凭据存储、双行扩展键及中英文界面。采用Termux的终端渲染引擎，提供丰富的配色和字体管理。
summary.en: Moke is a native SSH/mosh terminal for Android, built with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. It features multi-session management, mosh UDP roaming, smooth full-screen TUI support (vim, Claude Code), a tmux panel, encrypted credential storage via Android Keystore, dual-row extra keys, and bilingual UI. It leverages Termux's terminal rendering engine and offers extensive color schemes and font management.

metadata.name: mediamtx
metadata.description: Ready-to-use Media-over-QUIC / SRT / WebRTC / RTSP / RTMP / LL-HLS / MPEG-TS / RTP live media server and media proxy that allows to read, publish, proxy, record and playback real-time video and audio streams.

summary.zh: MediaMTX 是一个零依赖的实时媒体服务器和代理，支持 QUIC、SRT、WebRTC、RTSP、RTMP、HLS 等多种协议。它作为媒体路由器，高效地实现流媒体发布、读取、转发、录制和回放，并支持热重载、认证、监控和 API 控制，适用于直播、监控和视频分发等场景。
summary.en: MediaMTX is a zero-dependency live media server and proxy supporting QUIC, SRT, WebRTC, RTSP, RTMP, HLS, and more. It acts as a media router for efficient publishing, reading, forwarding, recording, and playback of streams, with hot reloading, authentication, monitoring, and API control, ideal for live streaming, surveillance, and video distribution.

summary.zh: Mini Todo 是一款基于 Tauri 2 + Vue 3 + TypeScript 的跨平台桌面待办管理应用，支持列表与四象限视图、子任务、Markdown 编辑、拖拽排序及日历功能。通过 WebDAV 协议实现云同步，兼容坚果云、NextCloud，支持 Gzip 压缩与冲突检测。采用 Rust 后端与 SQLite 本地存储，提供云端 API 供 AI 集成。
summary.en: Mini Todo is a cross-platform desktop todo app built with Tauri 2, Vue 3, and TypeScript. It features list and quadrant views, subtasks, Markdown editing, drag-and-drop sorting, and a calendar with lunar dates and holidays. Cloud sync via WebDAV (compatible with Nutstore, NextCloud) includes Gzip compression and conflict resolution. The Rust backend uses SQLite for local storage and offers a cloud API for AI integration.

metadata.name: wsl-dashboard
metadata.description: A GUI manager for WSL featuring a modern UI — a lightweight, low‑memory, high‑performance dashboard to manage WSL instances.  Install, list, start, stop, unregister, and configure your WSL distros​ from one place.

summary.zh: 基于 Rust 和 Slint 构建的轻量级 WSL 实例管理仪表盘，提供现代化原生 UI 和低内存占用。支持多语言界面，可高效管理 WSL 发行版，性能卓越且资源消耗极低。
summary.en: A lightweight, high-performance GUI dashboard for managing WSL instances, built with Rust and Slint. Features a modern native UI, low memory footprint, and multilingual support for efficient WSL distribution management.

metadata.name: fast-note-sync-service
metadata.description: High-performance, low-latency note synchronization, online management, and remote REST API service platform.

summary.zh: 基于Golang+WebSocket+React构建的高性能笔记同步与在线管理平台，支持毫秒级实时变更分发、REST API、MCP协议集成及附件分块同步，专为Obsidian生态设计，提供自托管解决方案。
summary.en: A high-performance note sync and management platform built with Golang+WebSocket+React, featuring millisecond-level real-time change distribution, REST API, MCP protocol integration, and chunked attachment sync, designed for the Obsidian ecosystem as a self-hosted solution.

metadata.name: WSA-Script
metadata.description: Integrate Magisk root and Google Apps into WSA (Windows Subsystem for Android) with GitHub Actions

summary.zh: 该项目通过GitHub Actions自动化构建集成Magisk root和Google Apps的Windows Subsystem for Android（WSA）包，提供稳定版和预览版下载，并支持用户通过Issue触发自定义构建。核心价值在于简化WSA的增强流程，无需手动集成，适合开发者和高级用户。
summary.en: This project automates the build of Windows Subsystem for Android (WSA) packages with Magisk root and Google Apps via GitHub Actions, offering stable and preview builds, and allowing custom builds through issue-triggered workflows. It simplifies enhancing WSA, targeting developers and power users.

metadata.name: MrRSS
metadata.description: A modern, cross-platform, and free AI RSS reader. 一个现代化、跨平台且免费的 AI RSS 阅读器.

summary.zh: MrRSS 是一款现代化、跨平台且免费的 AI RSS 阅读器，基于 Go、Wails 和 Vue.js 构建。它提供自动翻译与摘要、AI 增强功能（如推荐和技能操作）、丰富的插件生态（支持 Obsidian、Notion、FreshRSS 等），并支持多种订阅方式（URL、XPath、脚本、新闻通讯）及自定义自动化脚本，旨在提升信息获取效率。
summary.en: MrRSS is a modern, cross-platform, and free AI-powered RSS reader built with Go, Wails, and Vue.js. It offers auto-translation and summarization, AI-enhanced features like recommendations and skill-based operations, a rich plugin ecosystem (Obsidian, Notion, FreshRSS, etc.), diverse subscription methods (URL, XPath, scripts, newsletters), and custom automation scripts for efficient information consumption.

metadata.name: skills
metadata.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.

summary.zh: 该仓库提供一套面向真实工程实践的AI代理技能集，源自作者日常开发经验。技能设计为轻量、可组合、可定制，支持Claude Code、Codex等主流编码代理。通过插件或命令行快速安装，并配置问题追踪器、标签等。强调工程控制而非“vibe coding”，帮助开发者精准对齐需求并提升代理执行质量。
summary.en: A collection of AI agent skills for real engineering, curated from the author's daily workflow. These skills are lightweight, composable, and adaptable, working with any model like Claude Code or Codex. Install via plugin or CLI, then configure issue trackers and labels. Focused on engineering control over vibe coding, they reduce misalignment and improve agent reliability.

metadata.name: tick-stock-panel
metadata.description: TSP自托管、零运维的 A 股「选股 + 监控 + 回测」量化工作台  | LLM能力驱使策略定制+个股分析+复盘 | 自由接入第三方数据源与个性化扩展数据 | 个人开源 ,非第三方官方项目

summary.zh: TSP是一款自托管、零运维的A股量化工作台，集成选股、监控与回测功能。基于Polars实现毫秒级全市场扫描，支持25+内置策略及LLM辅助策略定制。采用插件化数据源架构，可自由接入第三方数据，提供异动监控、连板梯队、AI四维个股分析等特色功能，适合量化研究者本地部署。
summary.en: TSP is a self-hosted, zero-maintenance quantitative workbench for A-shares, integrating stock screening, monitoring, and backtesting. Powered by Polars for millisecond full-market scans, it supports 25+ built-in strategies and LLM-assisted customization. With a plugin-based data source architecture, it allows flexible third-party data integration and features anomaly alerts, limit-up ladder tracking, and AI-driven stock analysis.

metadata.name: search-skills
metadata.description: skills for deep search — multi-source search, content extraction, and structured research reports.

summary.zh: 提供多源并行搜索、意图感知检索、链式引用追踪与高保真内容提取的生产级Skills，支持Brave/Exa/Tavily/Grok四源融合，自动降级MinerU处理反爬页面，适用于深度调研与结构化报告生成。
summary.en: Production-grade skills for multi-source search, intent-aware retrieval, chain-of-citation tracking, and high-fidelity content extraction. Integrates Brave, Exa, Tavily, and Grok with automatic MinerU fallback for anti-scraping pages, enabling deep research and structured report generation.

metadata.name: istoreos
metadata.description: 提供一个人人会用的的路由、NAS系统 （目前活跃的分支是 istoreos-24.10，main或master分支不维护请勿使用）

summary.zh: iStoreOS 是基于 OpenWRT 的入门级路由与 NAS 系统，旨在降低使用门槛，让普通用户轻松管理网络和存储。它经过长期迭代，适配多种硬件平台，提供友好的界面和易用的功能，适合家庭和小型办公环境。
summary.en: iStoreOS is an entry-level router and NAS system based on OpenWRT, designed to lower the barrier for ordinary users to manage networks and storage. It has been iterated over time, adapted to multiple hardware platforms, and offers a user-friendly interface for home and small office use.

metadata.name: Lithe-IDEA
metadata.description: A lightweight, cross-platform IDE for the AI era, with on-demand tools and services.

summary.zh: Lithe是一款面向AI时代的轻量级跨平台IDE，专为Java和Spring Boot开发者设计，内存占用仅300-400MB。它提供代码浏览、导航、Maven管理、调试、Git diff审查、数据库等核心功能，语言服务器和工具按需启动，帮助开发者理解、运行和审查AI生成的代码。
summary.en: Lithe is a lightweight cross-platform IDE for the AI era, built for Java and Spring Boot developers with a baseline memory footprint of 300-400MB. It offers core workflows like code browsing, navigation, Maven management, debugging, Git diff review, and database tools, with on-demand language servers and services to help developers understand, run, and review AI-generated code.

metadata.name: AstroBox-NG
metadata.description: A Rust-powered, highly extensible and portable toolbox for wearables, focused on installing and managing third-party apps on your device.

summary.zh: AstroBox-NG 是一款基于 Rust 与 Tauri 构建的跨平台可穿戴设备工具箱，专注于第三方应用的安装、调试与分发。它实现了全球首个多平台经典蓝牙 SPP 通信，并深度还原小米穿戴设备协议栈，支持通过 WASI 插件系统扩展功能，覆盖 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 等平台。
summary.en: AstroBox-NG is a Rust and Tauri-based cross-platform toolbox for wearables, focusing on installing, debugging, and distributing third-party apps. It achieves the world's first multi-platform classic Bluetooth SPP communication, deeply reverse-engineers Xiaomi wearable protocol stacks, and supports WASI-driven plugins, running on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.

metadata.name: AstroBoxSkills
metadata.description: AstroBox相关skills

summary.zh: AstroBox Skills 是为 AstroBox 生态系统打造的技能集合，涵盖 CLI 自动化、设备管理、社区 Wiki 导航与技术支持。通过官方 CLI 控制设备、搜索安装表盘应用、排查故障，并提供 BandBBS Wiki 索引，助力小米穿戴设备用户快速获取教程与固件资源。
summary.en: AstroBox Skills is a collection of skills for the AstroBox ecosystem, covering CLI automation, device management, community wiki navigation, and support. It enables device control via the official CLI, searching/installing watchfaces and apps, troubleshooting, and provides BandBBS Wiki indexing for Xiaomi wearable users.

metadata.name: QuickClipboard
metadata.description: QuickClipboard 是一款跨平台剪贴板增强工具（现支持Windows，Android），基于 Tauri 2 + Rust + React 构建。它在你复制的那一刻就开始工作——自动记录文本、图片、富文本、文件，让你随时找回曾经复制过的任何内容。不只是记录，QuickClipboard 还集成了贴图、OCR、局域网同步等能力，是日常办公效率的全面提升

summary.zh: QuickClipboard 是一款基于 Tauri 2 + Rust + React 的跨平台剪贴板增强工具，支持 Windows 和 Android。它自动记录文本、图片、富文本和文件，提供智能去重、搜索筛选、快速粘贴、收藏分组、贴图、OCR 识别、WebDAV 与局域网同步等功能。低内存占用（后台约 50MB，轻量模式约 10MB），支持主题定制和系统集成，显著提升办公效率。
summary.en: QuickClipboard is a cross-platform clipboard enhancement tool built with Tauri 2, Rust, and React, supporting Windows and Android. It automatically captures text, images, rich text, and files, offering smart deduplication, search/filter, quick paste, favorites, screen pinning, OCR, WebDAV and LAN sync. With low memory usage (~50MB background, ~10MB lightweight mode), customizable themes, and deep system integration, it significantly boosts productivity.

metadata.name: paseo-plugins
metadata.description: Paseo plugins, including Sub2API usage monitoring

summary.zh: Paseo 插件仓库，以独立 npm 项目维护。首个插件 sub2api-usage 在 Paseo 界面中展示 Sub2API 账户的使用量、配额、速率限制、Token 统计和费用，帮助用户实时监控 API 消耗。插件独立安装，无工作区依赖，支持本地开发。
summary.en: A repository of Paseo plugins maintained as independent npm projects. The first plugin, sub2api-usage, displays Sub2API account usage, quotas, rate limits, token statistics, and cost within Paseo, enabling real-time API consumption monitoring. Plugins are installed individually without workspace hoisting, supporting local development.

summary.zh: SkillUI 是一款命令行工具，通过纯静态分析（无需 AI 或 API 密钥）逆向工程任意网站、代码仓库或本地项目的设计系统，提取颜色、字体、间距、动画、组件等设计令牌，并自动生成 Claude Code 可直接读取的 SKILL.md 和 CLAUDE.md 文件，帮助开发者快速复刻目标 UI 风格。
summary.en: SkillUI is a CLI that reverse-engineers any website, repo, or local codebase into a Claude-ready skill via pure static analysis—no AI or API keys required. It extracts design tokens like colors, typography, spacing, animations, and components, then auto-generates SKILL.md and CLAUDE.md for seamless integration with Claude Code.
